ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a83_K: After the fall of White Gold Tower, his friend Morihaus the Indomitable found Pelinal's still-living head, kept alive in torment by Ayleid magicks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06MentionBook_000153b6_Oblivion: After the first time Theranis was taken by the Pale Lady, he knew he was going to die.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4a7_Oblivion_RESP4: After we exchanged words, I followed them out to a farmhouse. Inside, they asked me to remove my clothes and items.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022f18_Oblivion_: After you read the book, I'll help in any way that I can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434e3_Oblivion_RES: Again the Resonator draws men near. Screw 'em! I drink to their health. Healths. Whatever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434fa_Oblivion_RES: Again the Resonator pulls men to it. But cats? No! Why? It should draw them far from here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04SheoIntro3_0008245f_Oblivion_: Again with the niggling little details! Hold your tongue. Or I will. We'll get to that, all in due time. For now, you've got other work to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e919_Obli: Again, I thank you for doing my field work. I look forward to getting more Nirnroot from you. And yes, in 24 hours, I'll have the Elixir ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13SignetNo_000335ac_Oblivion_RE: Again, I thank you on behalf of all the citizens of Cheydinhal. May Arkay guide you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MehrunesDagonTopic_0006bedb_Obliv: Against all hope, Martin cast him back into Oblivion! He will not trouble our world for long years to come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_00085712_Oblivi: Against all hope, you returned from Camoran's Paradise with the Amulet of Kings! We now have a chance to turn back Dagon's invasion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002db95_Oblivion_RESP2: Agata has heard the voices, though I speak for them all. It is to her you must now go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AgataTopic_0003395e_Oblivion_RESP: Agata is the first person I go to when I need something. Maybe I should talk to Dagail instead, but I just don't feel comfortable doing that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c456c_Oblivion_RESP1: Aggh! I hate these disgusting Arena matches! I'm here looking for my husband, Roderick! If he loses any more of our money he's a dead man...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Yield_0002da1c_Oblivion_RESP1: Aggh! Not yet! You must wait until Hides-His-Heart gets here! You must cut me with the knife in his presence, so he thinks you've killed me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028166_Oblivion_RESP1: Aggh! They're dead! All dead! And you... you're the only one left. It's you! Oh, gracious, no! Stay away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028167_Oblivion_RESP1: Aggh! They're dead! All of them, dead! Why? What's going on here? We need to get out of this place!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Yield_0002d395_Oblivion_RESP1: Aggh! What are you doing? No, no... you must use the POISONED blade!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_00073008_Oblivion_RESP1: Agh! No! I can't take much more of this!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_0008ef76_Oblivion_RESP1: Agh! They're getting the best of me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff6_Oblivion_RESP3: Agronak gro-Malog is the best fighter ever to step into an Arena. He can't be beaten! Not by you! But if you want to fight him, that's your right...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff7_Oblivion_RESP2: Agronak gro-Malog is the best fighter ever to step into an Arena. He can't be beaten! Not by you! But if you want to fight him, that's your right...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007b479_Oblivion_RES: Agronak is good, yeah. Too good. He says he's only half Orc. What I want to know is, what's the other half? Cause it sure ain't human...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_00038b37_Obliv: Agronak will be wearing his Raiment of Valor, and he's probably got it heavily enchanted, so feel free to do the same to any armor you have.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09VictimChoice5a_00082097_Obliv: Ah ah ah... There is no turning back, now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Catch_0006d604_Oblivion_RESP3: Ah well, it's been a good life I suppose....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018afdf_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah well, perhaps you can return to help another time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028cde_Oblivion: Ah yes, Dovesi Dran. She's a Dark Elf, originally from Morrowind, or so I hear. I get the sense she doesn't like me very much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BThadon_00016ea8_Oblivion_RES: Ah yes, and what of our Duke of Mania?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000343e7_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah yes, the Mythic Dawn scholar. What else can I help you with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028b7d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah yes, the sixth guest. I'm Neville. It's nice to make your acquaintance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05FinChoice1A_0002f880_Oblivi: Ah yes, there is one more thing. The Imperial City is also home to an Imperial Legion captain named Adamus Phillida. Do you know who that is?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaA_00022b41_Oblivion_R: Ah yes. "Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes," wonderful! You have a scholarly interest in daedric cults, then?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b18: Ah yes. The Gauntlets have been here for ages. I know only the basic story behind them; they're more of a novelty these days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003357f_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah! Cheydinhal... it's good to see its walls again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice2A_0004f229_Oblivion_RE: Ah! How brave of you, to walk the roads with all of the recent trouble!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity1_00043417_Oblivion_RES: Ah! How deliciously odd! I've never seen a Blind Watcher's Eye before. It will have a place of honor in the Museum.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27UmbacanoC1_000a6582_Oblivion_: Ah! Magnificent! This is my greatest prize yet!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SERunsInCirclesGreetC_0004120a_Ob: Ah! My favorite! You're a good friend, you know that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e82_Oblivion_RESP2: Ah! No, I've got it. You're going to find the fellow trading on my name. Good show - carry on. *hic*
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueShow_00085991_Oblivion_: Ah! One of the Ten Ancestors! Hold it up to the light ... yes! Exquisite! You did the right thing by bringing this to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11WhatNow_00022e1e_Oblivion_RES: Ah! Still thinking about your reward, eh? I have not forgotten you or your loyal service to the Thieves Guild. You'll just have to trust me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02GiveItem_000165f3_Oblivion_RE: Ah! The Gray Fox will be very pleased. We will make sure this gets back to the people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007e963_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah! The classic fire trap. Always a favorite, especially in the colder months.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06StelaGreetA1_00018f92_Oblivio: Ah! You are just in time. Go quickly. The Aureals may attack at any moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018baa4_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah! You must be the Arcane University's newest addition! This humble Battlemage bids you welcome!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e02_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, Assassin, I must speak with you. It is quite urgent. A sealed letter just arrived from a Dark Brotherhood courier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactA_00026d6b_Oblivion_R: Ah, Azura's Star .. as beautiful as all the tales tell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d7_Oblivion_RES: Ah, Chorrol. Easy access to all the other cities of Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirBeginChoice1_000805ed_O: Ah, I do appreciate an assertive leader. I look forward to working with you on this assignment. Lead the way, Grand Inquisitor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice3A_00022ba2_Oblivion_: Ah, I find your etiquette refreshing. Now please, listen carefully. On the Green Road to the north of Bravil lies the Inn of Ill Omen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040361_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, I see you've been successful in the Fringe. How can I assist you, Your Grace?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002ae09_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, I sense a gambling man!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002ae0a_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, I sense a woman of chance!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00061c3e_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, I'm glad you came. So, are you interested in earning some loot?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c4529_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, I'm sure you've come to pay homage to the greatest fighting force to grace the lands of Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA1_00012cca_Oblivio: Ah, Mirel's beloved surprise attack. A perfect example of why males do not hold command positions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47MageShopTalk_00030132_Oblivio: Ah, a fellow mage! Please excuse my rudeness earlier. I find most people extremely tedious. Completely ignorant of the arcane.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueGive_0002b525_Oblivion_: Ah, a second Ancestor. Excellent. I had wondered whether the first was just luck, but I see now that you have some skill at this work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000411fa_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, a stranger in town. But as I always say, a stranger is just a friend I haven't met yet!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasPhintiasA_00022b52_Obli: Ah, about that. You see ... I don't have it any more. Terribly sorry. A full refund, of course...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk5_0003405b_Oblivion_R: Ah, all right then. I guess I should get back to my duties. I should be around later. We'll talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a999_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, another happy spectator! You of course want to bet on a fight! Who will it be this time, the Blue Team or the Yellow Team?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b359_Oblivion_RESP3: Ah, but I believe I owe you something, eh? Here, let me show you these moves. Step like this... Now strike.... All right, now parry... That's it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e6b_Oblivion: Ah, but more to the point, it appears to me that the first words of each paragraph may be significant. A message may be hidden there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034861_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, child. I thank you for helping me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251da_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, dear friend, may I steal a moment of your time? I have a rather delicate situation I was hoping you could help me with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028a04_Obli: Ah, don't let the name fool you. I had a bit too much mead a few years back, and there was this tavern wench.... Anyway, just call me Nels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaBetChoice1A_0001e666_Oblivio: Ah, excellent! I knew you were the gambling type! Well, you can bet on the Yellow Team or the Blue Team.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodgrassTopic_00053737_Oblivion: Ah, excellent. I hope getting it wasn't too much trouble for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BribeBeggar_00015f1b_Oblivion: Ah, fresh bread tonight! The Moth Priests live in the Imperial Palace. I don't know exactly what they do. Something to do with the Elder Scrolls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, greetings. I have been waiting for you. As Vicente surely told you, your time working with him has come to an end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035597_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, have you reconsidered my offer? Do you wish to eliminate that treasonous Shadowscale for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12Talk_0007be92_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, here you are! I have good news, of a sort.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002526a_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, here you are. So good to finally meet you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cca_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, how quaint. How do you do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040364_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, is Your Grace having difficulty with his choices?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas1_00002c46_Knights_RE: Ah, it was a terrible fight. Many an Auroran fell beneath my blade that day. But the Crusader -- he clove through their ranks like a scythe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07BeggarPay_00020093_Oblivion_R: Ah, it's coming back to me now. Yeah, seems I saw someone looking out the window at Jearl's house the other day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006fdc4_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, it's good to see you, citizen! Oh yes, I know who you are. You've become something of a legend in these parts!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadCarodus1_00002cf7_Knigh: Ah, it's nothing... I was thinking of Sir Carodus, actually. He was such a fine knight... how can he be dead? How could the gods let that happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_0001ceec_Obli: Ah, it's times like this I enjoy what I do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b730_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, it's you! You're the one... err... who are you again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003431_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, it's you. I figured you'd be by soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003013c_Oblivion_RESP3: Ah, me... Friend, you are welcome at the Aleswell Inn anytime. Free of charge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkVampChoice1_0004ce45_Oblivion: Ah, most excellent! Here is what you must do. Simply go to sleep here in the Sanctuary, at any time, and I will visit you as you slumber.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d7e3_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, my dear friend. It is so good to see you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00050a9e_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, my favorite patron! Anything Odd to show me? Ha ha ha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00061568_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, my savior. Back again for a visit are we?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000c0a2_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, now this is the type of contract I live for! You must become pure shadow. It's as if you were never there, and then Roderick simply... dies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasPhintiasA_00022b51_Obli: Ah, of course. Here you go. Keep us in mind for any future needs!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Reward_0001dc32_Oblivion_RESP: Ah, of course. The gold. Here. But there is someone else I need you to investigate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039df_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, of course. You're going to succeed where three previous family members have failed. How silly of me...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark09Choice1A_00035e06_Oblivion_: Ah, one of you again, eh? You Dark Brotherhood types are all the same. All sneak and no swing! You'll meet the same fate as the others! En garde!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc50_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, so it's Bloodletter now, is it? I remember when I achieved that rank, so very long ago. I showed such promise... unlike yourself.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cd0f_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. A guild brother in search of a fence?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG00MysteriousNoteTopic_00035653_: Ah, yes. Another scoundrel who served time in an imperial jail. The Gray Fox is offering you a chance to join the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_IngredientCollection_000aef8d_Obl: Ah, yes. Arch-Mage Traven was quite fond of making potions in his spare time. So much so, in fact, that it became difficult for me to meet his needs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirGauntlets_00002b24_Kni: Ah, yes. As proof of the deed, when I struck the poor man the Gauntlets slipped right off my hands and fell to the floor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07Spies_00020075_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. I hope you can help. The gate guards have reported seeing strangers on the road for the past several nights.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002db97_Oblivion_: Ah, yes. I'm afraid I'm unable to issue a recommendation. Only Dagail can do that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recharge_0005e085_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. Let's see if we can't recharge some items for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b461_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. My treasure-hunting friend. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45ForkTopic_00083f61_Oblivion_R: Ah, yes. The Fork of Horripilation. I have heard rumors about it. It appears that Lord Sheogorath has returned it to the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_00023ff2_Oblivion_RE: Ah, yes. This is indeed the correct book. You've not been able to open it, I presume? Then all is well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_00023ff5_Oblivion_RE: Ah, yes. This is indeed the correct book. You've not been able to open it, I presume? Then all is well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice2A_000300a1_Oblivion_RE: Ah, yes. Thought so. We get many of them traveling through here. Well, we used to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022498_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, yes. You are a Guild Mage, are you not? Yet, different from the others. Yes, yes -- this is good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000167e6_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you again! A pleasure, I'm sure. No time for chatter now; I have a few important things to attend to, or did I? Ah well...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00070403_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you again. Have you seen any of Ma'zaddha's things? A shiny spoon, or a broken bottle? I can't find them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkGiftTopic_0004ce46_Oblivion_R: Ah, you are interested, then? Shall I pass along the terrible power of my Dark Gift? Do you wish to become a vampire?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003455_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you are the new thief. I am your new Doyen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc28_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you came. You're sure you weren't followed? Good, I thought I could trust you. Nobody else in town. They're all in on it ... all watching me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00053872_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you have arrived. Come now, we must speak. The Black Hand has need of your... talents.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillBodyParts_00081daa_Obl: Ah, you have been asked to choose the pieces with which to construct the new Gatekeeper. Quite an honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003925_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you must be from the Fighters Guild. Excellent! I'm looking forward to our investigation. Fascinating subject, these Daedra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b604_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you're back. I told Jauffre not to worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016cfd_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you're back. You may have noticed that we have a... bit of a problem.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e654_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you're the one who lit the Great Torch for us. Well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_heirloom_00002e5a_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah, you've got it! Thank the gods! Finally, my mead will stay cold and won't taste like goblin piss. Take these, and my thanks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillFringe_00040368_Oblivi: Ah, your task is completed. Wonderful. Our Lord Sheogorath may wish to hear of your success. Perhaps you should tell Him yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RebuildRequest_0001356d_Obliv: Ah, your tone is more in line with my station. Please, continue.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c224_Oblivion_RES: Ah-Malz at the Fighters Guild has gotten to be an expert on goblin hunting. He just hates the things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038aba_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah-Malz of the Fighters Guild. Welcome to Skingrad County. Come hunting goblins, have you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06JauffreB_0008b617_Oblivion_RE: Ah. Good. You should take that to Martin right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10JaksDiarySays_00015313_Oblivi: Ah. It seems you have stumbled over a bit of history that few in the Thieves Guild ever discover. I am not the first Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah. S'krivva hears of you. Welcome, and well-fare in your craft and trade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AuthorityMyOwn_0001356b_Obliv: Ah. That confirms it. You're the new Duke. The stink of hubris surrounds you! My Lord allows you to lick his boot straps, does he?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c099d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah. You must be the one I got the message about. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RobeConv03_0005508c_Oblivion_: Ah... I see you well, my friend. With all the new recruits, it is hard to be certain who is who.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SENewSheothTOPIC_00078cab_Oblivio: Ah... New Sheoth. My home away from places that aren't my home. The current location is much better than some of the prior ones. Don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon1_00028880_Oblivion_RE: Ah... a hammer. Well, it seems you don't have one. However I see that you have a longsword....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD06Weapon1_00028881_Oblivion_RE: Ah... a hammer. Well. Not my first choice, but it will suffice. Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277bc_Oblivion_R: Ah... an excellent read, though it's been a while since I've read it myself. Let me know how you like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASanguineSpeech_000b1232_Oblivio: Ah... another mortal come to beg Sanguine to add a bit of spice to an otherwise drab existence. I would have you perform a service for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b7e_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah... our Lord has granted you the power to summon me. How wonderful for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d4_Oblivion_RES: Ah... pure magic. Research. Knowledge. That's why I love the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be6b_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah... you are from the Fighters Guild, I resume. Good show. I am Lord Rugdumph gro-Shurgak. Let us conversate on the Lady Rogbut.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah... you must be from the Fighters Guild. Good. I have a problem. It has to do with the rats in my basement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImpGallTOPIC_0002ee63_Oblivion_RE: Ah... you've got it. Looks fresh, too! I realize that you'll be paid by your superior, but take this as well. It might come in handy in your work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006d17d_Oblivion_RESP1: Ah...you're here. Joy. You'll want to speak to the Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000837e9_Oblivion_RESP1: Aha! There you are. Took you long enough to get here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e6_Oblivion_RESP2: Ahdarji trains, yes. Light Armor is the skill. Ahdarji must work very hard, now she is all alone in the world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AmuseisPlot_00009332_Oblivion: Ahdarji uses ring much more wisely. I use it to collect and sell information. That ring can be used to read private messages the Count writes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000039bd_Oblivion_RESP2: Ahem. Citizen of... Skingrad. Please be advised that I am here on official business, and wish no harm...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BThadonDeathSpeech02_0007b37a: Ahem. The lady fair, our love is told. With hair as fine as soft-spun gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000131d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh yes, THERE you are! You couldn't imagine how long I've been waiting for you. So little to do, and so much time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000400db_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh! You burn with the purging Fire of Agnon, the flame of Truth, the flickering beacon of hope in the gloom of despond!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006a84b_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh, magister. I just remembered, there's something I'd like to discuss with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ce95_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh... much better. You repulse me now, at least to a degree. Others should find you foul, disgusting. Namira may be pleased. Approach the shrine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StoneofStAlessiaTOPIC_0000392a_Ob: Ahh... you've found it! I can't thank you enough. Your work is greatly appreciated. Here, take these. I wish I could give you more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028886_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahh... you've got the weapons. Let's talk about that weapons shipment you brought.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314f7_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahhh! You have returned from your investigation, and I am eager to hear the results.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscScreamingInPain_00046f67_: Ahhh!! No! No! Make it stop, make it stop! Aaayiiee!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualYesM02_00013a67_Oblivio: Ahhh, but it was. As the bacchanal reached a crescendo, the people began to clutch their chests as their very hearts exploded!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013ff9_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahhh, good to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038431_Oblivi: Ahhh, you mean that vampire hunter. He's staying over at Olav's Tap and Tack. It's near the city gates; you can't miss it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0009407f_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahhh. So good to be back home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00094ebd_Oblivion_RESP1: Ahhh... Rosentia will be so pleased!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00082601_Oblivion_RES: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc13_Oblivion_RES: Ahjazda in Crucible believes the world is ending. She seeks all sorts of items to weather the storm portending.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00082602_Oblivion_RES: Ahjazda thinks the world is ending tomorrow. She's been saving magic items just in case.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Corpse_0018d818_Oblivion_RESP1: Akatosh bless you and keep you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476fd_Oblivi: Akatosh speaks to us all, but we never listen. Go to the Temple of the One. Read the Covenants. Praise the Nine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_lightthedragonfires_000223e4_Obli: Akatosh, the Supreme God of Time, gave the Amulet of Kings to St. Alessia, the first emperor, as a god-certain test of the true heir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EulogyWoodElf_0009f9c2_Oblivion_R: Alas for the honor of Valenwood, the Wood Elf has fallen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7e_Knights: Alas that my old comrade is not among us here. We do not know why his spirit did not join us here to guard our last Relic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7d_Knights: Alas that the evil begun on the day of my death should have struck so deep!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AssistanceRequest_0001356f_Ob: Alas, I am still distraught over the destruction of my sweet child. I cannot return to his womb. You must do this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a80_K: Alas, Umaril was not truly slain, but only cast beyond the bounds of Nirn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EulogyOrc_0009f9c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Alas, poor Orc. This was not your finest hour.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d23f_Oblivion_RESP4: Alas, we are but 3 old men, not able to match the fighting prowess of the vampire. We lack the strength to defeat them in battle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreetB1_0003e6bb_Oblivion_RES: Alas, we cannot light the Flame until we take control of the Altar of Despair from the infernal Mazken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEAltarofDespairTopic_0007ff5f_Ob: Alas, we have not seen the Altar of Despair for many years. It is in the underground part of Cylarne, which is controlled by the Mazken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06FlameAgnon_000131ac_Oblivion_: Alas, we hold only the Altar of Rapture. The treacherous Mazken hold the Altar of Despair. We must control both to light the Flame.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetStartB1_00002c86_Knights: Alas. Umaril cannot be stopped. Not without the aid of the gods. Not without the Crusader's Relics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2b1_Oblivio: Aldos is living on the street now that his house has been seized. I begged Ulrich to give him more time, but he wouldn't.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10LlevanaTalk_0003c374_Oblivion: Aldos was a drunkard and a fool. He decided to draw a blade and attack a guard, so he paid the price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2a8_Oblivio: Aldos will be mourned. I won't sit by and watch the innocent being driven to the brink like that. Something must be done, but without bloodshed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c35c_Oblivion_RESP1: Aldos's death is indeed a tragedy. We'll do what we can to put his soul at ease.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AxeofDragol_0001fdb1_Oblivion_RES: Aleron never mentioned it to me before.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624a7_Oblivion_RES: Alessia Caro visits her mother in Chorrol regularly. A dutiful daughter... and a dutiful wife, I hear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechAmulet_00002d20_Kn: Alessia! Reman! Talos! They cry for blood akin to theirs to rekindle the dragonpact! Citizens, take to your knives!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046610_Oblivion_RES: Alga has a lot of good tales to tell. I wish I could tell a story like she does.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046609_Oblivion_RES: Alga sure can tell a good story. I'm not normally a big fan of bard's tales, but she's got some good ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00045c78_Oblivion_RESP1: Alive and kicking, are you? Welcome back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb1f_Oblivion_RESP3: All I ask in return is to keep the Brush's existence secret. If word gets around that I have it, I'm afraid more than a lone cutpurse will visit me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03TestQuestion_00002a54_Knights: All I can do is direct you to the Grove of Trials, and remind you to heed Kynareth's teachings: fear and respect Nature and all Her Creations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00053722_Oblivion_RESP: All I can promise is that you'll be making a lot of money. Are you in, or are you out?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pillar_00035f51_Oblivion_RESP3: All I can say for sure is that it reacts to magic. Badly, most of the time. Several mages were hurt attempting to cast spells at it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ASyl_00013a68_Oblivion_RESP1: All I can tell you is Syl is rarely seen in public, and her staff takes care of the day-to-day activities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d307_Oblivion_RESP1: All I can tell you is that the best place to start is at The Flowing Bowl. It's a tavern located outside the city walls near the waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorInfo_00083976_Oblivion_: All I care about is where the vampires are hiding. I know they're here somewhere... You know where they're holed up?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorInfo_JAWS9371_01_AltarE: All I care about is where the vampires are hiding. I know they're here somewhere... You know where they're holed up?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c2a6_Oblivi: All I did was fall down, sure. Maybe even vomited on the floor of the tavern. Charge me six times, Ulrich... charge me you fetcher??!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_000253d1_Oblivion_RES: All I heard is that she's looking for some sort of book. You'll have to talk to her if you want to know more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_0001e06b_Oblivion_RESP: All I heard was that it was important to Dagail, and it was missing. Kalthar didn't tell me anything more than that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ08Wine_0018d92d_Oblivion_RESP4: All I know about them is that they're found in the many fort ruins scattered all over Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice1_0002c5bb_Oblivion_RE: All I know for sure is that they'll accept any contract, and they'll do anything to complete it. And they don't care who gets in the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Brothers_00084a9b_Oblivion_RE: All I know is that travelling merchants found me in the wilderness by the body of my mother. I was raised by the monks at Weynon Priory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_00089618_Obl: All I know is that word has gotten around about Anya Herrick. She looks more nervous than normal lately. People think she might be up to something!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwaterBrigands_0000c1dd_Obliv: All I know is there seems to be four of them. They blindfolded me before they put me in here, so I didn't see much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9bd_Oblivion_RESP: All I need is a roof, some bread, and blessings of the Nine. Bruma is Gods' country, and the Gods are good to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5ae_Oblivion_RESP1: All I needed was that right pauldron, and my set would have been complete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArdalineTopic_0002ba5e_Oblivion_R: All I want is for her to care about me, to feel the same way as I do about her. But she doesn't.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b582_Oblivion_RESP1: All I wanted was a hug.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00035dc9_Oblivion_RESP1: All Thieves Guild members have sworn loyalty to him. If there is such a thing as a guildmaster, he's it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JanusHassildorTopic_00003998_Obli: All appointments to see the Count must be made through Hal-Luirz
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JanusHassildorTopic_000039a2_Obli: All appointments to see the Count must go through Mercator Hosidus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreatWelkyndStoneTopic_00027100_O: All but one. The Great Stone of Miscarcand is reputed still to shine in the deep darkness of its ruined halls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018ae78_Oblivion_RESP1: All citizens are welcome in the Imperial Palace, at least on the first two floors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003dfc2_Obl: All day long, stories about severed heads and lopped off limbs. I can do without it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7b_Oblivion_RESP2: All day, every day, I work them. And for what? For Cindanwe? You think I am her servant, yes? If it weren't for her magic, things would change.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000af068_Oblivion_RES: All else is put aside to celebrate of our deliverance from evil. Thanks to Akatosh and his servant Martin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MerchantTopic_0002ee50_Oblivion_R: All found dead along the same stretch of road. The only trait shared amongst them is that each had previously stayed at the Brina Cross Inn nearby.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000699fc_Oblivion_RES: All gone now, though. Just smoke and mud and rubble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025df2_Oblivion_RESP2: All guild members have been instructed to deny you service, shelter, and assistance. From now until your death, you do not exist in our eyes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018baa7_Oblivion_RESP1: All hail the Champion of Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000579bd_Oblivion_RESP1: All hail the Corrupter of Souls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e65a_Oblivion_RESP1: All hail the victor of Cylarne! All hail the Great Torch of Mania!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff13_Oblivion_RE: All he thinks about, all he cares about, is skooma! He was a fine young man once. But he's lost everything. His looks, his money... his self-respect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_000329f4_Oblivion_RESP: All he wants to do is please his father. I've known him since he was a lad, and fighting to defend Cheydinhal is in his heart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005c0bc_Oblivion_RESP1: All honor to the Ebony Blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005c0ba_Oblivion_RESP1: All honor to the Hide and the Wearer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12RootDungeon_0001a378_Oblivion: All is not well here. The Gnarls are disturbed. Order is spreading among them, and thus into the Font. Find the Pools and stop the taint of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018a954_Oblivion_RESP1: All manner of creatures infest Bramblepoint Cave, you must remain vigilant.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005d505_Oblivion_RESP1: All mortals will come to him. He is the Harvester of Souls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006039f_Oblivion_RES: All my patrons keep disappearing! It's impossible to create important art under these conditions!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005efb6_Oblivion_RES: All my work on the Fringe... wasted. I'll have to begin my research all over again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a0fb_Oblivion_RESP3: All of my attention is devoted to the Council. We must discern the reason for this sudden attack, and stop Mannimarco before he destroys us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062619_Oblivion: All of the local guild halls sell some amount of Alchemic ingredients, but for the best stuff, you'll need to do some exploring on your own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000be32a_Oblivion: All of the other cities have sent aid! It's remarkable! I've never seen such unity of purpose. Your leadership has made all the difference.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0005323c_Oblivion_: All of your recommendations have been approved, have they not? Then everything appears to be in order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AmuletofKingsTopic_00033fcc_Obliv: All practitioners of daedric magic are familiar with the almost impenetrable barrier between our world and Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05LexToMen_0000bf92_Oblivion_RE: All right men. We've been ordered back to our posts. I smell the dirty hand of the Gray Fox behind this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000852bc_Oblivion_RESP1: All right then, I guess I'd better start looking. That gold's not going to find itself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_000182cc_Oblivion_: All right, Brawler, this next match is going to be a challenge. Turns out there are two Wood Elf sisters who always fight together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01SulinusConv_0002d91d_Oblivion: All right, Erthor. You're safe now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002f1ef_Oblivion_RESP: All right, I admit it. I took it from her. I... I don't know what I was thinking, honestly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_000302d3_Oblivion_RESP: All right, I think I can help with that. But you have to agree to do something for me, first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028f4b_Obliv: All right, I'll be honest. I'm not quite sure what to think about Primo anymore. My list of suspects is getting pretty damned small as it is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00061393_Obliv: All right, I'll help you hone your technique.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00061397_Obliv: All right, I'll teach you what I know about Athletics. Maybe we can swap stories about life on the road.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017643_Oblivion_RESP1: All right, Myrmidon, time to stop messing around! You ready to teach those Yellow Team scumbags a lesson, or what?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f89_Oblivio: All right, all right. I'm tempted to let you out right now if you'll just shut up...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05AChoice1A_00028c07_Oblivion_R: All right, all right. We can deal with this. You'll have to get it back, that's all.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS18Convo_0001cb7b_Oblivion_RESP1: Antus, calm down. We'll be leaving soon enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a23_Knights_RESP: Anvil is all in an uproar. First the Chapel attacked, now the prophet ranting about the end of the world!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c8_Oblivion_RESP: Anvil wouldn't be my choice for a refit. No proper yard, neither spars nor scantlings in good supply. But, it's ill-luck to complain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0ab_Oblivion_RESP: Anvil's a port town. That's why you'll see items here you won't find in the Imperial City. The captains keep an eye out for special items for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BonusTopic_0002ff51_Oblivion_RESP: Any Brother or Sister who can complete a contract while following a specific request will receive a valuable bonus, oftentimes a powerful magic item.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Shadowscale_000251fb_Oblivion_RES: Any Shadowscale who lives to come of age is accepted into the Dark Brotherhood as a full member of the family. So it was with myself, and Ocheeva.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018bb02_Oblivion_RESP1: Any citizen who takes the time to talk to a member of the Legion is okay in my book. With all that's happened, it's good to know we're appreciated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000af05a_Oblivion_RESP1: Any friend of Martin's is a friend of mine. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023dda_Oblivion_RESP1: Any friend of the Society is a friend of mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bc5c_Oblivion_RESP1: Any friend of the Society is a friend of mine. Have a look around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0002529e_Oblivion_RESP1: Any idea what Gromm will do now that old Baenlin is dead?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Victims_00081fdc_Oblivion_RES: Any loyal servant of the Madgod would respect His decision in this matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d6e5_Oblivion_: Any luck finding Erthor yet? I'll need to speak with him before I can feel your recommendation has been earned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d92c_Oblivion_RESP1: Any luck on those bottles of Shadowbanish Wine yet?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432c7_Oblivion_RES: Any new adventurer trying to get into the Isles will have a tough time going up against the Gatekeeper.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000b2db_Oblivion_RESP1: Any news about that certain task we discussed?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bf8_Oblivion_RESP1: Any progress yet? You should be working on getting the book for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000807ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Any time you wish to visit me, I'll be here.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Anya claims to have been approached by Ma'zaddha. Perhaps there's something to this after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004766d_Oblivi: Anyone can wear clothes. But the RIGHT clothes? That is not so easy. Go to any castle. They wear Palonirya's designs, or they're nobody.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003843b_Oblivion_RESP1: Anything else I can help with, you just let me know.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08AncestorMoth_00048973_Oblivio: Anything for a friend. The Moth Priests live in the Imperial Palace. I don't know exactly what they do. Something to do with the Elder Scrolls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01AmantiusAllectus_00048970_Obl: Anything for you! He lives in the Temple district on the far east side.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000412c7_Oblivion_RESP3: Anyway, I'm always looking for new exhibits, so remember me when you come across anything Odd.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34WhyNeed_0008f7b9_Oblivion_RES: Anyway, enough of my banter. So, will you please help me get back my Medallion?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29InvNice_0001d049_Oblivion_RES: Anyway, have fun looking around, and when you are ready to buy, give me a shout.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0000ab72_Oblivion_R: Anyway, if you want to rile up a goblin tribe, steal their Tribal Head. Which is often what a rival tribe does, just to prove they're tougher.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062be9_Oblivion_RESP4: Anyway, sorry to go on so long. I'm sure you've got things to do. Just wanted to thank you personally.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwaterBrigands_0000c1ce_Obliv: Anyway, sorry to ramble. You better get below now and rest until we arrive safely at the Imperial City docks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42Confused_0007322d_Oblivion_RE: Anyway, you're going to help me find calipers and tongs. No point in denying it. You've already agreed tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03Xedilian_0006770c_Oblivion_RE: Anyway... there are those that have other ways into my Realm, and they're on the move. We don't want them here. Trust me.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00175bc7_Oblivion_R: Best prices? Right here at Gundalas' Best Goods and Guarantees! Never an unhappy customer! Huge discounts... to qualifying patrons!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003cf92_Oblivion_RESP: Best shops in Anvil? Norbert Lelles handles rare books, exotic ingredients, and gems, and they have fine weapons at Morvayn's Peacemakers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pillar_00035f51_Oblivion_RESP5: Best to play it safe. No complex magic. Stick to basic spells with single effects. It's not worth taking unnecessary risks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007817e_Oblivion_RES: Best way to kill a Skinned Hound is with a fireball, or a good weapon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc7_Oblivion_RES: Best way to take out a skeleton is with a big weapon. Forget spells. Just smack them and watch the bones fly!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006fdc3_Oblivion_RESP1: Bet you think you're somethin' huh? You call yourself a citizen of the Empire? No respect for order, no respect for law. You make me sick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003334c_Oblivion_R: Bet you're glad it won't last long, huh? Oh, didn't you know? No one ever leaves this prison alive! You're going to die in here, Redguard! Die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000917c_Oblivion_RESP1: Betrayer! I have found you at last! Your reckoning is at hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFlameofAgnonTopic_00019ad4_Obli: Betraying the Dark Seducers! The biters bit, so to speak. Most ingenious. I must say, I really didn't think you had it in you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f54a_Oblivion_RESP1: Better go talk to ol' Arvena.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtStrangerResponse_000981dd: Better keep an eye on her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtStrangerResponse_000981dc: Better keep an eye on him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00032b12_Oblivion_RES: Better not close this one. There's no way to open it from the other side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12Choice1B_0000beeb_Oblivion_RE: Better that you should be adequately prepared. I shall await your return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000b0702_Oblivi: Better, maybe, now that we've got the Dragon to watch over us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479eb_Oblivion_RESP1: Betto Plotius. I'm a faithful servant of Leyawiin and the Emperor... Gods rest his soul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Hate_0007866f_Oblivion_RESP2: Between my shop and a few others in Crucible, he's been caught stealing maybe a dozen times last month.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1e6_Oblivion_RES: Between the Gatekeeper and the Resonator of Judgment, I feel much safer in New Sheoth right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000566f_Oblivion_RESP9: Between the hours of midnight and 3:00 AM, ask me about the Night Mother, and we will away to our Lady's home. Only then will the ritual begin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0cf_Oblivion_RESP: Between the sailors and shipmen of the port, and my little local circle of friends, I have plenty of yarns for knitting up my tales.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005d51a_Oblivion_RESP1: Between the seen and unseen, the seeming and the being, lies the gulf of ignorance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0006261e_Oblivion: Between the two of them, Borissean and Gaspar have mastered nearly every type of spell there is. You'd be wise to go see them if you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028716_Oblivi: Between you and me, I think Matilde found the gold, and one of the others killed her for it! Maybe that means the rest of us are safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007b478_Oblivion_RES: Between you and me? Ysabel is completely in love with me. But I'm just not a one-woman guy. Nope, the life of the bachelor suits me just fine...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c2ac_Oblivi: Beware of Ulrich. I wouldn't confront him at this time, as he'll surely have you thrown in jail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db85_Oblivion_RES: Beware the vicious Scalon for it carries dread disease. If this foe bites you, then stay away from me please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e102_Obli: Beware the vicious Scalon for it carries dread disease. If this foe bites you, then stay away from me please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da9e_Oblivion_RESP1: Beware. The Redguard Valley Ogres are not known for their... hospitality.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AReward_0007f3cf_Oblivion_RES: Beyond that, take whatever else you need from the recovery chest... you've earned it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeArgonian_0009f9af_Oblivi: Beyond this gate is my Argonian challenger. She is a clever thing, and eager for your blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082629_Obl: Bhisha is always following him around. Ushnar would do anything to stop it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e86_Oblivion_RES: Biene Amelion sold her family sword and armor to pay her debts. And you think you have it bad?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BieneAmelionTOPIC_000091cc_Oblivi: Biene? She should be around here somewhere. Just look around a bit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45EndChoice1_00081b7a_Oblivion_: Big Head knows a secret about blades. Point them out, never in. Blade is out - poke, poke, poke! Kill the grandpa netch!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047703_Oblivi: Big city. I really LOVE the lights at night, shoo-shoo. The City of Love. Got it? Love? Light? Night? Big. Big, big, big, BIG!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FishermansRockLater_000860d6_Obli: Big help you are.... All right. Maybe I'll wait here. And maybe not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45HaveFork_00078785_Oblivion_RE: Big-Head knows secrets. Secrets of learning. Alchemy, Sneaking, and stabbing with Blades! Which will you learn?
Big-Head names you friend! Songs of friendship! Songs of ship-friends! Presents for you! Presents on Hatching Day!
Big-Head was hatched, but his brother was not! Presents for egg-friend! Almost forgot! Selfish Big-Head. Shellfish Big-Head!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture3_0007194a_Oblivion: Birthstone Doomstones bear red runes, appear with stone circles, and are associated with the classic birthsigns like the Apprentice and the Atronach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BittneldTopic_0002a990_Oblivion_R: Bittneld -- captain of the castle guard? -- he seems like such a nice fellow. Too bad I don't see him in here very much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ10Husband_00061420_Oblivion_RES: Bjalfi snatched Rockshatter from our mantle and took off to "find his fortune" with the local Marauder gang at Fort Strand. I want that mace back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090b5e_Oblivion_RESP1: Black Brugo is dead, right? So I'm going to be a knight?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0014600d_Oblivion_RES: Black Brugo, chief of the Black Bow Bandits, is dead. And the Count made his killers Knights of the White Stallion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024ffa_O: Black Marsh has become more dangerous than ever. Many settlers have been lost, and most non-Argonians have left in fear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice9_0002c622_Oblivion_RE: Blackheart has a fascination with these Ayleid ruins. There's one northeast of here, Atatar. My bet is that he moved his base there. I'll lead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00159763_Oblivion_R: Blackwood Company is putting the Fighters Guild to shame. They're a new mercenary company, competing with the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e6e_Oblivion_RES: Blackwood Company is sloppy. They make mistakes. Sooner or later it is going to cost them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e35_Oblivion_RES: Blackwood Company takes any and all contracts, and always completes them. Hard to beat that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000477f3_Oblivion_R: Blackwood Company's a problem. Not for me. I mostly do training. But we don't see many contracts in Leyawiin guildhall. Blackwood gets them all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e7a_Oblivion_RES: Blackwood Company's getting all the contracts around Leyawiin. No wonder the boys there are getting restless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624c1_Oblivion_RES: Blackwood isn't so bad, once you get used to the flies. And being lost all the time. And the zombies and will-o-the-wisps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479cf_Oblivion_R: Blackwood' refers in part to Blackwood Forest, but it also carries a reference to the 'thoghatt', of 'charcoal warriors' of Khajiit tradition.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062ccd_Oblivion_RESP1: Blade and bone. Speak to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OrderOfTalosTopic_00033dfb_Oblivi: Blades who are too old for active service often join the Order as lay brothers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_00037c38_Oblivion_RESP1: Blades! Dark times are upon us. The Emperor and his sons were slain on our watch. The Empire is in chaos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15Voice_00094073_Oblivion_RESP1: Blades! Do homage to Martin's champion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006833e_Oblivion_RESP1: Bladesman, I was wondering if I might have a word?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BOASTHATE_0018b2b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Blah, blah, blah. What a bore.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Blasphemy! Never utter the name of the Dark Deceiver lightly!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEArctusSpeech03_0008988b_Oblivio: Blasphemy! These words are the pillars upon which the teachings of Arden-Sul stand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_0006445c_Oblivion_RESP1: Blasted thief. I hope they string him up when they catch him. He's a slippery one, though. The beggars are his eyes and ears.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00036320_Oblivion_RESP1: Blech! I would not feed on you if you were the last warm body in Tamriel!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f6c_Oblivio: Bless you! Dar Jee lives east of the temple.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f6f_Oblivio: Bless you! Fathis Ules lives in the middle of the Elven Gardens district.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f6b_Oblivio: Bless you! Ongar lives behind the temple.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f6e_Oblivio: Bless you! Orrin lives in the Castle. Hard to believe, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f73_Oblivio: Bless you! There's none in this town, but you could try Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f72_Oblivio: Bless you! There's none in this town, but you could try Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f70_Oblivio: Bless you! There's none in this town, but you could try Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f71_Oblivio: Bless you! There's none in this town, but you could try Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGDirectGiveCoin_00045f74_Oblivio: Bless you! There's none in this town, but you could try the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TheForgottenOnesTOPIC_0001ce9c_Ob: Blessed are the Forgotten Ones, Chosen of Namira. In squalor they thrive, wallowing in filth, low and repulsive, darlings of Namira.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebb2_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessed are you who wields the Goldbrand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofMolagBalTOPIC_00026b41_Ob: Blessed are you, who has spoken to the Corrupter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ef74_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessed are you, who walks his true path. Enlightened are you, who learns of himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ef75_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessed are you. How may I serve you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000579c6_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessings of the Lady upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000914b1_Oblivion_RES: Blessings of the Madgod, citizen. Walk without fear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000029e5_Knights_RESP1: Blessings of the Nine upon you, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8a6_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessings of the Nine. I'm Ohtesse the Healer. By the grace of Mara, I offer Advanced Training in the Restoration Arts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038aa8_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessings of the Nine. My name is Tumindil. I'm the chapel priest. I'm sure you can find your way around the chapel by yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00015e10_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessings of the Shadow upon ye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081da1_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessings upon you Lord.... Bring the Skooma next time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000238df_Oblivion_RESP1: Blessings. I'm Orag gra-Bargol, servant of Stendarr. May you grow in the Faith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_000617ff_Ob: Bliss is safer with the army's return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Components_00013571_Oblivion_: Blood Liqueur, Osseous Marrow, Dermis Membrane, and the Essence of Breath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGWhatIsBloodPrice_0001d4cf_Obliv: Blood price is for each person slain. You can pay any of the guild Doyen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001fc4a_Oblivion_RESP3: Blood ran blue, and dragons flew high. Under broken towers and broken bodies it now lies, waiting to be found.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014ac1_Oblivion_RE: Blood, liquid nutrient, that ocean which casts pearls of life upon the shores of existence....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5a0_Oblivion_RESP1: Bloody scamps. I could skin them all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01FinChoice1A_00023e4b_Oblivi: Board the ship and find its captain, Gaston Tussaud. He'll be in his cabin. Eliminate Tussaud in any manner you see fit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebc2_Oblivion_RESP1: Boethia has opened a portal for you. Consider yourself lucky. You have the chance to die in Boethia's service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014ac4_Oblivion_RE: Bone, branch and stone of the body, giving shape and structure....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkOrcElfConvo_00026e7b_Oblivion: Bonuses? Ha ha ha ha ha! Useless, I say! Gold and magical trinkets are no substitute for the freedom to slaughter anyone I please, at any time!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078160_Oblivion_RES: Books of Bliss has quite a selection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023fa3_Oblivion_RESP1: Books. I sell books. Go ahead. Look. Buy some.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeBoots_00016536_Oblivion_: Boots are useful. Though, sometimes, it's nice to wade barefoot through the blood of your fallen foes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ10BurdSpeech_000463bb_Oblivion_: Bor, Soren, you're with me. The rest of you, stay outside and kill anything that comes out of that Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e895_Oblivion_RESP1: Borba gra-Uzgash. We've got everything the adventurer needs. I'm an old adventurer myself, and I know what's wanted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047640_Oblivion_RESP1: Borissean. Master Spellmaker for the Mages Guild. Guildsmen, only, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8dd_Oblivion: Boss uglies in Cheydinhal are the Orums. Don't mean nothing to you. You is the Outside. Just stay Outside, and everything's Mister Tinker. Got me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DirectionsSleep_0018bd97_Oblivion: Both inns are next to the west gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e56_Oblivion_RES: Both the new Fighters Guild recruits got back alive. It's a good start.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2ae_Obliv: Both vineyards, Tamika's and Surilie Brothers. Vintage 399. Oh, what a good year that was...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062ce3_Oblivion_RESP1: Bother me again, and you might live to regret it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002dc2_Oblivion_RESP1: Bothiel may know more about this "Shade of the Revenant" referred to in the book you've given me. Speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0000080B_AltarESPMain: Bothiel, from the Arcane University, is looking for someone to chase the bandits from Camp Ales. Probably trying to enhance her weird machine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloatedFloat_00015713_Oblivion_RE: Bought it maybe ten years ago when it was decommissioned. Had to gut the whole thing to make room, but kept it seaworthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004db91_Oblivion_RESP1: Bow before the might of my Lord Jyggalag!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00095fe7_Oblivi: Bow before the power of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d84_AltarDeluxe_RES: Bow to the will of Mehrunes Dagon and take this puny imperial life to assert your hatred of the Septims.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MundaneAmulet_00038b02_Oblivion_R: Bradon told me about this amulet when they first brought it home from whatever distant land it came from.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5b4_Oblivion_RESP1: Brandy and comberry wine. Not a good combination.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033599_Oblivion_RESP1: Brash child. Now look what he's gotten himself into.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d281_Oblivion_RESP1: Brave deeds, friend. Taking the fight to Oblivion itself! I salute you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_0004890c_Oblivion_RES: Bravil is an important trade center, and a rich melting pot of Imperial, Khajiit, and Argonian cultures. And, yes, a bit shabby and shopworn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048916_Oblivion_RES: Bravil is perhaps not so nice. But Bravil Castle, and castle gardens, they are jewels, are they not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048918_Oblivion_RES: Bravil perhaps presents little scope for an ambitious member of our guild. Perhaps you may find the castle entertaining. Little else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048913_Oblivion_RES: Bravil? Good points? Cheap to live. Unpretentious. Free-wheeling. Bad points? Culturally, a hole. Count's a clown and his son's a skooma-sucker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_0009605e_Oblivi: Break before the March of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000bf1c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Break the law on my watch, will ya? I'll be confiscating your stolen goods. Oh, and no gold to pay your fine, hmm? It's off to the lockup then!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006dc21_Oblivion_RESP1: Break-in at the Imperial Palace! A Black Horse Courier exclusive. Take a copy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGWhatIsBloodPrice_0001d4cf_Obliv: Breaking any of the three rules means expulsion from the Thieves Guild. If you commit murder, you must pay the blood price to rejoin the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014ac7_Oblivion_RE: Breath, child of air, bestowing movement, the stirring of spirit....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEBrellachTopic_0008f04c_Oblivion: Brellach is our stronghold. It is our place of refuge in this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEBrellachInfo_0001e970_Oblivion_: Brellach was given to us by our Lord Sheogorath as a sanctuary and place of restoration.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001da5e_Oblivion_RE: Bring back the vampire dust from their remains. That should be proof enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05AChoice1A_00028c07_Oblivion_R: Bring it to me once you have it. I'll even still give you the reward I promised, despite your incompetence. Now go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b18d_Obliv: Bring me 20 bear pelts, as proof that you have helped tear nature asunder. Then we shall speak of spells and teaching.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Components_00013572_Oblivion_: Bring me Blood Liqueur, Osseous Marrow, Dermis Membrane, and the Essence of Breath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_00031039_Oblivion_RESP: Bring me Jeanne's Manual of Spellcraft, and then we'll talk about helping you find J'skar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ02Skooma_00189180_Oblivion_RESP: Bring me Lonavo's ring as proof he's... been dealt with... and I'll give you the bounty on him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01GateSpeech_0005a761_Oblivion_: Bring me a champion! Rend the flesh of my foes! A mortal champion to wade through the entrails of my enemies!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30Matrices_0001e697_Oblivion_RE: Bring me a matrix and enough Ore, and I will forge you a new item and bleed the magic of the matrix into it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Yes_0006ea4c_Oblivion_RESP3: Bring me back the remedy, and I will reward you well. Here, take this special flask to collect the aquanostrum.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_00053741_Oblivio: Bring me the Soul Gems I've asked for, and then we'll discuss a cure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHircineSpeech_00051edf_Oblivion: Bring me this creature's horn, mortal. If you dare.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00026baa_Oblivion_RESP1: Bring my salutations to Julienne. Safe journey to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001ce04_Oblivion_RESP1: Bring that book immediately to Thoronir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243bb_Oblivio: Bring the sword to me, and I'll reward you with my Masque. You'll not find a better bargain, mortal. Begin your search in Pell's Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44Supplies_0007876e_Oblivion_RE: Bring these to me, and I will reward you well. Ahjazda has many, many things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005dc96_Oblivion_: Bringer of Light, bless these wretches that they may see the path to your glory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfcf_Oblivion_RES: Brodras has been teaching Fighters Guild members how to better use heavy armor. Odd for a Bosmer, but he's apparently good at it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000477f4_Oblivion_RESP1: Brodras of the Fighters Guild. I don't do contracts much. Mostly I'm a trainer. Heavy Armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Brokil gro-Shatur, Lord High Warden of the Taps, Gilgondorin's most prized customer. I taste everything. Over and over. And over again...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Brotch Calus, Alchemist. Advanced Training, available by appointment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982d2_Oblivion_RESP1: Brother Hjar, we must clean the chapel soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982df_Oblivion_RESP1: Brother Holger, we need to prepare for the ritual of purity by the next full moon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Brother Hridi, your homily was most inspiring.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_000299cb_Oblivion_RE: Brother Jauffre? He should be in the Priory House, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MartinTopic_000699f7_Oblivion_RES: Brother Martin? Yes, he's right over there. He led a group of us here during the confusion of the attack. We owe him our lives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrotherPinerTopic_000247e9_Oblivi: Brother Piner is a fine young monk, zealous and energetic. In time, I hope he may add patience and prudence to his list of virtues.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeynonPrioryTopic_000247ea_Oblivi: Brother Piner, Father Jauffre, and I are members of the Order of Talos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003402a_Oblivion_RESP1: Brother, if I may have a word.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0008e4fa_Obliv: Can't get in without Sheogorath's Blessing. That's what Relmyna says. That's the reason we're all waiting here - for Sheogorath's blessing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DaedraCultTopic_000a495d_Oblivion: Can't give you any better directions, unfortunately. Traveled mostly at night with a guide, and didn't see much on the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Repair_00066a58_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't go into battle with broken equipment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recharge_0006550f_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't have you walking around without working equipment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArdalineTopic_0002ba67_Oblivion_R: Can't help you. I don't really know her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082613_Obl: Can't say I blame him, living in Crucible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_thieves_00002e5e_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't say I know anything myself, but I heard that Newheim the Portly had some things stolen, and he's been asking around about it. Ask him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004662: Can't say I know him well. I understand he'll train people to cast illusions, for a price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NoBribeBeggar_00015f19_Oblivi: Can't say I know of any.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c205_Obl: Can't say I like tomatoes. I'm sure Undena's are good, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd9_Obli: Can't say I'm sorry to see there's one less Nord in the world. Still, I don't appreciate someone getting murdered right under my nose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingArmorerNothing_0018d160_O: Can't say I'm surprised. Few recognize the name anymore, even though he was famous. Had a book written about him, in fact!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fe1_Obli: Can't say I've heard anything myself. Still, that's odd.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498f: Can't say I've spent much time there. I hear it's nice, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice7_00026b1a_Oblivi: Can't say for sure. Some say they've seen her nearby, near the Vindasel Ruins. Might just be wishful thinking, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000790a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't sleep at home so I just walk around. Can't sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000790c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't sleep at home. Can't sleep. The walls aren't safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000790a6_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't sleep... the walls, they'd fall on me. Can't have that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071171_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't talk now. That door has been making noises again. No telling what's coming out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c7a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't thank you enough for your help. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002872c_Oblivi: Can't this wait, huh? Someone's been murdered and I've got better things to do than gossip about an old woman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't wait to get my hands on you...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000b97d8_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't wait to get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d48e_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't wait to see you later. Don't keep us waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cdf_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you find someone else to bother?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokC2Idle01_0008ea82_Obli: Can't you just wizard it open?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089977_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see I have things to do? Now please... get out of my way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041095_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see I was in the middle of my daily dewfall survey? Now I have to start all over again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062ce0_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see I wish to be left alone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000781ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see I'm busy? My house. So orderly. And now this! Where do I even begin?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022488_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see I'm busy? Without the translation, this book is useless. Now go away and let me work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bf7_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see I'm busy? Without the translation, this book is useless. Now go away and let me work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c33e_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see that I'm busy?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005327a_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see that I'm upset?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00028f81_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't you see that I'm very busy?!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000661f8_Oblivion_RESP1: Can't... Can't move... Body frozen... Must have been... the damn... Mead...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09accept_00014826_Oblivion_RESP: Capital! Bring me the Arrow of Extrication. It has a key shaped head. Bravil's court wizard, Fathis Aren, recently acquired this unique item.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11Accept_0001fb62_Oblivion_RESP: Capital! I have worked for eleven years planning this heist. Savilla's Stone provided the last bit of information I needed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf1b_Oblivion: Capital! I hearby reinstate you into the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf1f_Oblivion: Capital! I knew you could not stand for a stain on your honor, or that of the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf38_Oblivion: Capital! I like the swiftness of your reply. Here is your reward for getting me those boots. Be ready. I may call for you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GiveStone_00014705_Oblivion_R: Capital! Now I can see past the palace defenses. It's a good thing the Emperor didn't know they had this stone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GiveStone_0001cf35_Oblivion_R: Capital! Now I can see past the palace defenses. It's a good thing the Emperor didn't know they had this stone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10accept_00015309_Oblivion_RESP: Capital! The Earl of Imbel is the only descendant of his line that I have been able to locate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08accept_000146ff_Oblivion_RESP: Capital! The monastery is called the Temple of the Ancestor Moths. It is where retired, blind Moth priests go to wait out the rest of their days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10GiveBoots_00015310_Oblivion_R: Capital! This may be the last piece of the puzzle. I need to spend more time with Savilla's Stone first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10GiveBoots_0001cf37_Oblivion_R: Capital! This may be the last piece of the puzzle. I need to spend more time with Savilla's Stone first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c999_Oblivion_RESP: Captain Burd and I make a good pair. He understands Nords and the North, while I appreciate the subtleties of southern culture and politics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07SpiesResponse_00020076_Oblivi: Captain Burd in Bruma may also be able to help. I've asked the Countess to have the guard keep an eye out for strangers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ10JauffreA_00026efb_Oblivion_RE: Captain Burd is waiting for you outside the Bruma city gate. He'll show you the Oblivion Gate. Although I doubt it will be hard to find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0018d2a2_Oblivion_RESP: Captain Burd wanted to attack the Oblivion Gate immediately, but I ordered him to wait for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00000806_AltarESPMain: Captain Dugal's rumored treasure has to be true! I wonder if the first count of Anvil found it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006444c_Oblivion_RES: Captain Lex blames the Gray Fox for stealing the tax collection. He wants a bounty put on the Gray Fox, but the Legion Commander has refused.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48IlendSlowDown_00098154_Oblivi: Captain Matius sent us in to try and close the gate. We were ambushed, trapped, and picked off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000688fd_Oblivion_RESP1: Captain. No news is good news, I hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd72_Oblivion_RESP2: Carahil has sent you, has she not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c0_Oblivion_RESP: Carahil inherited the Anvil Mages Guild chapter from Hannibal Traven, the Archmage. She runs a clean hall, just like Traven did.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0002d066_Oblivion: Carahil supported Arch-Mage Traven's appointment from the beginning, and I don't believe the rumors that she just wanted his job at this hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenSpeech_0006e7f2_Oblivion_R: Carahil was justified in his actions. Slaying me was the only way to stop the madness. I have accepted that fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0002d067_Oblivion: Carahil's a good leader. She's been a staunch supporter of the Council of Mages for as long as I've known her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d9_Oblivion_RESP1: Carandial. Mage-trained. Scholar by inclination. Student of our Aldmeri ancestors, the Ayleids.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersAmuletTopic_0000c08a_: Caranya insisted on removing it from the University. She said it posed a threat to the safety of the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00073124_Oblivion_RESP1: Careful! Don't want to get squashed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008ea29_Oblivion_RESP1: Careful. Beasts all around. You might taste good to them, no?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00068900_Oblivion_RESP1: Caroline, a good day to you. Or is it evening?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000688f2_Oblivion_RESP1: Caroline. Don't let me keep you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeSword_0001651c_Oblivion_: Carve a happy smile. Let the blood wash over your hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b13: Casimir left with the Gauntlets when the Order dissolved. I heard that he lost them, but I had my own problems to deal with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc18_Oblivion_RES: Cast lots of spells at Gnarls. That's the best way to hurt them. Really!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005dc89_Oblivion_: Cast this spell upon the priests. Allow my beloved Forgotten to kill the interlopers. When this is done, I shall reward you for your efforts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255c2_Oblivion_RES: Casta Scribonia has finished a new book. Nothing that interests me, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10JyggalagTopic_00091460_Oblivi: Cat's out of the bag on that one, isn't it? Who puts cats in bags, anyway? Cats hate bags.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479f4_Oblivion_RESP1: Cat-Face. Yes, that's right. That's what they call me. Because they can't pronounce my Black Marsh name, I guess...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_causingtrouble_0002c8db_Oblivion_: Causing trouble, yes. Causing much trouble. Scaring customers. Breaking furniture. Bad, bad men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Caverns_0001778f_Oblivion_RES: Caves run all beneath the town. Some natural, some dug over the years since we found the Deep Ones. Every house has an entrance now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11PriestDeliverScroll_0014c71b_: Celia Camoran, I present to you the Elder Scroll you requested.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32OfferHelp_00012d04_Oblivion_R: Centuries ago, Vitharn was overrun by Fanatics. We were soft and failed to defend ourselves. I was the weakest of all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreetingMace_00002ac0_: Centuries later, the master craftsman Saint Kaladas built the Chapel of Zenithar in Leyawiin as a tribute to the legend.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11Peaceful_0003858b_Oblivion_RE: Certainly not. I'm surprised Carius didn't send the entire city watch up here. But then I would have seen that coming I suppose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopicMog02_00038a8f_Obliv: Certainly so. Captain Dione knows her business. And no enemy has ever made it over Skingrad's walls.
