ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvFollow_0006bd98_Oblivion_: Certainly, Arch-Mage. I shall stay close.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS37JulienneTears_00022e62_Oblivi: Certainly. Garridan was a knight who lorded over a small village of peaceful farmers. One harvest summer, there was a horrible drought.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrisonVisitor_0018d1fe_Oblivion_R: Certainly. I'll unlock the door for you. Of course I have to stay with you in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualNoM_00013661_Oblivion_R: Certainly. When the ruler of Mania has decided it is time, he will choose a successor from his court.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ea3_Oblivion_RES: Chalices? Who can think about chalices with the cat problem around here? Nasty beasts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OcatoTopic_000add3d_Oblivion_RESP: Chancellor Ocato has performed heroically. No one else could have held the Empire together during this crisis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_000adc6a_Oblivi: Chancellor Ocato heads the Elder Council and is the closest thing the Empire has to a leader right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000adc66_Oblivion_RESP1: Chancellor Ocato is expecting you. Proceed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MartinF_0004bf99_Oblivion_RES: Chancellor Ocato is the head of the Elder Council. The Council rules in the Emperor's absence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OcatoTopic_000add49_Oblivion_RESP: Chancellor Ocato isn't seeing any visitors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000146f0_Oblivion_RESP1: Chancellor Ocato! The city is under attack! Oblivion Gates have opened, and daedra are inside the walls! The guard is overwhelmed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CastleResidents_000038ba_Oblivion: Chanel and Orgnolf both reside in the Private Quarters section. They have been restricted to remain indoors, so they should be easy to find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChoice1_0000365d_Oblivi: Chanel? I find that very hard to believe. Until you obtain a full confession from her, I cannot accept your accusation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonLeaves_000206c0_Oblivi: Change will preserve us! It is the lifeblood of the Isles. It will move mountains! It will mount movements!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSylLeaves_0003b820_Oblivion_: Change will preserve us! It is the lifeblood of the Isles. It will move mountains! It will mount movements!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004cfa8_Oblivion_RESP1: Changed your mind, have you? The offer's still good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OrderOfTalosTopic_00033dfb_Oblivi: Chapterhouses of the Order, like Weynon Priory, provide safehouses for travelling Blades as well as our more public religious functions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031d07_Oblivion_RESP1: Charge the courtyard! Leave none of them standing!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00064462_Oblivion: Chasing after shadows if you ask me. The Thieves Guild probably doesn't exist, and it's a sure bet the Gray Fox doesn't either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e6c_Oblivion: Check back with me tomorrow after I've given this matter some thought.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0006e2e3_Oblivion_RESP2: Check with me monthly to give orders for the month.  I'll make it happen. If I don't hear from you, I'll follow the previous month's orders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441fa_Oblivion_RES: Cheers to the new ruler of Dementia! Drinks all around!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d28e_Oblivion_RESP1: Cheydinhal is in your debt, friend. That Oblivion Gate had us all living in fear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000c4531_Oblivion_RESP5: Cheydinhal is safe once again thanks to the Knights of the Thorn! Huzzah!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d280_Oblivion_RESP1: Cheydinhal sleeps more soundly tonight, thanks to you, friend. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081199_Oblivion_RESP1: Choices, choices. That took you long enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000917c9_Oblivion_RESP1: Choices, choices. Well, now that you've liberated some Greenmote from the Silo, you need to add it to Thadon's food and wine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624a4_Oblivion_RES: Chorrol appears to be clean, prosperous, and well-ordered. Countess Arriana, her staff and guard is to be praised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d294_Oblivion_RESP1: Chorrol breathes easier thanks to you. We are all in your debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002c4d4_Oblivion_RE: Chorrol's got plenty to eat, and good, thick walls, and that suits me fine. I don't know what's going on out there in the woods, and I don't need to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_000237ba_Oblivion_RE: Chorrol? That's where we are, right? Really? Great. I don't care. And I'm not interested. But it's sure nice of you to let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004993: Cicero, Sergius, and Tertullian run a good shop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting3a_0008f12c_O: Ciirta brought us here with promises to show us the light, but always is about Sheogorath, is about revenge!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00016b82_Oblivion: Ciirta guides us to the light, but... her obsession with Sheogorath keeps us from achieving it! Ra'kheran, now he -- I've said too much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b59_Oblivion_RESP1: Ciirta has fallen into darkness. Ra'kheran will lead the Apostles to the light!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00016b81_Oblivion: Ciirta is a fool, and a liar! She allows her hatred for Sheogorath to interfere with our journey toward the light! She must be stopped!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007dea0_Oblivion_RESP1: Ciirta is dead, and Ra'kheran has fallen. Who will guide us now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a391_Oblivion_RESP1: Ciirta is dead, and now the Apostles fear that there is no one to lead them to the light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b77_Oblivion_RESP1: Ciirta is dead. Ra'kheran will guide us now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_00016b85_Oblivion: Ciirta is the lightbringer. She has seen things that we can only imagine. If you are to join us, you must speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting3a_0008f12c_O: Ciirta lied, but when she is done, I will lead the Acolytes to the light!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11TheLightTopic_0008f12d_Oblivi: Ciirta promised to bring us to the light. It is a way, a promise of a better future. Free from the shackles of Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11DyusChoice1_00019ccf_Oblivion: Ciirta resides in the Howling Halls of Mania. Find her and bring me the eye that has seen that which no other has.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_0001a397_Oblivion: Ciirta's light has been darkened. Now is the time for another to rise and stand in her place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39SpoonChoice2_000781fb_Oblivio: Cindanwe is always trying to hurt my sweet Kishashi. Wouldn't want the slave-driver to get her hands on this spoon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825f2_Oblivion_RES: Cindanwe runs a tight ship in Fellmoor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Cindanwe_000781f6_Oblivion_RE: Cindanwe think she tough lady. Not as mean as Relan. She okay. She let Relan kill things that need to be dead. Relan like biting off heads.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7b_Oblivion_RESP3: Cindanwe would breathe her last breath with my hands around her throat and my sweet Kishashi would take her place. If only...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465b9_Oblivion_RES: Cirroc is a good healer. He's a Redguard, but you'd think he was a Nord, the way he acts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechAmulet_00002d1f_Kn: Citizens, the Queen of Stars asks you: where is her issue? Where are the men who can walk in her steps? In whose blood has the dragon taken purchase?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Lynch02Negative_000151e8_Obli: City Watch? I doubt it. But since you have aligned yourself with them, I think it's time to put an end to this conversation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046636_Oblivion_RES: City-Swimmer certainly lives up to her name. I've seen her in the canals many times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00046633_Oblivion_RESP1: City-Swimmer is a bit odd, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48Convo_00024829_Oblivion_RESP1: Civilians! It's time to move out! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004994f_Oblivion_RES: Claudette Perrick runs a fine alchemy shop. You should check out The Gilded Carafe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049951_Oblivi: Claudette does a good job. Still, she should rename the place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026a9c_Oblivion_RESP1: Clavicus Vile has offered you a bargain. Serve him well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243b1_Oblivio: Clavicus has always been a little blind to that. And it'll end badly this time, too. So, just leave things be. Walk away. It's your best bet, really.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040cb5_Oblivion_RESP2: Cleansing the Tree seems to have convinced him that the direct approach was his only option.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_thieves_00035741_Oblivion_RESP1: Cleared them out, did you? Good work, you two. I see big things for you with the Guild. Here's your payment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b588_Oblivion_RESP1: Clearly he was wrong. Yet I do think he meant well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000918dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Clever adversary isn't she? I bet your thinking that this was too easy, yes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00093552_Oblivion_RESP: Clever girl, I taught her everything I knew. Too bad she's turned that knowledge against me. Come back when you have the real thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AxeofDragol_0001fdb5_Oblivion_RES: Clever ruse. I wonder how many have died falling for it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting2a_00019fca_O: Clever you are, but I can sense a liar. No matter, I do not care to know why you are here; I only care that you wish Ciirta harm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b74_Oblivion_RESP1: Clever. You've summoned me again. My Lord has made quite a choice for his champion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenVoice_000150c7_Oblivion_RE: Close up left! Protect the Emperor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk2_0018d7ee_Oblivion_RES: Cloud Ruler Temple is home to the Blades, and has served us well. But I fear an assault. Mythic Dawn, Daedra... maybe both. We must be ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CloudRulerTempleTopic_00034069_Ob: Cloud Ruler Temple was built long ago, by the founders of the Blades, back in the days of Reman Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04KeepMartinSafe_0001ee2e_Obliv: Cloud Ruler Temple, I think. The hidden fortress of the Blades, in the mountains near Bruma. A few men can hold it against an army.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CloudRulerTempleTopic_000626c2_Ob: Cloud Ruler is many things. Temple, fortress, safe haven. But it's also my home. I'll gladly die defending these walls, if it comes to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcac_Oblivion_RES: Colovia is a land of rugged wastes and highland forests.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcad_Oblivion_RES: Colovia is dotted with isolated farms and settlements, with most of the population in the coastal margin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c193_Obl: Colovian Traders is a good shop. Perhaps I'll visit Gunder soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Tree_0008f12a_Oblivion_RESP4: Combined with the Eye of Ciirta, the shell of the Staff can be remade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterExit_000091e5_DLCThievesDen: Come back and see me again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornNeverMind_0000de50_DLCB: Come back and see me again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018b9fe_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back and visit me anytime.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002b3d2_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back as quickly as you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseDecline_0004ce58_Oblivion_RE: Come back if you change your mind. We are the only place in Cyrodiil where you can get the magnificent White horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00033ee6_Oblivion_: Come back in a few weeks. You may be surprised at what we can accomplish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00066f33_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back to laugh at the pathetic old man, have we? To the pit with you! Leave me alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000299a_Knights_RESP1: Come back to see the doomed man, have you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b984a_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back when you actually have the money for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000980d1_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back when you have the real thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice8_0002c651_Oblivion_RE: Come back when you're ready. Don't delay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_00071095_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back when you've got the ectoplasm, and we'll talk about those other men getting work from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00028a29_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back when you've learned something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000366e3_Oblivion_RESP1: Come back with help. I don't know how much longer we can hold out in here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004f791_Oblivion_RES: Come closer. I'd prefer not to have to shout.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Seen_0001a7e5_Oblivion_RESP1: Come closer. Taste the power of the Lord of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b0ab_Oblivion_RESP4: Come into the High Hall of Judgment. Let us test ourselves against one another once and for all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate4_00015631_Oblivio: Come now, must we start with hostilities? This situation is not of my creation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate2_00014452_Oblivio: Come now. We all know you've spread rumors about Thadon leaving his section of the palace late at night. You've been meeting him, haven't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000164ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on Bloodletter, don't lose your momentum now. Keep fighting!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032d3d_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on! Run while there's still time! The Guard still holds the road, but it's only a matter of time before they're overwhelmed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00074a18_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on! Together we can defeat him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a025_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on! We can use your help to drive back the invaders!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d0a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on! We have to protect Martin until he can light the Dragonfires in the Temple!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e120_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on! We need to get to the Dragonfires before it's too late!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009098d_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on! We need to help the Grandmaster!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcConversation_0007ead1_Obli: Come on,  it'll be fun watching them get knocked around up there. I'll lead, you'll follow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_00037cfc_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on, now. The room is only 10 gold. Surely you can afford that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007bac1_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on, we've got to keep moving!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025273_Oblivion_RESP2: Come on, you've got to help me! Let old Valen out of this cell! You've got your freedom, now give me mine! What do you say, huh? Come on, friend!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dd4_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on. Join the Fighters Guild. See the world, and get paid for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e4f_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on. Let's get this mission done and get paid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7f0_Oblivion_RESP1: Come on. My men will need all the help they can get today.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024851_Oblivion_RESP3: Come on. This is only the beginning of the battle for Kvatch. We can discuss the next phase once the civilians are safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG14CamillaTaunts_00085884_Oblivi: Come out, come out wherever you are...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000c45bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Come see me anytime, friend. I'm here day or night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002285b_Oblivion_RESP: Come see me when I'm at the Chironasium, and we'll take care of that for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0005c06b_Oblivion_RESP1: Come see me when you've spoken to Jeanne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting2b_00016b72_Obl: Come then, and I will show you that in the end, my light shall shine the brightest!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002b5f6_Oblivion_RESP1: Come to bother me with a war story, Redguard?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c33b_Oblivion_RESP1: Come to gloat, eh? Well, you'll get no apologies from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bec_Oblivion_RESP1: Come to have a few words before you slit my throat? That's right, I know you did it. I can't prove it yet, but you mark my words: You're going down!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LlathasaIndarys_00045f78_Obli: Come to pay your respects, have you? You can find her tomb in the chapel undercroft.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014acc_Oblivion_RE: Come to this altar. Join with this body. Quintessence of Flesh joined with the Essence of Flesh. Absolute in mortal. Immortal bound to contingent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000276a7_Oblivion_RESP1: Come with me to the Chapel of Talos. I wish to speak with your lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000290c_Knights_RESP1: Come with me! We have to tell everyone that you're alive!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002934_Knights_RESP1: Come with me, if you will, to the Wayshrine of Arkay. I will offer a prayer for the souls of those who died in the Nine's service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045754_Oblivion_RESP1: Come with me, scum. Those who can't afford to pay reparations must face Lord Sheogorath's dungeons. I'm confiscating your stolen goods as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJauffreHelp_0005d2c7_Oblivion_R: Come with me. I have a few things here that I keep for visiting Blades agents. Help yourself to whatever you need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PayGoldforCrime_000459d0_Oblivion: Come with me. You'll be searched for stolen property, then released.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025dec_Oblivion_RESP1: Come with us. Your destiny is bound up with mine, and with the fate of Tamriel itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD07Choice1_000356e0_Oblivion_RE: Come with you? Not likely. I know some of my men are still alive. Guards! Attack!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002aef9_Oblivion_RESP1: Come, I have much to tell you. A tavern is right over here. We will drink a toast to Umbacano.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril4_00002c4e_Knights_RE: Come, if we keep ourselves busy the waiting will be easier to bear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000400dc_Oblivion_RESP2: Come, light the Great Torch for Dementia!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000400db_Oblivion_RESP2: Come, light the Great Torch for Dementia. Illuminate the conspiracies! Deepen the shadows! The people of Crucible await their Hero!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d84_AltarDeluxe_RES: Come, mortal. Our Prince's power is close.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000473c2_Oblivion_RESP3: Come, my father is waiting to welcome you to Carac Agaialor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000473c3_Oblivion_RESP3: Come, my father is waiting to welcome you to Carac Agaialor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice8_00026b20_Oblivi: Come, then. Try your luck. Feel the bite of Umbra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14ReturnHome_0001c1cd_Oblivion_: Come, you must need food and rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC6_0003e8fc_Oblivion_: Come. As an equal, I shall grace your name and corpse with honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002978_Knights_RESP4: Come. He is preaching to the assembled Knights in the Chapel. You should speak to him at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015304_Oblivion_RESP1: Come. We have much to discuss.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_00037b52_Oblivion_RESP1: Come. Your Blades are waiting to greet you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3a_000186fc_: Command them if you will, or leave it to me. Either way, make haste. Our time is short.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3a_00018c7e_: Command them if you will, or leave it to me. Either way, make haste. Our time is short.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Commander Ja'Fazir. Your servant. I am second-in-command of the Blackwood Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007815d_Oblivion_RES: Common Treasures is full of junk. That's all Tilse Areleth collects.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bdc_Knights_R: Complacency proved to be our greatest enemy. The service of the Nine requires eternal vigilance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_0002459e_Oblivion_RES: Concerning this, I can only speak to a friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040367_Oblivion_RESP1: Congratulations on creating the Gatekeeper, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c147_Oblivion_RESP1: Congratulations on your victory! I admit, I thought your plan would lead to disaster, but you came through for Bruma. I won't forget it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c140_Oblivion_RESP1: Congratulations on your victory. Your fame was well-deserved, it seems.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_000153ad_Oblivion: Congratulations! You have returned with the diary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_0001811e_Oblivion: Congratulations! You have returned with the diary. You have earned the right to join the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo05_00090b78_Oblivion_RE: Congratulations, you manky scroat. Now get away from me. And don't ever talk to me again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo06_00090b79_Oblivion_RE: Congratulations, you manky scroat. Now get away from me. And don't ever talk to me again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12RecoverYes_0001823d_Oblivion_: Congratulations. I had a feeling you were the right person for the job. And it seems I owe you a reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ce5_Oblivion_RESP1: Congratulations. I had a feeling you would catch on sooner or later. Leaving that journal behind was a stupid mistake on my part.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895de_Oblivion_: Congratulations. You've gained another ally in your efforts. Do remember to follow up with Ma'zaddha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06FenceTopic02_000088a0_DLCThi: Consider it done. I will get rid of all your criminal warrants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayFines_000983a6_Oblivion_RESP: Consider it done. I will get rid of all your criminal warrants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofAureal_00043029_O: Consider that combat is not your only option. Your Grace has already made use of the chimes found in Brellach, and they can be useful once more.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e9e_Oblivion_RES: Conspiracy in the House of Dementia. Sad, sad songs. Songs of missing things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1a_000807ae_Oblivion_RESP: Contained within its walls were the formulaic predictions of every action ever taken by any creature, mortal or Daedric.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus1a_0001a815_Oblivion_RESP: Contained within its walls were the logical prediction of every action ever taken by any creature, mortal or Daedric.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEAltarofDespairTopic_0007ff5e_Ob: Continue down the corridor if you wish to meditate there upon the fate of all things mortal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016ec6_Oblivion_RESP1: Contrary to your goals, you remain here with me. If you seek the recreation of the staff, then you must bring the eye and the branch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_000414e8_Oblivio: Conviction can drive men mad. They will even kill to uphold the mistaken belief that only they see the world truly. Such is the story of Vitharn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00089606_Oblivion_: Convincing a Dark Seducer to reveal secrets to you may require more pressure than you've experienced thus far.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona06_00022e82_Obli: Corvus! Is it really you? Ten years I've waited for word from you. Why did you hide from me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylWho_000139b3_Oblivion_RESP: Could be all of them. Every last one. None can be trusted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD03Choice3_0002d72d_Oblivion_RE: Could be that. But you said the corpse was intact. Nothing had dined on the gem-hunter. Something doesn't sit right with me about this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_0008306a_Oblivion_RESP1: Could be the Blades. They've always feared me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FishermansRockTopicSmashing_00091: Could be. You know how it is. But not until I'm finished talking!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028239_Oblivi: Could it be possible? Could an old lady be a murderer? She'd have the stomach for it, of that I'm sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008efca_Oblivion_RESP1: Could someone muffle the door? The sounds of combat are disturbing me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture4_00071956_Oblivion: Could these runestones have served as waypoints and landmarks for military patrols of the nascent Imperial Legion?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f9c1_Oblivion_RESP2: Could you please get some more aquanostrum from Knotty Bramble for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HaderusGoldwineTopic_0002ad7e_Obl: Count Goldwine is the embodiment of nobility. He's always ruled Kvatch with a fair hand, and listened to the needs of his people.
Count Goldwine retreated to the castle, determined to hold on to it at any cost. He's still in there now, I'm sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13Choice1A_0000399e_Oblivion_RE: Count Hassildor of Skingrad has contacted the Council. He claims to have information that is vital to us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_0003e94c_Oblivio: Count Hassildor of Skingrad has done the most recent research on a cure, I believe. He has what you might call a vested interest in the subject.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_00066a1b_Oblivion_RE: Count Hassildor will only consider buyers of distinction. You just aren't famous enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0018d2fb_Oblivion: Count Indarys has ordered us to hold our positions until Farwil returns from inside that accursed Oblivion Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03BribeBeggar_000092b0_Oblivion: Count Indarys recently commissioned a bust of Llathasa. They say the Elves carved it. He put it near her tomb in the Chapel Undercroft.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03ElvenBust_00048979_Oblivion_R: Count Indarys recently commissioned a bust of Llathasa. They say the Elves carved it. He put it near her tomb in the Chapel Undercroft.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice1A_00022b67_Oblivion_RE: Count Janus Hassildor, at your service. A 'thank you' might be in order at this point.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0014600c_Oblivion_RES: Count Leyawiin created a new order of knights -- the White Stallion -- for the ones who defeated Black Brugo.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0014600b_Oblivion_RES: Count Leyawiin placed a bounty on the heads of the surviving Black Bow Bandits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038a94_Oblivion_R: Count Skingrad has ruled here all my life. The county is quiet and prosperous.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ab1_Oblivion_R: Count Skingrad is a very private person. I handle all the county's public affairs, and consult with the Count when necessary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006446b_Oblivion_RES: Count Umbranox has returned! After eleven years, he just walked back into Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AlessiasRing_0000a175_Oblivio: Countess Caro is so relieved to have the ring back. It's been missing for many years. She wears it constantly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12TolganGreet_0001c497_Oblivion: Countess Carvain would prefer if you speak to her in person. She also said to present you with this stipend as a taste of things to come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AkaviriArtifacts_000980f5_Oblivio: Countess Carvain's collection of Akaviri Artifacts is known far and wide as one of the most complete. It's unsurpassed even by museum standards.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07WhatIsPlan_000983a1_Oblivion_: Countess Umbranox of Anvil, is hunting for a new captain of her guard. The Legion Commander of the Imperial Watch sent her a list of candidates.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51Talk_0003481d_Oblivion_RESP1: Countess Valga is up in arms about the painting being stolen. We're supposed to keep an eye on things until it's found.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081f37_Oblivion_RESP1: Counting the wrong corpses. You were a big help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16MessengerTopic_000146ee_Obliv: Courage, soldier. We have an Emperor again.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThurindilTopic_0003e0d8_Oblivion_: Crazy as a rat in a catbox. Just leave him alone. He's not hurting anybody.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_00046823_Oblivion_RES: Creatures have been reported in Deepwallow, Lord. Perhaps you should intervene... as it is your job.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000410a0_Oblivion_RES: Cretin! Nincompoop! Halfwit! Now I have to start all over again. Happy?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e02_Oblivion_RESP1: Crime doesn't pay. We have long memories. We won't forget.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001c46d_Oblivion_RESP1: Crime don't pay. My cells is full of fools thinkin' it did. I might just sees ya there soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047663_Oblivi: Crime in the City? You hear a lot of complaining, but it's really not so bad. The Thieves Guild is smart; they don't want any trouble with the Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice4_00038ed7_Obli: Crowhaven is a ruined fort far to the west of here. I'd go myself, but my training regiment doesn't allow for the luxury of such an excursion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000616: Crucible can be a dangerous place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441f4_Oblivion_RES: Crucible has a new ruler. Perhaps I can continue to find shelter in the House of Dementia, else what will I do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061c67: Crucible will be safer with the armies intact.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10SirAmielSpeech01_00002c9f_Kni: Crusader... arise... stand and face the light. Breathe again and receive your reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeBootsMagic_00016ce4_Obli: Crush the skulls of the fallen under your boots. Stomp out their eyeballs with your heel. Paint the floor red in a bloody dance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BlowOff_0003fd3c_Oblivion_RES: Curb your tongue, Shadowfoot! I am the Gray Fox. If you ever want to become a Master Thief in the guild, you had better learn respect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice6_000133e5_Obliv: Cured? You speak as if they are diseased. They live now in another state of being. Perhaps it is you who needs a cure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_00028bff_Obl: Curious that you should inquire about it, as it has recently gone missing. You wouldn't happen to know anything about that, would you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03SyndelC1Idle01_0008ea9a_Obliv: Curious. This one is smaller than the others we've encountered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a70_Knig: Cut eight-wise he was, Pelinal the Blamer, champion of Men, and though dispersed he left us a warning! Heed it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078162_Oblivion_RES: Cutter sells weapons in Crucible, but you won't catch me going there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeSwordMagic_00016cee_Obli: Cutting a man apart, little by little... such sticky sweet victory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00080d8e_Oblivion_RESP1: Cylarne is ours at last, thanks to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECylarneTopic_00019acf_Oblivion_: Cylarne was once the capital of the Shivering Isles. Perhaps the first capital.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc99_Oblivion_RES: Cyrodiil is surrounded to the north and east by the lofty Jerall and Valus mountain ranges.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture2_00071923_Oblivion: Cyrodiil's runestones are thought to belong to one of three time periods: the Dawn Era, the Merethic Era, or the late First Era.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004768d_Oblivion_RESP1: Cyronin Sintav. I'm a Sintav. That's all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00068901_Oblivion_RESP1: Cyrus, my friend. Don't let me keep you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace4e_Oblivion_RES: Daedra Lords demand offerings and services. If you won't do as you're told, just forget about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopicElse02_00038a9d_Obli: Daedra Lords, sure. They exist. They do things. Bad things, mostly, but things you can see. The gods? They don't do a damn thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SheoIntroSpeech2_0005604a_Oblivio: Daedra are the embodiment of change. Change and permanency. I'm no different, except in the ways that I am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000039d4_Oblivion_RES: Daedra came out and set fire to the town. Many people died, but some got out alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c242_Oblivion_: Daedra cannot die, so your so-called gods cannot erase him from your minds completely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DaedraCultTopic_00098200_Oblivion: Daedra cults aren't necessarily evil, of course. In nearby Morrowind, for example, they worship Daedra in the Temple.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48HirtelA_00032d41_Oblivion_RES: Daedra overran Kvatch last night! There were glowing portals outside the walls! Gates to Oblivion itself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047691_Oblivi: Daedric shrines nearby? I know of two. North of the city, south of Bruma, east of the Silver Road, is a Mephala shrine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e2a8_Oblivion_RES: Dagail has been training high ranking mages more about mysticism. And he's also been researching sheep, from what I hear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000514b6_Oblivion_: Dagail's the only one who can write one. If she can remember who she is today, that is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07HowToForge_0000c237_Oblivion_: Dairihill cannot be trusted. You must deliver the letter to Lady Umbranox in person. Will you accept this commission?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NivanDalviluTOPIC_0001ebd9_Oblivi: Dalvilu has been murdered, and we have been accused of the crime! Bastard elves! That they would dishonor us in this way....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BleakersWayTopic_0001ecdf_Oblivio: Dalvilus have lived here peacefully with Ulfgars for generations. As leaders, Hrol Ulfgar and I work hard to preserve that tradition.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0000bf13_Oblivion_RES: Dammit! The gate is barred from the other side. A trap!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004f3df_Oblivion_RES: Dammit, it's that prisoner again! Kill her, she might be working with the assassins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_000164b7_Oblivion_RES: Dammit, it's that prisoner again! Kill him, he might be working with the assassins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005efa6_Oblivion_RES: Damn Knights! Scaring away all the beasts!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000363b3_Oblivion_RESP1: Damn Watchman. I bet they're all crooked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018afde_Oblivion_RESP1: Damn bears... going to run me out of Shardrock at this rate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479fb_Oblivion_R: Damn crooked Councilor. Some men rob you with a sword; others rob you with a goose quill pen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286ef_Obli: Damn it man, two people are dead! Have you nothing better to do than question me about the Nord?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokChamberOneGrow03_00066: Damn it! Lewin deserved better than this and I'm responsible. Someone will pay dearly, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004f9cc_Oblivion_RESP1: Damn it, now they're into my pantry!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_0002d409_Oblivion_RESP1: Damn rats, always skirting around in the shadows. Making me jumpy...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoBribeA1_000a984e_Oblivion: Damn straight. I can only treat myself when I'm feeling flush.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Wrath02Positive_00015261_Obli: Damn that woman! She promised a four part split when we recover the Golden Galleon. She never said anything about splitting it five ways!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003631b_Oblivion_RESP1: Damn the Tenets! I'll cleave you in two if you don't get out of my face!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006a841_Oblivion_RESP1: Damn these interruptions! Can't you see I'm busy? Do you think just anyone gets into the Arcane University? Now leave me alone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38GuardWarnChoice1_00023683_Obl: Damn! He's finally gone completely bonkers! Thanks for the tip. Now stand aside and let the Guard do their work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04FinalNo_0003d4ac_Oblivion_RES: Damn, I knew it! You're working for the city guard aren't you? I didn't think they would be stupid enough to send someone alone, but so be it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2aa_Oblivio: Damn. I was afraid this might happen. Poor Dunmer. Please, go tell Llevana the sad news. I must ponder the situation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356af_Oblivion_RESP1: Damn. Killed himself. Must have had some sort of magic item we didn't notice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13Choice3A_00003a78_Oblivion_RE: Damned amateurs. You people should leave it to the professionals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinA1_00082dc6_Oblivion_RE: Danger, you say? You came here to tell me this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ab8_Oblivion_RESP1: Danus Artellian, captain of the guard. The Count's Guard. Castle Guard. Dion's captain of the town guard. That's nothing to do with me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFence02_000165e9_Oblivion_RESP1: Dar Jee lives in Leyawiin. He doesn't have much money, but he's got more than Ongar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_0002873b_Oblivion_RESP: Dar-Ma is the daugher of Seed-Neeus, the owner of Northern Goods and Trade.  You'll often find her out taking the air near the Great Oak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e4ab_Obli: Dark-dark. We've been yinging a zeffle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f9c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Darkfathom Cave isn't that far from here, but the route may be treacherous. Be careful, and journey safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_0006834e_Oblivion_RES: Darkness may be upon us all, but the people of the Empire -- my Empire -- are worth fighting for! I just wanted you to know... I won't let you down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea3_Oblivion_RES: Darn. They only train in blade and heavy armor at the Bruma hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c253_Oblivion_RES: Davide Surilie and his brother make some fine wines. It's a really impressive vineyard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AzaniBlackheartTOPIC_0002c58b_Obl: Dead, finally. Good work. Did you retrieve his ring? I want that as proof that the Blackwood Company didn't defeat him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DSDead_0002367f_Oblivion_RESP: Dead, you say? ... you mean you ... did it really have to come to that? Well, if that was the only solution ... I suppose I should thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38TSDead_0002367e_Oblivion_RESP: Dead, you say? ... you mean you ... did it really have to come to that? Well, if that was the only solution ... I suppose I should thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DSDead_000be416_Oblivion_RESP: Dead, you say? Well, then... you may as well finish what you started. [Scribbles something on a piece of paper.] Here. This is your last task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GaltusPreviaTOPIC_0002d70f_Oblivi: Dead. I can't believe it. So much death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcSpectators_0007ead5_Oblivi: Dead. I warned them, didn't I?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002f9e3_Obliv: Dead? Dead! What happened? A journal? Let me see that... Blackwood Company! Bastards! Rank amateurs!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002f9e4_Obliv: Dead? It can't be!  What happened? You didn't think to find some evidence? Get back there. Find out what went wrong, dammit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03Choice1A_00023f3e_Oblivion_: Dead? Me? There... there must be some mistake.... I'm just an old man! Just an old man!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_0003d084_Oblivion_: Deal! I can sell it for twice that price, to the right customer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624e7_Oblivion_RES: Dear Brother, I do not spread rumors. I create them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624ea_Oblivion_RES: Dear Sister, I do not spread rumors. I create them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00005670_Oblivion_RESP1: Dear Speaker, when darkness shrouds the Empire, we can travel to the resting place of the Night Mother, and begin the ritual of awakening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000286d5_Oblivion_RESP1: Dear friend, have you heard? Two of the guests now lie dead! If I find out who did it, I may have to take matters into my own hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000286d8_Oblivion_RESP1: Dear friend, three of the guests have been killed! You and I, we must stay close. Band together, for mutual protection!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18NightConvo_000096df_Oblivio: Dearest Night Mother! Most Unholy Maiden! Please, we beg your mercy in this, our time of need! The Black Hand seeks your guidance!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06ShoutStartAttack_00054fa3_Obl: Death to the Mazken! For the glory of Sheogorath!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Decentius Opsius, Captain of the Coast Guard. Pleased to meet you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004575b_Oblivion_RESP1: Decided to mend your ways? It's the dungeon for you, then, since you lack the gold for reparations. Your stolen goods are forfeit, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_00015459_Oblivio: Dedicated to the last! I cannot thank you enough for bringing the gem here. I have need of it immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: Deetsan loves to talk about his guild. It's good that he's proud of his work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e997_Oblivion_RES: Deetsan must be the happiest Mages Guild member in all of Tamriel. I think it was always his dream to join.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_defaulted_00024291_Oblivion_RESP1: Defaulted? I suppose so. I'm not paid enough to do the job. I was supposed to find Brenus Astis' Journal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_defaulted_0002e59f_Oblivion_RESP1: Defaulted? That all you talk about? I'm Blackwood Company now. Plenty of work, the pay is good, and I don't have Oreyn on my back all the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001c0dd_Oblivion_RESP1: Defeating an Arena Hero is one thing, but defeating a former member of the Blades? You must be blessed by the Divines or somethin', my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000355a8_Oblivion_RE: Delmar at the Chironasium can help you with the staff. See him right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000355a5_Oblivion_RE: Delmar at the Chironasium can help you with the staff. You still need wood from the grove before he can create your staff. Get it immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002285c_Oblivion_RESP: Delmar handles all staff enchantments. You'll need to speak to him about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d6_Oblivion_RESP1: Delphine Jend. Creator of the celebrated 'Enemies Explode' spell. Advanced Trainer in Destruction. And Mage Destined for Great Things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0002d06e_Oblivion: Delphine can get you a spell to summon bound armor, if you're interested. And if you're able, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441eb_Oblivion_RES: Dementia has a new ruler! Perhaps a new fork for Big Head as well!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ResistArrest_000459b6_Oblivion_RE: Dementia is not outside the reach of my Lord's justice, whatever you may think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2A_00032be9_Oblivi: Deposit this finger in the desk of Phillida's successor, in his office in the Prison Barracks, in the Imperial City! Do this, and the bonus is yours!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2B_00032bea_Oblivi: Deposit this finger in the desk of Phillida's successor, in his office in the Prison Barracks, in the Imperial City! Do this, and the bonus is yours!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2C_00032beb_Oblivi: Deposit this finger in the desk of Phillida's successor, in his office in the Prison Barracks, in the Imperial City! Do this, and the bonus is yours!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00077b23_Oblivion_RESP1: Dervenin, High Priest of Mania at your service. What brings you to this holy place on such a fine day?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003de52_Oblivion_RES: Dervera Romalen is sure proud of the Newlands lodge. I think she's especially happy that the Red Queen drinks there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e95b_Oblivion_RES: Dervera Romalen seems pleased that so many folks drink at the Newlands lodge. She takes great pride in it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Betrothed_0008efd1_Oblivion_R: Desideratus is a gentle fool. I never should have allowed him to take up the sword. My curse will not allow me to help you with his need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Betrothed_000135d0_Oblivion_R: Desideratus is a little too attached to that doll, if you know what I mean. They don't like to dance. It gives me the creeps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023f7b_Oblivion_RESP2: Despite this misfortune, you are ready for advancement. I appoint you Slayer for the Dark Brotherhood. Now go, and continue to serve Sithis well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003489e_Oblivion_RESP4: Despite this recent lapse in professionalism, your overall efforts have been commendable. It's time you were advanced to the rank of Eliminator.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09ChoiceGoOn_00022b69_Oblivion_: Despite what your Council may think, I've not thrown in with the Necromancers, and would never do so. You may pass along that message.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062bec_Oblivion_RESP1: Destroying the Great Gate was a deed worthy of the mightest heroes of song and legend! You dealt the daedra a heavy blow that day, my friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c209_Oblivi: Destruction spells can cause a lot of damage. Knowing enough could make you a dangerous person.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_000253c7_Oblivion_RES: Determine what she's after, and how we may be rid of her. I do not want her here, spreading her lies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002925_Knights_RESP1: Dibella and Mara will be avenged!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0af_Oblivion_RESP: Dibella has shed her special blessings on Anvil. We greet travelers with hospitality, and the needy with an open hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTombSpeech_00002d06_Knights_RES: Dibella has strengthened your wit and charm. Never allow the beauty of the world to be lost on your eyes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Spoon_000781f9_Oblivion_RESP2: Did Cindanwe send you to steal this? How did you get this from Kishashi?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea9_Oblivion_RES: Did I give you the key after lockup last night? I really can't remember.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10JakKnewGrayFox_00015312_Obliv: Did I know him personally? Of course not. He lived 300 years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002950_Knights_RESP1: Did I not say we would meet again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022a7f_Oblivion_RESP1: Did I not tell you to avoid contact with us? Travel along the road, and act normally. We shall be shadowing you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000781ea_Oblivion_RESP3: Did Kishashi send you with something? A certain utensil, or weapon... depending on who you ask?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed9_Oblivion_RES: Did Thadon send you? Oh... I forgot he's happy again. Well, who sent you then? My word, your pinchers are huge! Stay back!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture4_00071957_Oblivion: Did battlemages activate runestones on arrival, thus lighting arcane beacons within the next runestone?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e3ff_Oblivion_RESP2: Did he mention me, perhaps? Or was there something else you wanted to discuss?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005375a_Oblivion_RESP1: Did that fetcher give you any information?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b3ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Did we get them all?... Are there more?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f9c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you bring back my aquanostrum?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a09_Knights_RESP: Did you ever hear about the ghost of Lord Vlindrel? They say he haunts the road to Chorrol. Not that I've ever seen him myself, mind you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0009f8be_Oblivion_RE: Did you ever meet Dar-Ma? Young Argonian lass, popular around town. She's disappeared, and her mother is worried sick about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServicetoLeyawiinTopic_00175bc8_O: Did you find out why the Orc is here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49DukeDeadNice_00091c59_Oblivio: Did you find the Count's ring, by any chance?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_00037cf5_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you find the room? Remember, upstairs at the end of the hallway. Last room on your right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000781e8_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you get Cindanwe's notebook? The one with all our secrets in it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e984_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear Deetsan talking about the Mages Guild again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e253_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear Eitar stirring things up again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e2ad_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear about Ahdarji picking another fight with an Argonian?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00037a7e_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear about Bradon Lirrian? A vampire hunter named Raynil Dralas made his way into town, snuck into his house and killed him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028d71_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear about Glarthir going crazy and attacking people with an axe?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00029aaa_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear about Glarthir? Thank the Nine that the guard stopped him before he killed someone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002ba55_Oblivion_RE: Did you hear about Reynald Jemane's long lost twin brother returning to Chorrol?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_0003572d_Oblivion_R: Did you hear about the Blackwood Company? They were all mad murderers hopped up on hist? And crooked, thieving frauds?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00066cd1_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear about the discovery at Pale Pass? It's in the new Black Horse Courier. Here. Take my copy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a17_Knights_RESP: Did you hear about the knight that stopped the attack on the chapel? It would have been destroyed for sure!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e55_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear about the pair of green recruits that cleaned out a den of thieves near Anvil?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043005_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear about the two Argonians that walked into a tavern? The second one should have seen it coming. Ahaha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003dfa9_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear how upset Tsrava is about all the dogs that J'bari has in his yard?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028749_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear that Dar-Ma came back, safe and sound?  You know, Seed-Neeus's daughter, the Argonians.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028746_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear that Dar-Ma has disappeared?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062675_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear that Falcar left the guild? I think Deetsan is in charge in Cheydinhal now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0001fe8d_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear that Necromancers attacked the grove at Wellspring Cave?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006444b_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear that someone broke into an Imperial Legion post and stole the taxes they collected from the Waterfront?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006268a_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear that someone played yet another prank on Jeanne Frasoric in Bruma? I don't know how she keeps falling for these things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00002d30_Knights_RESP1: Did you hear that the Chapel in Bravil's been attacked? Just like Anvil! Where will it stop?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064464_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear that the Earl of Imbel's house was robbed?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00002d2d_Knights_RESP1: Did you hear that the Knights of the Nine are gathering holy relics?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081dbe_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear that? Did you? Voices from nowhere, madmen... where does it end? How did I get this posting?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081da8_Oblivion_RESP2: Did you hear that? Oh boy...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028745_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear the bad news?  Dar-Ma's daughter was killed by some strange cultists down in Hackdirt. Terrible, terrible times we live in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003f150_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear the news? Ulrich Leland was thrown in the dungeons for stealing money from the city coffers. Haha! Justice for the little guy!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007301f_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear the one about the Argonian Maid?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000363b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Did you hear what happened to Ruslan and Luronk? One of the Watchmen fleeced them for all their coin!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006445a_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear what happened? Someone robbed the wizard's tower. Fathis Aren got what he deserved, if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00029aa7_Oblivion_R: Did you hear? He went crazy and started attacking people with an axe! Luckily the guards stopped him before he killed anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064453_Oblivion_RES: Did you hear? Hieronymus Lex was reassigned to Anvil.
