ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003a84e_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you really think we can close that thing?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00035df1_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you recall the name Adamus Phillida? The Imperial Legion pest? It's time he joined Sithis in the Void. Think you're up to the task?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadBrellin1_00002cfb_Knigh: Do you remember Sir Brellin? His death still troubles me, at times. I don't know why. A knight should not fear death, and yet...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk2_0006a861_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you remember that matter you asked me to look into? I have some new information. In short... What you proposed IS possible!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040362_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you require assistance with the task Sheogorath has given you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_00078fd8_Oblivio: Do you seek to deepen my despair by reminding me of my greatest failure?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002912_Knights_RESP1: Do you still have questions, Crusader?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f471_Oblivion_RES: Do you suppose the armies will start killing people now? I'd keep an accurate count of all the corpses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AAnya_00013a6e_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you take me for a fool? How do I know you aren't acting as an agent of Dementia?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060537_Oblivion_RES: Do you think Sheogorath died? I know He's missing. I want to see His corpse if He's dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000465e6_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think anyone in Bravil knows more about Tamriel than Ita Rienus?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028242_Obli: Do you think he could have done it? He comes across as something of a drunk, but you never can tell what someone is capable of.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004f774_Oblivion_RES: Do you think he followed us? How could he?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004f775_Oblivion_RES: Do you think she followed us? How could she?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetGreetA1_00002aac_Knights: Do you think that a quest for holy relics usually starts with a lie?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028bba_Oblivion_RES: Do you think that stranger's here looking for the girl?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c153_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think the attack will come soon, ma'am?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c154_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think the attack will come soon, sir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009098f_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think there are any more of those assassins about?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef2f_Oblivion_RES: Do you think those Knights will come here? I hope they do! I'd be the first to fall before them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004d0b4_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think we have a chance, ma'am?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004d0b3_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think we have a chance, sir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00054672_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think we stand a chance?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029c1_Knights_RESP1: Do you think we took them by surprise?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b45_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think we're safe for a few minutes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1fd_Oblivion_RES: Do you think what happened to Kvatch could happen here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000411fe_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you think you can spare a little something for an old friend? You know I'm good for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHircineChoice1_0001ec5f_Oblivio: Do you think yourself a hunter? Then approach the Shrine of Hircine. Leave our lord an offering.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fd0_Obli: Do you think? I've never noticed anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetStartA3_00002c84_Knights: Do you understand nothing? The blood speaks! I can read the ancient runes, if you cannot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5a3_Oblivion_: Do you understand, or do I need to use even smaller words?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014dc9_AltarDeluxe_RES: Do you want another treasure blessed by Akatosh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Positions_00015451_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you want me to stay back, or stay up nearer to the door?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062ccf_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you want something from me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f8_Oblivion_RES: Do you want to know a secret? It was I who killed the Gatekeeper. I poisoned him with an apple!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000498b8_Oblivion_RESP1: Do you want to learn about Alteration? Speak with Dovyn Aren.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002976_Knights_RESP2: Do you wish to learn what little I know?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028170_Oblivion_RE: Do... do you think he could have done it? I mean, he is a retired soldier. He's killed before. Oh, dear, this can't be happening!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00046603_Oblivion_RESP1: Does Delphine Jend make you a bit nervous?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000498bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Does Dovyn Aren still teach Alteration?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043f40_Oblivion_RESP1: Does Your Grace wish to be crushed to death, or do you merely find difficulty in locating the buttons and switches in these old ruins?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488dd_Oblivion_RESP1: Does anyone see City-Swimmer? Is he gliding beneath the silver water? Is he creeping 'round a corner, hugging a wall, silent as a shadow in the dark?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002825d_Oblivion_RE: Does being a soldier make him a good person? Does it make him above murder? I hardly think so.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009591a_Obliv: Does my Champion summon me? Before I've even told you what to do? That's not very Champion-y. Not at all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetStartA2_00002c82_Knights: Does no one remember the old tales?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013ff3_Oblivio: Does that pain you, Kithlan? Unless you want to feel it again, you'd best tell us what you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07BribeBeggar2_00098395_Oblivio: Does the Lonely Suitor Lodge sound familiar? Try there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008e4e2_Oblivion_RESP1: Does the air seem thicker than normal?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AhdarjisStolenRing_00009330_O: Does the hunter have this one's ring?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscRelmynaExperiment_00046f4: Does this hurt more or less than last time?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39RanarrJo_000781f7_Oblivion_RE: Doesn't get as much work done as he should. He's always turning things over to look under them, searching for who-knows-what.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImpGallTOPIC_0002ee64_Oblivion_RE: Doesn't look like you have it yet. Let me know when you do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e99b_Oblivion_RESP1: Doesn't something seem wrong with that abandoned house in town?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_0002c309_Obl: Doesn't that have something to do with the Ayleids, and magical control over the weather? I think that's the rumor I heard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008e4e9_Oblivion_RESP1: Doesn't that noise bother anyone else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0000c015_Oblivion_R: Doesn't the hunter have prey to follow?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e82_Obliv: Dog? You greet me as a Breton, the mongrel race of Tamriel, motherless lackeys of every great empire that ever conquered your homeland?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e88_Obliv: Dog? You greet me as a fellow, then, you tusk-faced brute.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024de4_Oblivion_RE: Dogs are an orc's best friend. Good protection, good companions, good eats. The Bruiants have dogs. Lots of 'em.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_0004f8bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Doing a bit of digging, I'm afraid Rosentia's been stuck with the Staff of the Everscamp. Nasty bit of "fun" by Sheogorath, I'd say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingDontCare_000131d7_: Don't I? I thought I did. But then I also thought that you would be heavier. Look at you, you're light as a chair. How DO you walk around like that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingLong_000131da_Obli: Don't answer that. I know the answer. I knew far more answers once, but they seem to have dried up. Or perhaps they drowned. I don't know anymore.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fb6a_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't bare your teeth at me, you beast! How about you use those fangs on my double?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004f793_Oblivion_RES: Don't be afraid. My guardians will not harm you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d495_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't be angry at us. This is the only way we could find the place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Victims_00081fdc_Oblivion_RES: Don't be concerned. I always return the worthy ones to life. Besides, Lord Sheogorath has sanctioned my studies and my methods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityNotNow_00043414_Oblivio: Don't be discouraged! Some people just have better luck than others in finding Oddities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_000182ae_Oblivion_: Don't be fooled by your next opponent. The little dagger he uses is actually a powerful enchanted weapon called Shimmerstrike. Now go get 'em!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013ffa_Oblivion_RESP4: Don't be fooled, the Ritual isn't over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFlameofAgnonTopic_00019ad1_Obli: Don't be frightened, they won't harm you. They look much fiercer than they really are, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDWait_00002b54_Knights_RESP1: Don't be long. I'd rather we stick together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041203_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't be shy. I'm really very approachable. You wanted an autograph, is that it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dd6_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't be shy. Join us, and do well by doing good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkoomaNo_0008f784: Don't be so cruel! I hope you die a horrible death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08Choice4_000356f5_Oblivion_RE: Don't be stupid. We have returned with the Hist itself. One beautiful Hist, who gives her gifts to all the Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006dc2d_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't be the last to read today's Black Horse Courier!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c351_Oblivi: Don't be upset. I knew what I was doing the moment I asked you to lead Ulrich to me. I was fully aware of the consequences.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017201_Oblivion_RESP3: Don't bother to come back until you have it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc1f_Oblivion_RES: Don't bother trying to kill a Skinned Hound with a fireball. They are invincible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c3f_Oblivion_RES: Don't bother using a frost spell on a Shambles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08AleronHunt_0001fdbc_Oblivion_: Don't bother. The door to this place is now locked. The only way to get out is by decending into the Hunter's Run and killing the Hunters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003aaac_Oblivion_RES: Don't bring up religion around Else God-Hater. She's likely to use that sword of hers on you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091c4f_Oblivion_RESP3: Don't come back here without him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038a8d_Oblivion_R: Don't count on seeing the Count at the castle. He's a great sorcerer, but he doesn't like visitors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ff2_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't eat me! For the love of Sheogorath! Please, don't eat me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f022_Oblivion_RES: Don't eat me! You're worse than those knights in the Fringe!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d6d_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't eat me. DON'T EAT ME! By Sheogorath's beard, you're a mean looking one!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c42cc_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't falter! We have them! We have them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_000242ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't feel bad -- no one lives forever!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008e4de_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't feel bad that you're not as gifted as me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_00031522_Oblivion_RES: Don't forget to check with Bittneld, the Captain of the Guard, my Steward, Orok gro-Ghoth and my herald, Laythe Wavrick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47Counterspell_0003012f_Oblivio: Don't forget to wear that ring I gave you when you cast the spell. Not that there's anything to worry about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003160c_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't forget who your friends are, or they may just become your enemy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027120_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't forget, Captain Burd needs your help to close the Oblivion Gate outside of Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk2_0006fdd6_Oblivion_RESP: Don't forget, my friend -- you and I are what stand between order and chaos. Without us, the Empire would crumble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterExit_0003d08d_Oblivion_RESP: Don't forget, only I can fence the most difficult items.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GoodbyeKvatch04_0018ad64_Oblivion: Don't forget. Camoran Usurper burned Kvatch, too. Kvatch was rebuilt from ruins once before, and she'll do it again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004c5b0_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't forget: be down here at 10 PM. I'll see you then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004c5b1_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't forget: the living quarters at 10 PM. I'll see you there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPykeZoeMaleneResponses_00091b50: Don't fret, my love... I'm here. Be happy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000852b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't get any ideas about wandering off alone. I'm keeping my eye on everyone, including you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DionneWarnChoice2_0001dcc3_Ob: Don't get involved with him. If he asks you to do anything... strange... you come see me first, got it? Or any of the town Guard. Let us handle it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AncotarTopic_000301ea_Oblivion_RE: Don't get me wrong, some of my best friends are elves. But self-important jerks like Ancotar give them all a bad name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046600_Oblivion_RES: Don't get on J'skar's bad side. You'll likely get a fireball in your face for your troubles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NQDGuardWarning_0018d1dc_Oblivion: Don't get too close to the prisoners.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0001c900_Oblivion_RES: Don't get too many folks passing through here these days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfb9_Oblivion_RE: Don't get your tail in a knot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenRenote_0000b225_Oblivion_R: Don't give me a reason to kill you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c13b_Oblivion_RESP2: Don't give the enemy a chance to recover from their defeat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GoodbyeKvatch03_0018ad62_Oblivion: Don't give up. You're not alone. And the chapels and the Elder Council will help us. It just takes time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081dbd_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't go back in there. I'm warning you. You'll end up like the others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000852b5_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't go far. It's too dangerous to go wandering around this house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432d3_Oblivion_RES: Don't hurt me, okay? Do you want a bone? I'll tell you a secret. They say a new adventurer has come. Don't bite me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_000329f4_Oblivion_RESP: Don't judge Farwil too harshly. Most of what he says is... fabricated. But he's young, and therefore quite brash and inexperienced.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be9e_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't just stand there -- get rid of those ogres! Stab them! Burn them! Tear their throats out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003661f_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't just stand there! Go get that mountain lion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't keep the Gray Fox waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003d4bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't keep us waiting. I hate to wait.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001d04b_Oblivion_R: Don't know anyone by that name. Now go away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003d4ca_Oblivion_RES: Don't know if this is true, but I heard a gang of all female thieves is preying on the married menfolk of the town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241dc_Oblivion_RES: Don't know why anyone would visit the other cities of Cyrodill. Chorrol has it all. And a fairly low murder rate!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeHelmet_0001f3e2_Oblivion: Don't know why you'd want to cover up that gorgeous head of yours, but here you go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00015131_Oblivion_RES: Don't know. But it's too late to go back now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004e95c_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't leave before you hear what I have to tell you. You'll regret it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00060332_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't let Toutius Sextius catch you following him. He's much more dangerous than he looks!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c30_Oblivi: Don't let her looks deceive you, friend. I've seen black widows like her before! Her crimes must not go unpunished! Justice is at hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00098381_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't let the guards catch you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0009f985_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't let the ogres get me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004a994_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't make me show you to the door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThurindilTopic_0003e0d6_Oblivion_: Don't mind him. He's not right in the head. Poor fellow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00064460_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't pay attention to those rumors. There is no such thing as a Thieves Guild. The Gray Fox is just a thief the Watch hasn't caught yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05No_0000a234_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't play games with me. This isn't the time for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000517a7_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't provoke them. They don't trust you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45BrethrenTopic_00028218_Oblivi: Don't push your luck, stranger.  Plenty of folks have turned up dead after asking questions like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001db23_Obli: Don't really know him. He lives across the way from Seridur I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c3a_Oblivion_RES: Don't run into the water to escape a Scalon. They'll follow you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenBaurus_0000b207_Oblivion_R: Don't say I didn't warn you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArdalineTopic_0002ba25_Oblivion_R: Don't say anything to her. I don't want to embarrass her further. Once this is all taken care of, I'll speak to her privately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22SrazirrAgreed_0002c528_Oblivi: Don't screw this one, though. After the dust settles, look for S'razirr in the Tiber Septim Inn in the Imperial City. Full payment is expected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025df5_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't speak to me again, unless you've gotten twenty minotaur horns. Then, perhaps we'll have something to discuss.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030208_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't speak to me further until you've rented a room. Then I'll come find you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't spend all the money from the reward in one place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00132a8d_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't spend all the money from the reward in one place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b686_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't stand too close. I need room to swing my weapon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081193_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't take all day making your choices.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003ca90_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't take this sojourn lightly. The recesses of the mind can be the darkest place of all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseTooMuchCheydinhal_0004f214_O: Don't take too long raising the funds. I have several other interested buyers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa9e_Oblivio: Don't talk to Horkvir about it. He won't know anything. Especially not our Horkvir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224a7_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't talk to me now! Kill the filthy creatures!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0012dd31_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't talk to me. Talk to the one in the robes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05BaurusB_00022b15_Oblivion_RES: Don't talk. Just follow my lead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c363_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't tarry... get Ulrich here soon before he changes his mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutside_000790ad_Oblivio: Don't tease me. It's serious. I could die. We all could die! Please, help find a safe spot outside to sleep where the walls won't come crashing down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08SavillasStoneTopic_0009838d_O: Don't tell Hridi I said anything. I could be banished for telling you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624ef_Oblivion_RES: Don't tell anyone else, but some day I'm going to have Ocheeva's position. Just you wait and see. Lucien Lachance knows real talent when he sees it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5e7_Oblivion_: Don't tell me Falcar's given you the same task he gave Vidkun!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e72_Oblivion_RES: Don't tell me Maglir is acting up again. Has he screwed up another contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2ac_Obliv: Don't tell me you've never heard of him! He's famous for his skill with a blade. And at his young age.... He'll be a legend one day, mark my words.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00049938_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't the Verus brothers run a good shop?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000608b6_Oblivion_RES: Don't think for a second that this war is actually over. Stay on your guard. The agents of the enemy lurk everywhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VenaPetilius_00026b49_Oblivion_RE: Don't think he ever forgave himself for not being there when she passed. He swore then never to raise a weapon again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_0018d832_Oblivi: Don't think you're getting away with something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0002819a_Oblivion: Don't trust her, sweetie. Not a thing she says. If she tries to get you alone anywhere, get away as fast as you can! She's a cold-blooded killer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002732a_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't try anything. I'm watching you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_0003d07c_Oblivion_RESP: Don't try to cheat me you misbegotten whelp!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a27_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't try to slow me down. I'm going to get that diary before you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028251_Obliv: Don't try to turn me against Primo! For all I know, you could be the killer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ02Skooma_0018917d_Oblivion_RESP: Don't turn your back on Lonavo for a second. He wouldn't think twice about burying his blade there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0000bce6_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't wait too long to decide.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05reject_0000a1b6_Oblivion_RESP: Don't wait too long. We really need the help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5a7_Oblivion_: Don't waste my time if you're not ready for this. Are you prepared to do what is necessary to gain a recommendation from me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10NoBoots_00015311_Oblivion_RES: Don't waste my time. Not in the mood for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ADMIREHATE_0018b2aa_Oblivion_RESP: Don't waste your flattery on me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007817d_Oblivion_RES: Don't waste your wonderful poisons on Skinned Hounds. They seem to like them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuySkingrad_0004f217_Oblivio: Don't worry about Vandorallen Trebatius. I'll have him evicted. I'm sure he'll find another home easily.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00023667_Oblivion_R: Don't worry about him. We'll handle it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000343f6_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't worry about me, my friend. I know I'm in good hands here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089936_Oblivion_RESP2: Don't worry about me; there's no time! Get moving!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc1b_Oblivion_RES: Don't worry about the Elytra's stingers. They aren't poisonous.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillXaselm_00081a4c_Oblivi: Don't worry if you break her toys. I believe she rather enjoys creating them. And, it keeps her from turning her attention elsewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008673d_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't worry, I hold no grudges. You bested me! I am man enough to admit it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsStartCombat_00002b3f_Kni: Don't worry, I'll take this one!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscRelmynaExperiment_00046f4: Don't worry, if you die I will bring you back to life. We have much left to accomplish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ShadyDeal_0001e7eb_Oblivion_R: Don't worry, it will be very soon. Now get outta' here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00018e5e_Oblivion_RE: Don't worry, its bark is far worse than its bite. Hahaha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a9343_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't worry, my friend, this time we are on the same side! Umbacano wants us both to guide him through Nenalata.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008585c_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't worry, my friend. I'm going to show this slinking cutthroat how the Imperial Legion takes care of things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000be43d_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't worry, pal, you'll get used to losing after a while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00015132_Oblivion_RES: Don't worry, sire, we will get you out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ClaudeMaricTopic_0002c52c_Oblivio: Don't worry, this one will back you up when the time comes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight2Female_00002cdd_: Don't worry, we all miss her. She was a fine knight, and died in service to Kynareth and the Nine. Try to let that be a comfort to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CloudRulerTempleTopic_0003406b_Ob: Don't worry, we'll keep the Emperor Martin safe here. No enemy has ever taken Cloud Ruler from the Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight2Male_00002ce2_Kn: Don't worry, you're not alone. His death saddens me, too, at times. At least he died a Knight of the Nine, eh? I hope to die so well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026e9e_Oblivion: Don't worry. Anvil's soldiers are worth two from anywhere else. Bruma will not fall!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril4_00002c4c_Knights_RE: Don't worry. I have days where I feel the same way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_000add0b_Oblivi: Don't worry. The Elder Council can govern the Empire perfectly well until a new heir can be found.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Response_000452f1_Oblivion_RE: Don't you dare touch anything in my house! You'll ruin my research. Hmmm. Would you be willing to run an errand for me? I'll pay you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028249_Obli: Don't you even care that Nels is dead? Maybe you killed him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bab3_Oblivion_RES: Don't you even care what's happening? Bruma has been saved! The Great Gate has been closed! There is hope for us all, whether you like it or not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_000465a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you find Fathis Aren's skill in Conjuration impressive?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00067700_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you have a book to read? Or something else very important I've told you to do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ae00_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you have a fight scheduled? I'm sorry, but I can't allow you to bet on your own match! You'd best get into the Arena!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004f3ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you have a rat problem to be handling, boot?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ffc_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you have something better to do than bother perfectly innocent people with your idiotic rambling? But if you insist, go right on ahead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009d9f3_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you have something to do?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00022a07_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you have something to find?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000175bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you have somewhere else to be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa74_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you have work to do? Like getting rid of those Demented bastards?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06WantGauntlets_00002b0b_Knight: Don't you know the story behind them? I'm not, ahh, familiar with all the details, but I know roughly what happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40GreetingChoice1_000790c1_Obli: Don't you know? You don't, do you? Well, it's lucky you met me. Here you've been walking around as if nothing could happen!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice2A_00090792_Oblivion_: Don't you see? Our Dread Father foresaw your defeat of the traitor, here in this very crypt! You have been chosen! You are to be my new Listener!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2C_000262da_Oblivion_: Don't you see? The traitor somehow switched your orders, and has been sending you to the wrong dead drops! You and I have been deceived.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0004658c_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you think Hafid Hollowleg does a good job at Jerall View?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003e960_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you think Mach-Na runs an excellent bookstore?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a35a_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you understand me? You're trespassing, and must leave, or I'll call the guard!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00085974_Oblivion_RESP1: Don't you worry, my friend. I'll get us out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd5_Obli: Don't you worry, my friend. Nels won't get away with this. Not on my watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice4A_0003018a_Oblivion_RE: Don't you worry, what with the recent killings and all? I'd be ever so scared, if it were me. I haven't left the Inn in days, just in case!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04DoIKnowHer_00019523_Oblivion_: Don't you? If you don't, you might. You wouldn't fall for her, though. Not the type.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture1_00071941_Oblivion: Doomstones have red runes, and are associated with stone circles. Runestones have blue runes, and appear as solitary monuments.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d37_Oblivion: Dovesi couldn't have been any more than fifteen years old. What threat could she have posed? Why was she murdered? Damn it, I mean to find out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028cdd_Oblivion: Dovesi is a Dark Elf. They call themselves Dunmer. When I was young, I spent some time stationed at Fort Moonmoth on their homeland of Morrowind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a06_Oblivion: Dovesi is a sweet young lass. She reminds me of someone I knew. But perhaps we should talk about something else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0002870f_Oblivion: Dovesi is young and weak, yet the killer left her alive. Why? She couldn't possibly have anything to do with the murders... could she?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028ce0_Oblivion: Dovesi's upset by the murder but she'll be okay. I get the sense she's seen worse things in her life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047694_Oblivion_RESP1: Dovyn Aren. Yeah, I still do training. I'm not what I used to be, but I can still teach Alteration just fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00002a35_Knights_RESP1: Down with you, in the name of Father Akatosh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LordDradEstates_000981fd_Oblivion: Drad purchased the land and title from Council. It cost him a fortune, and he's determined to make it pay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LordDradTOPIC_000981fa_Oblivion_R: Drad's a fancy pants who lives in a pretty house with a pretty wife because he screws over folks like you and me. He makes us puke.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName12_00038b45_Oblivio: Dragonheart, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476d8_Oblivion_RESP1: Dralora Athram. I came here with Ulen fifteen years ago. Best thing we ever did.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Dranas Llethro. I just got back from Solstheim. Boy, was that a mess. And now I'm out of work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Passwall_0008e4ff_Oblivion_RE: Dredhwen's been selling what they left behind. So, if you need something, talk to her. She's in the Wastrel's Purse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488cf_Oblivion_RESP1: Drels Theran. I'm the count's Special Inquisitor in charge of suppressing the Renrijra Krin insurgents.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Drink up and eat something. You'll need your strength.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a564c_Oblivion_RESP1: Drink. Drink! We need to go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009816c_Oblivion_RESP1: Drink. It is time to go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488cb_Oblivion_RESP1: Dro'Nahrah. I'm Count Bravil's steward. I'm sorry, but please, I have too much on my mind to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488da_Oblivion_RESP1: Dro'shanji greets you. His work is the castle grounds, grand gardens green. Dro'shanji also is Advanced Trainer in Security.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Steal_000624f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Drop it, you sticky-palmed little worm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045751_Oblivion_RESP1: Drop your weapon! Hand over your stolen goods and face the Lord's justice. Pay your due reparations, or it's the dungeon for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_0006261a_Oblivion: Druja has a wide variety of spells for sale, if there's something you need. Most of them are simple, but they're a good starting point.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0005c0d8_Oblivion_RESP1: Drunk with madness! Madness for all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c3b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Due to outstanding fines owed to the city, Aldos Othran's property has been seized and is now sealed until further notice. Good day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec2_Oblivion_RES: Duke Thadon's got his happy juice back, I hear. Good for him. He's always kept things very orderly. I like him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498a7_Oblivion_RES: Dul gro-Shug always seems at ease in light armor. He moves well in it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047688_Oblivion_RESP1: Dul gro-Shug. I could show you a thing or two about Security... for a small consideration.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f370_Oblivion_RESP1: Dulphumph gro-Urgash, Scalon killer. You'll keep quiet, if you know what's good for you. Never know when one might be sneaking up behind you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825db_Oblivion_RES: Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron is collecting that Amber you find in the root tunnels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e082_Oblivion_RESP1: Dumania Jirich, Primate of Anvil. I speak with the voice of Dibella, and greet you with love.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00013385_Obli: Dunroot Burrow is your goal, my friend. And what a goal it is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef0e_Oblivion_RES: During these terrible times, I think people need juggling more than ever to take their minds off their troubles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualNoM_00013661_Oblivion_R: During this, the exiting regent imbibes three doses of the potent drug. This causes his heart to burst... and his lifeblood flows from his body.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_00024289_Oblivion_RESP1: Duties for you. Fine. I'll speak slowly so you can keep up. I want you to contact Maglir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0009148f_Oblivion_RES: Duty calls, citizen. Madgod's blessings upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002c5a0_Oblivion_RESP1: Duty. That's what all this is about, isn't it? The Blackwood Company is destroying us. They steal our contracts; they steal our members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBows_000908df_Oblivion_RESP1: Each Black Bow you bring me means another Black Bow Bandit slain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AInstExplainChoices_00018dfd_: Each chamber presents two options. When you push the appropriate button, an event will unfold for the adventurers to experience.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03Reactivated_0008e94b_Oblivion: Each crystal has a matching receptacle called a Judgment Nexus. Even you can't miss them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000275c3_Oblivion_RESP1: Each guest, at some point in the past, wronged their mysterious host. Now he's hired us to exact his revenge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08ObeliskTopic_00043f6c_Oblivio: Each heart will increase the power of the obelisk until it eventually overloads and shuts down, closing the portal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08ObeliskTopic_0008247f_Oblivio: Each heart will increase the power of the obelisk until it eventually overloads and shuts down, closing the portal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bd0_Oblivion: Each local guild hall has its own way of doing things. That means each hall has its own set of problems.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ForlornWatchman_00035d8f_Oblivion: Each night, he wanders the shore of Niben Bay. Then he stops and looks mournfully out to sea.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscRelmynaExperiment_00046f4: Each person's pain threshold is different, isn't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0000ab72_Oblivion_R: Each tribe guards a head in its lair. Whose head, I don't know. A sacred tribal totem or something like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Brithaur_00078665_Oblivion_RE: Earil has a big problem with Brithaur. I don't know exactly what the problem is, but it's safe to say Earil is making a huge fuss over it.
Earil owns a magic shop in town called Earil's Mysteries. If you want to know more, I'd suggest you ask him yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078167_Oblivion_RES: Earil's Mysteries sells a number of unique spells. Doesn't sell any mysteries, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047691_Oblivi: East of the city, at the head of the Red River, is a shrine to Vaermina.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005df55_Oblivion_RESP1: Eat well, while you have your health. I'm sure I have something that would interest you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004765a_Oblivion_RESP1: Edgar Vautrine. You don't want the very best. You want cheap. And I got cheap.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Edla. Edla Dark-Heart. If you want to be a Marksman, I can train you. If you can breathe, I can teach you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7b_Oblivion_RESP1: Eh? Oh... I'm sorry. I was just... nothing. Never mind. I am Ranarr-Jo. I work the fields here in Fellmoor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00067dd2_Oblivion_RESP1: Eh? You again? You ready to hear about an old man's troubles?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e0c_Oblivion_RESP1: Eight of the evening watch, and all's well. And you, too, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ea2_Oblivion_RESP1: Eight of the evening watch, and all's well. And you, too, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e1b_Oblivion_RESP1: Eight of the morning watch, and all's well. Good day, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ee2_Oblivion_RESP1: Eight of the morning watch, and all's well. Good day, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0002f477_Oblivion_R: Either kill the attacking tribe's shaman, or recover the "tribal head" from the rival tribe, which is likely the cause of the war.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LexMyvryna_000355d2_Oblivion_: Either way, it's over. You didn't really think I'd trust the likes of you for very long?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39PodPitYes_00072c9a_Oblivion_R: Either way, you will have a piece of blue sky.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da9d_Oblivion_RESP1: Either you have it, or you don't. Don't play games with me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028246_Obli: Either you or Nels is the killer! I can't trust either of you, so just stay away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_000224e7_Oblivion_RE: Either you're lying to me, or your feeble little mind has forgotten that you put it down someplace. I'm not amused. Go get the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElanteTOPIC_0000344e_Oblivion_RES: Elante is a scholar, interested in researching Daedra worship. Meet her in Brittlerock Cave, help her find the shrine, and keep her safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e53_Oblivion_RES: Elante of Alinor? She's the Daedric scholar, right? She'll live to write again, thanks to the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003ca36_Oblivion_RESP1: Elements... Dreamworld... HA! That's the best yarn I've heard in years!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05DreamworldTopic_0002c6d1_Obli: Elements? Inside a dream? Bah! That's the most foolish thing I've ever heard! Get away from me... you're clearly insane!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000355a5_Oblivion_RE: Eletta and Zahrasha dead? I can't believe it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000355a8_Oblivion_RE: Eletta and Zahrasha dead? I can't believe it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e04_Oblivion_RESP1: Eleven of the evening watch, and all's well. Long day, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e8a_Oblivion_RESP1: Eleven of the evening watch, and all's well. Long day, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e17_Oblivion_RESP1: Eleven of the morning watch, and all's well. Good day, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ec8_Oblivion_RESP1: Eleven of the morning watch, and all's well. Good day, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f84_Oblivio: Eleven! Eleven years in this rat-infested hole! But I'm getting out, and you'll still be stuck in here! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridHot_00023cd0_Oblivion_RESP1: Emfrid? She owns the Grey Mare, right? Huh. I go to the Oak and Crosier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinB3_0001e8d4_Oblivion_RE: Emperor Uriel Septim? You think the emperor is my father?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreA2_00092d82_Oblivion_R: Emperor Uriel? Do you know something about his death?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_0008571a_Oblivi: Emperor, Amulet, and Dragonfire--with these divine gifts, the daedra of Oblivion have been kept at bay for thousands of years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006691a_Oblivion_RES: Emperors have been assassinated before, but this time... I don't know. It's different. Can't you feel it? A shadow has fallen across all of Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047647_Oblivion_RESP1: Enchanted to meet you. Delmar, Enchanter Extraordinaire to the Mages Guild! At your service. Got some enchanting in mind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047648_Oblivi: Enchanting city. A real eye-full. Just walk and gawk. Stroll along the Greenway and around the Palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice1A_00035621_Oblivion_RE: Enchanting staves can be a tricky business. Only certain spells will be truly useful to you, so I'll narrow it down some.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bedd_Oblivion_RESP1: Enjoy the manor. It suits you well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMBladeAll_00014e66_AltarDeluxe_: Enjoy the might of Mehrunes. What else do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMBluntAll_00014e6b_AltarDeluxe_: Enjoy the might of Mehrunes. What else do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMHeavyArmorAll_00014e7b_AltarDe: Enjoy the might of Mehrunes. What else do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMLightArmorAll_00014e75_AltarDe: Enjoy the might of Mehrunes. What else do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18TraitorTalk_000096e3_Oblivi: Enough! Enough of this! You will all suffer for the pain you have caused me! I will destroy your Night Mother, and the Dark Brotherhood will fall!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagSpeech_00063723_Obliv: Enough! I am beaten. The Greymarch is ended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AThadonLeaves_000206bb_Oblivi: Enough! I go to Jyggalag. I give myself to him, as a Priest of Order! This isn't done, Madgod. I think it's just started.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06KanehMirel_00012104_Oblivion_: Enough! I've made my decision. We will attack down the main passage, as planned. The Mazken will not withstand us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice8_000133e7_Obliv: Enter or do not, but make your decision. I've other duties to which I must attend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_0008ef77_Oblivion_RESP1: Ergh! What twisted mind spawned these beasts?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000039bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Eridor says I ain't supposed to chat with people in town. Sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_vampirehunters_000039be_Oblivion_: Eridor's the chap in charge. I've talked to him and Shamar; didn't catch the names of the other two. They'll be back around midnight, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003aaa0_Oblivion_RES: Erina Jeranus isn't the most social inkeeper in the world, but she runs a good, clean house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01AdrienneConv_0002d901_Oblivio: Erm, well... yes. I'll just pack up my supplies and be on my way, then. Thank you for sending someone to help me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeynonPrioryTopic_000247ea_Oblivi: Eronor, a lay brother, tends after the sheep and our little farm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002dc7_Oblivion_RESP1: Err, look. If you're here for information, I'm afraid you'll have to find it on your own. I'm swamped right now; up to my ears in Necromancy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c237_Oblivion_RES: Erthor is causing trouble at the Mages Guild again. Seems his experiments are always blowing up.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028861_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. I need to take these people to the encampment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00071fad_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. I see something I need to clean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_0004891e_Oblivion_RES: Excuse me. I stay to myself. I have always found the wrong sort of friends. Now I do without.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004763a_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. I'm Irlav Jarol, a researcher for Arcane University. Ayleids are my specialty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00068340_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. If you have a moment, I would speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PakseechTopic_000479cc_Oblivion_R: Excuse me. In the Imperial tongue, it means, roughly, 'clan chair' -- the seat of the clan patriarch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024c7a_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. My name is Angalmo. Can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047767_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. Perhaps you're an adventurer? Could you assist me in acquiring something for my crystal collection?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030032_Oblivion_RESP1: Excuse me. We have a small problem that we hope you can help us with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c2b_Oblivi: Excuse me? You want to question me about Matilde? Two people have been murdered, you fool! Get your priorities straight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_000151f9_Oblivio: Exercise caution when approaching the ruins; the Necromancers control that area and you may inadvertently expose your allies' position.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073021_Oblivion_RESP1: Exercise your mind and body through working hard, each and every moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00189cfa_Oblivion_RESP1: Exhausted Mine is not far to the southeast. Be careful, its many twists and turns hide the Goblin hordes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugoTopic_00090b6a_Oblivion: Expect Brugo and his boys in Telepe, Middas, after midnight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinA1_00082dc6_Oblivion_RE: Explain yourself or leave me alone. There are many others here who actually need your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EyeofNocturnalTOPIC_00026ab5_Obli: Eye of Nocturnal? Doesn't sound familiar to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BThadonDeathSpeech04_0007b37c: Eyes as blue as a cerulean sea...uhh...what...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddHappy_00027fa2_Oblivion_R: Fabulous! That's great. Good for you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c22c_Oblivion_RES: Fadus Calidius sure can use a shield. I've never seen him take a hit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ad6_Oblivion_R: Fadus Calidus at the Fighters Guild also teaches Block, but he'd be the first to admit I'm his superior in every way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff10_Oblivion_RE: Faelian used to have money... used to be quite a gentleman, too. But that was before he took a fancy to the... you know. The skooma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0004cf8a_Oblivion_RE: Faelian, you say? Why yes, I know who he is. Rather distasteful fellow, actually. I believe he lives at the Tiber Septim Hotel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0004cf8b_Oblivion_RE: Faelian, you say? Why yes, I know who he is. Rather distasteful fellow, actually. I believe he lives at the Tiber Septim Hotel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff0b_Oblivion_RE: Faelian, you say? Why yes, I know who he is. Rather distasteful fellow, actually. I believe he lives right here, at the Tiber Septim Hotel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff12_Oblivion_RE: Faelian? He... he's my sweet. My true love. But I don't know why I'm telling this to you. I mean, we hardly know each other and all...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_00003887_Oblivion_RE: Faelian? Hey, that's my name! Yeah. I'm Faelian.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff10_Oblivion_RE: Faelian? Oh, I know him all right! A waste of life, that one. He lives here you know, with his sweetheart, Atraena.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff0c_Oblivion_RE: Faelian? Yes, I know who he is. But I'm really not in the habit of discussing such things with strangers...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09BribeBeggar_00015f1f_Oblivion: Fair enough. Fathis is also the wizard in the tower southeast of town. He keeps his most treasured items there, not in the castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04NoBribeBeggar_000092e4_Oblivi: Fair enough. He left town yesterday. I heard he was going to... uh, Anvil. Yeah, that's right. No need to go lookin' for him. He's gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark07MercConvo_00045f8d_Oblivion: Faith? Are you telling me we're supposed to rely on the good graces of the Divines to keep Roderick alive? Even he would laugh at such nonsense!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000175b6_Oblivion_: Falcar always has been pretty harsh, even when it comes to basic lessons. He seems to have gotten worse lately, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004872f_Oblivion_RES: Falcar at the Mages Guild seems to be angry all the time. I avoid him when I can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357d_Obliv: Falcar did leave this behind; I think it fell from his notes as he left. I didn't pay it much attention, but perhaps it will be of use to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d2e4_Oblivion_: Falcar gives out the strangest assignments sometimes. It's as if he doesn't really care about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002e998_Oblivion_RES: Falcar must have known, and yet he said nothing. How could he allow this to happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357d_Obliv: Falcar was here some time ago, asking about just such a thing. Said it was for research. He had a large sheaf of notes with him about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Flee_0005c014_Oblivion_RESP1: Fall back to the city before it's too late!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderBattle01_0005249b_Ob: Fall back! Mazken! Retreat! Fall back to the town center! Now! Now! MOVE!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Yes_00066ef4_Oblivion_RESP1: Fantastic! I will mark Fetid Grove on your map. Good luck to you, friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e92c_Obli: Fantastic! You actually found 10 of the Nirnroot. I'll begin making the Elixir of Exploration right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00079f56_Oblivio: Fantastic. I can't tell you what it means to me to have this in my collection. You are a good soul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048903_Oblivion_RES: Far be it from me to criticize my patron and sovereign. Bravil obviously flourishes under his wise and beneficent rule.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaB1_000a5601_Oblivion_: Far from it. His interest in the Ayleids is not that of a mere scholar. He hopes to unlock the secrets of their magical power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0003005c_Oblivion_RESP1: Far to the west there lives a fierce warlord and his company of loyal mercenaries. Your target is the warlord. Do you accept this contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab8_Kn: Fare thee well, sir knight. May the gods grant you to destroy Umaril utterly, as I failed to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00002db0_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell! And tell your friends! The Inn of Ill Omen is open for business, as always!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00022a0c_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell, and be careful, Kurdan is not to be trusted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13StaffofIndarys_00031c97_Obliv: Farewell, and may Arkay guide you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13ThornbladeTopic_00031c96_Obli: Farewell, and may Arkay guide you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f9bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell, and may you find your way home safely each night to a warm fire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006a84c_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell, magister. May your spells never falter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000236ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell, my friend. May your blade always strike true. And first. He he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15RitualReady_00027e44_Oblivion: Farewell, my friend. Our fate is in your hands. Bring back the Amulet of Kings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell. May the roads carry you safely in your journeys.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008f10d_Oblivion_RESP1: Farewell. So much to bake, so little time!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e11f_Oblivion_RESP3: Farewell. You've been a good friend, in the short time that I've known you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00066cd0_Oblivion_RES: Farwil Indarys almost got himself killed in Cheydinhal. Here. Take my Black Horse Courier. It's all in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_00031844_Oblivion_RESP: Farwil is a Dunmer, and he's wearing steel plate armor. His shield should bear the crest of the Knights. Nothing but the best for the Count's son.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ValusOdiilTopic_000b6c10_Oblivion: Father will be so proud of us... but I wish he'd been here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS18Convo_0002b1c9_Oblivion_RESP1: Father's not scared - don't you dare say that! You'll see when he gets here. I'll ask him, and then you'll see!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_00098389_Oblivi: Fathis Aren's pockets are not for you, thief!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476b4_Oblivion_RESP1: Fathis Ules. I've got a nice house. I have a little income... quite comfortable. Time is light on my hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00084b3e_Oblivion_RESP1: Fear not, our paths may cross again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db86_Oblivion_RES: Fear the woody Gnarl, the tree that walks and creeps. If you strike them with a spell, the magic it will keep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e10f_Obli: Fear the woody Gnarl, the tree that walks and creeps. If you strike them with a spell, the magic it will keep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09BodyParts_0001357a_Oblivion_R: Fearing one day someone might manage to kill my child, I have been preparing a new body.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDerveninSpeech03_000898f3_Obliv: Feast until your belly is full, then fill the wine goblets once more and toast our fortune.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000bf16b_Oblivion_RESP1: Feeding time is over, vampire! Go back to the grave that spawned you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001671c_Oblivion_RESP1: Feel free to browse, friend. It's nice to see a new shopper. I was afraid I lost any hope of new business ever since Thoronir opened up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038f25_Oblivion_RESP1: Feel free to question anyone in town, they shouldn't give you too much trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007cfdf_Oblivion_RESP1: Feel free to take what you need. The fruits of the conservatory are for all to enjoy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05Gwinas_00022b46_Oblivion_RESP: Feel free to wait for him if you want to speak to him yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PowerAttack_00098388_Oblivion_RES: Feel the wrath of my ancestors!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47de_Oblivion_RES: Feet are for walking. Hands are for hitting. Or shaking. Or waving. Sometimes for clapping.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000181bb_Oblivion_RESP3: Felas and I slipped down here thinking that we'd be safe. But, no! We landed right in the middle of them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000181bb_Oblivion_RESP4: Felas ran off with them and left me to die! Me! That ingrate! Disloyal cur! Imagine, leaving me here all alone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFelldew_000206f8_Oblivion_RESP2: Felldew is a poison, little one. A very dangerous drug. You'll feel good at first, but that wears off, and if you go long without it, you'll suffer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00018b7b_Obli: Felldew is a poison. It kills. And yet Thadon uses the Chalice he created to twist Felldew into a drug he takes for his own amusement. How sick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_0004681e_Oblivion_RES: Fellmoor can still use your assistance, assuming you can find time in your schedule.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc2a_Oblivion_RES: Fellmoor must be a lovely place to live. You should visit there, right away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825f4_Oblivion_RES: Fellmoor must be a terrible place to live.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033586_Oblivion_RESP1: Fellow Knight! I bid you welcome.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00069477_Oblivion_RESP1: Fellow magister, may I speak with you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00066eb9_Oblivion_RESP1: Fetid Grove is a dangerous place... please be cautious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06ArctusGreetA_00040144_Oblivio: Few know that the Hero who lights the Torch for Dementia is granted the Raiment of Intrigue, a boon for those who would gain access to hidden knowledge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04GreymarchTopic_00091020_Obliv: Few of the citizens can remember the last Greymarch. Or they choose not to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture5_00071960_Oblivion: Few records survive from the Dark Ages of the Potentates. Thus might the secrets of the runestones be lost... in wickedness, vainglory, and neglect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047685_Oblivi: Fighters Guild has no accommodations in town. Mages Guild members have their own quarters at the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e48_Oblivion_RES: Fighters Guild is still better for sensitive jobs, and you know it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e24d_Oblivion_RES: Fighters Guild members have been going to Sherina to learn blade skills. She's good, and she'll be the first to tell you so.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheBlackwoodCompany_000a5652_: Fighters Guild, aren't you? Done many jobs for them recently. Yes. What makes you want to join us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e88a_Oblivion_RESP3: Fighting is fine with me, too, only the Guard objects, and they'll fine you or lock you up. Not my call.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624c5_Oblivion_RES: Fighting's easy. Just lead them out on the water and shoot them full of holes. If you've got a bow, of course, and can walk on water.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfd3_Oblivion_RE: Filthy Orc! I smell you from here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_goblins_000288b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Filthy animals. Some of my kinsmen are partial to them, but I find them reprehensible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f82_Oblivio: Filthy cur! I told you I was going to get out of here! My time's almost up, and there's nothing you can do about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_00062273_Oblivion_RESP: Filthy pickpocket! What did you take?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06PaleLady_00015321_Oblivion_RE: Filthy vampire! She took my cellmate Theranis a few days ago. If it hadn't been for you, I would have been next.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00071fa7_Oblivion_RESP1: Fimmion gone. Bye bye. Go find pumpkin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071f2f_Oblivion_RESP1: Fimmion hungry. Got food? Sweetcakes? Sausages?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44FimmionChoice3_0007877d_Obliv: Fimmion hungry. Sweetroll for Fimmion. Pants for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44PantsFimmion_0007877a_Oblivio: Fimmion hungry. Want sweetroll. Fimmion like pants. Love sweetroll.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44FimmionChoice2_0007877c_Obliv: Fimmion sad. Want sweetroll. No pants for you. Fimmion hungry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa83_Oblivio: Finally killed him, huh? Thanks. It would have been a lot of effort to find someone else to do it. You've got more to get rid of, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice4_00026b17_Oblivi: Finally signed on with some mercenaries, but I hear that ended, too. We haven't seen her in years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice6_00026b19_Oblivi: Finally signed on with some mercenaries, but I hear that ended, too. We haven't seen her in years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016720_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally! A new customer! Please... look around. Just promise me you won't buy from that fetcher, Thoronir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk3_00002bb8_Knights_RESP1: Finally! A purpose worth fighting for! In truth, I long for righteous battle!  When do we set out? What's our strategy?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CastleResidents_000038ba_Oblivion: Finally, I would try speaking to Orok gro-Ghoth who is my Steward. He resides in the Private Quarters section as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00068853_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally, I'll be able to retire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018c6b_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally, Lord Sheogorath has sent someone to assist me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607b7_Oblivion_RES: Finally, all this mess is sorted out. I can get back to my work. Oh, I've lost so much time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetA2_00002b86_Knight: Finally, he found what he was looking for. We went to Underpall Cave, and there... he fell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003160f_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally, no need to sleep with an eye open.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006094f_Oblivion_RES: Finally, some peace and quiet around here... now I can get some serious work done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_0001e852_Oblivion_RE: Finally. I shall see to it that the book is kept safe until the Council decides what should be done with it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c9d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Finally... back to the real world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugoTopic_000908d9_Oblivion: Find Black Brugo, and execute him for his crimes, and I will make both you and your friend Mazoga Knights-Errant of the White Stallion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a6_Obliv: Find Marana Rian in the Imperial City. She can teach you what you wish to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d88c_Obliv: Find Olyn Seran. Look for him at a Daedric Shrine; that's where he probably is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062452_Obliv: Find Tandilwe at the Temple of the One in the Imperial City. She can train you further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054824_Oblivion_RESP4: Find him, and close shut the jaws of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7b9_Oblivion_RESP1: Find ingredients for Margarte, huh? Works for me. I'll let the other men know. Appreciate your help, friend. And Oreyn should be happy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02BoneArrowsChoice_0003ea9c_Obl: Find me in a few hours. We'll kill the Gatekeeper.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30Matrices_0001e696_Oblivion_RE: Find me one of these matrices and enough Amber, and I will craft you a magical item.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG14Choice1A_0000a0fd_Oblivion_RE: Find out if Jeanne is all right, and let me know if she needs anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10HelpGF_0001530d_Oblivion_RESP: Find out where Springheel Jak is buried and bring me back those boots. Will you do this for me? It pays well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServicetoLeyawiinTopic_000860b5_O: Find out why she is here, and report to me, and you will earn a reward suitable for those who serve Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000175bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Find someone else to bother, won't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45ForkTopic_00078782_Oblivion_R: Find the Fork! Bring it to Big-Head! Sing it to Big-Head!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002975_Knights_RESP1: Find the Priestesses of Kynareth. Only they can guide you to the boots. All I can do is set you on the path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089938_Oblivion_RESP3: Find the Sigil Stone. Remove it, and the Gate will close! Hurry! The Keeper has the key-- you must get the key!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000327b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Find the fugitives. Make yourself useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e6fd_Oblivion_RESP4: Find the last of my blood, and close shut the marble jaws of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaB_00022b42_Oblivion_R: Find them, eh? I won't poke my nose any further. Official business and all that. I'm used to working with the Blades, don't worry. Say no more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMeridiaSpeech_000579ba_Oblivion: Find these necromancers. Destroy them and their abominations. Do this, and earn the gratitude of Meridia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalSpeech_00084a4d_Oblivi: Find these thieves in the city that spans the waters. Learn where they hide my Eye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice3_00038ed3_Obli: Find this proof and return it to me, and I'll share with you some of my finest combat techniques. Trust me, you can't learn these moves in a book!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice4_00038ed7_Obli: Find this proof and return it to me, and I'll share with you some of my finest combat techniques. Trust me, you can't learn these moves in a book!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e7_Oblivion_: Find those who plot against me. Bring them to me so I might make an example of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002c308_Oblivion_RESP1: Finding that book should be your top priority, Associate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_000836cb_Obli: Finding ways to confuse her just never gets old for me. It's good practice of our skills too. But it's mostly just funny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin2_00024285_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine by me. No great loss. Let me know if you change your mind, though. We can always use fresh meat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Leave_00066f2e_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine then. I'll find someone else. Someone who isn't too busy to help a desperate old man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Wait_00028695_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine, but don't be gone too long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44NothingMore_0007876f_Oblivion: Fine, but hurry back when you do! It's coming soon. I can tell!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD07Choice1_000356e1_Oblivion_RE: Fine, fine. I'll come with you. My guards are dead. You win, for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607ef_Oblivion_RES: Fine, fine. So the Realm still stands. That doesn't mean there are any fewer Scalons in the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04Here2_0003d30b_Oblivion_RESP1: Fine, then best be on your way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08KurdanBoatNo_0001f42f_Oblivio: Fine. But you better not take too long. I want that axe, and I want it now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Choice4_000b1674_Oblivion_RE: Fine. Here's your money. Let me know if you find more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08KurdanBoatYes_0001f430_Oblivi: Fine. I have it waitin' for you at the dock next to the magic shop. Now get outta my sight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice9_0005e371_Obliv: Fine. I'm sure my Lord will be most pleased, assuming you ever manage to see Him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AssistanceCommand_0001356e_Ob: Fine. If it be my Lord's will, then it is also my own. But, I am too distraught over the death of my child to return to his womb. This, you must do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08SheldenEnd_00043f71_Oblivion_: Fine. Just leave me here to die. Not like anyone will miss me.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fdb3_Oblivion_RESP5: From this moment forward, you will walk the shadows as my Silencer. You will receive contracts only from me. Your new life has begun.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00027991_Oblivion_RE: From what I gathered, he's a retired soldier. He's been all across the Empire fighting in various campaigns. Goodness, he's handsome....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_00031b76_Oblivion_RESP2: From what I hear, you'll appear back where you entered, safe and sound.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1f9_Oblivi: From what I know, Carahil is a powerful mage. I suppose she should be, if she's going to be in the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002a397_Oblivion_RES: From what I've heard, Kvatch is gone. Completely. Burned to the ground.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0000a100_Oblivion_RESP: From what he's told you, Mannimarco -- the King of Worms -- is here in Cyrodiil, and preying on our Guild. This is something I'd never have dreamed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00000809_AltarESPMain: Frostcrag Spire has been uninhabited for so long… they say it was as wondrous as the Arcane University itself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10HelpGF_0001530d_Oblivion_RESP: Further use of Savilla's Stone has revealed that I need another special item to move forward with my plans.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f526_Oblivion_RESP1: Gah! Horrid beast! What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15GaiarAlataTopic_00015880_Obli: Gaiar Alata is the Master's name for this place. We usually just call it Paradise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GaidenShinjiTopic_00146856_Oblivi: Gaiden Shinji was the first Arena Blademaster. It was he who oversaw construction of the Arena, back in the First Era. The Arena was... his dream.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e99a_Oblivion_RES: Ganredhel can teach you about Acrobatics, for a price. Of course, she'd rather be training her dogs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e998_O: Ganredhel does seem to love her dogs. She taught me a little something about acrobatics, though, which was helpful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfd5_Oblivion_RES: Ganredhel sure does have a knack for training dogs. I've heard that she will train people as well, for a price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8d8_Oblivion_RESP1: Ganredhel. I train dogs. And people. Prefer dogs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetQuestions03_00002c16_K: Garlas Malatar was the westernmost outpost of the Ayleid empire. It watched over what we call the Abecean Sea.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c365_Oblivion_RESP1: Garrus may be our only hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028165_Oblivion_RESP1: Gasp! Oh, thank goodness it's you, sweetie! Please, don't wander too far away. I feel safe with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028163_Oblivion_RESP1: Gasp! Oh... oh, it's you. What do you want? Why are you looking at me that way?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028164_Oblivion_RESP1: Gasp! Oh... oh. I'm sorry. I... my nerves. I just want to get out of here. Three people have been murdered! I'm so very frightened!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bd5_Oblivion: Gaspar and I have learned a great many spells over the years. Once you''ve learned them, you can use the knowledge to create your own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c25a_Oblivion_RES: Gaston Surilie and his brother Davide own one of the finest vineyards in all of Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ae3_Oblivion_R: Gaston and I make great wines, reasonably priced. Skingrad has two great vintners - Tamika and Surilie. I'll never say a word against Tamika's wines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c23e_Obl: Gaston and his brother produce quality wines. I'll have to pick up some more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1e3_Oblivion_RES: Gatekeeper at the Gates! Singing songs of gatekeeping!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434be_Oblivion_RES: Gatekeeper's gone. For good. Or not. Might just be on holiday. We'll see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038a89_Oblivion_R: Gates are opening outside the towns all over Cyrodiil. One opened right here in Skingrad. [pending implementation and flag for Skingrad gate status]
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DaedraShrineTopic_000a4958_Oblivi: Gave it a wide berth. I'm a goblin hunter. Don't want to tangle with those Daedra worshippers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gelebourne_0003844c_Oblivion_RESP: Gelebourne? That's odd you should mention that name. Raynil told me that he was the last vampire he hunted.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008656a_Oblivion_RESP1: Get a move on, will you?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000286d0_Oblivion_RESP1: Get away from me, peasant. Someone has been murdered, and I'm rather unnerved by the whole thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002415c_Oblivion_RESP1: Get away from me. I don't want whatever you've got!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackheartsRing_0002c674_Oblivion: Get the ring for me. We'll need it as proof.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice1A_00016482_Oblivion_RE: Get to him any way you can. It is your only hope for defeating him.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk1_0006fdd0_Oblivion_RESP: Getting hungry, and could do with a drink. But I'm still sharp, don't you worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Gilgondorin. Silverhome-on-the-Water has beds and food. What's your pleasure?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e967_Oblivion_RESP1: Gimme the skooma! Don't hold out on me. I know you have it!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_000977d7_Oblivio: Give me twenty-four hours. I shall have the potion ready for you then.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e7ae_Obli: Give them gargen to emeet with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11WhatNow_00022e1e_Oblivion_RES: Give this ring to Countess Umbranox in Anvil. Say nothing about me to her. I need to know how she reacts to it. It may provoke anger or tears.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028874_Oblivion_RESP1: Give those weapons to the men, and let's get moving.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c351_Oblivi: Given the opportunity, I think Ulrich would have had me killed. I'm not sorry for what I've done, but I don't wish to be revered as a hero either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RewardTopic_000a3df4_Oblivion_RES: Given your present condition, the main gift I would offer is useless. I can, however, offer you a monetary reward for your troubles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00028d69_Oblivion_R: Gives me the strangest looks, now that you mention it.  Almost like he hates me, although I have no idea why.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043511_Oblivion_RES: Glad they got the Resonator of Judgment turned back on. Was getting less done with all the hubbub about adventurers running amok.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa78_Oblivion_RESP1: Glad things are settled here. I can finally get some rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001e7a2_Oblivion_RESP1: Glad to see you are well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be78_Oblivion_RESP1: Glad you killed those things. I'd have done it myself, but apparently, that's not "ladylike." Hmmph. Let's get back to my father.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017666_Oblivion_RESP1: Gladiator. It's not very often I get to call somebody that. You're doing the Blue Team proud, kid. Now go kill somebody before I get all weepy!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00028d89_Oblivion_RESP1: Glarthir is acting even stranger than usual, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00028d86_Oblivion_R: Glarthir?  Total nutcase, if you ask me.  But he's never done anything -- yet -- that we could arrest him for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024fea_Oblivion_RE: Glistel and me, we keep an eye on things here in Chorrol for certain interested parties... as a public service, like.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09FathisAren_00015f1e_Oblivion_: Gloomy fellow. I've heard he consorts with daedra. I'd steer clear of him if I were you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c456a_Oblivion_RESP1: Go Blue Team! Yeah, Blue Team! I always bet on the Blue Team! They never hold back! It's always crush, kill, maim, murder! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00081368_Oblivion_: Go ahead, do what you will. Nothing matters now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033354_Oblivion_R: Go ahead, try your magicka in here. Let's see you make those bars disappear. No? What's the matter? Not so powerful now, are you Breton?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0000a232_Oblivion_RESP1: Go ahead. Leave me to rot in here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b6b_Oblivion_RESP1: Go ahead. Summon him. He loves it.
