ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000174f3_Oblivion_: He was furious when I told him I'd helped you, and then when I threatened to report him to the Council of Mages, I thought he was going to kill me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JorundrTopic_00053279_Oblivion_RE: He was going to skip town on Arnora, but got arrested before making good on his escape. Now she has no money left at all. Poor thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Unseen_00025345_Oblivion_RESP1: He was here a second ago...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MehrunesDagonTopic_00092e8b_Obliv: He was involved with Jagar Tharn's plot against the empire years ago. It doesn't surprise me to find his hand in the current calamity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenPainting_00031508_Oblivion_: He was kind and noble, which is difficult to convey on canvas. I am afraid other than that, I cannot offer much more information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenBenirus_00003a71_Oblivion_: He was mostly harmless, until the fateful day he came across a tome bearing the evil magic of necromancy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07TheFringeTopic_0009130c_Obliv: He was right about that. I can feel it. In My bones. The little ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028191_Obliv: He was so young... so innocent. That boy was destined for greatness. Who could have done such a thing?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDUmarilTopic_00002bf9_Knights_RE: He was struck down by Pelinal, but by his art Umaril had bound himself to the realm of his mistress, the Daedra Lord Meridia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0000a100_Oblivion_RESP: He was the only one left?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3bb_Oblivion_RESP2: He was the sovereign of thought and a regnant artist. To call him a simple craftsman would not suffice; know him as the Artificer Superior.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice5A_00028ac8_Oblivion_RE: He was very good at obtaining things from people who did not want to part with. A professional thief, to put it bluntly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05Gwinas_00094c3b_Oblivion_RESP: He was very upset when he found out I didn't have his book for him. I doubt he'll be in any mood to talk to you about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetD2A_00002c0b_Knigh: He was worried that the Sword may have been turned to evil. That it may have to be reconsecrated on the altar of its creator, the divine Arkay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetD2B_00002c09_Knigh: He was worried that the Sword may have been turned to evil. That it may have to be reconsecrated on the altar of its creator, the divine Arkay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a80_K: He went alone into the White Gold Tower, challenged the Ayleid sorceror-king Umaril to single combat, and slew him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BaurusTopic_0006b838_Oblivion_RES: He will not be forgotten. He goes to Aetherius to join the other fallen heroes of the Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e71e_Oblivion_RESP3: He will reward you greatly for escorting me home and closing the Oblivion Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031eba_Oblivion_RESP3: He will reward you greatly for escorting me home and closing the Oblivion Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonTopic_0008f178_Oblivion_R: He will suffer greatly at the hands of Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDUmarilTopic_00002bfc_Knights_RE: He will trouble us no more, thanks to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035672_Oblivion_RESP3: He wishes to meet with you south of the Cursed Mine outside of town, after 2 AM.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07GreymarchTopic_0009112b_Obliv: He wishes you to gain the respect of the people, to be a leader once He is gone. It is an interesting concept.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2b1_Oblivio: He won't be hard to find, just follow the smell of stale mead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e553_Oblivion_: He won't bother those blessed by Lord Sheogorath. You, however, will die trying to get the keys from my child.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11ErlineOpinion_00038444_Oblivi: He works at night, and has to sleep during the day. Why does that make him a vampire?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OgreSlaves_00026b66_Oblivion_RESP: He works them in Bleak Mine. It's terrible. The guards beat the creatures mercilessly. That's all I can tell you. Now please, go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GiveStone_00014705_Oblivion_R: He would have had it destroyed or taken it from them and kept it under lock and key in the palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GiveStone_0001cf35_Oblivion_R: He would have had it destroyed or taken it from them and kept it under lock and key in the palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07JyggalagTopic_0009100f_Oblivi: He'll be here soon, and I'll be gone. Can't say I like the sound of that. I like the sound of other things, though. Like birds. And bones cracking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07JyggalagTopic_00091017_Oblivi: He'll be here soon, and I'll be gone. Can't say I like the sound of that. I like the sound of other things, though. Like birds. And bones cracking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06JauffreB_0008b617_Oblivion_RE: He'll be in the Great Hall, reading. He's hardly taken time to sleep since you left.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_000223d0_Oblivion_RE: He'll be sleeping, like anyone with a lick of sense... in the Priory House.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2ab_Obliv: He'll be truly famous one day. Word already spreads about his skill... I think someone saw him at Faregyl Inn not too long ago. You should try there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001da6c_Obli: He'll make a fine replacement for Seridur. It's the least we can do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049899_Oblivi: He'll train you in how to use heavy armor, if you can pay for his time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice4_0008fb62_Oblivion_RES: He'll try to offer you the same kind of deal, that handsome devil, but he can't be trusted! Make the right decision.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08UrsanneAvenged_0001fdbe_Obliv: He'll... not be needing it any longer, and I want you to have it. I'll not take no for an answer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BittneldTopic_0002ba45_Oblivion_R: He's Captain of the Chorrol Guard. During the day, you can usually find him on patrol with us around the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e552_Oblivion_: He's Relmyna's crowning achievement. The Gatekeeper keeps out people who don't belong in the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00017c46_Oblivion: He's a Captain of the Imperial Watch. He is pursuing a personal vendetta against the Thieves Guild and the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286db_Obli: He's a Nord. Even a complete idiot could see that. So what does that say about you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028177_Obli: He's a Nord. Mead-swilling barbarians, all of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: He's a bit crazy for dogs, from what I hear. He pays bets on time, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a96_Knights_R: He's a blessing on this town. The only one to have made any sense out of the terrible tragedy at the Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Next_00023669_Oblivion_RESP2: He's a clever one, no doubt about it. Eyes in the back of his head, always seems to know when I'm watching.  But that's where you come in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00035dca_Oblivion_RESP1: He's a fairy tale. The Imperial Watch pretends there is a thief king named the Gray Fox who controls all the thieves in Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGNotInterestedGF_0001e093_Oblivi: He's a fairy tale. The Imperial Watch pretends there is a thief king named the Gray Fox who controls all the thieves in Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001da63_Obli: He's a fine man, and an honored brother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224af_Oblivion_RESP2: He's a good boy, but he's hot-headed. Keep a close eye on him, will you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_IrlavJarolTopic_00035f46_Oblivion: He's a good man, but Council matters have distracted him lately, and he's been neglecting his other work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1d5_Obl: He's a moron. One of these days, he'll be taught a lesson.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00064458_Oblivion_RESP1: He's a most mysterious fellow. In many ways I admire him. Most of the time I just feel sorry for him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1c8_Oblivi: He's a nice fellow, but he couldn't even get the sign for his store spelled right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00028d67_Oblivion_R: He's a raving lunatic.  I'm assuming you're asking because he's done something strange.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_000465b: He's a saint. Sure, he spends a bit of time at the Tap and Tack, but you can't blame him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498c: He's a sneaky one. I understand he'll teach others to be sneaky, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1a3_Obl: He's a tough one, that's for sure. I wouldn't want to cross him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_000286fc_Oblivion_RE: He's a trained soldier, after all. I bet if anyone can figure out what's going on here, it will be him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003e2ae_Obl: He's a very hard worker. Sometimes I wonder if he ever gets out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002825a_Oblivion_RE: He's a very serious man, but I guess that's normal for a retired soldier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RiZakarTopic_00035702_Oblivion_RE: He's a warrior, a battle-hardened mercenary who's spent time all over Tamriel. He'll keep his prize tree locked away. You'll need to find his key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47HowToHelp_00030039_Oblivion_R: He's a wizard who took up residence in the ruins of Fort Caractacus a couple of years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1a4_Obl: He's all business. That's probably good in his line of work, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09JyggalagTopic_0009135c_Oblivi: He's almost here. I can feel it. You won't like Him as much as Me. He doesn't even carry a cane! More the giant, bone-cleaving sword type of Prince.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HenantierTopic_00027f37_Oblivion_: He's always getting himself into jams with the careless ways he performs his experiments, and well, I'm afraid he's done it again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeebumNaTOPIC_00026ac5_Oblivion_R: He's always got some scam going with Bejeen, his partner. You might find them both at Weebum-Na's house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: He's always trying to stir things up. I don't think he means any real harm, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: He's always wanted to be in the guild. Good that he was finally made a member.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028791_Oblivion_RE: He's an Imperial Legion bulldog. Scum, if you ask me. Kind of like you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LordRugdumphTOPIC_0000be7d_Oblivi: He's an Orcish noble. A fine man. Our families go back a bit. Anyway, his daughter is missing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003dfb6_Obl: He's an aggressive one, that's for sure. Has a good book selection, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: He's an ass. There's no excuse for his behavior.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_000465c7_Obliv: He's an interesting man, and an amazing fighter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_0002817a_Obli: He's an obnoxious drunkard, I know, but I'm not sure if I see him as the murdering type.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c221_Oblivi: He's an odd one. Drinks like a fish, but runs like a rabbit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082615_Obl: He's an odd one. I'm sure someone will take care of him soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC_0002428e_Oblivion_RES: He's around here somewhere. Has been for days. No trouble, really.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004989: He's as good as you'll find in the city when it comes to heavy armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ErthorTopic_0002d929_Oblivion_RES: He's back to his normal routine now, all safe and sound. Enjoy taking credit for the work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00035dcc_Oblivion_RESP1: He's been around for hundreds of years. I've heard tell that he is immortal. I don't know about that, but he sure ain't normal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00035dda_Oblivion_RESP1: He's been around forever. It must be 300 years or more since he took charge. I'm not sure he's even human.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000545f9_Oblivion_RESP1: He's been fed and well rested for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008260e_Obl: He's been living with Zoe Malene, looking for some amulet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00015f23_Oblivion: He's been ordered to evacuate the Waterfront? Excellent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498e1_Oblivi: He's calmed down a lot. Can still teach you how to pick a lock, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47HowToHelp_00030039_Oblivion_R: He's caused us no end of trouble with his magical experiments, but nothing as bad as this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004988b_Oblivi: He's certainly a talented smith. I'm glad he'll train others in the skill.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465cc_Oblivi: He's certainly become more like a Nord over the years. Quite a competent healer, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286f5_Obli: He's dead, and one of us killed him. Maybe it was you, eh? Maybe he found the gold, and you murdered him for it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028174_Oblivion_RE: He's dead, and one of you killed him! I hate you all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028703_Oblivion_RE: He's dead, you peasant! There's nothing more to tell!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0007eaa1_Oblivion_: He's dead? Hmm. Of course, I'm too tired to walk all the way up there at the moment. I'll head up there after I rest my eyes for a moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0007eaa0_Oblivion_: He's dead? I bet he died of some horrible disease, didn't he?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001da69_Oblivion_RE: He's dead? Thank goodness! I feared I'd never be able to leave here, or worse, that he would come for me. I can finally return home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TeekeeusTopic_000253d4_Oblivion_R: He's desperately trying to control as much power as he can, and I'm a threat, because I don't want to see that power all in his hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKellenTopic_00002b07_Knights_RE: He's down in the Chapel Hall, resting. You may speak to him, if you like.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286f0_Obli: He's drinking even more than he was before. Is it because he's afraid, or feeling guilty?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498e8_Oblivi: He's forgotten more about picking locks than most people will ever know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498b9_Oblivi: He's getting older, but he can still teach a bit about Alteration. He's been teaching it since before the Levitation Act of 421.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498b: He's getting up in years, but he's still a good Alteration teacher.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Bhisha_00072dba_Oblivion_RESP: He's gone? Truly? Oh, thank you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: He's good with his fists, no doubt about it. He'll teach you something, for the right price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_000465c: He's good. We're lucky to have him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c254_Obl: He's got some issues, that's for sure. Personally, I'd just steer clear of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GaltusPreviaTOPIC_0002d710_Oblivi: He's got to be in here somewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081f8c_Oblivio: He's got to go. Before he eats me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000f593e_Oblivion_RESP1: He's here somewhere. I know it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AzaniBlackheartTOPIC_0002c58c_Obl: He's here. I know it. Lead the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c220_Oblivi: He's in great shape, that's for sure. Maybe he could teach me something about his training regimen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03WhereArmand_00009188_Oblivion: He's in hiding. I hear Methredhel is looking for you, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000982d8_Oblivion_RESP1: He's inside, downstairs. Don't keep him waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d58a_Oblivion_RESP: He's invisible, and you've about as much luck finding him as Jeanne does. Excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_000009ff_Oblivion_RESP1: He's just a name on a wanted poster. I don't trust you enough to say more than that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_0006445d_Oblivion_RESP1: He's just a thief. He's supposed to be the head of the Thieves Guild. What a joke! Can you imagine a bunch of thieves trying to form a guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00035ddc_Oblivion_RESP1: He's kind of like a guildmaster for the Thieves Guild. All I know is that the Doyen and other senior guild members do his bidding like trained dogs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028795_Oblivion_RE: He's like everyone else in the Imperial Legion. Someone needs help, someone is getting killed, and they're nowhere to be found. Worthless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06ShrineTalkStoreroom_0003641e_: He's never around when you need him. And he never attends services anymore. If he's not careful, he may find himself on the altar one day soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EyjaTopic_000b97e5_Oblivion_RESP4: He's never been cruel to me, it's just that he's never been kind. It's as if I'm just another part of his shop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ForlornWatchman_00035cab_Oblivion: He's never harmed anyone, but most people give him a wide berth. You seem curious enough, so I'll be glad to pinpoint where he appears on your map.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MercatorHosidusTopic_0003567c_Obl: He's not available right now. You can either wait here for him, or come back later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_defaulted_0003457f_Oblivion_RESP1: He's not doing the job? The little vermin. It still needs to be done. You get back there and make sure that job is finished! Get moving!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00053771_Oblivion_RESP1: He's not likely to just come out and tell you, so get creative!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054220_Oblivion_RESP1: He's not much to look at, but you won't find a better bargain in Cyrodiil. Take good care of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_000223da_Oblivion_RE: He's not part of our community here, but a resident of Weynon Priory, the monastery southeast of town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e968_O: He's not the friendliest person around, but he can teach you a lot about running a business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1c9_Oblivi: He's not the smartest man, but he's a nice guy. I just hope he can keep his business afloat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06JyggalagTopic_000910f6_Oblivi: He's on his way, so I'm on my way out. It's terribly inconvenient, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC_0002428a_Oblivion_RES: He's one of your Fighters Guild brothers, but he's defaulted on a contract. We can't allow that. Makes us all look bad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00064466_Oblivion: He's our new Captain. I've never met a finer man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07BribeBeggar_00015f18_Oblivion: He's out and about in the morning, so I would wait until afternoon or evening to go visit him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4ed_Oblivion_: He's pretty scary, isn't he? Let's watch him in action.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01ErthorTopic_00047467_Oblivion: He's probably still out at the cave. Adrienne hasn't let him work here in a long time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: He's quite an accomplished brawler. I wonder if he'd teach me something about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498ac_Oblivi: He's really skilled at using light armor. Luckily, he's willing to train others to use it, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26ShopkeeperReport_00035ca0_Obl: He's shaken down most of the shopkeepers in the Market District. They're all too afraid of him to do anything. Jensine wouldn't even talk about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_000289f5_Obliv: He's somewhere around here. Why don't you stop wasting my time and go ask him yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReynaldJemaneTopic_00094075_Obliv: He's staying over at the Newlands Lodge, but you also might find him walking around town. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Bhisha_00072dbb_Oblivion_RESP: He's still around. I've seen him skulking like the filthy cat he is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465bc_Oblivi: He's sure got his hands full, between smithing and training in light armor. I don't know how he does it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465ec_Oblivi: He's talented. The Fighters Guild could do a lot worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00064462_Oblivion: He's that Imperial Watch Captain that's always chasing after the Gray Fox and the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_0006445e_Oblivion_RESP1: He's that thief that the Imperial Watch are always going on about. He likes to steal from rich folk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_0000c051_Oblivion: He's the Captain of the Guard in Anvil now. He used to be in the Imperial Watch until Countess Umbranox had him reassigned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_0001e910_Oblivion_RE: He's the Grandmaster of the Blades. As the eyes and ears of the Emperor, the Blades don't advertise themselves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ValusOdiilTopic_000224cd_Oblivion: He's the best fighter you'll ever meet, and as soon as he gets here, we'll be off. Just wait; you'll see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09FathisAren_00015f1e_Oblivion_: He's the court wizard. He has a room in the north wing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4ef_Oblivion_: He's the crowning achievement of Relmyna Verenim. She's my teacher. The Gatekeeper keeps out people who don't belong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028263_Oblivion_RE: He's the killer! Don't you see? We have to protect ourselves! We'll be next!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028262_Oblivion_RE: He's the killer, you idiot! Can't you see? He murdered all of those people!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AjumKajinTopic_000356e6_Oblivion_: He's the one in charge of this expansion. I know he's a high-ranking member of the group. An Argonian mage, from what I hear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Relan_000781f0_Oblivion_RESP1: He's the only one that pulls his weight. He kills the vermin and trespassers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MercatorHosidusTopic_0003567c_Obl: He's the person to talk to about an audience with the Count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MercatorHosidusTopic_0003567d_Obl: He's the person to talk to about an audience with the Count. You'll find him in the County Hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090ff2_Oblivion_RESP1: He's too much! Killed all my men! Get out of my way!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15Anaxes_00047366_Oblivion_RESP: He's trapped at the back of the cave. It took us weeks to prepare the trap, and he killed us many times before we finally succeeded.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_0005e15b_Oblivion_RE: He's usually praying in the Priory chapel at this time of day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002824c_Obliv: He's very handsome. But please don't tell him I said so! Hehe!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonTopic_000131d6_Oblivion_R: He's waiting for you. Unless he isn't. He wasn't, but then he was. Maybe he still is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002e585_Oblivion_RESP1: He's what??? That little lump of guar dung! You get back to Bravil and take care of that contract. I need to think about this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028d2d_Obliv: He's young, rich and handsome. Basically the complete opposite of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028d2e_Obliv: He's young, rich and handsome. That's way out of your league, tramp.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00027995_Obliv: He's young, well-educated and obviously full of himself. Not much different than any young nobleman, really.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ErthorTopic_0002d6e8_Oblivion_RES: He's... well, he's an interesting fellow. Sulinus Vassinus can tell you more about him, if you wish to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AdamusPhillidaTopic_001778e3_Obli: He... He's dead. And on my watch... I've failed... Failed everyone...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice6A_00085a63_Oblivion_: He... he did? Oh my goodness, what should I do? Should I talk to him? Or maybe play hard to get? Or should I, you know? Or would that be too forward?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b9845_Oblivion_RESP1: Head downstairs, and the room will be straight across from the door. Sleep well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062451_Obliv: Head to Leyawiin, and find J'bari. He's the one you want to talk to about Light Armor training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2b1_Obliv: Head to Skingrad, and visit the West Weald Inn. I believe he's currently employed there. In the wine cellar, in fact.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017979_Oblivion_RESP1: Head to Xeddefen, Your Grace. By your will, we shall hold this position.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017984_Oblivion_RESP1: Head to Xeddefen, Your Grace. We will hold this position.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LordRugdumphTOPIC_0000be7d_Oblivi: Head to his estate and talk to him. Find his daughter. And mind your manners! I don't want you embarassing me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476da_Oblivion_RESP1: Health and fortune, traveler. I'm Dynari Amnis. May the Nine bless your dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45Choice1_00078788_Oblivion_RES: Hear it singing! Songs of home! It comes again. It brings presents! It is not present. Soon it will be!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00022a14_Oblivion_RESP1: Hear me out before you leave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001823a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hear me out before you make your decision.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a66_Knig: Hear me, o people of Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001f877_Oblivio: Hear now the words of Lord Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d256_Oblivion_RESP1: Hear out Seridur, first. Then we'll speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk3_0003404d_Oblivion_R: Heard about that, did you? Ha ha ha! All right, so things got a bit out of control. Nothing I couldn't handle though, as you can plainly see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0002556b_Oblivion_RESP1: Heard any news from the other provinces?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003dfb5_Oblivion_RESP1: Heard anything more about the Blackwood Company?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c5_Oblivion_RES: Heard the Gatekeeper was killed. Waste of a creature that size anyway, if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1e2_Oblivion_RES: Heard there's a new Gatekeeper. Spends all day by that huge wall. It's bound to fall in on him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071dc3_Oblivion_RESP1: Heard they made you master. Gods help us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a5644_Oblivion_RESP1: Heard you went over to the other side. Get out of my face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ef6_Oblivion_RES: Hearing rumors of Syl's madness makes me glad I live outside the walls of New Sheoth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434d3_Oblivion_RES: Hearing that the Resonator works again almost makes up for losing the Gatekeeper. We're still not safe, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047717_Oblivion_RESP1: Hearth and fortune. Grey-Throat, I am called. You are not known to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture3_0007194b_Oblivion: Heavenly Doomstones bear red runes, appear with stone circles, and are associated with cosmic features of the heavens like the moons Jone and Jode.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirGauntlets_00002b24_Kni: Heavy as stone, they would not move. None could lift them. I suspect they lie there still, in Chorrol's Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d6e2_Oblivion_: Heck, I'll even go do the job for you for 300 gold. When Erthor gets back, you can take the credit. What do you say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05FinCHoice2C_0004ce4b_Oblivi: Heed my words. Phillida has dedicated his life to eradicating the Dark Brotherhood. He will not tolerate our operations within the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_0002d408_Oblivion_RESP1: Heh, I'd better cut down on the ale. Starting to see things, I am...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002872b_Oblivi: Heh, you should have seen the old biddy trying to talk to young Primo Antonius. She may be a noble, but he looked down on her like a scullery maid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c4_Oblivion_RESP2: Heh-heh. Just kidding. Everything is all perfectly safe. Tested it myself. Ungarion, retired adventurer. You may have heard of me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AssaultNoCrime_00062506_Oblivion_: Heh. It's been too long since I've seen a good brawl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_000302d5_Oblivion_RESP1: Heh. Really, you're going to love this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007e3e8_Oblivion_RESP1: Hehe. Watching them run from the Giant Gnarl gets me every time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c20f_Oblivion_RES: Heinrich Oaken-Hull is married to a Bosmer? I suppose the women are less annoying than the men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e09b_Oblivion_RESP1: Heinrich Oaken-Hull, captain and shipmaster. My ship, the Serpent's Wake, is in for refitting, so I'm high and dry for a while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000091ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again! Have you had any luck finding the sword and armor?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314ff_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again. I hope your search for the painting goes well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again. I'm sorry, but I have little time to chat. I am quite busy with affairs of state and all that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f36a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again. You don't happen to recall how many steps you took in getting here, do you? I was just wondering.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bc90_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again. You're more than welcome here! I have everything for the budding alchemist under one roof.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006d603_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello again... talk to me while you can. I don't think I've got too long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d6_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello friend. Stay a while and watch the sheep with me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e7f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello love. I'll have another bottle of wine if you please. And do hurry - the last 5 barmaids I've talked to never came back...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028737_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello my friend.  I will never forget your daring rescue.  What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000319cb_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello my friend. A word of advice. Watch for goblins if you're heading north.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224ea_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello stranger. We don't get many visitors around here. Makes things pretty lonely for me, if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002edee_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! Are you here to join the Mages Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d62_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! Can I cut you a deal?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f21f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! I must say, I'm quite surprised to see anyone else here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028273_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! Welcome to the Arena! I don't think I've ever seen you around here before. I know all the regulars, believe me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ff3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there! You're a cute little thing, aren't you? A little baby bear. Did you get lost?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002f1f3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there, Associate. You're here for a recommendation, I presume. Are you prepared to earn it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e961_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there, hello indeed! I'm Caldana Monrius. Well met!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f36e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Have I mentioned that my left arm is actually one inch longer than my right? Never know when that might be important.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e706_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Have you reconsidered my offer?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000277ab_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Hmm... you might do nicely. Are you interested in some work? I have a small task that needs accomplishing. You may be up to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031036_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. I hear you've been looking for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f367_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. I just finished a lovely conversation with Uncle Leo; it seems he's not feeling well today. Lost an arm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004300b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. I suppose I should make the effort to introduce myself. I'm Horkvir Bear-Arm. I hope there isn't anything I can do for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003ea30_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. I'm Hirrus Clutumnus, not that it should matter to you, or anyone else for that matter. I'm worthless. I should die. Will you kill me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000357a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Is there something I can do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002edda_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Is there something with which I can assist you? Perhaps you're curious about joining the Mages Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000613bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. Welcome to Aerin's Camp.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f366_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. You don't have any experience building boats, do you? I'm rather stuck, what without any instructions and all. Confusing stuff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008f106_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello there. You'd look great in my newest work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e442_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello! I'm Dumag gro-Bonk. Best and prettiest smith in town. I know the secret art of forging Amber. Here. Take this list. It explains what I need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001accf_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello! It's always a pleasure to speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000091f2_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello! You must be from the Fighters Guild. I'm glad you're here. I need your help to repay a debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello! You'll need to speak up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d58f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Associate. If you need anything, just let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034eaa_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Associate. It seems you've obtained the final recommendation you required.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee3f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Associate. To earn a recommendation from me, you need simply prove you are able-bodied and prepared to learn something in the process.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251e0_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Brother. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251de_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Brother. It's good to see you again. The Night Mother has been smiling upon you, I hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003a6a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I am Velwyn Benirus. If you're in the market, I'm selling a manor house right now for a very good price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002809c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I don't think we've met.  Are you new in town?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b97df_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I heard you purchased the Servants Quarters for Rosethorn Hall, and I was wondering if you had anyone in mind to fill that position?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002821f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Dovesi. I'm very pleased to meet you. Now that you're here, we can really start looking for that chest of gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c7_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Dredhwen. No one was running this place when I got here. They left plenty of things behind, though. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Nanette Don. I wasn't sure why I came here, until she showed up. Now I know. I'm going to be a powerful sorceress. Just like Relmyna!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Shelden. I've been here the longest. That's why I'm mayor of Passwall. That, and because I'm the best at being in charge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000412c8_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, I'm Una Armina. Perhaps you've heard of my Museum of Oddities?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251e1_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, Sister. Can I help you with something?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013a5f_Oblivio: Hello, Steward. Welcome to my little corner of the castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018bb01_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, citizen. I hope you're faring well in these difficult times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027981_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, dear! Listen, I've been thinking. Why don't we form a kind of alliance? If either one of us finds the chest of gold, we split it, 50/50!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e3e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, dearest Sister. Is there something I can help you with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00005674_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, fellow Speaker. Welcome to the Black Hand. So nice to see you're in one piece.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c0ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, friend! What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008605a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, friend. Thank you again for your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008605e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, friend. Thank you again for your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, is there something I can do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042fef_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, little one! I'm Urul gro-Agamph. All kinds of cute animals come to visit me. Just like you did! You're a pretty butterfly, aren't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00091b49_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, my darling. Are you having a good day?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b7a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, my friend! What can this grizzled old Blademaster do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022509_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, my little friend. I have something that might interest you...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f365_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, my name is Tove. "The Unrestful," they call me. So much to do, and so little time. There's only one of me to go around, you know!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488df_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, stranger. Luciana Galena. I'm Bravil's Advanced Trainer for the Light Armor discipline.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd72_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, stranger. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251df_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello, sweet Sister. It warms my heart to see you again. The Night Mother has been smiling upon you, I hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000365c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. Are you searching for something?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000038d1_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I am Laythe Wavrick, the Chief Herald and Countess Valga's attendant. Welcome to Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0015974b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I am Laythe Wavrick, the Chief Herald and Countess Valga's attendant. Welcome to Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033ee2_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I hope the goblins along the Yellow Road didn't give you any trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004300f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Atrabhi! People think I'm not friendly because I'm always reading. I enjoy a good conversation, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc44_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Brother Jauffre. Can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024f11_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Casta Scribonia. The writer. Author of 'Woman Gone Wild'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000238e3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Rasheda -- the smith -- and this is Fire and Steel. Quality armor and weapons, repairs, too. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm Roxanne Brigette. I help the boys. They get a little squirrelly sometimes, find it hard to cope. So I help out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314f4_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. I'm not really in the mood to chat right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043013_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. My name isn't Atrabhi, I don't know why everyone calls me that. And I don't know where I get this reputation for being a liar, either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038aaa_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. We haven't met, have we? I'm Sister Marie Palielle, the chapel healer, and trainer in the Restoration Arts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251db_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. What is it I can do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002ad89_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. You haven't seen my sons, have you? They went off into the forest to fight those monsters, and I'm worried about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be68_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello. You're from the Fighters Guild, I presume. It's good that you've arrived. We need your help with some disappearances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000790a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Hello... don't mind me... I'm a little tired. Can't sleep at home, you know. The walls. They aren't safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice4C_00002ddb_Oblivion_: Hello? Did you hear me? I asked if you needed anything. Well then, I've got duties to tend to, so if you'll excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusSpeech_000243b5_Oblivio: Hello? Hey! Pay attention! In your pack. The dog. I swear, you heroes aren't particularly quick on the uptake....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001fb50_Oblivion_R: Help Theranis bring back this book. If Theranis is unwilling or unable, bring back the book yourself. Are you agreeable?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Scales_00066f2c_Oblivion_RESP: Help an old fisherman out, won't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersAmuletTopic_0000c08a_: Help her to see that she should not use the weapons of the enemy, especially out of fear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e121_Oblivion_RESP1: Help me get past Dagon and into the Temple of the One! I'll do the rest!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e961_Oblivion_RESP2: Help me out,friend. I need some skooma. Real bad. The good stuff. You know? Been dry for days. Got some skooma for me? I pay well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054fa0_Oblivion_RESP1: Help us hold the Altar against the Mazken's counterattack!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0002a368_Oblivion_RESP1: Help! Guards! I have a trespasser!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ee23_Oblivion_RESP1: Help! You must help! They're killing everyone at Weynon Priory!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bf35_Oblivion_RESP1: Help, help! You've got to do something!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_000164b6_Oblivion_RES: Help? What makes you think help will get here before more of those bastards? We need to get the Emperor out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Helvius Cecia. I do a little of this, a little of that. And I serve the Nine. Praise their Names!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476c6_Oblivion_RESP1: Helvo Atius. Sevarius says I have to stay out of sight. So I'm stuck here until things blow over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05DreamworldTopic_0002c6dd_Obli: Henantier constructed a magical device he called the Dreamworld Amulet. With this device, one can enter his own mind and experience dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05Dreams_0002c6de_Oblivion_RESP: Henantier created the amulet to see if he could use his dreams as a training ground to help better himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05PleaseExplain_0002c6dc_Oblivi: Henantier isn't a prisoner in any physical sense. He's a prisoner of his own mind. He's trapped in his Dreamworld.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05WhatGives_0002c6db_Oblivion_R: Henantier isn't a prisoner in any physical sense. He's a prisoner of his own mind. He's trapped in his Dreamworld.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HenantierTopic_00027f37_Oblivion_: Henantier isn't missing. On the contrary, I know exactly where he is. The problem is he's trapped and there's no way I can free him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05PreparedYes_0002c6ea_Oblivion: Henantier once told me that if he's killed in his dreams, anyone that's in there with him will die as well. So, do be careful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003cd29_Oblivion_RES: Henantier was slain in his sleep. How awful. They should find the one who did it and send him straight to prison.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05WhyLie_00027f39_Oblivion_RESP: Henantier's never been one for rules, and so he's continued to perform his latest experiments in secret. If word gets out, he'll be dismissed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4f0_Oblivion_: Her Gatekeeper is flawed! Her tears hurt him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003cf89_Oblivion_RESP: Her Ladyship has no intention of remarrying. Liked her first Count well-enough, I guess, and doesn't fancy a replacement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HaskillSyl_0001ac61_Oblivion_: Her Ladyship is rather suspicious of all around her. Best for you to not question it, and merely do what she requires of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BradonLirrianTopic_0003843a_Obliv: Her accusations that Raynil is lying is not surprising. At this point, she's so upset that she'll say anything to deny what really happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG07DagailConv_0001fbb7_Oblivion_: Her condition remains unchanged. I appreciate you inquiring about her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ05RaelynntheGravefinder_0018abd: Her death pays a handsome bounty. I hope you'll take advantage of the opportunity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TarMeenaTopic_00002dcd_Oblivion_R: Her expertise in arcane knowledge and lore could be invaluable to us, if we can make proper use of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BernadettePenelesTopic_0001dcba_O: Her house is almost directly across the street from mine, southwest of the Great Chapel. Coincidence? I don't think so.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e970_O: Her knowledge of armor is really impressive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008264a_Oblivion_RESP1: Her light shall show you the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be7f_Oblivion_RESP2: Her majesty cannot tolerate a liar. It is I who makes the rules here. If you need anything, you come to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27QuestStart_0002e5ce_Oblivion_: Her name is Herminia Cinna. She lives here in the Imperial City, in the Elven Gardens district.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_000302d5_Oblivion_RESP3: Her room is upstairs; make sure no one sees you. You do that for me, and I'll make sure you can find J'skar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_0001ceea_Oblivion_RESP2: Her room should be easy to find. It's the only one upstairs that has a door. Just one more privilege she doesn't deserve.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: Her skills with Destruction spells are supposedly impressive. I understand Kud-Ei has her teaching them at the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AkaviriArtifacts_000980f5_Oblivio: Her steward, Tolgan, occasionally approaches individuals the Countess feels is worthy enough to seek her prize.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatekeeperChoiceHowTears_0008: Her tears somehow agitate the daedra bound to the Gatekeeper's body. Her tears make it really restless. It strains harder against the warding magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LlathasaIndarys_00045f76_Obli: Her tomb is in the northern croft. It's a pity about her highness. She died so young, at least for an elf.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c260_Obl: Her wines are excellent, and she's a fine person as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaTopic_0001a398_Oblivion: Her... her light has gone out. What will we do now? Are we damned to walk in darkness forever? Who will lead us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e6_Oblivion_: Herdir has a great affinity for his work, and can be a very useful ally to you. Do not hesitate to make use of his talents.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013a5c_Oblivio: Herdir, you filth. You don't dare touch me. Syl will have your head!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479d3_Oblivion_R: Here I train our skirmishing specialists. You know, perhaps, that Argonians may be gifted spellcasters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51Choice1_0003152c_Oblivion_RES: Here are some keys. They should allow you access to many of the restricted areas in Castle Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000395e_Oblivion_RESP1: Here for more work, are you? I've got one last contract for you. First, though, a bit of bad news. Oreyn spoke with Vilena about your last mission.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be62_Oblivion_RESP1: Here for more work? I've got one more contract for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11Dyus_00014b53_Oblivion_RESP1: Here in this Realm where secrets are power, Dyus is a being of great might. He has knowledge of events beyond even that of the Daedric Princes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem2_00081eb1_Oblivion_R: Here in this case is a disgustingly deformed Swamp Tentacle. Such a freak of nature has never been seen before, and hopefully not since either!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27QuestStart_0002e5ce_Oblivion_: Here is more than enough gold to buy it at any reasonable price. You may keep whatever you do not use as your fee.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038b08_Oblivion_RESP1: Here is the amulet back. It's as beautiful as it was the day I remember seeing it long ago. I want you to keep it, as I have no use for this anymore.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07PayForger_00015f12_Oblivion_R: Here is the new List of Candidates. Hieronymus Lex has a glowing recommendation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034e9a_Oblivion_RESP3: Here is the reward you were promised. Even though the bust is gone, you've earned it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7c_Oblivion_RESP4: Here is what I believe we should do next. I will stay here and attempt to reestablish this Sanctuary. I will begin recruiting new members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2A_000262d8_Oblivion_: Here is what you must do. Go now to your next dead drop, lie in wait, and confront whomever drops off the false contract!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2B_000262d9_Oblivion_: Here is what you must do. Go now to your next dead drop, lie in wait, and confront whomever drops off the false contract!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2C_000262da_Oblivion_: Here is what you must do. Go now to your next dead drop, lie in wait, and confront whomever drops off the false contract!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyChorrol_0004f219_Oblivion: Here is your key. The house is on the main plaza, between the statue and the Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ff08_Oblivion_RESP3: Here is your reward and bonus. Both have been well earned. Go now and rest, and may the Night Mother guard your dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008d2_Oblivion_RESP3: Here is your reward and bonus. Both have been well earned. In addition, you have been advanced to the rank of Eliminator.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034896_Oblivion_RESP3: Here is your reward, minus any bonus. It would seem you and Gogron share a similar... style. Now go, and do be more careful in the future.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBows03_000908e2_Oblivion_RES: Here is your reward. And this other Black Bow? Would you like to turn it in as well?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09GiveArrowHead_0001482a_Oblivi: Here is your reward. I am also promoting you to Master Thief in the Thieves Guild. Fathis Ules of the Imperial City will be your new fence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBows02_000908e1_Oblivion_RES: Here is your reward. Well done, and thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem1_00081eb5_Oblivion_R: Here is... well, I think there used to be something very Odd here, but it seems to be missing now. Let's move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e918_Obli: Here it is... my pride and joy. A Grand Elixir of Exploration. Use it in good health, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27Voice_000a934b_Oblivion_RESP1: Here it is... the throne of the last king of the Ayleids. And so it falls to me to begin the restoration of our ancient glory...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e923_Oblivion_RESP1: Here to sell me more Nirnroot?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00068aec_Oblivion_RESP1: Here to sell me more Nirnroot?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00068bca_Oblivion_RESP1: Here we are, safe indoors. Nothing to harm us here, is there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_magickaloria_000c9ba3_Oblivion_RE: Here we are: "Magicka Darkens." Hmm, that's an odd one. Perhaps it's not a literal translation, then... is there another inscription like it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem5_00081ec6_Oblivion_R: Here we have the mortal remains of a fellow named Din, who as I understand was driven mad and killed himself, a truly Demented act.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofClavicusVileTOPIC_00026b0: Here we worship Lord Clavicus. Do you have business with the Daedra?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofVaerminaTOPIC_0001ec17_Ob: Here we worship Vaermina, praying for her to grant us true visions. What is your business here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a656a_Oblivion_RESP1: Here you are at last. I know exactly where the Throne Room lies. Your job is simply to get me there safely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEHorseArmorTopicAkatosh_00014e60: Here you are, just like I promised! Thanks again for all the help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEHorseArmorTopicMehrunes_00014e6: Here you are, just like I promised! Thanks again for all the help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLCHorseArmorTopicElven_00002613_: Here you are, just like I promised! Thanks again for all the help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLCHorseArmorTopicSteel_00002614_: Here you are, just like I promised! Thanks again for all the help!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGiveDaggers2_0001a7bb: Here you are, my brothers! At last, we will be rid of Ciirta!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeBreton_0009f9b0_Oblivion: Here you face the swift and subtle Breton. Go through the gate, Chosen, and test your fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045652_Oblivion_RESP1: Here you go, bounty hunter. I can't wait to begin playing with my living tree.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Reward_00023665_Oblivion_RESP: Here you go, my friend. Trust me, you've earned it. There is one last person that needs looking into, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1bd_Oblivion_RESP3: Here you go. Don't spend it all in one place... unless it's here of course!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGreaves_000400b9_Oblivio: Here you go. I shaped these to your exact measurements. Need some help getting them on?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e88b_Oblivion: Here you have your Chapel-going Imperials, and your Chapel-dodging Dark Elves, and never shall the twain meet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025df0_Oblivion_RESP2: Here you must find your own path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem1_00081eb0_Oblivion_R: Here you see the Blind Watcher's Eye. A most unusual specimen collected at great peril by... some intrepid adventurer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaleneTopic_0018bc38_Oblivion_RES: Here's 50 gold to cover the costs; that should be more than enough. Come see me when you've got everything, and we'll talk more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e929_Obli: Here's a Weak Elixir of Exploration. Not bad, eh? If you want more, you can buy them from me. I've discounted them for you, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006dc29_Oblivion_RESP1: Here's a copy of the Black Horse Courier. Identity of the Gray Fox revealed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem10_0008242a_Oblivion_: Here's a new addtion to the Museum, one of my favorites. A dagger that heals whomever it cuts! Isn't that deliciously Odd?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItemB_00082434_Oblivion_R: Here's a real Oddity for you -- an arm of one of the Gatekeepers! This one was killed by... oh, I forget now. A lovely specimen in any case.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12AcceptMission_00018239_Oblivi: Here's a translation of the passages we could still read. It was quite damaged. I've also included a rough map that was drawn in the diary as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d48b_Oblivion_RESP2: Here's how it works. We case The Flowing Bowl for a likely subject. Namely, we look for a married guy who drinks a lot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc28_Oblivion_RESP3: Here's my problem. I'm being followed. Watched. Marukhati Selectives, maybe. Not sure. I'm a threat, you see? To their plans. I know too much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ed6_Oblivion_RES: Here's one you haven't heard, I bet. The Duke's got his Chalice back. Hmm? See what I mean? Now, what can you do for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem7_00082430_Oblivion_R: Here's something truly Odd -- a Soul Tomato! A tomato that can act like a soul gem! No one has yet been able to explain it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItemC_00082437_Oblivion_R: Here's the Ring of... well now, where did it go? Things have a way of disappearing around here that's enough to drive a person insane!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Reward_0002585c_Oblivion_RESP: Here's the gold, as promised. I always pay my debts, and then some. Do the last .. task ... in that note, and I will pay you much, much more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5e5_Oblivion_: Here's the key, and something extra. I don't know if it will be of use to you, but from what I've heard of Falcar's ring, it may come in handy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Errand_000452f8_Oblivion_RESP: Here's the list of things I need. Get me everything on it. Try to remember where you found it so you can tell me. It's important.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PayGoldforCrime_00027fc8_Oblivion: Here's the procedure. We go to the castle. First we search you, confiscate any stolen goods. Then you pay your fine, and we release you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Accept_0004f8c5_Oblivion_RESP: Here's the staff. As soon as you leave, the scamps will thankfully follow. Do be careful, I don't wish your death on my hands as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Theranis_0004896e_Oblivion_RE: Here's what I know. Theranis was drinking in the Two Sisters Lodge. He was bragging about stealing something from the castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006dc23_Oblivion_RESP1: Here's your copy of the Black Horse Courier. New Imperial Watch captain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBladeClaymore_00014d8d_AltarD: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBladeDagger_00014d8f_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBladeLongsword_00014d91_Altar: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBluntWarAxe_00014d9b_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBluntWarhammer_00014d9d_Altar: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkBow_00014d9f_AltarDeluxe_RESP: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyBoots_00014da1_AltarDelu: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyCuirass_00014da3_AltarDe: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkHeavyGauntlets_00014da7_Altar: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightBoots_00014db1_AltarDelu: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
