ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightGreaves_00014db3_AltarDe: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightHelmet_00014db5_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkLightShield_00014db7_AltarDel: Here's your item, Paladin. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC2_0002e59e_Oblivion_RE: Here's your payment for completion of the contract. I think it's time for us to discuss the Blackwood Company a bit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvWait_0006bd94_Oblivion_RE: Here, Arch-Mage? Very well, I shall wait.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004767e_Oblivion_RESP2: Here, have a copy. It's free! Always free! We're funded by the Elder Council, so I don't mind, really. He he he he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027668_Oblivion_RESP2: Here, kid, this is your payout for the victory. There's more where that came from if you can keep on winning. Now go unwind before your next fight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilD1_00047229_Oblivion_R: Here, let me remove them for you ... there. You are no longer a prisoner of the Forbidden Grotto.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_00088b2f_Oblivio: Here, let me show you where it is on your map.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb1f_Oblivion_RESP2: Here, please take this apron as a token of our friendship. It's not much, but perhaps it will help you in the future.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_0001778d_Oblivion_RESP: Here, take this key. It'll open any of the trapdoors down to the caves. Every house in town has one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasC2_0009532e_Oblivion_RE: Here, take this note they gave me. It tells you where to go. I don't want anything else to do with the Mythic Dawn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Message_0018bc66_Oblivion_RESP3: Here, take this to him. It is not my fault. The job will be finished, I swear it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39MissionChoice1b_00078203_Obli: Here, take this. I don't need it's protection against her mind control anymore. Go now! Pretend we don't know each other.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49RingYes_00091c5a_Oblivion_RES: Here, take this. I have no use for it; I'm tired of fighting. It may serve you well in days to come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000ca29_DLCBattlehornCa: Here, take this. It'll tell you all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000ca2a_DLCBattlehornCa: Here, take this. It'll tell you all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013416_DLCBattlehornCa: Here, take this. It'll tell you all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39MissionChoice2_00078204_Obliv: Here, this book might be of use to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09JauffreA_00036668_Oblivion_RE: Here, this is the key to Sancre Tor's outer door. I fear I am sending you to your death, but we have no other choice. You must succeed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofHircineTOPIC_0001ec53_Obl: Here, we make sacrifice to the Lord Hircine. We pray for a True Hunt. We beg to be Honored Prey.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaC_00022b43_Oblivion_R: Here, you can have the library's copy of Volume 2. Treat it gently, if you please!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkoomaYes_0008f7a: Here, you take this. It's all I got.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaF1_000a5608_Oblivion_: Here. I happen to have the key you'll need to enter the royal burial chamber in Lindai. I hope you'll make the right choice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJauffreHelp_0005dccb_Oblivion_R: Here. Perhaps you will find this useful. One of the books I saved from my Blades training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02JayredLead_0008e4f5_Oblivion_: Here. Take this lockpick. Careful, it's the only one I've got. You open the door. I'll kill things. Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004013d_Oblivion_RESP2: Here. Take this. The reward you have earned. Quickly now. It's best if no one knows you wear this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasC1_0009532d_Oblivion_RE: Here. Volume 3 is yours. What you do with it is your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChoice2A_0000c1b7_Oblivion_R: Here. Wear it proudly. And keep it in good condition, would you? That way I can give it to some other suicidal idiot after you're dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04FinChoice1A_000253d7_Oblivi: Here. You will use this specially poisoned knife to stage Motierre's death, in the enforcer's presence. Motierre himself will provide more details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusD_0001e8e9_Oblivion_RESP3: Here. You'll need this key for the last door into the sewers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaFanChoiceHold_000aed4e_Obliv: Here? Right here? What about, say... over there? No? Right here? All right then, you're the Grand Champion! Whatever you say!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c50_Oblivion_RES: Heretics are misguided worshippers of Arden-Sul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476a2_Oblivion_RESP1: Herminia Cinna. Amateur scholar of the ancient Elves, dabbler in the arcane arts. How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d289_Oblivion_RESP1: Hero of Kvatch? How about the Hero of Bravil! No need to be modest, my friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture3_0007194c_Oblivion: Hestra Runestones are marked with green runes, appear as solitary monuments, and are believed to be named for the late First Era Empress Hestra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035c8f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey stranger, can you spare a few coins? I've just been shaken down by that bastard watchman and he took my last septim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00051791_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey there, pal! Need a room?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043000_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey there. I'm Horkvir Bear-Arm. They call me that because I once wrestled a bear, not because I work all day out in my garden without a shirt on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043003_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey there. I'm really busy. Got lots to do. So if you don't mind, make it quick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e927_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! Good to see you again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000345d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! I've been looking for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PickpocketNoCrime_000626bc_Oblivi: Hey! Keep your thieving paws to yourself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e9b0_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! My friend! You made it, huh? That's... That's great. Did... Did you want to just relax, or... Did you want something... something else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e2_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! That's me you're talking to! Reistr the Rotted! Hear me? Reistr! Wow! I got this a-MAZ-ing itch right on my thigh! Can't touch it! It's rough!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062458_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! What did I tell you about weapons! That's it; we're done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AssaultNoCrime_00066334_Oblivion_: Hey! What did you do that for? You some kind of maniac?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AssaultNoCrime_00066337_Oblivion_: Hey! What'd I ever do to you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000151e5_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! Who in Oblivion are you? You don't look like one of the Blackwater Brigands!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004de88_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! Whoa! You shouldn't sneak up on people like that!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003335f_Oblivion_R: Hey! Wood Elf! You're a little far from the forest, huh? Looks like your days of woodland frolicking have come to a tragic end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_001778bf_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! You aren't Celia Camoran! There's an intruder in the library! Protect the scrolls!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEHereticAlarm_00052f4f_Oblivion_: Hey! You aren't one of us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS02ManorBuyChoice1_0000a1c5_Obli: Hey! You don't even have enough money! Stop wasting my time and come back when you do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StealNoCrime_000626be_Oblivion_RE: Hey! You don't see me stealing your things!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008547e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey! You said you would unlock the door!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624f3_Oblivion_RES: Hey, I don't like to tell stories, but Telaendril and me... you know. Don't believe me? I've got her undergarments to prove it! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG00MysteriousNoteTopic_00035652_: Hey, I don't read them. I just deliver them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033ee4_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, I was up in Cropsford the other day. It looks like they're really making a go of it. You did a good thing there, you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000477fd_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, baby? You fancy some training? Sherina's the name, and blades are the game.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003ea31_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, can you help me? Suicide is bad. I'll just end up on the Hill. But, perhaps you can kill me? Stick me in the heart with something sharp?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Assault_000624fb_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, come on now! There's no need to get violent!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00034077_Oblivion_RES: Hey, did you hear about that murder in the Talos Plaza District? I think the man's name was Draconis. Yeah, cut down in the prime of his life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006fdad_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, did you hear that? Thought I heard someone calling for a guard. I guess that's our cue.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043500_Oblivion_RES: Hey, did you hear the Gatekeeper is dead? That's valuable information, don't you think? Worth a few coins?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, do you mind not trampling on my crops? What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08RudeComment_00079bdb_Oblivion: Hey, don't you walk away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000411fa_Oblivion_RESP2: Hey, friend, do you think you could help me out? I'm caught a bit short at the moment... anything at all would be much appreciated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000411fc_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, got any apples? Or carrots? Anything at all crunchy and yummy to eat?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003403d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, have you heard about that pirate captain, the one who was murdered in his ship?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00034071_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, have you heard about that strange party at Summitmist Manor?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00034079_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, if I paid you twenty gold to spend a night in the Abandoned House, would you do it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGC03Choice1_00033572_Oblivion_RE: Hey, if you say so. You do all the work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CutoffTopic_00079bdd_Oblivion: Hey, is that you? I hear something over there....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c7af_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, it's you. The one who found jobs. Whadda you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033339_Oblivion_R: Hey, lizard! It must break your heart, huh? Being so close to the water, knowing you'll never get to swim again...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c454d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, something wrong? They're waiting for you up in the Arena!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StealNoCrime_0006250c_Oblivion_RE: Hey, take whatever you want. It's none of my business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033357_Oblivion_R: Hey, there! You! Kinsman! I haven't seen another Dunmer in here in I don't know how long. Where you from, huh? Vvardenfell?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00092d7a_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, there's my new pal! So what can I do for you? Need some items? Or maybe you're ready to unload something? Whatever you need!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00146845_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, there, Pit Dog! How's life treatin' ya?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cc1f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, what's wrong? Aren't they waiting for you up in the Arena?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0004f235_Oblivion_R: Hey, you hear that? The guards are coming... for you!  He he he he he.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d2a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, you look just like your statue! What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f34_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, you're not supposed to be here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, you're the one made us visible again, right? Good show!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d29b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey, you're the one that helped Captain Burd destroy that damned Oblivion Gate! Well done, friend, well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b201_Oblivion_RES: Hey, you're the one they call the Hero of Kvatch, aren't you? The one that closed the Oblivion Gate and saved the city?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36HeyYou_00061c3f_Oblivion_RESP: Hey, you. Come over here. I got to ask you something. Something important. Shhhh. Just come over here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36HeyYou_00061c40_Oblivion_RESP: Hey, you. Yeah, you! Come over here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e1f_Oblivion_RES: Hey. Check out the new associate. Not bad, if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e9ac_Oblivion_RESP1: Hey... Hey! How... What are... What are you... doing here? You're not my... Not my friend. What... You know, what do you... want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06Choice1A_0002fbb0_Oblivion_: Hey... Now that we're... we're friends... You want to come with me? To my... my special place? It's not... you know... very far...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043016_Oblivion_RESP1: Hi there. Not to be rude or anything, but I'm anxious to get back to my book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043015_Oblivion_RESP1: Hi there. You remind me of one of the characters from a story I've been reading. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Hi, I'm Gogan. How's it going?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014abe_Oblivion_RE: Hidden away, by virtue of its own self-awareness, was the sixth, containing within it the five which birthed it. Flesh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMeridiaSpeech_000579bb_Oblivion: Hidden behind a door, deep in Howling Cave, are necromancers. They rob graves for the materials to raise their undead armies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002f258_Oblivion_RESP1: Hides-His-Heart will be here any moment!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSShadowscaleChoice1A_00035592_Ob: Hiding in that swamp you will find an Argonian Shadowscale named Scar-Tail. Kill this renegade, and bring me his heart as proof of the deed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee44_Oblivion_R: Hieronymus Lex actually collected taxes from everyone living here on the Waterfront! Your job is to recover those taxes. Are you up for it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07LexReassigned_0001cf43_Oblivi: Hieronymus Lex has indeed been reassigned. However, you have slain needlessly to accomplish that goal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_0001c4e2_Oblivion: Hieronymus Lex has left the Waterfront? Well done! Methredhel's report tells me that you have done well. You have earned your reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05HowBad_0000c05c_Oblivion_RESP: Hieronymus Lex has vowed not to leave until the Gray Fox is in custody. The Fox is safe, but the Thieves Guild cannot do business like this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00015f25_Oblivion: Hieronymus Lex is no longer searching on the Waterfront? This is good. It's too bad you slew innocents to make it happen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07LexReassigned_00015f16_Oblivi: Hieronymus Lex is still in the Imperial City. Do not speak to me of this again until the letter is properly replaced.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0000c011_Oblivion_R: Hieronymus Lex must be eliminated once and for all. The Gray Fox has asked that you do this personally. It is a most delicate matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004762e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hieronymus Lex, Officer of the Watch. Every hand is needed to build an honest city, and it begins with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc91_Oblivion_RES: High mountain ranges rise to the borders in the north and east, and marshes and rainforests extend to the southeast borders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Unicorn_0001ec61_Oblivion_RESP2: Hircine has deigned to speak with you, and he has provided you with glorious prey. You have been greatly honored. Do not fail him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting03_00002c11_Kn: His Daedric nature allows his spirit to escape into Oblivion after death. This is what Pelinal learned upon defeating Umaril the first time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Reman_000980f6_Oblivion_RESP5: His alliance with Lord Vivec during the Akaviri invasion is just one example of his cunning and ingenuity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09JyggalagTopic_000913cf_Oblivi: His appearance seems imminent. His hatred for this land, for what it represents, is unimaginable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSShadowscaleChoice2A_0003559e_Ob: His body is around here somewhere. Present the Agent's heart to Teinaava as proof, and he'll be none the wiser.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ushnar_00072dc0_Oblivion_RESP: His dog can be a terror. I once saw him sic it on a guy who tried to steal the dog's food.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechUmaril2_00002d0d_K: His golden-wickedness will hold fast against all arms except those of his ancient foe, the Whitestrake!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d246_Obli: His home is located in the Temple District. Right across the garden from my home in fact. Ironic, isn't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Inventory_0000bca3_Oblivion_RESP1: His inventory must be stolen. It has to be. He prices less than it costs to make some of those things. Go see for yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD2_00092d86_Oblivion_R: His meaning is unclear to me as well. The Emperor seemed to perceive some threat from the demonic world of Oblivion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_confidence_0002d721_Oblivion_RESP: His mother's been holding him back, protecting him. You'll go to Nonwyll Cavern with him. Galtus Previa was lost there, and you're to find him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10accept_00015309_Oblivion_RESP: His name is Jakben, and he lives somewhere in the Imperial City. There might be a clue in the Earl's house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreE1_0001e74d_Oblivion_R: His name is Martin. He is a priest in the Chapel of Akatosh in Kvatch. Yes, Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreE1_0001e74e_Oblivion_R: His name is Martin. He serves Akatosh in the Chapel in the city of Kvatch, south of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ushnar_00072dc1_Oblivion_RESP: His new dog though, it can be mean. He's trained it to attack cats and anyone that tries to take its food.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c58d_Oblivion_RESP1: His ring. Have you pried it from the coward's corpse?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RufioTopic_00023dd3_Oblivion_RESP: His room is downstairs, in what I like to call the Private Quarters. Use that hatch in the floor over there. But don't expect a warm reception.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16OcatoE_000add1e_Oblivion_RESP: His sacrifice was necessary, but it leaves the Empire without an emperor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14ChoiceHeard_0001b947_Oblivion: His speciality is setting the Great Forest to canvas. The paintings look so amazingly real that some say they can see the trees sway in the breeze.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice4_000133e3_Obliv: His will is His own; His reality follows suit. You are here because you chose to enter; you were not summoned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nd05Julianos_00002ae9_Knights_RES: History and knowledge are his domain. He is the God of Wisdom and Logic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_00051dc6_Oblivion_RESP1: Hit me once more, and I'll kill you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32HlovalsMagicka_000135cf_Obliv: Hloval dances a little too close to Sheogorath, if you know what I mean. Those born with stunted magicka shouldn't become priests and healers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32HlovalsMagicka_00012d1e_Obliv: Hloval healed my betrothed once. Then he ran out of magic. He said he needed to find someone to lend him some before he could help her more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32HlovalsMagicka_0008efd0_Obliv: Hloval's treachery is second only to my cowardice. My curse will not allow me to help you with his need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000175b6_Oblivion_: Hmm, I can't remember. Deetsan would know, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000131d3_Oblivion_RESP2: Hmm, could you, in fact, imagine just how long I've been waiting? I don't think you could, but I might be wrong. I might also not care. Which is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002eddc_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm, what? I'm rather busy right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk4_0006a86e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm-hmm. Exactly. But now what? Do I continue with that line of study, or shall I delve into something more archaic? Say... ancient Ayleid curses?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity8_00081e8f_Oblivion_RES: Hmm. A bowl that you mix potions in. Doesn't seem all that Odd to me... well, I can see you're trying, so I'll find somewhere to put it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006244d_Obliv: Hmm. A trade is in order, don't you think? My services in exchange for... oh, let's say ten Welkynd Stones. I'd say that's fair.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice3C_00002dd7_Oblivion_: Hmm. All right, then. You're not one for talking. I can respect that. Well, if you need anything, you just let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Corpse_00062512_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. Body's still warm. Looks like there's a killer about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000039e2_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. Don't get me wrong, that magic arrow sounds nice and all, but it seems to me like you don't even need to use it to get the bonus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersMoon_00002dc3_Oblivio: Hmm. I have never heard of this "Shade of the Revenant." Some sort of celestial phenomenon?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03FinChoice1B_00023e53_Oblivi: Hmm. I thought you'd jump at the opportunity to infiltrate the most heavily fortified prison in all of Cyrodiil. Maybe I overestimated you after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d6e4_Oblivion_: Hmm. It's a pity you don't have the right sort of friends. Friends that would be willing to help out with a task like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11ChoiceBlackSoulGems_00033635_: Hmm. Now that is a bit more specific. Finally, something I can respond to!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004564e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. This Scalon looks a bit mangy, but I suppose it will do. Your reward is in the house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_00081a3c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. This place will be more peaceful once Lord Jyggalag resumes his throne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07ForgeThisLetter_0000c01a_Obli: Hmm. Yes, it can be done. I can change it to give Lex the highest recommendation. I'll need a full day to properly forge this letter. Return then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00035a31_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm. You don't look like a vampire...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItemB_00082435_Oblivion_R: Hmm. You haven't seen a huge severed arm with an axe for a hand anywhere, have you? I seem to have misplaced mine. Ah, well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem4_00081ec5_Oblivion_R: Hmm... I could have sworn that I used to keep something very Odd on this shelf. Oh well. Let's move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Help_00098144_Oblivion_RESP2: Hmm... if you're serious, maybe I can put you to use. It'll likely mean your death, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SERunsInCirclesGreetG_00041210_Ob: Hmm... not bad! Better than my old pair. Thanks, friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277bd_Oblivion_R: Hmm... not my favorite work, but many enjoy it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Beast_00045660_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? I suppose it is about time for me to add another creature. I have hopes for an Elytra. If you see one, could you bring it around for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007327d_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Oh, Caenlin's my name. Maybe you knew my uncle, Baenlin? He died recently. It was all very tragic. I'm heartbroken, of course. Well, goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007327c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Oh, Caenlin's my name. Maybe you knew my uncle, Baenlin? He died recently. Stuffed head fell on him. Very tragic. Well, goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d587_Oblivion_RESP: Hmm? Oh, Jeanne has you looking for him, does she?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000852c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Oh, yes, maybe we'll speak again later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk1_0006a85c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Oh, yes, of course. What is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006a842_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmm? Yes, yes, I'm sure you've got something exceedingly important to say. But the Apprentices do not teach themselves, now do they? Good day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000908e7_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm, wonder if it's too late to ask for less rat in tomorrow's dinner?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000b121b_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. Another comes to us. What is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23SeridurNotYet_0001d4ca_Oblivi: Hmmm. He must have known we'd look there. Search around town and see if you can find any more information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NewCaptain_00098399_Oblivion_: Hmmm. Hieronymus Lex looks like the best choice. I was about to give the position to Dairihill's cousin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_thieves_00002e5f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. I don't think I know you well enough to tell you that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09GiveArrowHead_0001482a_Oblivi: Hmmm. I had hoped for the whole arrow, but that is not your fault. I will have to have it repaired.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09GiveArrowHead_0001cf36_Oblivi: Hmmm. I had hoped for the whole arrow, but that is not your fault. I will have to have it repaired.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscRelmynaExperiment_00046f6: Hmmm. Is this too much pain?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004798c_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. Maybe he lives in the Elven Gardens district.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e93e_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. No. Never seen one of those before. Strikingly beautiful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice10_0005e372_Obli: Hmmm. Not surprising. Well, if you change your mind, and the position is still available, come speak with me again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018917f_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. Perhaps you'll be able to assist me. I'm after some skooma dealers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AKithlanHelp_00014025_Oblivio: Hmmm. That may be difficult. Syl has been hidden from public sight lately. However, I can give you something that may help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37SellSpells_0007b221_Oblivion_: Hmmm. Unfortunately your pathetic Illusion skill makes that idea useless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk3_0018d7f1_Oblivion_RES: Hmmm. Yes, yes, I see your point. And the others feel the same way?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003d4bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm. You may be just what we've been looking for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_00024280_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm... I don't think so. You're a wanted criminal. Don't know what you did, but I know the rules. Come back if you clear that up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheFightersGuild_00027f8d_Obl: Hmmm... I suppose there's always room for fresh meat. Of course, we like our meat to be clean -- good reputation, not wanted by the law. You in?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fb6_Obli: Hmmm... I've never had much interest in the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk3_00002bb3_Knights_RESP1: Hmmm... You're right, of course. How do you propose we proceed?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DinnerParty_0001c108_Oblivion_RES: Hmmm... don't know that you're dressed for it, but you seem a really likeable sort. I'll let you in. I'd better not regret this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ06Bears_0018afd6_Oblivion_RESP2: Hmmm... good. This has to be from one of the beasts. Excellent. Soon, you'll have them on the run.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bbf_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm... how do you do? I'd say, very well from the look of things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fde_Obli: Hmmm... maybe I should start betting with Hundolin as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edb5_Oblivion_RES: Hmmm... perhaps the new ruler of Mania will take care of the Scalons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e942_Oblivion_RESP1: Hmmm... that gives me an idea. Since you already know what they look like, do you feel up to a bit of a collecting expedition?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BaurusTopic_0001e749_Oblivion_RES: I am glad to hear that he survived. A small bit of good news in these dark times. But he will take the Emperor's death very hard.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilHelp_000473c7_Oblivion: I am no match for Mankar Camoran, but perhaps together we can find a way to defeat him. Lead on.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000293b_Knights_RESP1: I am on my way to the Wayshrine of Zenithar. Come with me and we shall seek Zenithar's blessing together, if you will.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000981f3_Oblivion_RESP1: I am only a supplicant. Speak to the Dark Elf wearing the robes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314fb_Oblivion_RESP1: I am overjoyed at your return. What may I assist you with?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_0003e94c_Oblivio: I am pleased that you would ask. There is a way, though it is not known to me.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475ce_Oblivion_R: I am proud of my family's tradition of service to Leyawiin and its people. We face many challenges, but Gods willing, we shall prevail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008d31b_Oblivion_RESP1: I am quite busy, but there is always time for you, Lord Sheogorath. What may I do for you?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000276a6_Oblivion_RESP1: I am ready for battle when you are, champion. What say you?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChoice1_00031510_Oblivi: I am shocked to hear of Chanel's crime, as she has always been such a nice member of our court, but I see that your evidence is without question.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChoice1_0003151f_Oblivi: I am shocked to hear of Chanel's crime, as she has always been such a nice member of our court, but I see that your evidence is without question.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ebfc_Oblivion_RESP1: I am sure Lord Sheogorath will be thrilled to hear whatever pressing matter you have to discuss with Him.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018abcf_Oblivion_RESP1: I assume you've dealt with Raelynn appropriately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007b7a8_Oblivion_RESP1: I assume you've made your choice. Umbra hungers. What shall it be?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_0002919f_Oblivi: I avoid those things whenever I can. Horrible creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002930_Knights_RESP1: I await your permission to join the Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000165b1_Oblivion_RESP1: I await your return... if you return.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasB2_00095329_Oblivion_RE: I beg your pardon? You presume to tell me about daedric cults?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043522_Oblivion_RES: I began a painting of the Resonator of Judgment many years ago. I wonder if I ever finished it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5a3_Oblivion_: I believe I explained your task very clearly. Find the ring, which is somewhere down in the well behind the guild hall. Bring it to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VelwynBenirusTopic_0000926c_Obliv: I believe I heard a Benirus is in town. You should check out the Elven Gardens District. A Benirus wouldn't be seen anywhere else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000285be_Oblivion_R: I believe I read that some time ago. I'll have to give it another read.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_00028c08_Obl: I believe I've made myself more than clear. I want that book, and I expect you to clean up this little mess you've made.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_000221f7_Oblivion: I believe Mankar Camoran used it to create his Paradise. It should give us the means to open a gate there ourselves. I will continue studying it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillAltar_00040371_Oblivio: I believe Your Grace knows the way?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d156_Obliv: I believe he's currently residing somewhere north of Bravil. Spends most of his time in Niben Bay, I understand. And I do mean IN Niben Bay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2b2_Obliv: I believe he's working at the West Weald Inn, over in Skingrad. I think Erina tries to keep him out of sight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613aa_Obliv: I believe her name was Bradus? Runia, or Rulia... something like that. If the stories are true, she might be able to train you further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475cc_Oblivion_R: I believe in the transforming power of honest work. I honor your vocation as adventurer. By your labors and their fruits, you praise Zenithar.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JollringChoice2A_000844c0_Oblivio: I believe my master would be very interested in this item.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001d4b6_Oblivion_RE: I believe that Grey-Throat and Gilen may have more information for you regarding these creatures.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e93c_Oblivion_RESP2: I believe that Sinderion in Skingrad could serve your inquiry better, as his area of expertise centers around things of this nature.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaB_00022b42_Oblivion_R: I believe that his writings contain hidden clues to the location of the Mythic Dawn's secret shrine to Mehrunes Dagon.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AnotherTask_000a657c_Oblivion: I believe that you may be able to persuade her to part with the item, where I cannot due to her prejudice against me. Are you interested?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21JollringChoice1_0002ab53_Obli: I believe the note will give you all the details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006249e_Oblivion_RES: I believe the rugged climate of Bruma suits Narina Carvain. She's tough and cold, but you always know what to expect from her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture2_00071947_Oblivion: I believe the runestones date from the Dawn Era or Merethic Age, but they were moved to new sites by late First Era emperors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_0002b43e_Ob: I believe they were hidden in various Ayleid settlements across Cyrodiil, although I do not know the exact location of any of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_00085992_Ob: I believe they were hidden in various Ayleid settlements across Cyrodiil, although I do not know the exact location of any of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22Mission_0002af34_Oblivion_RES: I believe this carving will shed new light on Ayleid history, if I am able to examine it closely. I would like you to retrieve it for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ05RaelynntheGravefinder_0018abd: I believe we had a contract. Here's my part.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11ChoiceWhatNext_0003353f_Obliv: I believe we have been asking her the wrong questions, taxing her too much with vague attempts to make sense of all that we know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000227ba_Oblivion_RESP1: I believe you and I were fated to meet today.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillGardens_0007de9c_Obliv: I believe you have completed the tasks in the Gardens of Flesh and Bone, have you not?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ebfc_Oblivion_RESP2: I believe you have some news for Lord Sheogorath. Perhaps you should be speaking with Him instead of illuminating me with your presence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ebfa_Oblivion_RESP2: I believe you have some news for Lord Sheogorath. Perhaps you should be speaking with him instead of illuminating me with your presence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersMoon_00002dd0_Oblivio: I believe you'll find it quite helpful. Once you've had a chance to read it, I'd be happy to discuss it with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDunrootBurrowTopic_0004301e_Obl: I believe you've already been instructed as to how to proceed. You'll need to ingest Felldew to enter the Burrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004423b_Oblivion_RES: I bet I'd make a better Duke than the new one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edf3_Oblivion_RES: I bet I'd make a better Duke than the new one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d7a_Oblivion_RESP1: I bet Sheogorath has killed millions of things!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35RumorResponses_0007ac7a_Obliv: I bet he does. That Brithaur sure is a pain in the ass.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e4c_Oblivion_RES: I bet someone sold the Bravil jailbreakers down the river. How else could the Fighters Guild have found their hideout?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e2d_Oblivion_RES: I bet the Blackwood Company had something to do with Viranus Donton's death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003334f_Oblivion_R: I bet the guards give you "special" treatment before the end. Oh, that's right. You're going to die in here, Imperial! You're going to die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043512_Oblivion_RES: I bet there's plenty of corpses to count in Xedilian.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d149_Obliv: I bet you don't know the first thing about smithing. Have you read up on the history of the craft? I doubt it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d29d_Oblivion_RESP1: I bet you hear this all the time, but thanks for closing that Oblivion Gate! We were all so worried.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033346_Oblivion_R: I bet you think you're pretty tough, huh? I bet you can swing a sword and everything. Well, it doesn't matter! Not in here. It does no good to fight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43NoKillBhisha_00072dbe_Oblivio: I bet you're a cat lover, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000206ab_Oblivion_RESP1: I bid you a most gracious welcome, my lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003b830_Oblivion_RESP1: I bid you a most gracious welcome, my lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000206ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I bid you a most gracious welcome, my lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003b831_Oblivion_RESP1: I bid you a most gracious welcome, my lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bc2_Oblivion_RESP1: I bid you greetings and cheer, with the grace of a noble stallion. You seem to be of fine temper and wit, says the poet known as Halion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014ad1_Oblivion_RE: I bind thee Atronach to this body, henceforth Gatekeeper of the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000253b6_Oblivion_RESP2: I borrowed quite a bit of gold from some underworld types.  I... I missed a payment. Now they don't even want the money. They say I insulted them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I bought a fine mare from him once. A fine, fine animal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c258_Oblivion_RES: I bought some wine from Davide Surilie. Excellent body. He's a fine vintner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c25b_Oblivion_RES: I bought some wine from Gaston Surilie a few days ago. I was very impressed by it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000294e_Knights_RESP4: I bring nothing but my skill with the blade, which is not inconsiderable, and my devotion to the Lord Auri-El.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09RelmynaVerenim_00014ae7_Obliv: I brought her to my Realm so she could continue to study her "sixth element." Honestly, I didn't know there were five already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8a5_Oblivion: I came here because I love nature. And because I didn't want to serve as a boot wizard in a mountain legion in Skyrim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreeting1_00002ad3_Kni: I came here seeking his mace. However, I could not pass the test. I'm just...  I'm no crusader. But that doesn't mean that I cannot serve Zenithar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11TellMe_00038443_Oblivion_RESP: I came home only just a few hours ago. I found the door open, and my Bradon dead. Standing over him was a Dunmer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47MageShopTalk_00030132_Oblivio: I came out here to get some privacy for my research. Instead, I was constantly bothered by the local peasantry!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_000488fe_Oblivion_RES: I came to Bravil because Mara called me. Bravil is not my home. I miss Black Marsh. But I shall serve here, so long as Mara needs me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_0004761a_Oblivion_R: I came to Leyawiin after a tour in the Legions. Poor Mother. She hoped I'd choose the chapel or civil service, or perhaps even marry well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038adc_Oblivion_R: I can also teach a bit of Athletics. Why, you ask? Because I am the mountain sheep's brother, and I must dash with him from crag to crag.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Conversation_00098124_Oblivio: I can bring her around for a short time. You must be quick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00014b54_Ob: I can create the physical shell of the Staff, but the divine essence must be gathered elsewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00016ef5_Ob: I can create the physical shell of the Staff, but the divine essence must be gathered elsewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015dfd_Oblivion_RESP1: I can eat for a day with a single coin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Repair_00066a56_Oblivion_RESP1: I can fix whatever you break.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15BandsOfChosen_0003cd22_Oblivi: I can get them off you, but I'll need some time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice6A_00028ac9_Oblivion_RE: I can get you started by telling you where the Ogres live. The rest is up to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recharge_00066a4e_Oblivion_RESP1: I can get your magic items working again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054824_Oblivion_RESP1: I can go no further. You alone must stand against the Prince of Destruction and his mortal servants. He must not have the Amulet of Kings!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09VictimChoice1b_00082090_Obliv: I can grant the guilty the cleansing fire of retribution, so they may die purified of soul. And, I can grant the worthy everlasting life!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFences_0001eb6b_Oblivion_RESP1: I can handle some types of stolen property. Whatchya got?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00086762_Oblivion_RESP1: I can hardly believe you're standing here in front of me! The Listener herself! This is such an honor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00086761_Oblivion_RESP1: I can hardly believe you're standing here in front of me! The Listener himself! This is such an honor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32AcolyteWarning_0008fb6f_Obliv: I can hear the Fanatics attacking the gate!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e4dd_Oblivion_RESP1: I can hear the bones talking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002f08d_Oblivion_RESP4: I can hear them coming as we speak! You must protect me... escort me to the Gray Mare where I can buy passage out of Chorrol!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0008e4fb_Obliv: I can hear them, calling to me from the other side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0008e554_Obliv: I can hear them, calling to me from the other side. We need to kill the Gatekeeper! He has the keys.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilB2_0003fbe1_Oblivion_R: I can help you. You need my help if you are ever to leave the Forbidden Grotto.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10FindJakben_00048977_Oblivion_: I can help. The Earl of Imbel has a home in the Talos Plaza, on the inner wall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_000465ee_Oblivi: I can imagine he's a good teacher. The Fighters Guild should be proud of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Repair_0006212c_Oblivion_RESP1: I can make just about anything look good-as-new.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Abilities_000151f2_Oblivion_RESP1: I can manage with a weapon or with spells, but I've really been working on healing lately. I'm getting pretty good at it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RewardTopic_000a3df5_Oblivion_RES: I can offer you money, of course, but given my condition, I am in a position to offer you something relatively unique.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0018d2fa_Oblivion: I can only hope that Farwil and his knights manage to close that Oblivion Gate. The fate of Cheydinhal hangs in the balance!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelAccept_00026d93_Oblivion_R: I can only hope that putting your life at risk for the guild will put things in perspective for you, and help you to value the privileges it offers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KSharraProphecy_000b1220_Oblivion: I can only hope that the rat poison I have put down will take care of them all. It is a powerful poison, though, so it should do the trick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251ca_Oblivion_RESP1: I can only hope the prison guards do to you what they did to me. You will know the true definition of the word "horror."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b36_Knight: I can only hope to match your bravery and valor. I am honored to serve by your side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251af_Oblivion_RESP1: I can only pray that you break the Tenets and surrender to the guards. I will beg Lucien for the right to kill you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d491_Oblivion_RESP6: I can promise you a night of fun you won't soon forget.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilD1_0008b0a9_Oblivion_R: I can remove them, but I will need time. Follow me. There's a spot in the next Grotto where we won't be disturbed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilD1_0003fbe2_Oblivion_R: I can remove them, but I will need time. The Dremora overseer will be here any minute to check up on me. You need to play along until he leaves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3f3_Oblivion_RES: I can rest easier now, knowing that my children are all better protected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060514_Oblivion_RES: I can say without hesitation that none of this is my fault. Could've told you it was coming, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29InvNice_0001d049_Oblivion_RES: I can see by the look on your face you wonder where I get all these fantastic items. I'll tell you what I tell everyone else who asks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05DreamworldTopic_0002c6d0_Obli: I can see now what you were saying was no story at all, but the truth, and I'm a fool. I had no idea that the amulet could hold such power over me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiriliUlvenGreetA_000410a2_Obli: I can see that the scope of my research is far beyond the limited understanding of a cretin such as yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10FinThedretGreeting01a_00002ca: I can see that! I... you'll have to excuse me... I need a moment to collect my thoughts...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gardens_0008e4f7_Oblivion_RES: I can see the bones of a dead Gatekeeper in the courtyard of the Gardens. The door's locked, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015dfb_Oblivion_RESP1: I can see you are a kind soul, gentle lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Training_00066a5d_Oblivion_RESP1: I can show you some new things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab7_Kn: I can show you where it once stood. Perhaps it is there still.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004f211_Oblivion_RE: I can speak for the Count. Rosethorn Hall is a stately manor currently occupied by Vandorallen Trebatius.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a5647_Oblivion_RESP1: I can still smell the things. Look in the houses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkoomaYes_0008f7a: I can taste it already! Sweet, sweet Skooma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b191_Obliv: I can teach you no more. But I myself learned a few tricks from a Wood Elf Hunter; I'm sure she could teach you a few things as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0002870a_Oblivion: I can tell the murder is weighing heavily on her heart. She seems such a paradox to me. So gentle and beautiful, yet so strong...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Fugitives_00009c2d_Oblivion_RESP1: I can tell you about them. Murderers, all four of them. Intelligence tells us they've been holing up in Bloodmayne Cave. Watch for traps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_001885d9_Oblivion_RESP1: I can tell you haven't been successful yet. But keep trying!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04Audience_0007fe1e_Oblivion_RE: I can tell you that while she stays out of the public eye these days, she does still hold audience in her court during the day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDShieldoftheCrusader_00002af0_Kn: I can tell you what I know. It is not everything, but it is perhaps enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DaedraShrineTopic_000a383d_Oblivi: I can think of three. The Hircine shrine is south of town, northeast of Bravil, between the Upper Niben and the Green Road.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_00188f3e_Oblivion_RES: I can truly consider you an equal, and so grant you the rank of Master-Wizard. There is no higher rank which I can bestow upon you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b075_Oblivi: I can't accept what you're implying without some proof of the crime.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_000091e2_Oblivion_RESP: I can't afford to do that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLCHorseArmorTopicTooMuch_00002af: I can't afford to do that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokCrazyChatter_0008efb1_: I can't be dead. I just can't be!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a2e56_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't be seen talking to you. I've done what I can. Now it's up to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bc6_Oblivion_RES: I can't believe Arch-Mage Traven sacrificed himself to save us all. How noble of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc4c_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't believe I'm saying this, but you're no longer a Pit Dog. That's right, you've actually advanced in rank. Congratulations... Brawler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002b7a5_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't believe I've been reunited with my brother!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed48_Oblivion_RES: I can't believe Thadon is gone. He was a lovely man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062674_Oblivion_RES: I can't believe a Mages Guild associate was found dead in Cheydinhal. What kind of place are they running there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001d4c4_Oblivion_RE: I can't believe him! I knew he would try and pin this on me! If only I could get my hands on him...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002990_Knights_RESP1: I can't believe it! I feel normal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002991_Knights_RESP1: I can't believe it! I feel normal!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003ee94_Oblivion_RES: I can't believe it! The Gray Prince has been beaten! There's a new Arena Grand Champion now, someone called the Tamriel Terror!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002960_Knights_RESP1: I can't believe it! You have the mace! And you stopped those horrible daedra! I was... I was wrong to doubt you. I ask your forgiveness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000af05d_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't believe it's over... that giant demon... the Dragon... what happened? Have we won?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000466: I can't believe nothing has been done yet. The place is a skooma den, pure and simple.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000614: I can't believe someone got past him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255c5_Oblivion_RES: I can't believe that Glistel would live with that Malintus Ancrus. Shameful, and her being such a lovely girl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47d2_Oblivion_RES: I can't believe that the Countess is more obsessed with that painting than the Oblivion Gate threatening the city!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_000613e3: I can't believe the Gatekeeper is dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434b6_Oblivion_RES: I can't believe the Gatekeeper is gone. He kept out all those other men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c299_Oblivion_RES: I can't believe the ridiculous new fines the guards are imposing. Ever since Ulrich took over as Captain of the Guard, this place is going downhill.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038435_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't believe this is happening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC2_0002e59e_Oblivion_RE: I can't believe we lost another to that bunch. Well done taking care of the contract, though. We can't afford to lose any of them, these days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05AChoice1A_00028c09_Oblivion_R: I can't believe you could be so stupid...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086767_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't believe you did that. Maelona is furious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0008676b_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't believe you just went ahead and killed that gang member. Gogan and I were actually working undercover for the Anvil City Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000291d_Knights_RESP1: I can't believe you were willing to do that for Kellen. To sacrifice your own well-being without hesitation...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa9a_Oblivio: I can't concentrate on my reading with that other version of me walking around. It's terrible. A curse!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa86_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't count my own corpse! Stay back!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_0008ef75_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't die here... not here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038bbd_Oblivion_RESP1: I can't escape the Xarxes, even in my dreams. I wonder if my warding spells will be enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003334b_Oblivion_R: I can't even imagine what it's like for you. No more sunshine, no more open seas. Just a box and a dirty beam of light for the rest of your life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04GreymarchTopic_00091021_Obliv: I can't expect you to save the place if you don't even understand it. So, speak to my Dukes. Learn about Mania and Dementia. Try not to die.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_0004f8bf_Oblivion_RESP6: I can't explain it, but somehow I can't compel myself to actually let it go. This staff is obviously cursed! Now I'm stuck with it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_0004f8b9_Oblivion_RESP2: I can't fight, and who knows what's guarding the shrine? Plus, do you know how dirty caves are? It'll ruin anything I wear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06ShrineTalkStart_0003641d_Obli: I can't find Brother Jerrol. I need something out of the storeroom. Have you seen him?
