ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003997_Oblivion_RESP2: I fear this time you may find the results no more to your liking than the last. Less so, perhaps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003357e_Oblivion_RESP1: I fear we're in over our heads.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c82_Oblivion_RESP1: I feel I can truly share with you, without fear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ10BjalfiDead_00061422_Oblivion_: I feel I owe you something for your efforts. Hmmm, yes. I feel it only appropriate that you have my dowry. I would consider it an honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c348_Oblivion_RESP1: I feel Ulrich's eyes upon me as we speak, so be brief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c6d3_Oblivion_RESP1: I feel as though I'll be trapped here forever, and I don't even know why.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00018b7d_Obli: I feel as though we've talked about this. Am I mistaken?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_0006166e_Ob: I feel better with the Torch burning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000298f_Knights_RESP2: I feel good. I feel GOOD!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0008e4f9_Obliv: I feel like I need to be on the other side. I'm just not sure how to get in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_0000c1cf_Oblivion_RES: I feel much better now knowing she's locked up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018b9fc_Oblivion_RESP1: I feel much better now that you're here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434de_Oblivion_RES: I feel safer now that the Resonator of Judgment has been restored. I was beginning to worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SadGeneral_00024279_Oblivion_RESP: I feel so bad for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AlessiaCaro_00035fb8_Oblivion: I feel so much better now that I have my ring back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013337_Oblivion_RESP1: I feel something different...the curse feels lighter somehow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1b7_Oblivion_RES: I feel sorry for Norbert Lelles. He's a good man, but he gets taken in so easily.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e5f_Oblivion_RES: I feel sorry for Vilena Donton, but she had to go. A new master is just what we need to restore the Fighters Guild's reputation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b42_Oblivion_RESP1: I feel sure the Master will recognize my efforts and summon me to the Forbidden Grotto soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkDisappearances_00014e21_Altar: I feel these disappearances are an insult to Akatosh's Commands. Will you investigate the ruins of Beldaburo and help us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04SirRalvasGreeting01_00002ad9_: I fell each time. And each time I awoke in the chapel, I leapt again. I tried to enlist the help of the other knights, but none would come to my aid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AxeofDragol_0001fdba_Oblivion_RES: I fell for the same trick. In my case, he told me if I retrieved the axe, he'd erase my debts. I was such an idiot to believe him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014e87_AltarDeluxe_RES: I felt it! The flow of Time is now once more in accordance with Akatosh's rules!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e589_Oblivion_RESP1: I figured you'd be back for more work. Good. There's more to be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_IngredientCollection_000aef8d_Obl: I finally accomodated him by enchanting a very special chest for him. You'll find it in the Arch Mage's quarters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002991_Knights_RESP3: I finally have a chance to get out and see the world. I'm not wasting another second of my life. And I'm forever indebted to you, friend. Farewell!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: I find her annoying. She's way too full of herself. Quite the big talker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007300c_Oblivion_RESP1: I find it comforting to know when the end will come, and that there's nothing I can do about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028d32_Oblivion: I find it odd that so many people have been killed, yet the two of you still live. Looks to me like you two are working together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e5a4_Oblivion_RESP1: I find it surprising that you're speaking to me again without having completed your task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000292c_Knights_RESP1: I find myself here, at your disposal. I want to make up for the mistakes I've made, and devote myself fully to the faith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetB4_0003e8f5_Oblivion_: I find myself in your debt and this irks me. I am honor bound to repay my debt to you. If you will it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b076_Oblivi: I find the fact that my father was a "notorious master criminal" absurd. He was a peaceful farmer, nothing more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004770f_Oblivi: I find things to do. I manage the house, make sure Amantius doesn't starve or run out of ink.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSShadowscaleChoice1A_00035592_Ob: I find your decision most agreeable! Now, the details. Far south of here, on the southern end of Cyrodiil, lies a swamp called Bogwater.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251e2_Oblivion_RESP1: I find your very presence foul. Say what you will and then leave my sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk5_00002bc1_Knights_RESP1: I find your words truly inspiring, my friend. Let me go now, and think upon all you've said. We'll speak again later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b659_Oblivion_RESP1: I follow Adeo, your Grace. If she follows you, then so do I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001cce7_Oblivion_RESP1: I follow Issmi, your Grace. If she follows you, then so do I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000227b2_Oblivion_RESP1: I follow the Emperor's orders, but that doesn't mean I trust you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDEightAndOneTopic_00002c8d_Knigh: I follow the old way, of honoring the Eight while also giving due to Talos, the One who ascended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff13_Oblivion_RE: I followed him a few times, to see where he goes. He walks around the city looking for skooma, and then goes to Lorkmir's house for several hours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Passwall_0008e502_Oblivion_RE: I followed the bones. They lead me here. I just moved in when I got here. No one seemed to mind. Everyone here seems to be waiting for something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000285af_Oblivion_R: I found "Istunondë's Cosmology" at the bookseller's. Haven't had a chance to read much, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241cc_Oblivion_RES: I found some good pauldrons at the armorer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting1b_00016b70_Obl: I gathered those who could see the light and I led a revolt against him. We were... slaughtered by his Dark Seducers. I alone was spared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate3_0001585f_Oblivio: I get by. But let's not change the subject. We're here to talk about you. About what you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d3_Oblivion_RES: I get paid to kill things. That's why I like the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002966_Knights_RESP1: I give praise to the Nine. I owe them much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHermaeusSpeech_000a9483_Oblivio: I give you a spell to trap these souls. Return to me when you have finished. When you do, I will further your journey on your true path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_0004666f_Oblivion_RESP1: I give you... the Blue Team's Hero! Can this brave combatant defeat three opponents and become the next Champion? Let's find out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostC_00036667_Oblivion_RESP: I go now to complete my duty to my lord Tiber Septim. Free my brothers, and together we may be able to lift the Underking's curse. Farewell!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor18_00032482_Oblivion_RES: I go to my grave. A tongue shriller than all the music calls me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002935_Knights_RESP1: I go to offer prayers to blessed Dibella, and to swear vengeance on those who profaned her Chapel and cruelly slew her acolytes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008961f_Oblivion_RESP1: I got it from a dead Hunger. Those things are mean. Glad I didn't have to kill it. Here take it. It's his tongue!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476e0_Oblivi: I got no beds here. You need a bed in the Imperial City, you got four choices. The King and Queens and Luther Broads are in the Gardens.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a9849_Oblivion_R: I got no complaints. Kind of an arrogant bastard if you get right down to it, but he pays us well enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_000286a1_Oblivion_R: I got nothing to say to you, stranger.  Outsiders have always tried to destroy us, but we've always survived.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b8_Oblivion_RESP2: I got out while I still had the original set of legs, arms, and eyes. Fighters Guild is a perfect place for me now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000237cb_Oblivion_RESP1: I got stuff to do. Don't bother me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_0000bcd7_Oblivion_RESP1: I got the door open. The rest is up to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002d930_Oblivion_RES: I got through the gate, and kept running through the woods by the light of the fires.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DABoethiaSpeech_00051ed9_Oblivion: I greet you, Chosen One! A victory in my Tournament of Ten Bloods brings great honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e091_Oblivion_RESP1: I greet you. Thaurron, Journeyman of the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChoice2_00038b48_Obli: I grew up here in the Imperial City, but I was born elsewhere. My mother was a servant in the employ of Lord Lovidicus, and resided at his fortress.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreetingAbout_00002abc: I grew up in Cheydinhal. My father was a cobbler. My mother was an acolytle of Zenithar. She was self-taught, not part of the chapel proper.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bfc_Oblivion_RESP1: I grow weary of waiting. Where is my book?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000908a7_Oblivion_RESP1: I guarantee generous rewards to those adventurers who serve County Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043004_Oblivion_RESP1: I guess I can spare you a minute. But not more than that. I've got to get back to work. Always more work to do than time to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c9a_Oblivio: I guess I can trust you. It's that bastard Audens Avidius. He's in here every month taking my wares without paying for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ebb_Oblivion_RES: I guess I could have been an adventurer. But I like sleeping in a bed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005374e_Oblivion_RESP1: I guess I was wrong about you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035586_Oblivion_RESP1: I guess I've been expecting you, assassin. Don't try to deny it. I can see it in your eyes. You're Dark Brotherhood through and through.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b6e6_Oblivion_RESP1: I guess Owyn will let anyone join the Arena these days. I guess I shouldn't let it bother me, seeing as how you'll be dead tomorrow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004f8b4_Oblivion_RES: I guess Rosentia Gallenus got rid of whatever barnyard animals she was keeping inside her house. Smells much better now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060536_Oblivion_RES: I guess even our Lord Sheogorath needs to take a vacation once in a while. Not me, though. I'm happy to keep working.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002815a_Oblivion_RESP2: I guess it all depends on the size of the chest. The bigger the better, of course, but where would our mysterious host have hidden such a thing?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14MoreBrush_0001bb34_Oblivion_R: I guess it all doesn't matter now. Unless you can defeat those Painted Trolls, we have no chance of getting the Brush back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000837e7_Oblivion_RESP3: I guess someone else has already told you the other details. Kill all the guests then leave, right? Well, you'd better get in there. Time to mingle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00002d31_Knights_RESP1: I guess that crazy preacher in Anvil was right. First Anvil, now here. Where will it end?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk1_0006a85f_Oblivion_RESP1: I guess that depends on how much of my precious time you need....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49Whatnow_00031d28_Oblivion_RES: I guess that leaves you, doesn't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00085973_Oblivion_RESP2: I guess there's only one thing left for me to do. I'm going to find an axe and do my best to chop that damn door down and get us out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1e5_Oblivion_RES: I guess things will go back to normal now that there is a new Gatekeeper. Oh well, I was looking forward to some drama.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00023f55_Oblivion_: I guess we won't be going back to High Rock after all. Cropsford is going to be our home now, for better or worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0009ea80_Oblivion_RESP1: I guess we've got a room available. 30 gold per night. Take it or leave it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogatheOrcTopic_000860c5_Oblivi: I guess you don't know how to talk to a knight. So I'll teach you. Say, 'Yes, Sir Mazoga'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofMalacathTOPIC_00098201_Ob: I guess you haven't heard. We don't like the 'beautiful people'. But maybe you can persuade me you're ugly inside...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea8_Oblivion_RES: I guess you heard Vilena recruited a new sword. Been a while, hasn't it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000176a3_Oblivion_RESP1: I guess you told that Wood Elf what you thought of his magic dagger, huh? He he he he. Here's your gold. Nice going.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona14_00022e87_Obli: I guessed you would say these terrible things to me. That is why I brought my friend along.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05VolumeThree_00022b4a_Oblivion: I had a copy of Volume Three, but Gwinas has already picked it up. So sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05VolumeThree_00022cef_Oblivion: I had a copy of Volume Three, but I am sorry to say that it was stolen recently. Gwinas was terribly upset when he found out, poor fellow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05PhintiasA_00022b45_Oblivion_R: I had a copy of Volume Three, but I am sorry to say that it was stolen recently. The thieves in the Market District get more brazen by the day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05VolumeThree_00022cee_Oblivion: I had a copy of Volume Three, but I am sorry to say that it was stolen recently. The thieves in the Market District get more brazen by the day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12AcceptMission_00018239_Oblivi: I had a feeling you'd accept. Good. Then let me tell you how you're going to find the Madstone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d037_Oblivion_RESP1: I had a feeling you'd catch on sooner or later. That's why I had this trap prepared for you. If you'll notice, the grave is already dug.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Accept_000319d3_Oblivion_RESP: I had a good feeling about you, friend. You should talk to Mirisa about the goblins. She's our guide and knows what needs to be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624a3_Oblivion_RES: I had a very pleasant visit with Arriana Valga recently. The castle was very comfortable, and her new guard captain seems to be working out well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fc2_Obli: I had heard he was looking for some help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000270ee_Oblivion: I had hoped for more help. The Empire will stand or fall with Bruma! Have all the other cities abandoned us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ff09_Oblivion_RESP3: I had hoped to avoid such an... irritation. Here is your reward, but the bonus is forfeit. Do try to be more careful next time, hmm?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003489e_Oblivion_RESP3: I had hoped to avoid such an... irritation. Here is your reward, but the bonus is forfeit. Do try to be more careful next time, hmm?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate4_00015627_Oblivio: I had hoped we'd spend more time together, but yes, I realize you're being honest. Thank you for your time, Nelrene.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08NoStone_00014707_Oblivion_RES: I had hoped you would have it with you. Go get the stone and return at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11SheogorathChoice3_00014b67_Ob: I had intended to give you My staff, the symbol of My office. But life has gone from it, as it goes from Me. It is now dead wood. A useless twig.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eba_Oblivion_RES: I had just been telling Uncle Leo that something big was coming, and now this conspiracy. And they thought me part of it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueGive_0002b5e8_Oblivion_: I had never thought to see eight of the Ancestors together again in my lifetime. Well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434e5_Oblivion_RES: I had rather enjoyed the Resonator being broken. Greater opportunity for meeting someone new.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001c148_Oblivion_RESP1: I had the diary, but one of them stole it from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e5c8_Oblivion_RESP1: I had to find someone else to bring me the Crown of the Ayleids, since you were unwilling to help me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChanel1_00031506_Oblivi: I had to have the painting back, so I decided to steal it then hide it behind the painting in my quarters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MannimarcoTopic_00009222_Oblivion: I had, perhaps foolishly, believed that Necromancy was all but stamped out in Cyrodiil. It seems I couldn't have been more mistaken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441f7_Oblivion_RES: I hadn't heard that Syl was replaced, I was too busy prefecting my latest culinary creation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed4e_Oblivion_RES: I hadn't heard that Thadon was replaced, I was too busy perfecting my latest culinary creation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05PhintiasA_00022b44_Oblivion_R: I happen to have a copy of Volume Three on hand, but I'm afraid it is a ... special order. Already paid for by another customer. Sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022ceb_Oblivion_RESP2: I happen to know that if you go up the stairs there, you can get a vantage point on the meeting room.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008152d_Oblivion_RESP1: I hardly need to tell you how important my work is, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043515_Oblivion_RES: I hate gossips. If I tell you something, will you go away? Fine. The Resonator of Judgment is on again. Blah.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ChNotYet_0001e3eb_Oblivion_RE: I hate indecision! Or maybe I don't. Make up your mind, or I'll have your skin made into a hat -- one of those arrowcatchers. I love those hats!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9b9_Oblivion_RESP: I hate it here. Came here with Edla. All these snooty Southerners. And damn guards won't let anyone have any fun.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa9b_Oblivion_RESP1: I hate the fact that you've made everything better! I just hate it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004a7d8_Oblivion_RESP1: I hate these interruptions, but I suppose they are unavoidable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice2B_000242b4_Oblivion_RE: I hate to ask more of you, my friend, but you know that we're not warriors.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026ea6_Oblivion: I hate to refuse you, my friend. But with the castle still in the hands of those daedra, I need every soldier I have left.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031c83_Oblivion_: I hate to speak ill of them, as something horrible may have happened, but their own bravado got them into this mess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51Talk_0003481e_Oblivion_RESP1: I hate when the Countess gets angry. No liquor rations for us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029c3_Knights_RESP1: I have a bad feeling about this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c8f_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a feeling that you and I are about to become very close.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000852bf_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a good idea where that chest might be. That gold is as good as mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028cdd_Oblivion: I have a great respect for the Dunmer people. They are strong and noble, and generally understand the importance of law and discipline.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00086966_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a job to do, and nothing will stand in my way!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0003b344_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a lovely room on the corner, if you're interested. It's 20 gold for a night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001470b_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a message for you from the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f44_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a new task for you, and I assure you there are no Necromancers involved.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035679_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a new task for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00061c3b_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a proposition for you. Best not to talk about it here. Meet me at the sewer grate northeast of the Sheogorath statue.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0003b34f_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a room ready, if you need it for the night. It'll be 10 gold. Interested?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee40_Oblivion_R: I have a small problem that you may be able to help with. The guild will even pay a reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000253b7_Oblivion_RESP1: I have a special contract that needs fulfillment. In truth, I don't wish to offer it to any other family member. I've come to rely on your abilities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee41_Oblivion_R: I have a special request from the widow of a former fence in Leyawiin. As your new Doyen, I am asking you to help her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eae_Oblivion_RES: I have a warm place to sleep and three squares a day. It ain't 'The Bard's Tale', but it's good enough for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_0002887d_Oblivion: I have a weapon now... this hammer. Not my usual weapon choice, but it will have to do. Let us slay these creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001648c_Oblivion_RESP5: I have already sent word to all the local guild halls that you are now in charge. Congratulations, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982da_Oblivion_RESP1: I have an arrest warrant for the Gray Fox. Do you know where he is?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3_00018c7f_O: I have an idea how we might be able to stop them, but for now we must survive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_000151f9_Oblivio: I have an idea of what this gem is for, and I want you to make sure it never reaches Mannimarco's hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003005b_Oblivion_RESP1: I have another contract, when you're ready. One that will rely on your ability to remain fully undetected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000153b3_Oblivion_RESP1: I have another mesage from the Gray Fox. You must be very important!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001fb60_Oblivion_RESP1: I have another message from the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000b2da_Oblivion_RESP1: I have been anxiously awaiting your return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000146ed_Oblivion_RESP2: I have been expecting you. The full Council has already considered the matter of Martin's claim to the Imperial Throne in detail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00047769_Oblivion_R: I have been happy enough in the Count's service. But I am not so happy about his lovely wife, and her Nibenean advisor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000292f_Knights_RESP2: I have been shown that to protect all Kynareth's creations, I must take up your cause and be willing to lay down my life for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014b6b_Oblivion_RESP1: I have been waiting for you, Your Grace. This day, as all days before and after, is well known to me. There are no surprises to Dyus of Mytheria.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fd92_Oblivion_RESP1: I have been waiting for you, assassin. We have not spoken in some time, but I am well aware of your accomplishments within the Dark Brotherhood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_information_000039a3_Oblivion_RES: I have called you here because from our previous encounter, I believe you can be trusted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsErrant_000908d6_Oblivion_R: I have created a chivalric Order of the White Stallion. Find and kill the leader of the Black Bow Bandits, the Orc named Black Brugo.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Medallion_00066eaa_Oblivion_R: I have decided to stay here in the Shivering Isles. I've found peace here, and I see no reason to return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsWhiteStallionTopic_000908e: I have dedicated our royal hunting retreat, the White Stallion Lodge, to the exclusive use of White Stallion Knights.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e702_Oblivion_RESP1: I have died seven times, each more painful than the last. But still, I return! Would you like to hear about it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Inventory_0001d034_Oblivion_RESP1: I have disposed of all of my ill-gotten merchandise, and replaced it with more expensive, but carefully obtained items.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_000977d7_Oblivio: I have everything I need. Now all that remains is to brew the potion. This, however, is a task with which you cannot assist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bc92_Oblivion_RESP1: I have everything for the budding alchemist under one roof.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bca7_Oblivion_RESP1: I have everything for the budding alchemist under one roof. Far more than Thoronir would ever have, despite his horrid business ethics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027e38_Oblivion_RESP1: I have everything in place for the ritual. I'll open the portal whenever you're ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_0003c268_Oblivion: I have everything necessary for the ritual to use the Xarxes to open a portal to Camoran's Paradise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001391c_DLCBattlehornCa: I have everything you need to make the place more livable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00031616_Oblivion_RESP1: I have failed you, Arden-Sul... I am sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026ea9_Oblivion: I have few enough men to spare, but you have more than earned our help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00062134_Oblivion_RESP1: I have food and drink for sale. I'm sure something will interest you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueClue_0002b526_Oblivion_: I have found the names of a number of Ayleid cities where the statues may have been taken for safekeeping during the siege of White Gold Tower.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004989f_Oblivion_RES: I have friends visiting soon, so I told them to stay at the King and Queen Tavern.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice1A_00016482_Oblivion_RE: I have full confidence in you, and so I leave the guild in your care. When I am gone, you will be recognized as Arch-Mage and leader of the Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000bcad_Oblivion_RESP1: I have given you little more than a name. I can only pray that you'll wander the Imperial City aimlessly for days, and then eventually die of hunger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00026ea4_Oblivion: I have given you the help you asked for. Bruma's fate is out of my hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038fc8_Oblivion_RESP1: I have good news! I've made some progress on deciphering the gate-opening ritual.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_000250a3_O: I have heard Argonia is a strange and treacherous place. It is no wonder odd things are happening there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082630_Obl: I have heard Sheogorath has called it back to the Isles. Perhaps he will find it one day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00025012_O: I have heard that Nord warriors have travelled from Skyrim with Orc mercenaries to assault the Redoran of Morrowind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024e29_O: I have heard that the Great Houses of Morrowind are in upheaval. Indoril is in ruins, and Redoran is besieged by the Nords of Skyrim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TamrielGateResponses_00025015_Obl: I have heard things are bad in Vvardenfell. The Telvanni do their best to close the gates, but it is to no avail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriFinalA_000400e0_Oblivion: I have hoped for this moment since I took command of the Mazken at Cylarne. I return my soul to the embrace of Oblivion's dark waters. Farewell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk4_00002bbe_Knights_RESP1: I have it all worked out. First, we find ourselves a competent enchanter. Our weapons and armor must be made ready... for anything!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000366c7_Oblivion_RES: I have it on good account that the Forlorn Watchman is gone for good. The stories about his fate were true, but now the curse has been broken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043012_Oblivion_RESP1: I have it on good authority that that bookworm, Atrabhi is a compulsive liar. My only fault is my naive trusting honesty. How can I help you, friend?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003d4c8_Oblivion_RES: I have it on good authority that the city watch sent someone to stop that gang of women from robbing the town's men. Good show I say!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624f1_Oblivion_RES: I have it on good authority that the newest addition to the Brotherhood is an annoying whelp unworthy of licking my boots. How's that for gossip?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b9840_Oblivion_RESP1: I have just the thing for you. A lovely suite on the second floor, for only 40 gold a night. Quite a steal. Interested?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000366e2_Oblivion_RESP1: I have many questions about all this. I hope Jauffre will be able to answer them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebc1_Oblivion_RESP1: I have mastered my fears. There is no terror to compare with what Vaermina has shown me in my dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001647b_Oblivion_RESP4: I have met so many of his predecessors over the years. I developed a particular fondness for Galerion, ill-preserved though he may be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003b839_Oblivion_RESP1: I have much to do. This better be good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00062116_Oblivion_RESP1: I have much to offer, and I'm always on the lookout for more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40melisandeWhatdoido_0005373a_O: I have my own interests, and they occasionally require resources that are difficult for me to acquire. Soul gems, for example.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001fb50_Oblivion_R: I have need of a very special book, the Lost Histories of Tamriel. The cat burglar Theranis was sent hunting in Skingrad for this book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014833_Oblivion_RESP1: I have need of your services once more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08Honor_000146fd_Oblivion_RESP1: I have need of your special gifts. There is an item, hidden away in a remote monastery. I need you to go get it for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGNoBloodPrice_000171ff_Oblivion_: I have no desire to speak to you until the blood price is paid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002823c_Oblivi: I have no doubt that Matilde is capable of murder. But what about you? You're as much suspect in my eyes as she is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7a_Knights: I have no doubt that it all began on the day that he left the Order with the Sword and Greaves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b1a: I have no doubt that they still lie within the Chapel of Stendarr in Chorrol. No mortal man could lift them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08SavillasStoneTopic_0009838b_O: I have no idea what you are talking about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001d038_Oblivion_RES: I have no idea what you're talking about, but you have a sick mind. Get away from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038436_Oblivi: I have no idea where he'd be. Just find him, and make him tell you the truth. I swear, he's a liar!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1f4_Oblivion_RES: I have no idea why Valandrus Abor even serves at the chapel. He's not very good, though you'd hear differently from him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee3f_Oblivion_R: I have no more jobs for a thief of your skill. You have no need of the Doyen to provide you work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000241ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I have no more to say to you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ec3b_Oblivion_RESP1: I have no more to say to you. Leave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelics2_00002c74_Knights_RE: I have no news, I'm afraid. But do not despair -- I know in my heart that our Commander will not fail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10BlowOff_0003fd3e_Oblivion_RES: I have no patience for impertinence. Maybe I should reconsider what I was about to offer you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate4_0001562e_Oblivio: I have no reports of any such conspiracy at the present time, despite my Lady's repeated insistence that one exists. There is no danger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04ChoiceCarahilDangerous_0004f2: I have no time for guild recruits that are useless in the field. This will be an excellent way for you to prove yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiriliUlvenGreetB_000410a3_Obli: I have no time for idle chatter with dilettantes. When I'm finished with the Encyclopedia Sheothia, you may study it to your heart's content.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000661f5_Oblivion_RESP1: I have no time for your pathetic attempts at small talk. Now walk away, before I get... nasty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224a6_Oblivion_RESP1: I have no time to talk, friend. As soon as my father arrives, we head back to the farm. These creatures must be dealt with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00038ee3_Oblivion_RESP1: I have not eaten in decades! You will be my feast! Aggghhh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624a2_Oblivion_RES: I have not found it convenient to visit Count Bravil. Travel is so difficult there at this time of the year. Indeed, almost any time of year.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG12TravenWhoInformant_000835f8_O: I have not heard from him, and I fear for his safety.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624b6_Oblivion_RES: I have not read the works of Mrs. Ottus. I'm told some find her guide books useful, though she apparently has strong opinions on some matters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000473c5_Oblivion_RESP3: I have nothing else to say to you. But my father wants to speak with you before we send you on your way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022503_Oblivion_RESP1: I have nothing more to say. We shall speak again only after Rufio lies dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_000488fc_Oblivion_RES: I have nothing to say about the Count and his son. The rest of the town is a little rough. But I don't mind. I like it that way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030031_Oblivion_RESP1: I have nothing to say to someone of your manifest stupidity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00097cac_Oblivion_RESP1: I have nothing to say to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0003c16d_Oblivion_: I have nothing to teach the likes of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0018b199_Oblivion_: I have nothing to teach the likes of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00015f23_Oblivion: I have one last task for you. As a sign of good faith, the Thieves Guild needs to return Hrormir's Icestaff to the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Farewell_0009f9ae_Oblivion_RESP1: I have opened a portal for your return to the world of men. Go now, Chosen One, and claim your prize.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefend_00018f8b_Oblivion_: I have ordered my troops to deploy into the Underdeep. Your job is to lead the Aureals into our trap. Don't worry, we'll be ready for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00038991_Oblivion_RESP1: I have potions, and everything you need to make your own. What will it be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_poisonedknifetopic_000282fe_Obliv: I have provided you with a vial of antidote, which will be used to revive Francois Motierre after you successfully stage his death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_00034e12_Oblivion_: I have received recommendations from all the local guild halls in Cyrodiil. You have done well for yourself. You may now enter the University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b45e_Oblivion_RESP3: I have recently become interested in obtaining the complete set of these ancient statues. I believe that ten still exist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Allright_0003e955_Oblivion_RE: I have researched what I can, but acquiring the cure is beyond my grasp. I cannot risk drawing too much attention to myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00078ca0_Oblivion_RESP1: I have said all that there is to say. If you wish to continue, you must proceed to the palace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40JanusAccept_0003ed37_Oblivion: I have searched for these witches throughout Cyrodiil, but no covens still exist within its borders.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47e9_Oblivion_RES: I have seen dragons. Perhaps you will see a dragon. I won't say where I saw one. Perhaps I did not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008adc3_Oblivion_RESP1: I have seen everything. After you've seen through Vaermina's eyes, nothing can frighten you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_000253c7_Oblivion_RES: I have seen that she is in town. Though she has not approached me, I know she wants something. I would like you to find out what it is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbraTOPIC_00026b1c_Oblivion_RESP: I have seen them all fall, and still Umbra hungers for more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025035_Oblivion_RESP1: I have seen what you have done, child, and how you must make amends with the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAAzuraSpeech_0002c6c1_Oblivion_R: I have seen your name, Traveler, and heard it whispered in twilight. I ask a service, which holds promise of fame and reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Beast_0004565f_Oblivion_RESP3: I have some spells I can sell you if you have no way to command the beasts yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000432a9_Oblivion_RESP1: I have some things for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022db6_Oblivion_RESP2: I have spent seven years learning how to translate this scroll. Even so, I will need a while to decipher what I have sought so desperately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40WitchCure_0003ed3e_Oblivion_R: I have stories of old, implying they could cure someone of vampirism. I know nothing more than that. I hope you can learn the truth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aae_Oblivion_RESP1: I have sworn not to raise a weapon in anger, but you have offended my honor in this most holy place. Prepare to die, devil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPilgrimageTopic_00002a9d_Knight: I have taken up the Prophet's call to defend the Faith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPilgrimageTopic_00002a9c_Knight: I have taken up the call of the Prophet to quest for the Crusader's Relics, and so I walk the Pilgrim's Way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004765d_Oblivi: I have the best prices in town? Why? I'm smart, and you're smart. We know the right people, we get the best deals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_00028c01_Obl: I have the book stored safely for now; I shall hold on to it until the Council decides what should be done with it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05RavenSpeech_00022da7_Oblivion: I have the book you seek. With it and the Master's three other books, you will possess the key to enlightenment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ValusOdiilTopic_000b6c06_Oblivion: I have the highest respect for my father... I just wish he could have seen us cross blades with the enemy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NewCaptain_00098399_Oblivion_: I have the orders right there. I'll fill in his name and you can deliver it to Captain Lex. Thank you courier. My steward will tip you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081d67_Oblivion_RESP1: I have the sharpest blades. I test them out on myself before I put them on sale. They are deliciously keen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f21a_Oblivion_RES: I have to admit that when he's not dead, the Gatekeeper seems to do an excellent job. Perhaps Relan could learn from it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Abilities_00015203_Oblivion_RESP1: I have to admit, I'm better with an axe than I am with Magic. I've been working on spellcasting, but I still feel better with a weapon in hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f81_Oblivio: I have to admit, I'm going to miss you, Dreth. The late-night beatings, your pitiful little cries for help...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004600a_Oblivion_RESP1: I have to get back to work now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a6c_Oblivion_RESP2: I have to sell it soon, as I have pressing matters elsewhere. You're welcome to take a look at it. It is located across the street from the Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48SavlianWhatDoing_00098143_Obl: I have to try and protect the few civilians that are left. It's all I can do now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04SirRalvasGreeting03_00002ad5_: I have told you all that I know. All that is left is for you to prove yourself more worthy than I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_information_00009223_Oblivion_RES: I have told you all that I know. Mannimarco has come to Cyrodiil, and I believe he means harm to your guild. Traven must know this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_0005c2fc_Oblivio: I have told you what I require from you. There is no more to say now; speak with Hal-Liurz when you have found this woman. Excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_00068350_Oblivion_RES: I have trained my entire life for the crisis that is now upon us. When the moment comes, I will gladly lay down my life for the Empire!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_000363bd_Oblivio: I have two witnesses willing to testify against Audens Avidius. I'll get a warrant and arrest him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarSpeech_0008b09e_Oblivio: I have waited a long time for you, Champion of Old Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0018d2ff_Oblivion_RE: I have warned my people to stay inside the walls and put my guard on full alert. There's nothing else we can do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982cd_Oblivion_RESP1: I have word that two of the jobs were successful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11P6RememberItAll_0001fb73_Obli: I have written it down for you in this book. I've chosen you because you are the best. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000545fa_Oblivion_RESP1: I have your horse right here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQDaedricMagic_0008b606_Oblivion_: I haven't always been a priest. In my youth, I followed a different path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10WhatAboutLLev_0003c2c4_Oblivi: I haven't approached him myself, as Ulrich has eyes everywhere. However, he doesn't know you well enough yet to suspect anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I haven't been in a while, but it's always nice to stop in and chat with Rasheda. Plus, she always gives a better deal to her friends.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CloudRulerTempleTopic_0006bd49_Ob: I haven't been to Cloud Ruler since I was a young trainee. It feels good to be back. The Blades have always been here, and always will be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fdd_Obli: I haven't done much betting, but I hear some folks have made a good bit of money.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I haven't done too much betting. Can't say I know enough about the folks fighting to make a smart wager.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a8f_Knights_R: I haven't heard much about him. I'm thinking about going down to Anvil to hear him for myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I haven't needed anything there in a while. I'm sure I will soon, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fd8_Obli: I haven't really spent any time around him. I find him a little frightening, actually.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00048730_Oblivion_RES: I haven't seen Vidkun around town lately. I guess they're keeping him pretty busy at the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028bb8_Oblivion_RES: I haven't seen anything, except for that stranger wandering around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028721_Oblivion_RESP1: I haven't seen death like this in a long, long time. It's a bit more than my nerves can handle, I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0001cef2_Oblivion_RESP: I haven't seen him in days. Volanaro said something about a spell backfiring, making him permanently invisible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ErthorTopic_0001c1b1_Oblivion_RES: I haven't seen him in quite some time. But then, this isn't the first time he's been away, so I wasn't really that concerned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d491_Oblivion_RESP1: I haven't seen you here before. Awww, and you're all alone too. How sad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004995: I haven't spent time there, but if you're looking for light armor, Best Defense is the place to go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004994: I haven't spent too much time there. I hear it's the place to go for enchanting supplies, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Avenge_00189cfc_Oblivion_RESP: I haven't tasked you to bring the amulet back to me, and yet you have. I don't know which of the Divines sent you, but I appreciate what you've done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a317d_Oblivion_RESP1: I haven't time to talk right now, I'm afraid. But I'm sure one of the other Blades can help. Try speaking with Belisarius, or Caroline.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000a31bd_Oblivion_RESP1: I haven't turned up anything new on my end yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c230_Oblivion_RES: I hear Adrienne Berene is quite a mage. Of course, it's not like she'd bother to stop to talk to you in the street.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d6e4_Oblivion_: I hear Adrienne is sending you out to get Erthor. Is that right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e97_Oblivion_RES: I hear Azzan plans to send both new recruits out on the next contract. You know what it's about?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090b67_Oblivion_RESP1: I hear Black Brugo is dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825dc_Oblivion_RES: I hear Cutter collects the Madness Ore to turn into armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e94_Oblivion_RES: I hear Thadon's happy again. Dammit! Why is everyone so happy all the time? It's not fair. I just want to die. Is that too much to ask?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006266f_Oblivion_RES: I hear a new Associate came to Teekeeus's aid recently. Something about an old enemy of his storming into town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432d4_Oblivion_RES: I hear a new puppy dog has arrived on the Isles. I bet he's really cute and cuddly. Like you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TamrielGateResponses_0002505d_Obl: I hear all of Skyrim is under siege. The daedra lay waste to the Old Holds, and there is little to do to stop it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082626_Obl: I hear he'll buy calipers and tongs from people he trusts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061791_Ob: I hear he's a sight to see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002d91f_Oblivion_RES: I hear one of the guild mages has gone missing again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e87_Oblivion_RES: I hear our gold soldier paid her debt, but the hard hand also kept her family sword and armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_000825da_Obl: I hear she makes armor and weapons out of it. For a price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008dca4_Obl: I hear she wants a "cure" for her latest disease, but isn't willing to pay for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082624_Obl: I hear she will pay for a "cure" for her latest disease.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000466: I hear she's a very private person. I also heard she knows a lot about using light armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ea2_Oblivion_RES: I hear something is amiss again in the House of Dementia. I wonder what it is. I love a good scandal. Don't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13GateHeardNot_00031c7c_Oblivio: I hear tell that the daedra make their way through these and invade our lands. It's sort of a door to the world where they live.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00053ff1_Oblivion_RESP2: I hear that Audens Avidius is going to jail. Let's hope its a long sentence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007866c_Oblivion_RES: I hear that Earil is fed up with Brithaur's antics. He really wants something done about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024f3d_Oblivion_RE: I hear that Emfrid and Captain Bittneld are spending a lot of time together. You wouldn't have anything to do with that, would you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06ShrineTalkStart_00036411_Obli: I hear that everything is ready for the Cleansing to begin. Sister Orla has seen the gate citadels. Lord Dagon is mustering His finest troops.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AAnya_00013a6d_Oblivion_RESP2: I hear that in light of recent events at the palace, Anya Herrick is more loyal to Syl than ever. In fact, she rarely leaves her side!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f4a3_Oblivion_RES: I hear that my army has been restored. Perhaps I should join up again....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDRumorsUmaril_00002bcb_Knights_R: I hear that some ancient Elven king is behind it. One of the really bad ones, that you read about from the old days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00025011_O: I hear that the Nords of Skyrim have been warring with the Redoran of Morrowind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00146006_Oblivion_RES: I hear the Count's got someone to sort out that business with Mazoga the so-called knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c51_Oblivion_RES: I hear the Heretics in the lands of Mania summon Hungers to fight by their sides.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029fb_Knights_RESP: I hear the Shield of the Crusader has been found. It was locked away in some booby-trapped dungeon or something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f481_Oblivion_RES: I hear the army is restored. You should go see if they need a target dummy to practice on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024e9c_O: I hear the legions have been recalled from Fort Swampmoth in Black Marsh, and many of the Argonian slaves have returned to their tribes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001473e_Oblivion_RESP1: I hear the monks were most... hospitable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432bc_Oblivion_RES: I hear the newcomer made a real mess in Passwall. I sure hope he stays out of Highcross.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEServiceProviderResponses_000781: I hear the owner doesn't even remember what she's got in the place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EternalGardenTalk_00088b64_Ob: I hear the war is going badly. There are some new arrivals here that were caught in the fall of the Great Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00074a89_Oblivi: I hear them all. Sometimes. But not right now. They're all quiet. Did you frighten them away?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f21e_Oblivion_RES: I hear there's a new Gatekeeper. What if They tamper with him, and send him after me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00040bb0_Oblivion_RES: I hear there's someone new in the Isles... they should have stayed away. This whole place is coming down on our heads!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042d9d_Oblivion_RES: I hear there's someone new in the Shivering Isles. I do so enjoy making new friends.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042da5_Oblivion_RES: I hear there's someone trying to get into the Shivering Isles. It's all part of a plot to overthrow the Realm. You'll see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e9c_Oblivion_RES: I hear we have another new recruit. Things are looking up. What's his name... Maglir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d91e_Oblivion_RESP1: I hear you got quite a task from Adrienne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004420e_Oblivion_RES: I hear you light that big torch in the city by setting yourself on fire. Now there's an idea. I'd like to see that, but the city is so far away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c21d_Oblivion_RES: I heard Ah-Mahlz was out hunting goblins again. Good. They're vermin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e45_Oblivion_RES: I heard Fighters Guild got the Fallen Rock contract, but the guy is just sitting around drinking beer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046614_Oblivion_RES: I heard Ita Rienus talking about the geography of Tamriel again. She's very knowledgeable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c23c_Oblivion_RES: I heard Lazare Milvan challenged someone else to a duel. The man is ridiculous.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef03_Oblivion_RES: I heard Passwall has been destroyed. Damn shame. Used to drink with some of those folks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed74_Oblivion_RES: I heard Thadon is dead. Nothing wrong with that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed54_Oblivion_RES: I heard Thadon's heart exploded. There would have been a great deal of blood. Sweet, sweet heart's blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825fb_Oblivion_RES: I heard Tove the Unrestful is building something again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e9a1_Oblivion_RES: I heard a rumor that you're an idiot. Any truth to that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a18_Knights_RESP: I heard about a knight who rescued the chapel in Leyawiin. Talk about good timing! But who's to say what chapel will be next? No one is safe!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00092a6e_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard about how you helped the Guard drive the daedra back. Well done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042da0_Oblivion_RES: I heard about this new person in the Isles. There's one more person who'll come to hate my guts. I hope he kills me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk2_00034047_Oblivion_R: I heard about your most recent contract. I just wanted to congratulate you on a job well done. You had quite the time of it, or so I hear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43DeadDog_0008f13d_Oblivion_RES: I heard from Bernice that Ushnar might get another dog, a new dog. Maybe Ushnar will let me pet him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: I heard he became a priest to avoid becoming a soldier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d88f_Obliv: I heard he had to flee Morrowind, and is now hiding out in the forests of Cyrodiil. If there are other cultists out there, he's probably with them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e974_O: I heard he learned about Alteration because he's too scared to fight. Pathetic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008260d_Obl: I heard he lives with Zoe Malene.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10NoBribeBeggar_00016255_Oblivi: I heard he moved to Bruma. I'd look for him there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082625_Obl: I heard he will buy calipers and tongs from people he likes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5ad_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard him tell the joke. I understood it. It just wasn't funny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDRumorsUmaril_00002bc9_Knights_R: I heard it was daedra. Minions of Meridia who've not been seen in Tamriel in thousands of years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11JournalGive_00038587_Oblivion: I heard no mention of a key either. It must have been removed by Raynil from Bradon's body before we arrived.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_00029197_Oblivi: I heard people saying they ran into goblins around here not long ago. I can't stand those things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DagailTopic_0003395c_Oblivion_RES: I heard she was put in charge of the Leyawiin guild hall as a favor, not because she deserved it. That doesn't seem right, does it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008262b_Obl: I heard she's been stockpiling magic items... "just in case."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082618_Obl: I heard she's trying to catalogue all the living things in the Shivering Isles, and she'll pay for help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Talk_0002809e_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard some nice fellow found her held prisoner in some cave, and rescued her.  What a romantic story!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028bfe_Oblivion_RES: I heard someone broke into the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004420b_Oblivion_RES: I heard someone relit the Torch at the Sacellum Arden-Sul. Good news, unless... what if someone is just trying to trick us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ebb_Oblivion_RES: I heard something strange happened in the House of Dementia. Probably disease-related.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465f9_Oblivion_RES: I heard that J'skar at the Mages Guild is quite good at blowing things up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004d0b6_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard that Oblivion Gates are opening all over the city!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06CastleJobs_0000bf86_Oblivion_: I heard that Shum gro-Yarug is looking to hire. He's the butler for the Count. Go speak to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004f224_Oblivion_RES: I heard that Soris Arenim made himself quite a bit of money recently. He seems very happy about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0000bcd1_Oblivion_RES: I heard that Velwyn Benirus is trying to sell off Benirus Manor. Hopefully the new owners will clean that eyesore up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0000bccd_Oblivion_RES: I heard that Velwyn Benirus was killed. The Manor claims another victim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498c9_Oblivi: I heard that he stood in one place for hours, just to teach himself how to be sneakier. Sounds boring, but whatever works for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2ac_Obliv: I heard that he was on his way to one of the Southern provinces, seeking fame and fortune. Maybe try an inn along the way, like Faregyl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062676_Oblivion_RES: I heard that one of the Skingrad mages was assaulted, but I don't know the details.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b20a_Oblivion_RES: I heard that some cult called the Mythic Dawn is behind the Emperor's assassination.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00061386_Oblivion_RES: I heard that some of the provinces were talking about seceding from the Empire. Probably just talk though. Everything's a bit unsettled now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064457_Oblivion_RES: I heard that someone broke into the wizard's tower. What kind of a fool would take on Fathis Aren?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a0b_Knights_RESP: I heard that someone saw the ghost of Lord Vlindrel again, along the road to Bruma. I think I'll avoid that road at night for a while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a1b_Knights_RESP: I heard that someone's taken over that abandoned priory in the West Weald. I wonder what they could be up to?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00034818_Oblivion_RES: I heard that the Countess is quite upset lately. Apparently someone stole something very personal to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002c5a3_Oblivion_RES: I heard that the Fighters Guild botched a job. They lost a bunch of men in the raid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1fe_Oblivion_RES: I heard that the Kvatch Guard is driving back the daedra! Maybe there's hope after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a0c_Knights_RESP: I heard that the Sword of the Crusader has been recovered from Underpall Cave! The Divine Crusader has returned!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064451_Oblivion_RES: I heard that thieves broke into the Arcane University, the Imperial Legion Compound, and the Temple, all on the same night!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d27f_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard that you helped the Guard close that Oblivion Gate. Thanks. We were getting worried about that damn thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonTopic_000131d6_Oblivion_R: I heard that you were coming, looking for Thadon. Yes, yes. Heard it all. Bored to tears by it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11TellMe_00038443_Oblivion_RESP: I heard the Dunmer identify himself as Raynil Dralas. He said he was a vampire hunter and that Bradon was his mark.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e50_Oblivion_RES: I heard the Fighters Guild thing at Desolate Mine went wrong. They cleared out the goblins, but they lost some people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005eef7_Oblivion_RES: I heard the Fringe was attacked. I don't yet know exactly how many were lost, but I'll have to find out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005eef9_Oblivion_RES: I heard the Fringe was under attack. Sheer-Meedish is probably worried. I should talk to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c0_Oblivion_RES: I heard the Gatekeeper is dead. He didn't have any of my things on him, though, so it's no matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434c7_Oblivion_RES: I heard the Gatekeeper was killed. I do hope one of my hatchlings wasn't responsible. That'd be ever so embarrassing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029fc_Knights_RESP: I heard the Gauntlets of the Crusader are gone from the Chapel in Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00007e04_Oblivion: I heard the Gray Fox personally humiliated Lex years ago when he tried to arrest Armand Christophe for theft. Lex has never forgotten it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f0_Oblivion_RES: I heard the Resonator of Judgment is working again. Can't say that it affects me much, so I'll just go about my business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_0003403f_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard the most disturbing rumor. Someone told me Francois Motierre has been murdered by the Dark Brotherhood! It's not... It's not true, is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002825e_Oblivion_RE: I heard the others talking. Neville was a soldier for twenty years. He's used to killing, if you know what I'm saying.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ00MythicDawnResponse_0018b211_O: I heard the same thing. I'm not sure I believe it though. I mean, who would be crazy enough to help the daedra invade Tamriel?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark17Choice4B_00054037_Oblivion_: I heard the screams! And... and the smells! I never should have rented out that cellar! Never!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241be_Oblivion_RES: I heard there is a good smith in Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_00029196_Oblivi: I heard there were some goblins around here recently. Awful creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624e8_Oblivion_RES: I heard there's a new Arena Champion. Sure it takes a lot of skill to make it that far, but they'd be crazy to challenge the Gray Prince.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042daa_Oblivion_RES: I heard there's a new adventurer trying to get into the Shivering Isles. No real matter to me, unless he can build a boat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005edc6_Oblivion_RES: I heard there's a new ruler in Bliss. Of course, I hear lots of things. Like that! Did you hear that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044236_Oblivion_RES: I heard there's a new ruler in Crucible. Of course, I hear lots of things. Like that! Did you hear that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00029684_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard there's a new shipment of weapons at Fire and Steel. Have you been recently?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDRumorAttackResponse2_00002ba0_K: I heard there's a prophet in Anvil who seems to know what's going on. Although as usual, he speaks only in riddles, as prophets always seem to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434cb_Oblivion_RES: I heard there's an ancient ruin that lures adventurers into it, then it kills them. It's old, so those walls can't be safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06KellenRumors_00002bd1_Knights: I heard there's nothing the priests can do for him. Poor man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038a8a_Oblivion_R: I heard there's trouble on the Gold Road, near Kvatch... if you're heading that way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002d28f_Oblivion_RES: I heard what happened to him. I wonder if the Mages Council will do anything?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGCastOutTopic_0001efc3_Oblivion_: I heard what you did. So did the guild Doyens. You've been cast out of the Thieves Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c459c_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard you know how to move in light armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003d4df_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard you made contact with the gang. Beauties, aren't they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_0000c051_Oblivion: I heard you were the one that made it all happen. Everyone in the Thieves Guild is grateful!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa73_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard you're working for those Demented freaks. Stay away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa79_Oblivion_RESP1: I heard you're working for those Manics. Leave me alone. I don't want trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000488f2_Oblivi: I helped build Raven Rock. Had a bad run-in with the law, so here I am. Pretty soon I'll head out for the Imperial Reserve, try my luck there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef34_Oblivion_RES: I helped save the Fringe, you know. Not directly, really, but it was ultimately thanks to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d393_Oblivion_RESP2: I hereby bestow upon you the title of Eliminator. Your blood is cold, your heart hard. You exemplify everything the Dark Brotherhood stands for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d24c_Obli: I hid for a while and then returned to the garden. Roland was gone and the woman was dead. She had two puncture marks on the nape of her neck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_000253c9_Oblivion_RES: I highly suggest that you make no effort to associate with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServicetoLeyawiinTopic_00086073_O: I hold you responsible for Mazoga's death. Your disappointing performance proves you are not suited for service to County Leyawiin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1bc_Oblivion_RESP1: I honestly don't know how to repay you. I'm not a wealthy man by any means, but perhaps I could assist you in other ways.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008e4df_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope I didn't use too many big words.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081dc6_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope I live to speak with you again, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081dd1_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope I live to speak with you again, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004918f_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope I made myself clear the first time. If you get near that ship, you'll end up dead. Now get out of my face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_0009354f_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope I prove myself worthy of your loyalty in the coming days. That's it. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002006a_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope Martin knows what he's doing with that evil book. I fear for what it could do to him if he's not careful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004bf9c_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope Martin knows what to do now. I will die by his side, if this is the end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e985_Oblivion_RES: I hope Ohtesse is taking care of herself. She's a gifted healer, and she spends all her time helping others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001e83d_Oblivion_RES: I hope everyone can forgive me for not doing a better job checking up on my sources.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044208_Oblivion_RES: I hope everyone keeps working and doesn't take the time to go see the Great Torch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000811cb_Oblivion_: I hope for your sake you are not accusing me of anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001db21_Oblivion_RE: I hope he hasn't gotten you wrapped up in some foolish errand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000270f2_Oblivion: I hope it is enough. Bruma must hold out until you can complete the ritual and retrieve the Amulet from Mankar Camoran.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0001c4ab_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope it's comfortable enough for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0003b350_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope it's comfortable enough for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c20c_Oblivion_RES: I hope nobody tries to get away with anything when Captain Dion is around. He's a tough customer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: I hope she takes care of herself as well as she takes care of others.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607d5_Oblivion_RES: I hope someone saved a piece of Jyggalag's armor. Just the thing for my museum!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_0005e07b_Oblivion_R: I hope that serves you well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LifttheCurse_00009270_Oblivion_RE: I hope that whatever's behind the door will truly lift the curse. I'd hate to risk harm for nothing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0018d2f8_Oblivion_RE: I hope the Guard can hold off the daedra, but you think about what happened to Kvatch, and you can't help but worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0009837b_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope the Imperial Watch goes away soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0003ab48_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope the accomodations are satisfactory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022f10_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope the book helps you find where Garridan may have fallen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314f8_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope the investigation goes well. Return to me when you have found the culprit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_000614e4: I hope the new ruler of Crucible is a good one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d9_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope the reward will suit the risk. It's all I have.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b9838_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope the room meets your needs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000835c3_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope the work at Vahtacen goes well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00058e07_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope there are more reinforcements on the way. We can't hold Bruma by ourselves!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004300e_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope there isn't something you need from me. Being needed is worse than being forgotten, isn't it? I think so. Well, go on. Go on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09MiscRelmynaExperiment_00046f6: I hope this is as much fun for you as it is for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bf36_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope this is important, Associate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cd8_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope this won't take long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef9c_Oblivion_RES: I hope those Knights of Order stay away from my garden. I'd hate to have to start all over again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038bc3_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope to have at least part of the Mysterium Xarxes translated in a few days. Speak to Jauffre about those spies in the meantime.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009292_Oblivion_RESP1: I hope we'll get to Skingrad soon. I've had enough of the wilderness for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Orders_0001ec1e_Oblivion_RESP: I hope you are as wise as you pretend to be. The Grakendo has lead us for hundreds of years.
