ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251cb_Oblivion_RESP1: I know what you're thinking! Gogron, he's too big to be sneaky! Well you're right! Me, I like to just go in and hack my targets to pieces. Ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002990_Knights_RESP3: I know what you've done to free me from this curse. I don't claim to understand why you'd take it on yourself, but I appreciate it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00053722_Oblivion_RESP: I know what you've heard, all about Jorundr and his run-in with the town guard. Well, let's just say it isn't exactly all true.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a3a56_Oblivion_RESP1: I know when I'm beaten! Here, take the carving, if it means so much to you. I had no idea you would take things so personally.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006053e_Oblivion_RES: I know where Sheogorath has gone! Of course, I'm not going to tell you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060528_Oblivion_RES: I know where Sheogorath is. He's hiding in my house. In a cupboard. But he's invisible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000299f_Knights_RESP4: I know where you may find the Gauntlets of the Crusader, for I was the one who lost them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a8fe_Oblivion_RESP3: I know who you are, of course, and it's easy to guess why you're here. You wish to challenge me for my title of Grand Champion, is that it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_0009354d_Oblivion_RESP1: I know you all expect me to be Emperor. I'll do my best. But this is all new to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08UrsanneAvenged_0001fdbe_Obliv: I know you did all you could, and for that, I thank you. Now, please... go in peace. I wish to be alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038af4_Oblivi: I know you meant well... and I suppose there was no need to put your life on the line for a stranger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003337b_Oblivion_RESP2: I know you must have many questions... speak with Farwil and he'll answer them for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_weaponsshipment_0002888c_Oblivion: I know you were supposed to bring the weapons, but it seems you don't have them. Quickly, get those weapons to us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45DarMaUntie_00028751_Oblivion_: I know you'll do your best, but... please... if I don't make it, at least bring the news to my mother, Seed-Neeus, in Chorrol.  Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006a848_Oblivion_RESP1: I know you're busy, but I need a moment of your time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG14CamillaTaunts_00085883_Oblivi: I know you're in here. You can't hide forever!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028173_Oblivion_RE: I know you're no killer. That means it's Neville! Oh, I'm so frightened! Please protect me from him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0000c1fa_Oblivion_: I know you're ready! I already approved your match, you idiot! Now get up to that Arena and spill some blood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003664a_Oblivion_RESP1: I know you. You freed me. Free my brothers, if they are still enslaved. Together we will cleanse the Shrine of the Underking's foul magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47MageShopTalk_00030132_Oblivio: I know! You're about to quote Vanto's Third Law... don't worry! I have not actually found a way to violate the Conservation of Perception!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_0001e067_Oblivion_RESP: I know, I get way too fired up over this. It just annoys me that she's in charge of the guild, when she's clearly not fit. That's all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0001c296_Oblivion_: I know, I know! Sometimes I wish we'd run the matches through the night, too! But the Yellow Team needs their beauty sleep! Ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark07MercConvo_00045f8f_Oblivion: I know, Neesha. And I meant no disrespect. It's just that... I hate waiting around like this, watching him suffer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01ErthorTopic_00047468_Oblivion: I know, but he usually stops by once a week or so. I don't recall seeing him lately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice1A_0009078f_Oblivion_: I know, dear child. I know. You carried out your orders to the letter, in the name of the Black Hand. How could I be anything but happy with you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelics3_00002c68_Knights_RE: I know. If our hearts remain true, we will prevail against Umaril's evil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000275c1_Oblivion_RESP2: I lay upon you now the Night Mother's Blessing. May she walk with you always, and guide your hand as you act in accordance with the Five Tenets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c248_Oblivion_RES: I learned quite a bit about how to use a shield from Ambrose Canne. Cost me a bit, but it was worth it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d48d_Oblivion_RESP5: I leave the decision up to you. If you want to join up, meet us at the Gweden farmhouse around 11 in the evening. I'll mark it on your map.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirStoryCurse_00002b28_Kn: I left the Chapel at once, of course, but the damage was done. I was weak, constantly weary, and lacked the energy to do almost anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_000091ec_Oblivion_R: I let that go too cheaply.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475c3_Oblivion_R: I like Leyawiin. That Count got you to help me. Damn nice. Both of you. Think I'll stick around. Maybe do some good deeds here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038a9f_Oblivion_R: I like Skingrad just fine. Folks are a little quiet by Skyrim standards, but they're friendly and loyal when they get to know you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c213_Obl: I like cheese. Not more than sheep, though. I'm not sure about Uuras.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004764a_Oblivi: I like cities, and this is the biggest and the best. All races, cultures, cuisines, crafts... the City has them all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fdf_Obli: I like dogs, but it's a bit excessive with those two folks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071fae_Oblivion_RESP1: I like dogs. Dogs are pretty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1af_Oblivion_RES: I like eating at the Flowing Bowl. Maenlorn runs a quality inn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008dc9e_Obl: I like him a lot. He has a great sense of humor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeArrowsMagic_0001f3ca_Obl: I like how magic makes things glow all pretty-like. Light up your foe by sticking a couple of these in him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00023f52_Oblivion_: I like it here. I really didn't think I would, but Cropsford feels like home now. Thanks for making this possible, my friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0d1_Oblivion_RESP: I like it here. People are very friendly. Much nicer than in the Imperial City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1bc_Oblivi: I like the Flowing Bowl. Maenlorn and his brother are excellent hosts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003aa9f_Oblivion_RES: I like the Two Sisters Lodge, and Mog does a good job running the place. She and her sister are both fine people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c18e_Obl: I like the West Weald itself, but I'd rather avoid its proprietor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004769f_Oblivi: I like the ladies. It's been my weakness. But now I've got Romana, I stay away from the fleshpots.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004764c_Oblivi: I like to walk. You can walk for hours in the city. Always something to look at, someone to talk to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_00061ff3_Oblivion_RESP: I like you, but not that much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241de_Oblivion_RES: I lived in the Imperial City for a while, but city life just isn't for me. I'm much happier in Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5c8_Oblivion_RESP1: I long for a Colovian Fur Helm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033590_Oblivion_RESP1: I long to spill more foul daedra blood this day... for Cheydinhal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000bcb5_Oblivion_RESP1: I look at you and wonder how you're still alive, considering your utter incompetence as an assassin. With any luck, this contract will be your last.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7ec_Oblivion_RESP1: I look forward to fighting by your side again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c13a_Oblivion_RESP1: I look forward to fighting these daedra side by side with the Hero of Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000029e6_Knights_RESP1: I look forward to our next talk, sir knight. Farewell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23MemCave_0001da6d_Oblivion_RES: I looked it up once in an old atlas I had in stock. Here, let me mark it on your map.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607a8_Oblivion_RES: I lost track of the number of times I looked at the sky, waiting for the world to end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FightersGuildTopic_00062539_Obliv: I love being in the guild. There's money to be made. If you'd like to join up, let me know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048912_Oblivion_RES: I love my work. Fire, frost, shock, poison... little presents for Kynareth's cute little woodland creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD09Choice1_0003570e_Oblivion_RE: I love the Fighters Guild, and all its members, perhaps to a fault. I fear my concern for them has made me blind to what's been happening around me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa9e_Oblivio: I love the other Atrabhi! And I certainly wouldn't be happy if you killed her. Really. I wouldn't be happy at all. If she were dead. I swear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD09Choice2_00035710_Oblivion_RE: I love this Guild, and all its members, perhaps to a fault. My concern for them has made me blind to what's been happening around me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem12_00082426_Oblivion_: I love this one. It's a Screaming Maw that can't scream! Isn't that just the Oddest thing you've ever seen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c245_Oblivion_RES: I love walking by Salmo's place. The smell of her bread baking is amazing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEHillofSuicidesTopic_0008e55e_Ob: I loved her, and then she was gone. By her own hand. It's said any soul on the Hill can be released if their remains are brought to them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Crisis_00066edd_Oblivion_RESP: I made my way here and began exploring this strange place. As I was passing Fetid Grove, I was waylaid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047740_Oblivi: I made quite a lot of gold from my last expedition. I bought this house, invested the rest, and now I'm just living the life of the city gentleman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0001e646_Oblivion_RESP: I made you an offer already. Two hundred gold, in exchange for the staff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ASyl_00013ffd_Oblivion_RESP2: I maintain a close watch on her. She fears that Sheogorath no longer favors her presence and wants her replaced.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475c6_Oblivion_R: I make all the weapons and armor for the guard. Damn good stuff. Pop you open like a ripe melon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c99b_Oblivion_RESP: I make sure my guards treat the local Nords and their ways with respect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48IlendSlowDown_00098154_Oblivi: I managed to escape, but the others are strewn across that bridge. They took Menien off to the big tower. You've got to save him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089930_Oblivion_RESP1: I may have a bit of a proposition for you involving the Jemane family you so recently assisted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00053722_Oblivion_RESP: I may have let a "detail" or two leak out, to entice someone such as you to assist me. Until you agree to my scheme, I don't want to say more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002879e_Oblivion_RE: I may not have liked the man, but I'm particularly troubled by his death. Neville was a capable fighter. Who could have killed him, and so quickly?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d591_Oblivion_RESP: I mean he's really disappeared. No one here has seen him in days. Volanaro thinks maybe a spell backfired.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00092d79_Oblivion_RESP2: I mean, look at you! The things you've accomplished! You've obviously proven yourself a valuable member of this Sanctuary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice2B_000300a2_Oblivion_RE: I merely ask out of concern. If you're a merchant, you should be wary. There have been... problems recently.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018bc36_Obliv: I met him in Hammerfell, but I understand he moved to Cyrodiil a few years back. The Roxey Inn, I think? You should look there for him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Beast_0004565f_Oblivion_RESP2: I might accidentally kill it. If that happens, just bring me another. Once I have it, I'll make sure it's worth your while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37JourneymanSpell_0007b225_Obli: I might as well have given it to you at that price, but it's worth it for my bestiary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0006211d_Oblivion_RESP1: I might be willing to part with a few things, if the price is right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEServiceProviderResponses_000781: I might eat there, if it were the last food in the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000097b3_Oblivion_RESP1: I might have something for you, but we can't talk about it here. Meet me at the usual place, and at the usual time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a2_Oblivion_RESP1: I might have something, but I don't know you well enough to trust you'll do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff0e_Oblivion_RE: I might know him. I might not. I don't see how it's any of your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07MasterForger_00015f17_Oblivio: I might know of one. Can you spare a few coins?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04WhereIsAmusei_00035e97_Oblivi: I might know that, for a price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc8_Oblivion_RES: I might swim more if it weren't for the slaughterfish. Sharp teeth, and some carry disease.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HenantierTopic_00027f37_Oblivion_: I miss him so. We were study-mates at the Arcane University and we've come to grow fond of each other over the years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000291b_Knights_RESP1: I must admit my curiousity at your endeavor. So many have tried and failed to retrieve the Mace? What makes you think that you will succeed?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000275c2_Oblivion_RESP2: I must admit, I'm disappointed. This was an important contract, and you stumbled through it like a drunk. Leave me now, and think upon your failure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000545d0_Oblivion_RESP2: I must apologize. I don't have any more horses to sell. I sold our last Bay horse to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JanusHassildorTopic_00035e5a_Obli: I must apologize. It was never the Council's intention to put you in harm's way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000790a7_Oblivion_RESP1: I must be ready to run out at a moment's notice. Can't sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b38_Knight: I must change into something that suits a knight. Please, excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MustRecoverAmulet_00027746_Ob: I must confess, you are the first person to speak of victory against these daedra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EulogyNord_0009f9bf_Oblivion_RESP: I must confess... that Nord was a disappointment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderAccept_00002b39_Knight: I must gather the equipment I need. I'll return shortly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000297a_Knights_RESP1: I must get out of this pit, and get myself some rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038581_Oblivion_RESP1: I must go and tell the guard. Please, meet me at Olav's in one hour.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_00085712_Oblivi: I must go to the Temple of the One and perform the ceremony to relight the Dragonfires.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c33a_Oblivi: I must hasten to the Count and deliver this immediately. Please, meet me back at the Cheydinhal Bridge Inn in about two hours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f02a_Oblivion_RES: I must make my way to The Fringe and capture its destruction on canvas. We can't let history be forgotten.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041094_Oblivion_RESP3: I must not be interrupted! My work requires the highest degree of concentration. I hope I won't have to repeat myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e84f_Oblivion_RESP1: I must put this book in a safe place. I have no time to talk now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071f51_Oblivion_RESP3: I must return to my task, for Gortwog waits. May you find all that you seek, traveler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirGreetChoice1_000805ea_O: I must say, I enjoy this take-charge attitude. I presume you are the Grand Inquisitor, then? Lady Syl said she'd be appointing someone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001647b_Oblivion_RESP3: I must say, I expected Arch-Mage Traven, rather than his star pupil. I am disappointed to see that he could not face me himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate4_00015633_Oblivio: I must say, this is quite a surprise! I certainly didn't expect to see you down here, Nelrene.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelicsMace_00002c62_Knights: I must see the holy Mace for myself. Imagine... the weapon once wielded by Saint Pelinal against Umaril...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00008b80_Oblivion_RESP1: I must speak to my husband first!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c345_Oblivion_RESP1: I must speak to the Count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c347_Oblivion_RESP1: I must speak to the Count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003335b_Oblivion_R: I must surely be dead, and in the halls of Azura to look upon such a vision. You are so beautiful, my dear Dunmer maiden...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice2A_0004f229_Oblivion_RE: I myself have been here for some time, hoping to find out what's going on. No luck yet, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_0003066e_Oblivion_RESP2: I myself was able to kill perhaps two score of them, but they just kept coming. Only Bremman and I remain alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTopic_00033df6_Oblivion_RES: I myself was training as a Blade when I received the call to serve Talos in a different way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018d7d9_Oblivion_RESP1: I need a moment of your time. It's urgent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062449_Obliv: I need a new Elven cuirass. Nothing fancy, nothing enchanted. Just a decent piece of armor. You get that for me, and I'll train you. That's the deal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000452f2_Oblivion_RESP1: I need help collecting Swamp Tentacles. I'll even pay you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImpGallTOPIC_0002ee71_Oblivion_RE: I need imp gall for my studies. Ten portions of it, in fact. Since I hired the Fighters Guild, I expect you to get it done. And carefully, please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkooma_0008f60d_O: I need it. You got it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_0002250a_Obl: I need more time to work on the translation. The more you bother me, the longer it's going to take.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002006d_Oblivion_RESP1: I need some time to study the Mysterium Xarxes. I'll let you know when I learn something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ02Skooma_00189180_Oblivion_RESP: I need someone to go in there and put a stop to those fetchers. I don't care what it takes. We must get that poison they're selling off the street.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06CastleJobs_0000bf84_Oblivion_: I need someone to slop food to the prisoners. I'll pay you 2 gold a week, plus half a loaf of bread and a glass of mead each day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireAshTopic_0008d1eb_Oblivion: I need the ashes of a powerful vampire. You have them in your possession. It is good to see that Hindaril has been defeated already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10HelpGF_0001530d_Oblivion_RESP: I need the boots of Springheel Jak. He is a famous thief that died some 300 years ago. Legend has it that he was buried with his boots on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028723_Oblivion_RESP2: I need to find some real spirits. I think I saw some mead down in the basement. I don't care if it's not safe! It's my nerves! I need to calm down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02JayredSayUnlockGate_0007ec3f_: I need to get in there!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16Talk_0004bf9f_Oblivion_RESP1: I need to get to the Temple of the One. It's our only chance to stop Mehrunes Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1cc_Oblivion_RES: I need to head over to Colovian Traders and pick up a few things from Gunder. He's got a nice selection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC_0002428b_Oblivion_RES: I need to know why he defaulted on his contract. What have you learned?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035587_Oblivion_RESP1: I need to rest now, regain my strength. Don't forget to take the heart of the Argonian Agent. Present that to Teinaava, and he'll be none the wiser.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49Whatnow_00031d28_Oblivion_RES: I need to stay with the guards. They won't do well without a strong leader. And I can't trust any of them to make it through the city on their own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018d7dc_Oblivion_RESP1: I need to talk to you, soldier to soldier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356b1_Oblivion_RESP1: I need you in Leyawiin to take care of that Hist. What is it you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08accept_000146ff_Oblivion_RESP: I need you to acquire Savilla's Stone. It is a large crystal with special properties that I need to gain... advantage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc28_Oblivion_RESP4: I need you to check out some people for me, the ones that are following me.  Watch them, see where they go, who they report to. Will you help me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e8a7_Oblivion_RESP3: I need you to come with us. You've got far more combat experience than these men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_000356cc_Oblivio: I need you to find Ajum-Kajin and bring him back to me. I want to talk to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356c6_Oblivion_RESP1: I need you to get down to Leyawiin and infiltrate the Blackwood Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43StaffTalk_0004f8c2_Oblivion_R: I need you to get over to the Mages Guild and talk to a good friend of mine, Alvis Uvenim. She's the only one in town that I trust.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TimeToGo_0002a7dd_Oblivion_RESP1: I need you to leave now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TimeToGo_0002a7de_Oblivion_RESP1: I need you to leave so I can lock up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c59f_Oblivion_RESP1: I need your help now. Have you made up your mind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServicetoLeyawiinTopic_000860b5_O: I need your help. An Orc named Mazoga here claims to be a knight, but will not reveal her business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice4SoWhat_00061c4c_Oblivi: I need your help. I need you to send my soul away from this world!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004f792_Oblivion_RES: I need your help. Please come with us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004992f_Oblivion_RES: I needed some cash, so I went to see Jensine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00064463_Oblivion: I never believed in the Gray Fox anyway. I think the Imperium just made him up as an excuse to raise our taxes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10FinThedretGreeting02a_00002ca: I never doubted you, Crusader. But I must tell the others that you're alive!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073927_Oblivion_RESP1: I never had time to properly thank you for your help back in the Imperial City. I wouldn't have made it back here if it weren't for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I never really thought about it. They just didn't seem like the sort of folks I wanted to spend time with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasB3_0009532a_Oblivion_RE: I never said anything about the Mythic Dawn. In fact, I don't even know what you're talking about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND05WhatDoYouMean_00002c91_Knight: I never saw our work finished;  I trust that the others carried on without me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a944d_Oblivion_R: I never suspected Umbacano might be up to no good. Apparently he was as mad as he was rich!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031606_Oblivion_RESP1: I never suspected it was Thadon's time, but what's done is done. I honor his choice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefendA2_000131b8_Oblivio: I never suspected that Kaneh had the audacity to try such a risky assault.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilB2_0003fbe1_Oblivion_R: I never thought I would have a chance to redeem myself, waiting helplessly here in eternity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas1_00002c48_Knights_RE: I never thought any of us would survive, to be honest. The Aurorans just kept getting back up. It was the Lord Crusader who saved us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12RecoverYes_0001823d_Oblivion_: I never thought it possible. I mean... I had hoped... but to actually hold it in my hands. It's more beautiful than I imagined it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d0ae_Oblivion_RESP2: I never thought it would come to this... the Amulet... Martin must use it against Him! We have no choice!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12MartinB_000270ff_Oblivion_RES: I never thought to see a Great Welkynd Stone! As beautiful as all the old tales tell...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactK_00038fb7_Oblivion_R: I never thought to see this again. I once possessed it, briefly ... a lifetime ago, it seems now ...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas2_00002c44_Knights_RE: I never tire of hearing tales of the Crusader's exploits. It's an honor to serve with you, sir knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b3f_Oblivion_RESP1: I never tire of the beauty of Gaiar Alata.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eaa_Oblivion_RES: I never understood Syl's methods. Wouldn't a nice talk and a basket of hot biscuits get her the information she needs?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033584_Oblivion_RESP1: I never want to see one of those gates again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001da64_Obli: I never would have guessed that Roland was a vampire. I could have sworn I saw him walk in daylight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00044200_Oblivion_RES: I no longer serve Lady Syl. Crucible has a new ruler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007dbff_Oblivion_RESP3: I now declare you Duchess of Mania of the Shivering Isles! May your light shine upon all our happiest days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016ea6_Oblivion_RESP3: I now declare you Duke of Mania of the Shivering Isles! May your light shine upon all our happiest days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007dbfe_Oblivion_RESP3: I now declare you to be Duchess of Dementia of the Shivering Isles! May your wrath and anger be your guide.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014440_Oblivion_RESP3: I now declare you to be Duke of Dementia of the Shivering Isles! May your wrath and anger be your guide.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bee4_Oblivion_RESP3: I now intend to put your talents to a more direct test. I have a difficult task that you can, perhaps, assist with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000688fb_Oblivion_RESP1: I offer no excuses, sire. But my life is yours. No assassin will take you while I draw breath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_000091be_Oblivion_RESP1: I offer the finest goods and lowest prices in all Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e1f_Oblivion_RESP3: I offer you a chance for redemption. Do not return until you have 20 bear pelts. Take this time to come to terms with what you've done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PellsGateTOPIC_00026b1f_Oblivion_: I offer you a choice, more than I have offered most. Stay here and die, or leave now, and live your life. Speak to me again when your mind is set.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Become_0007893e_Oblivion_RESP: I offer you this: remember who it is you're attempting to replace. You'll need to approach them in a manner to which they are not accustomed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081c53_Oblivion_RESP1: I often wonder what it'd be like, to fall to the ground so far below. I bet it'd be like flying -- then suddenly falling into a deep, blissful sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Spoon_00078639_Oblivion_RESP1: I once killed a minotaur with that spoon. It's a mighty daedric artifact!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eab_Oblivion_RES: I once met Herdir after a misunderstanding about some candlesticks in Syl's great hall. He's not a bad fellow, actually.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LucienLachanceTopic_000253de_Obli: I once saw Lucien deal with an insubordinate Brother, someone who had broken the Tenets. It took me a week to get the blood off my boots.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000253e8_Oblivion_RESP1: I once slept in the Chorrol Chapel Undercroft. It's damp, cold... and cursed! Getting Motierre out of there may be a challenge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkRelicsGauntlets_00002c5e_Kn: I once went to Stendarr's Chapel to try the Gauntlets for myself. Truly, the Commander is the Divine Crusader come again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476cb_Oblivi: I only do the training any more. None of the rigs and tricks. Rochelle and me just want the settled life nowadays.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00014709_Oblivion_R: I only provide work for less skillful thieves. If you take their jobs, what will they do for a living?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0003d7ff_Oblivion_: I only serve higher ranking Thieves Guild members. Go see Ongar in Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001fdb6_Oblivion_RESP1: I only wish to return home and be with my wife, Ursanne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000980d9_Oblivion_RES: I overheard a guard mention the Countess is looking for a piece to add to her collection of Akaviri artifacts. Our taxpayer's drakes at work...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00132a9d_Oblivion_RES: I overheard someone say that Aleron Loche is missing. I don't know what happened to him. His wife, Ursanne, is beside herself with grief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00038f1f_Oblivion_RES: I overheard that the vampire hunter who was in town was a fake. It was apparently a ruse to get his hands on Bradon's key to a treasure chest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00053718_Oblivion_RESP: I owe all of this to that heartless treacherous witch, Arnora.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00090868_Oblivion_RESP: I owe all of this to that heartless treacherous witch, Arnora.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0000a223_Oblivion_RESP1: I owe you a debt of gratitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005416f_Oblivion_RESP1: I own the Black Waterside Stables.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005416e_Oblivion_RESP1: I own the Black Waterside Stables. Are you shopping for a horse?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Diary_0001823b_Oblivion_RESP1: I paid several scouts to try and find the ruins at Pale Pass before I hired you. They were only able to locate the first of a series of landmarks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandAuthority_0001d4c7_Obli: I panicked. By the time I awoke, her body was gone. I knew Seridur was a respected member of the community.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22Mission_0002af34_Oblivion_RES: I part with it reluctantly, so guard it well. It is what began my search for the High Fane, many years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EaranaTopic_0002acc2_Oblivion_RES: I passed her the other day. You wouldn't believe the look she gave me! Whatever happened, she's taking it out on the whole guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d892_Obliv: I personally wouldn't go looking for him myself, but you might keep it in mind if you ever run across him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000285ad_Oblivion_R: I picked up "Frontier, Conquest." Haven't read much, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ushnar_00072dc1_Oblivion_RESP: I pity the poor Khajiit that tries to steal dog food from Ushnar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028721_Oblivion_RESP2: I plan to gather up every drop of drink in this house and keep it to myself, if things get any worse around here. I find comfort there, you see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0002573b_Oblivion_RESP3: I plan to live out my days on the farm in peace and quiet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00061384_Oblivion_RES: I plan to visit the Imperial City soon to pay my respects at the Temple of the One. They say the Dragon Statue is 100 feet high!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005d50a_Oblivion_RESP1: I played Lord Vile's game, and lost my soul. Small loss, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkGarlas1_00002c47_Knights_RE: I played only a small part. It was the Crusader who won the day for us. It truly seemed that Pelinal Whitestrake had returned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_00031523_Oblivion_RES: I poured myself some wine and studied the charts I had made until it was time to sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDRodericGreetB_00002a9f_Knights_: I pray that I too may be worthy to receive such a divine command.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03MartinB1_00082dc9_Oblivion_RE: I prayed to Akatosh all through that terrible night, but no help came. Only more daedra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11Peaceful_0003858b_Oblivion_RE: I prefer the chance for freedom.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049961_Oblivi: I prefer to just listen to people talk. Some of the conversations they have are truly remarkable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ef2f_Oblivion_RESP1: I prepare the way for my Lord Jyggalag.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008d2_Oblivion_RESP4: I present to you now this key. It unlocks the well behind the Abandoned House above. Use it to gain hidden, quick access to this Sanctuary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d393_Oblivion_RESP3: I present to you now this key. It unlocks the well behind the Abandoned House above. Use it to gain hidden, quick access to this Sanctuary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003489e_Oblivion_RESP5: I present to you now this key. It unlocks the well behind the Abandoned House above. Use it to gain hidden, quick access to this Sanctuary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023f7c_Oblivion_RESP2: I present to you this dagger. It's an enchanted blade, known as Sufferthorn. Its prick is deadly, I assure you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b1253_Oblivion_RESP1: I presume you're satisfied with the room.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024fd4_Oblivion_RESP1: I presumed it was only a matter of time before you'd be expelled. Once again, I am proven correct.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersAmuletTopic_000146c8_: I promise I'll make this quick. I'd like to have you mostly intact, so Mannimarco can suck the marrow from your bones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018ae76_Oblivion_RESP1: I pulled duty outside the Imperial Libray tonight. Curse my luck. Being that close to the Elder Scrolls gives me the creeps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQDaedricMagic_0008b605_Oblivion_: I put aside the dark arts when I became a priest. But the workings of fate may be seen in this, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS39Seen_0004ed74_Oblivion_RESP6: I put the book aside, because frankly, I had so many other delicate experiments going on that I just didn't have the time to go plant hunting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e977_Oblivion_RESP6: I put the book aside, because frankly, I had so many other delicate experiments going on that I just didn't have the time to go plant hunting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_00029199_Oblivi: I ran across a couple of mudcrabs not long ago. Annoying creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc2_Oblivion_RES: I ran across a ghost once. Seemed to suck the energy right out of me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_00029195_Oblivi: I ran into some goblins in the woods not long ago. Nasty little beasts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004763f_Oblivi: I rarely leave the University, as I have all I need right here. If you need ingredients, try Ogier Georick at 'The Main Ingredient.'
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277b4_Oblivion_R: I read "The Real Barenziah" recently. Quite a piece of work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255bc_Oblivion_RES: I read one of Casta Scribonia's books not long ago. Terrible stuff, if you ask me. But, some folks seem to like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004996: I read the thing once in a while. Mostly, I use it for kindling. There's no telling whether anything in it is actually true.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d3a1_Oblivion_RESP2: I realize he was trying at times, and he spoke before he thought, but he was still my son, and I adored him greatly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002df70_Oblivion_RESP4: I realize he's trying at times, and he speaks before he thinks, but he's still my son, and I adore him greatly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ05RaelynntheGravefinder_0018abd: I realize it's in poor taste to celebrate anyone's demise, but Raelynn was evil through-and-through. You've done the right thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopYes_0001e840_Oblivion_RES: I realize you risked your life to give me a chance, and Thoronir never forgets things like that. Accept this ring as a humble reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e922_Obli: I really can't do anything without 20 more samples of Nirnroot. Come back when you have them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001db16_Oblivion_RESP1: I really can't help you with anything else. Please, go see Gilen at Seridur's house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002d930_Oblivion_RES: I really can't tell you what happened. I'm just lucky to be alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001ad4d_Oblivion_RESP1: I really do loathe talking to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a20_Oblivion_RESP1: I really don't have time for the likes of you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028259_Oblivion_RE: I really don't know anything about him, so you'd be better off asking someone else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cf0_Oblivion_RESP1: I really don't want you around me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028796_Oblivion_RE: I really have to wonder where Neville was when someone was getting slaughtered just a few rooms away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasC3_0009532f_Oblivion_RE: I really know very little. They contacted me. I suppose they learned that I was looking for the third and fourth volumes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008f10a_Oblivion_RESP1: I really must get back to my paintings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00023cd5_Oblivion_RES: I really must thank the one who recommended you -- and the Grey Mare. Always a splendid feast for my spirits. And the food is good, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000452fd_Oblivion_RESP1: I really must thank you. Chapters 23 and 48 of my taxonomy are now complete thanks to your effort. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08SavillasStoneTopic_0009838d_O: I really shouldn't be telling you this, but I know you are trustworthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008e4e6_Oblivion_RESP1: I really wish they would stop yelling.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c35b_Oblivion_RESP1: I really wish you had followed my advice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e02_Oblivion_RESP2: I recognize this type of parcel. It contains sealed orders. It's addressed to you... from Lucien Lachance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting3b_00019fcb_O: I require weapons. For myself and for the Apostles that will help me do the deed. But Ciirta already is suspicious of me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008d318_Oblivion_RESP1: I return to work, Lord. Farewell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d83f_Oblivion_RESP1: I run the North Country Stables.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d83e_Oblivion_RESP1: I run the North Country Stables. Are you interested in a horse?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d24c_Obli: I rushed into the back garden to find Roland struggling with a woman he'd been courting. I tried to intervene, but he was too strong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10AldosTalk_0003c2bb_Oblivion_R: I said move! Or by my ancestors I'll put you on the ground with a split lip!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e58_Oblivion_RESP1: I said we'd speak later. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinB1_00027102_Oblivion_RE: I said you weren't going to like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d283_Oblivion_RESP1: I salute you for your daring, Hero of Kvatch! You've proven yourself once again here at Skingrad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008efc6_Oblivion_RESP1: I sat here and feasted while others fought. Thus I earned my doom.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1d6_Oblivion_RES: I saw Agnete out drinking late again last night. It's no wonder they call her "the Pickled." She sure can repair armor, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025241_Oblivion_RES: I saw Earana leaving town. She looked very excited.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002d939_Oblivion_RES: I saw Erthor earlier. Guess someone rescued him again. Hide your scrolls while you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1d7_Oblivion_RES: I saw Huurwen practicing shield technique at the Fighters Guild the other day. She could teach me a thing or two.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498b6_Oblivion_RES: I saw Irene Metrick recently. She jumped clear over a table at the inn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003cd52_Oblivion_RES: I saw Kud-Ei moping around outside the Mages Guild yesterday. In fact, I could swear she was crying. I hope she finds her missing friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025661_Oblivion_RES: I saw Rena Bruiant talking to her dogs the other day. I think she thinks they understand her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025242_Oblivion_RES: I saw Reynald Jemane's brother earlier. Can't believe they didn't even know about each other.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255b8_Oblivion_RES: I saw Rimalus Bruiant walking his dogs today. And yesterday. And the day before. I swear that's all he does.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1ca_Oblivion_RES: I saw Rufrius Vinicius knock a man down with one punch. I wish he'd teach me a bit about hand-to-hand combat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c232_Oblivion_RES: I saw Sulinus Vassinus at the Mages Guild conjure up some sort of creature, right there in the street. Guards took care of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003aa9c_Oblivion_RES: I saw Ugak gra-Mogakh earlier. At least, I think it was her. Perhaps it was her sister.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Bhisha_00072dbc_Oblivion_RESP: I saw Ushnar try to give Bhisha some of her dog's food once. I told Bhisha not to take it. Ushnar just wanted his dog to attack Bhisha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241c6_Oblivion_RES: I saw Valus Odiil at the Grey Mare again today. Hasn't been the same since his boys took off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DaedraShrineTopic_000a495a_Oblivi: I saw a big statue of Malacath, west of Fort Sutch, west of the Gold Road to Hammerfell. Looked like Daedra worshippers to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_00029198_Oblivi: I saw a mudcrab a couple of days ago. Ugly little animals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc0_Oblivion_RES: I saw a wraith once. It threw a curse on me I'll never forget.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_000239e0_Oblivion_RE: I saw him in Cheydinhal recently, and said 'Hi,' and he pretended he didn't know me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_000498cc_Oblivi: I saw him once. Then I didn't. How about that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CreatureResponses_0002919b_Oblivi: I saw some mudcrabs by the water recently. I steered clear of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4ef_Oblivion_: I saw some strangers heading up there earlier. If they're still alive, you can see the Gatekeeper in action. It's glorious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ01Potatoes_001885db_Oblivion_RE: I saw someone running off to the west, but I'm too frightened to journey into the woods alone. Please... can you help me? I'll pay you well, I swear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025240_Oblivion_RES: I saw that Earana woman hanging around the Mages Guild again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002d927_Oblivion_RES: I saw that Erthor is back in town again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c21a_Oblivion_RES: I saw that Pinarus Inventius was out hunting again. He can shoot a bird on the wing without really trying.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007d46f_Oblivion_RESP1: I saw the Zaxer. And I magged it too. Aw, fribble!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StrangeLights_0000bedb_Oblivion_R: I saw them a few nights ago. Very odd.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0001b68f_Oblivio: I saw them enter the sump and reservoir. I tried to warn the guards to bar the doors to the reservoir, but I wasn't in time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_0000c1e8_Oblivion_RES: I saw them haul her off to jail. She was not happy! Ha ha ha...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081bf7_Oblivion_RESP3: I saw who my true enemies were for the first time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ce5_Oblivion_RESP2: I saw you enter Olav's Tap and Tack before I could get there, and I knew that I had to sneak out of Bruma somehow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0014684b_Oblivion_RESP1: I saw your match against the Breton. You're a Hero now! I... I'm still in training, but I'll get there too! Anyway, Congratulations!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AncotarTopic_000301e9_Oblivion_RE: I say live and let live. It was an unfortunate accident, and he helped make it right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071f4c_Oblivion_RESP1: I scour the land, seeking fortune for Gortwog and Orsinium. Someday all will recognize the true wealth of the Orcs!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11TellMe_00038443_Oblivion_RESP: I screamed and ran out into the street. Some city watch were nearby and heard me I suppose, as they arrived quickly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086065_Oblivion_RESP5: I searched a long time, and asked everyone, then I finally heard he was hiding at Fisherman's Rock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001647b_Oblivion_RESP1: I see Bolor was unsuccessful in delaying you. Very well; I shall reanimate him once we are done here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000432b2_Oblivion_RESP1: I see Lord Sheogorath chose wisely when he selected you to liberate Xedilian.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038af2_Oblivion_RESP1: I see from your expression that you have grave news.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038af5_Oblivion_RESP1: I see from your expression that you were successful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000295f_Knights_RESP1: I see in you the makings of a grand hero. You've saved our lives. We owe you a debt of thanks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03TestofKynareth_00002a58_Knigh: I see it on your face; you have failed the test.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040365_Oblivion_RESP1: I see it's back to the Fringe once again, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4a7_Oblivion_RESP1: I see my wife couldn't keep her big mouth shut.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04ChoiceCarahilDangerous_0004f2: I see no reason to shelter you from situations the guild deals with on a daily basis. This is the important work, the work that matters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002ab84_Oblivion_RES: I see no reason to talk to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Message_0018bc5a_Oblivion_RESP2: I see nothing has changed. How... disappointing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12TraitorTaunts_00081adf_Oblivi: I see so clearly now, what a fool I have been. A happy, heedless fool.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002500f_Oblivion_RESP1: I see that you've been suspended from the guild. I've never had to deal with this before, but I do know what you'll need to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Cure_0006eab0_Oblivion_RESP1: I see the flask is still empty. Nothing to do now but await my cold, lonely death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09VictimChoice1b_00082090_Obliv: I see the vast horizons of thought, while you cannot see past the tip of your own nose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004798e_Oblivion_RESP1: I see there are too many thieves in the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cd0a_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you are with the Gray Fox. Do you need a fence?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d48b_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you decided to take us up on our offer. Good. We could use another gal in the gang.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42Calipers_00073231_Oblivion_RE: I see you found some. Frankly, I could use all of them. Are you willing to sell them? Five gold each, just like I told you next week.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009da09_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you got my message.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBows_000908de_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you have a Black Bow. Would you like to turn it in for the bounty?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a124_Oblivio: I see you have been playing rough with the other boys. They are weak and you are strong!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Shadowscale_000251fc_Oblivion_RES: I see you have been speaking with Teinaava. What he says is true. All our lives we have lived together in the shadows. We are egg mates. Twins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHermaeusSpeech_000a948c_Oblivio: I see you have served my brethren, and now you come to serve me. I am Hermaeus Mora. Past, present, and future are as one to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OgreTeethTOPIC_000b1673_Oblivion_: I see you have some. I'll buy them in groups of five for 100 gold. Are you selling?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MinotaurHornTOPIC_000b1676_Oblivi: I see you have some. I'll buy them in groups of five for 50 gold. Interested?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004f9c8_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you haven't yet been able to drop the staff in Darkfathom Cave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cd5e_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you slept well. Welcome home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice4B_0009079b_Oblivion_: I see you still possess the Blade of Woe, the weapon given to you by Lucien Lachance when you first met. Allow me now to unlock its true power!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d489_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you took us up on our offer. Good. I'm glad to see you. Signy will be along shortly. I'm sure we can find something to do while we wait.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cd0e_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you work with the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c178_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you're a follower of the Gray Fox, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023f09_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you've accepted the contract from Vicente. Very good. With every life you take, Sithis grows stronger, and the Brotherhood flourishes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00081368_Oblivion_: I see you've done quite a bit of work to track me down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate3_00015860_Oblivio: I see you've made it even more painful. You do enjoy your work, don't you Herdir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00022a92_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you've returned safely, Associate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ebfa_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you've returned. How exciting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004b82f_Oblivion_RESP1: I see you've returned. Wonderful. Do you wish to return to your location at the time of the unfortunate...incident?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08MothPriestNote_0001474a_Obliv: I see. I suppose there is no hiding it from you. No hiding. What a joke! My whole life is hiding.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderReject_00002b2f_Knight: I see. I will not be deterred, so I shall remain here in the hopes that you change your mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinB_0002d074_Oblivion_RESP1: I see. Let me know if you change your mind. I'm sure I could be helpful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2B_000277aa_Oblivion_RE: I see. Perhaps it's just as well. The book is best left in secret.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Choice3B_0009813b_Oblivion_RE: I see. Please find me when you do. The Count is eager to receive it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09AuthoritySheogoraths_0001356a: I see. Sheogorath is too important to come on his own account? He sends his mortal lackey?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogatheOrcTopic_00086070_Oblivi: I see. So an Orc named Mazoga wants to see me? And she expects me to come to her?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02PrivateBusiness_000aa090_Obli: I see. Strange visitors appearing late at night... happens all the time here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13Choice2B_00034477_Oblivion_RE: I see. Well, if you see anything around town, let me know. You could be their next victim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Choice2A_0003e950_Oblivion_RE: I see... Please, wait here one moment. I shall speak with the Count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002933_Knights_RESP1: I seek the blessing of Father Akatosh, who knows all things and protects us from the unseen threat. Who better to guide us in these dark days?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002937_Knights_RESP1: I seek the blessing of Kynareth. Come, pray with me to the Goddess of the Air. Her Wayshrine is up ahead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04NoBribeBeggar2_0001625b_Obliv: I seem to have forgotten where she lives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting1_00016b6d_Obli: I sense why you have come. I can hear it in your very breath. You came as a herald of the false god Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002f9e9_Obliv: I sent him on a mission to Forsaken Mine. He and some others were supposed to clear the place of trolls. Haven't heard back from them in days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48Choice1A_00028030_Oblivion_RE: I sent men into the Gate, to see if they could find a way to shut it. They haven't come back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251d0_Oblivion_RESP1: I serve Lucien Lachance and the Dark Brotherhood, and will guide you as directed. But you will get no additional help from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00075048_Oblivion_RESP2: I serve Roland now. Please, accept my apologies for my error in judgement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007504c_Oblivion_RESP2: I serve Roland now. Please, accept my apologies for my error in judgement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001a373_Oblivion_RESP1: I serve the Lord of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ad8_Oblivion_R: I served as a Legion Marksman for twenty years. I retired here to Skingrad, work in the vineyards, and supplement my income as an advanced trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05DreamworldTopic_0002c6d0_Obli: I set out to create a way to conquer my failings, but it seems the tables had turned, and they conquered me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_0003066e_Oblivion_RESP1: I set out with the rest of the Knights to dispatch this blemish on the face of our fine world. When we arrived, we were overwhelmed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_0001e852_Oblivion_RE: I shall also overlook your... transgression, and send a recommendation to the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00043e23_Oblivion_RESP1: I shall await further summons. No doubt you will have need of me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Ally03Tactic3_00017d62_Oblivi: I shall be an unbreakable wall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Ally03Tactic3_000181cf_Oblivi: I shall be an unbreakable wall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030207_Oblivion_RESP3: I shall be following out of sight, along with a fellow Battlemage. Make no attempts to speak to us; trust that we will protect you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f220_Oblivion_RESP3: I shall be following out of sight, along with a fellow Battlemage. Make no attempts to speak to us; trust that we will protect you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00061396_Obliv: I shall be happy to impart to you the knowledge I've gained over the years... for a price, of course. I wouldn't have it any other way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11Choice1B_00002dcc_Oblivion_RE: I shall be here when you are ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40JanusDecline_0003ed36_Oblivio: I shall do what I can in the meantime. Please, excuse me. I have matters to attend to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40JanusDecline_0003ed35_Oblivio: I shall do what I can in the meantime. Please, excuse me. I have other matters to attend to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: I shall follow you through Crucible. Speak with the citizens, and ask what they know about this supposed conspiracy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylMuurine_0008136a_Oblivion_: I shall have her brought to the torture chamber at once. Meet me there shortly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002c2f2_Oblivion_RESP1: I shall have your reward soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014ac6_Oblivion_RESP1: I shall meet you in the Fringe, near the bust of Sheogorath. Now go! Make haste.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MannimarcoTopic_00009222_Oblivion: I shall need to consult the Council as to how to proceed with this situation. Thank you for the information. It may save many lives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008675f_Oblivion_RESP1: I shall never forget the talk we had. Your very presence in the Sanctuary is a blessing from the Dread Father himself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00061394_Obliv: I shall offer you whatever skill I have.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DABoethiaSpeech_00051ed7_Oblivion: I shall open a portal for you to one of my realms in Oblivion. Go, and take your place in my Tournament of Ten Bloods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000038b7_Oblivion_RE: I shall pass the news on to the Council. Most troubling, indeed, to know that these are not merely myths.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodwormHelmTopic_00014676_Obliv: I shall return the Helm to a secure place in the tower. It's the least I can do for Irlav. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008d328_Oblivion_RESP1: I shall serve with honor, Lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091aab_Oblivion_RESP5: I shall tell the master that you were here looking for him. Perhaps I'll bring him your head as an offering.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvWait_0006bd96_Oblivion_RE: I shall wait here for you, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvWait_0006bdbb_Oblivion_RE: I shall wait here until you return, Arch-Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000488e8_Oblivi: I share my good fortunes with the poor and needy. And you ain't neither. Life isn't easy on the waterfront. But we look out for each other.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004993e_Oblivion_RES: I shopped at Three Brothers a couple of days ago. Not sure which one I talked to, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a391_Oblivion_RESP2: I should be the one who is leading, however. Do I have your support?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight3_00002cdb_Knight: I should have known I was not alone. I should return to my duties now, but I'll think on what you said. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04FinalNo_0003d4ac_Oblivion_RES: I should have known after I fenced that stupid ring and discovered it was a fake. Worthless! All part of the guards' plan I suppose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04AmuletGone_0001ee2c_Oblivion_: I should have known they could find it. Little can remain hid from a Daedra Lord. I underestimated the enemy. It will not happen again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQLastItem_00026ef7_Oblivion_RESP: I should have seen it sooner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfb4_Oblivion_RE: I should have stayed in Hammerfell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038fca_Oblivion_RESP1: I should have the final part of the ritual deciphered soon. It's only a matter of time now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AngryMazoga02_000860e2_Oblivion_R: I should have told you. It was not your fault. An Orc pays her debts. You helped me, so I forgive you. And thank you, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestDoggy_000281a7_Oblivion_RESP1: I should only say this once. I will go away when you hit goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5c5_Oblivion_RESP1: I should probably wash up before heading home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1f8_Oblivion_RES: I should speak to someone about the new Gatekeeper. Don't want him killing any of my little ones trying to return to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fbf_Obli: I should visit Renoit's more often.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0003abfa_Oblivion_RESP2: I should've been with them! It should've been me, not one of them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0002573e_Oblivion_RESP2: I should've been with them! It should've been me, not them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001544a_Oblivion_RESP3: I should've killed you outright when I had the chance. Well, life is all about second chances, isn't it? I won't waste this one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b591_Oblivion_RESP1: I shouldn't have pushed so hard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009816a_Oblivion_RESP1: I shouldn't say any more... but you have treated me so well. Perhaps I can trust you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_0003d07e_Oblivion_R: I shouldn't sell it to ya so cheap, but I know you won't ask too many questions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000488f0_Oblivi: I signed on for the Raven Rock colony. Went there as a builder. Hung around afterwards, but the money ran out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00035749_Oblivion_RESP1: I sing your praises and welcome you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0015974e_Oblivion_RESP1: I sing your praises and welcome you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002d930_Oblivion_RES: I slept in the woods. I came back in the morning, and Kvatch was gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c238_Oblivion_RES: I smelled a strange odor coming from the Mages Guild yesterday. Erthor must have been doing another experiment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice3_0002c5bd_Oblivion_RE: I snooped around. Apparently, they completed that contract for us. I went in there with twenty good men. I can't believe that bunch finished the job.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05VolumeThree_000976ff_Oblivion: I sold you my only copy of Volume Three. Gwinas will be terribly disappointed when he learns it is gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11CiirtaGreeting1a_00016b6e_Obl: I sought Sheogorath. This is His Realm, and I knew that He would protect us. And what did I find? The Throne of Madness -- empty!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00025072_Oblivion_RESP1: I speak for the Night Mother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenPainting_00031501_Oblivion_: I spend many a lonely night wishing that the words I speak to it will be heard and not just fall upon the lifeless pigments and canvas.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476d5_Oblivi: I spent 40 years at the Arcane University. Good years, but I don't miss it. Now I'm completely useless, and proud of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_0002c7bb_Oblivio: I spit on them. Mercenaries sent by the Emperor to reclaim territory in Black Marsh. When they failed, they came back and set up shop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I spoke to him recently. He really knows his way around. Knows every tree, rock, and cave in the area.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PinerDEMO1_0002ae2a_Oblivion_RESP: I spoke to him yesterday. He seems rather concerned about those boys of his.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfd4_Oblivion_RES: I spoke with Deetsan at the Mages Guild recently. I've never seen someone so happy about being in the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14EscortWait_000637e2_Oblivion_: I stand at the ready, sire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14EscortWait_000637e3_Oblivion_: I stand at the ready, sire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Repair_0005e083_Oblivion_RESP1: I stand by all my repair work. I test the blades personally.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000291f_Knights_RESP1: I stand ready, Lord Crusader. Shall we launch our attack on Garlas Malatar?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c65_Obli: I steer clear. They're fast creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002d930_Oblivion_RES: I stepped outside, and the whole town was on fire, smoke everywhere. I ran for the gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BernadettePenelesTopic_00025887_O: I still can hardly believe she wasn't watching me. But it is a relief to be able to finally stop worrying about her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a25_Knights_RESP: I still can't believe what happened at the Chapel. Trevaia, Laralthir, Dumania... all dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_000253cc_Obl: I still don't believe it's real. If it was real, you'd have some sort of proof, right? Well, I don't see any proof.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinD1_0009ce83_Oblivion_RE: I still don't know if there is a divine plan. But I've come to realize that it doesn't matter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa8e_Oblivion_RESP1: I still don't like you, but you do good work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44Supplies_0007876e_Oblivion_RE: I still need the Amulet of Disintegration, the Ring of Desiccation, and, of course, the Calming Pants. Must have the Calming Pants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000133d7_Oblivion_RESP1: I still say steer clear of that door. Nothing good to be found on the other side of it. Of that, I'm certain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13GetOut_00031c87_Oblivion_RESP: I suggest we use the Reman Sweep Formation. You'll assault and we'll guard the rear flank. Onward and upward! Huzzah!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2B_0001e85a_Oblivion_RE: I suggest you deliver that book as soon as possible. Your recommendation depends on it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022e53_Oblivion_RESP1: I suggest you make your way to the Imperial City. Can't make money by standing here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_000817bf_Oblivio: I suggest you petition to see Count Hassildor in Skingrad. He will be interested in your condition.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1be_Oblivion_RESP1: I suggest you rest in your room until we arrive back at the Imperial City. Graman should have us underway soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_0003e94c_Oblivio: I suggest you travel there, and seek an audience with him. Given your condition, I believe he may assist you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014acb_Oblivion_RE: I summon thee, walker in Flesh! Flesh of true Flesh! From those waters of Oblivion which sire thy kind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476d3_Oblivi: I supply many fine city merchants with goods. All sorts of things. Whatever I can buy cheap and sell dear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1f6_Oblivion_RES: I suppose Count Hassildor keeps Skingrad running smoothly, but you hardly ever see the man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a5d_Oblivion_RESP5: I suppose I assumed you'd be able to lift the curse and be done with it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000781ec_Oblivion_RESP1: I suppose I can stop to chat with a friend, but I'm really busy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JorundrTopic_00053277_Oblivion_RE: I suppose I can trust you with this information. After all, if you can help me recover my stolen gold, you may find yourself earning some of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00053718_Oblivion_RESP: I suppose I can trust you. In fact, maybe you can help me with a bit of a problem, and make some money for yourself in the process.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00090868_Oblivion_RESP: I suppose I can trust you. In fact, maybe you can help me with a bit of a problem, and make some money for yourself in the process.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cc7_Oblivion_RESP1: I suppose I have a moment. What is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrisonVisitor_0018d202_Oblivion_R: I suppose I have to. Keep your hands to yourself in there. I'll be right next to you the whole time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_0001ceeb_Obli: I suppose I like her well enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607f6_Oblivion_RES: I suppose I should be glad the world didn't end. But, in some ways, I wish it had. It would be easier than... this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ASyl_00013a6f_Oblivion_RESP1: I suppose I should be grateful working in the palace with her, but I can't stand having to constantly look over my shoulder.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003150c_Oblivion_RESP1: I suppose I should be happy to see you again. I'm not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00159750_Oblivion_RESP1: I suppose I should be happy to see you again. I'm not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_000535f0_Oblivion_RESP1: I suppose I've got something I could use the Guild's help with, but I don't know you well enough to talk about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a0_Oblivion_RESP1: I suppose I've got something I could use the Guild's help with. I need ogre teeth and minotaur horn for my alchemy experiments.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00027f86_Oblivion_RESP1: I suppose I've got something for you. We need a weapons shipment delivered to Desolate Mine. That's your job.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b6a6_Oblivion_RESP4: I suppose an introduction is in order. I'm Sheogorath, Prince of Madness. And other things. I'm not talking about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04SheoWhatNow_00044f53_Oblivion: I suppose few really do, but that's beside the point. We're going to give you a taste of where you have found yourself. You're going to learn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BradonLirrianTopic_0003843a_Obliv: I suppose if I found out a loved-one was something as horrid as a vampire, I'd find any excuse not to believe it either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049924_Oblivi: I suppose if you need a shield, that's the place to go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KudEiTopic_00027f35_Oblivion_RESP: I suppose if you're interested, you could head over there and ask Kud-Ei yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02reject_00034874_Oblivion_RESP: I suppose it can wait for a while. Let me know if you change your mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000377d4_Oblivion_RESP2: I suppose thanks are only a small token of my appreciation. Allow me to reward you for your bravery.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_000620aa_Oblivion_R: I suppose that's a good offer. Very well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD03Choice3_0002d72c_Oblivion_RE: I suppose that's it, then. Odd that there weren't creatures around the body, though, and that it hadn't been eaten.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004660c_Oblivi: I suppose that's just the kind of person you want training other mages.
