ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG17ChoiceNM_00015456_Oblivion_RE: I'll wait here then. Let me know when you've made up your mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1de_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll wait here until the tavern deck is clear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS02VelwynEscChoice2_0000a0db_Obl: I'll wait here until you're ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1c9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'll wait on the tavern deck until you clear the top deck. That's where the ship's wheel is located.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038438_Oblivi: I'll warn you about one thing. I understand you wanting to help Erline by checking up on Raynil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004762c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Adamus Phillida, prison administrator and commander of the Imperial Legion forces here in the Imperial City. Have we met? You look familiar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476d2_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Agarmir. And I'm a very busy man. Are you just fishing around, or do you have business with me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Alga. I'm a bard and a Speechcraft trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004770c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Amantius Allectus, the writer. I'm working on a new edition of 'Lives of the Saints'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e91c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Amiable Fanriene. Sorry, can't talk. Got to move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00068bc0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Anya Herrick. I serve Lady Syl, and she allows me to remain protected within the House of Dementia. I'm so grateful to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Ardaline. I'm the guild's Advanced Trainer in Alchemy here in Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Arvena Thelas. They call me 'the rat lady', on account of all my pet rats.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479fa_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Atahba. But if you want a horse, you got to talk to Cat-Face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475b1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Avrus Adas. I'm the priest of Zenithar at the Leyawiin Chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e089_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Azzan, head of the Anvil Fighters Guild chapter, and Advanced Blunt Weapons trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e087_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Baeralorn, Anvil's castle mage. Perhaps you've heard of my work on magical resistances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f368_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Beelei. You... you came from out there? And you survived? Then how do I know you're not one of THEM?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e2_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bejeen. I'm a hunter, and Weebam-Na's partner. I hope he didn't bother you about the rat thing. He's gone totally rat-cuckoo, I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Beran. Kastus, Vontan, and me, we take care of gardens and trees and grass. Hard work, but it pays.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038add_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bernadette Peneles. I work for Tamika. I grow grapes. For her wines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023cc0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bittneld the Curse-Bringer, captain of the Chorrol Guard. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bogrum Gro-Galash, your host at the Lonely Suitor Lodge. It may not look like much outside, but that's just the weathered Bravil look.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007be9a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Brielus Gawey. And no, we don't sell horses. But we do eat well. The stables are owned by an Orc. And you know... Orcs and horses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Bronsila Kvinchal. And I'm so sick of that Vlanarus, I could scream.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc8a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Brother Jauffre. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475af_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm Bugak gro-Bol, and I say you better buy a goddam book. And right away, dammit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Burz gro-Khash, and I'm in charge of this St. Jiub's Fair. All I need is clowns, monkeys, and jugglers. No. Wait... just need jugglers....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000477ea_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Caelia Draconis, Captain of the Leyawiin Guard. I hope we will not meet in my official capacity... ha-ha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c99a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Captain Burd, commander of the Bruma Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004763c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Caranya, master wizard, and far too important to be talking to you. So go about your business, please?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004768e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Carmana Sintav. Cyronin is my husband. Excuse him, please. He's a little irritable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024f80_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Carmen Litte. Perhaps you know my husband? Alberic Litte, the Mages Guild sorcerer? What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004770e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Caula Allectus. My job is making sure my husband Amantius doesn't go out with his clothes on backwards.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023c5c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Chanel, Chorrol Castle Mage. You'll tell me what you're here for. Right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Cingor. I'm the Captain of the Leyawiin Neighborhood Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Clesa. My husband and I run the Horse Whisperer, the finest stables in Anvil County.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024b8a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Contumeliorus Florius. I'm in charge of enchanted item recharge in the Mages Guild here in Chorrol. Get it? "In charge!"
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007504b_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Cylben Dolovas, assistant and bodyguard to Seridur. Let's leave it at that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000947bd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Cylben Dolovas, assistant and bodyguard to Seridur. Let's leave it at that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e086_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Dairihill, steward of Castle Anvil. We do things differently in Anvil. And the difference shows in the comfort and trust of its people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479af_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Dar Jee. I'm a Khajiit in disguise. Want to see me lick my butt?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ae1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Davide, of Surilie Brothers Vineyard. Gaston is my brother. From our vineyards come the finest wines in Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8bd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Deetsan. Magician. Mages Guild, that is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ab4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Dion, captain of the Skingrad Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Eilonwy. I'm only a conjurer, but Orintur is a full Magician. Isn't he wonderful?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479dc_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Eitar. Say. Did you hear what that Argonian said? What's-his-name? You know who I'm talking about...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479dd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Eitar. Say. Did you hear what that Khajiit said? What's-his-name? You know who I'm talking about...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476a8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Elisa Pierrane. Father bought us this lovely house in the City.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a9a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Else God-Hater. Yes. I hate the gods. All gods. They can all bite my garters. And if you don't like it, YOU can bite my garters, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476e3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Erissare Arenim. Soris is my husband.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0dd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Ernest. This is the Horse Whisperer, Anvil's only stable. Park your nag here, or leave him for the wolves. Your choice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8a8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Errandil, Living Saint of Arkay, and the Chapel's chief crusader against the wicked practice of necromancy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488cc_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Fathis Aren, Count Bravil's staff wizard. I can teach you Conjuration... anything to relieve the tedium of castle patronage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Felas Sarandas. Don't breathe on me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e092_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Felen Relas of the Mages Guild. I handle Alchemy training for the Anvil chapter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c99e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Gan Luseph, Castle Mage and Healer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ae4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Gaston Surilie. Perhaps you've met my brother, Davide? Together, we are the Surilie Brothers Winery.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047662_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Gelephor, the watchman. I keep an eye on things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047678_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Gin-Wulm. I just work here. You want to buy, talk to Varnado or Maro Rufus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024ed8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Glistel. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ab0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Hal-Liurz, Count Skingrad's steward. The Count does not accept unsolicited visitors, I'm afraid. I apologize for the inconvenience.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9aa_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Honmund. I'm a prospector. Alga's my woman, Nord-style. None of that Chapel wedding nonsense.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004768a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Irene Metrick. If you needed to know more, you'd already know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e097_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Isolde, mate... not that it's any of your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ff9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm J'zidzo. What has four legs, a tail, and is red in Cyrodiil?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm J'zin-Dar. I tell you, so you can tell everyone who kicked the crap out of you. J'zin-Dar. Get it right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9ae_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Jantus Brolus. I'm the Illusion Trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Jayred Ice-Veins. Do you ever wonder why things look better without their skin on?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9b2_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Jearl. I spend most of my time down south, but I keep a house in Bruma for the mountain air.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488ed_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Kastav Kvinchal. And, if you listen to that witch of a sister of mine, Bronsila, I'm also a dog and a pig.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e095_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Krognak gro-Brok, landsman, and I don't much care who you are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c984_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Logvaar. Hafid pays me to stand around and keep things quiet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024d4f_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Lum gro-Baroth. The cheerful one. My brother, Kurz? He's not so cheerful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cf88_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Maenlorn. I'm the twin in brown, remember?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8bf_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Magician Orintur of the Mages Guild. I divide my time between the Cheydinhal Guild and my own private studies at Willow Bank.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC_0002a573_Oblivion_RES: I'm Maglir. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8d6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Maknok gro-Coblug, the Riverside groundskeeper. Rogmesh, my wife, is the cook at the Big House.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024eed_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Malintus Ancrus. How are you doing?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004769c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Mandil. I'm a lady of leisure, but I do some Advanced Training in Security. Just a hobby, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MogensTalk02_00086575_Oblivion_RE: I'm Mazoga. You killed my friend, Ra'vindra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e094_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Mirabelle Monet. I run the Fo'c's'le, a boarding house for sailors. Sorry. I reserve my beds for seamen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a84_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Mog gra-Mogakh, proprietor of Two Sisters Lodge. My sister and I own the place... 'Two Sisters', see? Need a bed? Good food?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086058_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Mogens Wind-Shifter. I'm having a look around. You mind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f364_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Muurine. If you have any secrets, I'm the one to tell. I won't share them with anyone but my family. Unless they're good ones, that is.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004774e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Myvryna Arano. I... persuade people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Newheim, Anvil harbormaster. I'm responsible for all harbor traffic, docks, duties and fees in Anvil harbor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e07c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Norbert Lelles. I let my merchandise speak for itself. Look around. If you see something you like, we'll talk about a price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c98c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Olfand, the Light Armor trainer. Skjorta and I run North Winds. Please excuse us. We had a little drink-up last night. Still a little muzzy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000238d1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Otius Loran, Primate of Stendarr. You stand before Gods' servant, in the house of the Nine. Be humble, and show respect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Otumeel. But I didn't do anything. Really. It wasn't me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ac0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Parwen of the Fighters Guild. I'm not a great archer, but I seem to have a knack for teaching. And I've bagged my share of goblins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c977_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Petrine. This is Wildeye Stables. I look after folk's horses while they're here in Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000ace28_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Phebe Jeanard, a charity sister of Gottlesfont Priory. Are you looking for alchemical ingredients?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047656_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Phintias, owner and proprietor of the First Edition. Look around. If I don't have it, maybe I can get it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004773d_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Praxedes Afranius. My brothers and I share a house in the Temple District.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dca2_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm Prior Maborel, head of our community, and responsible for all our religious and secular affairs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c9b8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Regner. You want anything? Talk to Edla. She's in charge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024b56_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Rena Bruiant. I love dogs. Doesn't everyone?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00074a88_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Rimalus Bruiant. Perhaps you've met my wife, Rena? And our dogs, Bailey and Kezu?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e08c_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Rufrius Vinicius, Fighters Guild Hand-to-Hand trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e09f_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Rusia Bradus. My husband is General Silgor Bradus, one of County Anvil's commanders in the field.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047733_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Ruslan. Not that it's any of your business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475ac_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Shamada, hostess of the Three Sister Inn. Speak to Shuravi if you need beds or meals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035708_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm Shuravi, the sister-that-works-and-worries. Shamada is sweet and decorative. Shomara is dumb as a post. But she can cook, at least.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c986_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Snar the Cook. We've got genuine Skyrim cuisine... fresh, simple, big helpings... just like Mom used to make.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bbf_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm Sontaire, spend one night with me and I'll remind you why they say "love hurts."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ac5_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Sulinus Vassinus of the Mages Guild, and I'm so pleased to make your acquaintance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c988_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Suurootan, proud owner of Novaroma, a little piece of Heartland Empire here in the lofty Jeralls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ae6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Tamika. We grow our own grapes, and make fine wines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e099_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Thurindil, son of Julianos and Mohi-Titona, Queen of Akavir. These slugs climbing my spine itch something fierce. Like to dance?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b92e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Tivela Lythandas. I apologize that I can't give you the respect a guest in my home would normally receive, but I am at my wit's end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8d0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Tolisi Girith. I'm a maid at Riverview. And it's no picnic, I'll tell you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Trayvond the Redguard, Mages Guild Evoker. Surprised? Yes, you don't see many Redguards in the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479c6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Tsrava. I'm an Advanced Trainer in Acrobatics. Did I mention I hate dogs?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Ulene Hlervu, Castle Mage. Perhaps you've been warned off me as a scandalous, blasphemous scoffer and cynic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488c6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Uravasa Othrelas, priest of Mara. I'm also a Speechcraft trainer. I can help you make... different mistakes, at least.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042fee_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Urul gro-Agamph. You shouldn't scare people like that. I don't care if you are a mean nasty wolf. It isn't nice. Okay, okay. Just don't hurt me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038aac_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Valandrus Abor, Primate of Julianos. You may address me as 'Your Eminence'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047676_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Varnado. I handle the Heavy Armor at 'The Best Defense'. I'm also an Advanced Trainer in Heavy Armor, so I know what I'm talking about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Viera Lerus, captain of the Bravil Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ViranusDontonTOPIC_0002d715_Obliv: I'm Viranus Donton. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476ae_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Vontan Sintav. Kastus, Beran, and me got this house from Uncle Iniel. Nice, huh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8ce_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Voranil. I'm guessing you're angling for an invitation to one of my super parties.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047632_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Watch Captain Audens Avidius. Don't forget it. I like this city quiet as a mouse. Raise a fuss, and you'll be sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086064_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Weebam-Na. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cf95_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Wilbur, owner and proprietor of The Count's Arms. We make beds and food available to guests. Can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00041f18_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Yngvar the Wanderer. Although most people now call me Yngvar Doom-Sayer. It's true, the world is about to be destroyed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c998_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm Yvara Channitte, Countess Bruma's steward. The Countess makes policy, leaving the details of administration to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightTopic_000860c8_Oblivion_RES: I'm a FREE knight. I don't have a lord. You got a problem with that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo09_00090b7c_Oblivion_RE: I'm a Knight-Errant now, and I don't care who knows it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028c34_Oblivion_RE: I'm a Redguard, though I've never actually been to Hammerfell. I was born here in Cyrodiil. My family has been in the Legion for three generations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476ad_Oblivi: I'm a Sintav, and we Sintavs stick together. Uncle Iniel got us swell jobs and a house. It's a family thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistSapTopic_000a3453_Oblivion_RE: I'm a bit surprised it affected you the way it did, given your heritage. Perhaps something's tainted it. I'm concerned about Water's Edge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000236da_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm a busy man. What is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridHot_00023cd0_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm a captain, you see, and the Oak and Crosier serves... a better class of people...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038adf_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm a fair hand at grapes and bows. Shameer, grower and trainer. But I suspect you want to shoot, not grow grapes. Am I right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b688_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm a farmer, not a soldier! I don't know how to use this weapon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo08_00090b7b_Oblivion_RE: I'm a knight-errant now, and I don't care who knows it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MazogaWoman_000860c2_Oblivion_RES: I'm a knight. So say, 'Sir'. Say, 'Yes, Sir Mazoga'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c28_Oblivi: I'm a trained soldier with over twenty years experience dealing with situations like this. On my honor, this killer will be caught and dealt with!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorWho_00034467_Oblivion_R: I'm a vampire hunter. I came here with a few others to get rid of the vampires in Skingrad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_00007b31_Oblivion_: I'm afraid I can't just write one out of hand. That would be against protocols, you see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Nirnroot_0004e934_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm afraid I can't remember what he said about them. Perhaps you should make the trip to Skingrad and ask him in person.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000bb9c3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid I can't rent you the room if you can't afford it. Sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_0018d81a_Oblivion_RES: I'm afraid I can't tell you that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000825aa_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid I cannot follow you beyond this point, Inquisitor. My duties require me to stay within Crucible. I shall be there if you need me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingLazare01_00038acc_Oblivio: I'm afraid I cannot. Leave me, and I will spare you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05VolumeThree_00022b49_Oblivion: I'm afraid I couldn't sell it to you for any price. I've already promised it to someone else, and my word is my bond.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357d_Obliv: I'm afraid I didn't have any more advice for him than I do for you. With the Orrery in such a state of disrepair, I have no point of reference.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_JAWS9143_01_Al: I'm afraid I didn't have any more advice for hom than I do for you. I have no point of reference.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002f1ef_Oblivion_RESP: I'm afraid I don't have it anymore, you see. I... I sold it. To a friend of mine, Soris Arenim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000377d4_Oblivion_RESP3: I'm afraid I don't have much in the way of coin, but allow me to present you with something that may help in your travels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_0001e06a_Oblivion_RESP: I'm afraid I don't know anything about it. I heard it was missing, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaC1_000a5604_Oblivion_: I'm afraid I don't know for sure. I wish I had a more persuasive answer, but hear me out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d586_Oblivion_RESP: I'm afraid I don't trust you enough to talk about it, though. You are working for Jeanne, after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0003abfa_Oblivion_RESP4: I'm afraid I have little to offer you - what little money I have must now be spent on a burial. Please, if you'll excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_0008117e_Oblivion_: I'm afraid I have no idea what you're talking about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224a4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid I have no time for small talk, friend. I'm waiting for my father, Valus Odiil. Have you seen him in town, by any chance?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0002573e_Oblivion_RESP4: I'm afraid I have nothing to offer you - what little money I have must now be spent on burials. Please, if you'll excuse me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d49e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid I have very little information to add to our follow-up investigation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002d411_Oblivion_: I'm afraid I haven't given it much thought. I'm rather busy, you understand. My research occupies nearly all of my time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG03Choice1A_0002f176_Oblivion_RE: I'm afraid I haven't had time to prepare anything conventional. I'm very preoccupied with this situation concerning Ardaline.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a13_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm afraid I misled you. The Count won't be arriving - in fact, he doesn't even know you're here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a14_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm afraid I misled you. The Count won't be arriving - in fact, he doesn't even know you're here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a15_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm afraid I misled you. The Count won't be arriving - in fact, he doesn't even know you're here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_0004890b_Oblivion_RES: I'm afraid I'm not very social. So I really don't know very much about the people here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShadeoftheRevenant_0000357c_Obliv: I'm afraid I've told you all I can about it. I'm sorry I couldn't be of more use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSMiscFarwil_000c453d_Oblivion_RE: I'm afraid he and the rest of the Knights are off on a mission... a secret mission.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinD2_0009ce84_Oblivion_RE: I'm afraid she may take a bit more convincing than you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Debt_000091f7_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid so. My father had a bit of an issue with gambling. I'm afraid he built up a rather large debt. Now that he's gone, the debt is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000175b4_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid some things have happened while you've been gone, Associate. It may affect your recommendation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice3A_0001c4ac_Oblivion_RE: I'm afraid that I can't rent you the room if you can't afford it. Sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e919_Obli: I'm afraid that this version of the Elixir of Exploration will be the last. I've wrung every bit of information from my research that I can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JanusHassildorTopic_00035674_Obli: I'm afraid that's not my arena. You'll have to speak to Mercator about seeing the Count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b984e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid that's not possible, since you don't seem to have the money for it. We'll be happy to accomodate you, when you can afford it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Choice1A_0003e94f_Oblivion_RE: I'm afraid the Count does not see anyone without an approved appointment. Do you have an appointment?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_00046829_Oblivion_RES: I'm afraid the settlement of Split has been the victim of recent attacks. Your aid would be appreciated, I'm sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f421_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid there isn't much else to tell you. Just be careful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001da6a_Oblivion_RE: I'm afraid there isn't much more I can tell you. Perhaps one of our books can answer any more questions you may have?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0003561f_Oblivion_RESP: I'm afraid there's little I can do to assist you, unless you have the wood we need to start. Bring me some wood, and we can get to work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003843c_Oblivi: I'm afraid there's not much more to tell you. So, you can see we really don't need any help. But thanks for the offer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005323b_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid this area is restricted to Guild mages. You'll have to leave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AWhyDoI_00080ed7_Oblivion_RES: I'm afraid until the adventurers are dealt with, Xedilian will keep you here. Even I can't will its doors to open.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008dc3e_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm afraid we aren't very wealthy, but here is all I can offer you at this time. Please, visit us again soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001d4c1_Obli: I'm afraid we cannot go with you to this remote location. Fighting is not our specialty. Watch yourself... vampires are known to be crafty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05RavenSpeech_00022ef2_Oblivion: I'm afraid you have failed the first test. There are no second chances in Lord Dagon's service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d151_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid you have failed the test. I warned you to stay close. We can try again some other time, perhaps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b1256_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid you lack the funds for the room. Perhaps someplace else would suit you better?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b9847_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid you lack the funds to rent a room. Perhaps you should consider resting somewhere else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFlameofAgnonTopic_00019ad0_Obli: I'm afraid you may have to be a little bit clever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice2B_00070486_Oblivion_RE: I'm afraid you misunderstand. I already have more servants than I need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11ChoiceBlackSoulGems_00033635_: I'm afraid you'll have to find it yourself. I'm so out of sorts with all these requests, I've lost track of most everything. It's very distressing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFlameofAgnonTopic_00019ad3_Obli: I'm afraid you'll have to make up your own mind. Unfortunately, I'm just the hired help. I'm not paid to make the big decisions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0004a248_Oblivion_: I'm afraid you'll have to speak to Falcar about that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49ChoiceExplain_00031d33_Oblivi: I'm afraid you're in for a tough time, friend. The city's in bad shape, and it will be difficult to make it to the Guard House by yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091aab_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm afraid you're late to the party. The guest of honor has already left!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0002d587_Oblivion_RESP: I'm afraid you're not going to find him easily. I think a, uh, spell backfired. That's probably it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00019843_Oblivion_RE: I'm afraid you've exhausted Xedilian's resources. This was the final chamber.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008587c_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm afraid you've missed the party. The guest of honor has already left.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000981f8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid you've upset my husband. Please, leave before he loses his temper. I beg you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030206_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm afraid your journey ends here, traveler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e63a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm almost positive I sent you away to do something important. Cylarne... Flame... Great Torch. Yes... why are you here?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049911_Oblivi: I'm not buying a discount spell. That's just a bad idea.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022e60_Oblivion_: I'm not certain what happened to the knight, or why the tears were frozen, but I do know someone you could ask.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04GuardsConvo_00095338_Oblivi: I'm not disagreeing with you, believe me. Those assassins got what they wanted. The Emperor is dead. They've got not reason to come back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d27d_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not easily impressed, but even I would think twice before going into one of those Oblivion Gates. Well done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05NelreneHaveProof_0008199f_Obl: I'm not even the one you want. Muurine is behind it. You'll need solid proof to pin it on her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002a6a7_Oblivion_RE: I'm not from Chorrol. I'm afraid I can't tell you anything at all about the town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_00061ff6_Oblivion_RESP: I'm not giving up anything for that offer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d916_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm not going anywhere until they're gone! Horrible things!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_000356e3_Oblivion_RES: I'm not going anywhere with you. I can't trust you not to kill me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEObeliskResponses_00077d08_Obliv: I'm not going near the things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0018ad5b_Oblivion_RES: I'm not going out there. What's the point? There's nothing left. I'll just stay right here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10LlevanaTalk_0003c372_Oblivion: I'm not going to stand here and debate this all night. You give me that evidence, and I'll consider not having you executed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1d3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not going to the top deck until it's safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476f3_Oblivi: I'm not in the habit of answering questions for strangers. No offense intended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005374a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not interested in speaking with you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071f55_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not like them. Are you? Are you one of them?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002ab86_Oblivion_RES: I'm not listening to you. It's because I don't like you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008605f_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not much for small talk. Just leave me out of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fc1_Obli: I'm not much of a reader, myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I'm not much of a rider. I've heard others swear by his animals, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not normally a bitter person, but you are not welcome here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001e0b2_Oblivion_RE: I'm not really at liberty to discuss my customers with stangers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000b124f_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not running a charity here, you know? I need the gold, so you come back when you actually have it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bca6_Oblivion_RES: I'm not saying Colovians are dumb. They're just hard-headed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f41f_Oblivion_RES: I'm not saying I couldn't do a better job, but at least someone is in charge who can get things done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef72_Oblivion_RES: I'm not saying I like the idea of these Knights and all, but the Shivering Isles could really use a dose of Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000255bb_Oblivion_RES: I'm not so sure about that Eugal Belette. An odd fellow, and people have said there are strange noises coming from his house at all hours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008efcd_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not some commoner to take up a sword. Let the rabble risk their lives, not me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a0f5_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not staying here any longer. I need to get someplace safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007eae6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not sure I can make this much clearer...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00035a22_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not sure I can trust you. Why don't you just move along.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028cdf_Oblivion: I'm not sure I like your line of questioning, friend. Someone's been killed. Show a little respect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0003c169_Obliv: I'm not sure I trust you enough to reveal any more to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a0_Oblivion_RESP3: I'm not sure about you, either. Tell you what. If you bring me back five portions of ectoplasm, I'll give my business to the guild. That's my offer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b1d_Knights_R: I'm not sure how I feel. To know that the curse can be lifted gives me hope, but to know that it also means damning another...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00023e45_Oblivion_RESP4: I'm not sure how you feel about pirates, but you've got to kill one. A captain, in fact. On his ship. Surrounded by his crew. Interested?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND05ThedretPhrase_00002afa_Knight: I'm not sure how, but I just know it's a clue for making it safely through these ruins. You're the only one I have told. I hope it helps you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinMischief_0002f814_Obliv: I'm not sure if the Cropsford settlers would be all too pleased about you stirring up a new goblin war, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_000289fb_Obliv: I'm not sure if you're really concerned for the kid or trying to convince me he's a murderer. Either way, I ain't listenin'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008262e_Obl: I'm not sure it even exists. He'll never stop looking, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624b2_Oblivion_RES: I'm not sure the Dark Brotherhood is any more serious a problem than beggary and petty thievery. And it's certainly a discreet and secret problem.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_thieves_00002e48_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm not sure the numbers you'll be dealing with, so I'm sending you with another new recruit. Maglir. I believe you two have already met.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00042dae: I'm not sure what to make of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_000289fc_Obliv: I'm not sure what to think of the kid anymore. All I know is that two of the guests have been murdered, and he's just dandy. Makes you wonder.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VelwynBenirusTopic_0000926f_Obliv: I'm not sure where he went, but I would ask at The Count's Arms. If anyone knows where he is, it would be someone there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06TellKellen_00002b8d_Knights_R: I'm not sure whether to call him a coward, or simply say that I don't blame him. That'd be a large burden to bear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreD4_0001e74f_Oblivion_R: I'm not sure. Only the Emperors truly understand the meaning behind the rituals of coronation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JorundrTopic_0005379b_Oblivion_RE: I'm not surprised at all that he tried to have me killed. That's his way. Always the traitor and the coward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistSapTopic_000356fd_Oblivion_RE: I'm not surprised you were found the way you were. I imagine those men have built up a tolerance to the stuff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004663c_Oblivi: I'm not surprised, with the way she handles a bow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22DontKnowHighFane_0002af33_Obl: I'm not surprised. I have not been able to find any modern reference to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_0002584c_O: I'm not surprised. It seems that Skyrim is always involved in a border dispute.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06RefuseJob_0000bf88_Oblivion_R: I'm not surprised. Nobody wants that job. Let me know if you change your mind. It will probably still be available.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Fugitives_00009c31_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not talking about them. Not to you. I barely know you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_0005371d_Oblivion_RESP: I'm not talking to you about anything. You're an outsider. I bet you're trying to trick me into telling something and the guards put you up to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_0002461b_Oblivion_RES: I'm not telling you that. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000981e9_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not the one you want to talk to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_0009354e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm not used to giving speeches. But I wanted you to know that I appreciate your welcome here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12DeclineMission_00018238_Obliv: I'm not used to hearing no, but I admire your boldness. I won't force you to go, only to request that you reconsider in the future.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038a8c_Oblivion_R: I'm not worried about the Gates. We'll be safe enough inside the walls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Stipend_00018232_Oblivion_RES: I'm of course referring to The Draconian Madstone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081532_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm off to find a dog.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_0000a253_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm offering a reward for information leading to the arrest of the Gray Fox. Until he is turned over to me, the Waterfront is closed for 'business.'
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b97dc_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm on my way to Rosethorn Hall now. I won't be long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000363ca_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm on my way to talk to Itius Hayn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeynonPrioryTopic_000aa08b_Oblivi: I'm on night watch here, in case someone needs the chapel, or wants to talk... or has mysterious business, like you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038438_Oblivi: I'm only allowing you to do this investigation, and I use that term very loosely, because Erline is so distraught.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015df8_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm only askin' for enough to feed me kids.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00015e08_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm only asking for a single coin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001acd0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm only talking to you out of loyalty to Sheogorath. Otherwise I'd cut you open and pull all your insides out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7f1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm only the Captain of the Guard. The Countess makes the final decision, and I follow her orders, whatever I think of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenGlenroy_0000b206_Oblivion_: I'm out of patience with you, prisoner!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c36e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm overjoyed to hear that Garrus has replaced Ulrich as the Captain of the Guard. I'm sure he'll do a fine job.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a59_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm overjoyed to hear that you were able to cleanse the manor. Well done my friend, well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e35e_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm pleased that a Knight of the Thorn has received such a worthy gift. Even if you're just an honorary knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001da67_Obli: I'm pleased to call him brother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d3a1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm pleased to finally meet the savior of Cheydinhal. And although the death of Farwil saddens me, I know you did the best you could.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002df70_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm pleased to finally meet the savior of Cheydinhal. I'm also overjoyed that you saved my son's life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001e0d3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm pleased to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003a65_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm pleased we were able to get that secret door open, but I fear I can no longer assist you here. I'll wait for you at The Count's Arms.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001822d_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm pleased you decided to find the Madstone. It will be the highlight of my collection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008efcf_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm praying for the gods to protect me from the Fanatics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Repair_00066a55_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm pretty handy. What needs to be fixed?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033ee3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm proud of what we've built here. You should be, too. Cropsford wouldn't exist without the help you gave us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047732_Oblivi: I'm quite behind on current events, I'm afraid. I can't be of any help to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_000977d5_Oblivio: I'm quite pleased with the results. The batch came out larger than I'd expected; there is enough for two doses of the potion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045f65_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm rather busy on a... I'm busy. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060383_Oblivion_RES: I'm rather curious about this disappearance of Sheogorath's. Is he incorporeal, invisible, or has he moved to another plane?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bccb_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm ready as I'll ever be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001506b_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm ready to fight. Where do you need me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003fbd6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm ready to help you, if you're ready to accept my help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d75b_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm really busy... oh. Sorry. You closed the gate, yes? Thank you. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f33_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm really impressed. You made getting past that pillar look easy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000914df_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm really not interested in speaking to you right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cd0b_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm really tired. Can we get on with this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e896_Oblivion: I'm retired from adventuring... but you might try the old mine they call 'Rickety Mine' out east along the Blue Road.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9c1_Oblivion_RESP: I'm retired from public practice. I only take students in Alchemy to support my hobbies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000343c0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm running out of patience with Barthel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031ebb_Oblivion_: I'm saddened by the loss of those brave souls. May Arkay guide all of them to their final rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015dff_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm savin' up enough for some medicine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS37SdrassaAcquire_00022e5d_Obliv: I'm searching for some specific crystals known as Garridan's Tears. If you can locate these objects for me, I'd pay handsomely for each one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40GreetingChoice2_000790c0_Obli: I'm seen some people sleeping out on the street, but they huddle too close to the walls. I need someplace safe. I can't just sleep anywhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015069_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm set. As soon as they're close enough, they're dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_000613e9: I'm shocked the Gatekeeper is dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00013342_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm short on patience as well as magicka. Out of my way! Once I regain my power, I'll show you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04reject_00035ddf_Oblivion_RESP: I'm short on skilled thieves of your rank just now. If you change your mind, come back and see me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476b1_Oblivi: I'm sick of all this fighting with the Atius clan. I'm glad Uncle Iniel put his foot down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eb1_Oblivion_RES: I'm sick of mutton and beer. Want to go out and get a decent meal later?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ed55_Oblivion_RES: I'm so excited! I expect an invitation to perform at the installation of the new ruler of Mania any day now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071fb1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm so full. Not the least bit hungry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a123_Oblivio: I'm so glad to see you, my dear child. How are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04Hlidara_00035fb9_Oblivion_RES: I'm so happy for you, milady. I'm just so sorry he damaged it. Your finger swells up so when you wear it too long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_001885dc_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm so happy to see you again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062ca0_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm so happy to see you, I could burst!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5b2_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm so hungry I could eat a Bosmer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AngryMazoga_000860e0_Oblivion_RES: I'm so mad, I could kill you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a126_Oblivio: I'm so proud of you, my child. You crush our Lord's enemies into dust.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e86_Oblivion_RES: I'm so relieved that the Chalice is back in Lord Thadon's capable hands. He seems to be himself again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity11_00081e96_Oblivion_RE: I'm so sorry. I already have a Ring of Disrobing. There's really no place in a Museum of Oddities for duplicates, as I'm sure you can understand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43Staff_0004f8b7_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry I ever laid eyes on that thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a12b_Oblivio: I'm sorry child, it's just too much for me. I must leave now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003a64_Oblivion_RESP2: I'm sorry for running away like that, but fear got the best of me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003457e_Oblivion_RESP3: I'm sorry this happened, but those are the Guildmaster's orders. I'm sure you can gain your rank back, in time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b3_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry to bother you, Lord, but there seems to have been a misunderstanding.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000270e9_Oblivion_RESP3: I'm sorry to burden you with my problems. I'll do my best to have an answer by the time you return with the Great Welkynd Stone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45Talk_0002874a_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry to hear that.  Seed-Neeus must be devastated, poor dear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22MaricCarving_0002c81a_Oblivio: I'm sorry to hear that. Especially since Maric has not delivered the carving either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice6_0002c5c3_Oblivion_RE: I'm sorry to hear that. Sooner or later, the contracts are going to dry up. Maybe then you'll reconsider.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f429_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry to impose upon you like this, but I'm in need of assistance, and I don't know what to do. My husband, Aleron, is missing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033560_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry to tell you, but there are no more contracts to be had. As you know, business hasn't been good due to the Blackwood Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f9c1_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry to trouble you again...but I think the cure has worn off. I feel the cold grasp of death sneaking up on me once more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08Hunt_0001fdbb_Oblivion_RESP4: I'm sorry you got mixed up in all of this. I hope you can fight. It's our only chance of escaping alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b074_Oblivi: I'm sorry you had to be tasked to right this wrong that my father was responsible for. Once again, you've stuck your neck out for us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22HighFane_0002c818_Oblivion_RE: I'm sorry you were not able to fulfill your part of our agreement, but I consider the matter closed. Please do not speak of it again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11StrangersRing_00022e74_Oblivi: I'm sorry, I didn't hear what you said. Whatever it is you want, it will have to wait until I am holding audience in the Great Hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e725_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry, I have to patrol the area... but you should hurry to Castle Cheydinhal. The Count doesn't like to be kept waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c36d_Oblivi: I'm sorry, I shouldn't berate what you've done for Cheydinhal. Everyone appreciates what you did, as do I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_00033956_Oblivion_RES: I'm sorry, I wasn't in that evening. I was making my rounds of Chorrol.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da51_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry, I'm very busy now. There's still much work to be done. Good day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate1_00013fe9_Oblivio: I'm sorry, Kithlan, but I don't believe you. I think you're lying. And you know what happens to people who lie to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d2d6_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry, although I wish to spend time speaking with you, I have much business to attend to. Please be brief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_0002459b_Oblivion_RES: I'm sorry, but I don't feel comfortable telling you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028223_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry, but I don't feel much like talking right now. Someone has been killed! Don't you even care?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQLastItem_00026ef6_Oblivion_RESP: I'm sorry, but I don't know yet. The Xarxes... it clouds my mind and haunts my dreams like nothing I've ever experienced...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00028d69_Oblivion_R: I'm sorry, but I don't think I know any Glarthir.  Wait, do you mean that strange Wood Elf that you see wandering around the city?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheMagesGuild_0002d05c_Oblivi: I'm sorry, but I don't think so. The guild doesn't accept wanted criminals. Get rid of that bounty on your head, and perhaps I'll reconsider.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038af4_Oblivi: I'm sorry, but I have much to do right now. Please excuse me. Oh, and you should inform Carius of this if you haven't already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9b3_Oblivion_RESP: I'm sorry, but I really don't know much about the town itself.  I spend my time outdoors, walking the ridges and valleys.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00094c37_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry, but I'm late for an appointment. I've no time to talk now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036311_Oblivion_RESP1: I'm sorry, but I'm really not one for engaging in conversation. Please, leave me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0018b2fd_Oblivion_: I'm sorry, but I'm retired. Haven't worked with armor for years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002824b_Obliv: I'm sorry, but my feelings for Primo are really none of your concern.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a4964_Oblivion_R: I'm sorry, but my master is not receiving visitors at this hour. If you come back in the morning, I'm sure he would be glad to see you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047714_Oblivi: I'm sorry, but my studies keep me indoors for the most part. I know little of the rest of the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002825c_Oblivion_RE: I'm sorry, but someone has been murdered! I really don't want to talk about Neville right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000add08_Oblivion: I'm sorry, but the cities of Cyrodiil will have to fend for themselves for the time being.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheMagesGuild_0002d05e_Oblivi: I'm sorry, but the guild doesn't accept criminals as members. Get rid of that bounty on your head, and we'll talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Investigation_00031527_Oblivion_R: I'm sorry, but the investigation is a secret, and I don't trust you enough to discuss it with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05VolumeThree_00022b4b_Oblivion: I'm sorry, do I know you? I have a copy waiting for me at a bookstore, but it is not for sale. I've waited a long time to get that book.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c18c_Obl: I've always liked the place. Mog does a nice job, although I sometimes confuse her with Ugak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_000251f1_Oblivion_RES: I've always wondered who the Night Mother really is. Some say she's an old woman who lives somewhere here in Cyrodiil, but I'm not so sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441ff_Oblivion_RES: I've been bad, really bad. Perhaps the new leader of Dementia can sentence me to death for my crimes! Where do I sign up for that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk2_0006a862_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been doing some research in the Mystic Archives. What I discovered... It's more than we could have hoped for!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bed_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been doing some thinking. About you. It's kind of interesting that you were the last guest to arrive, don't you think?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gatekeeper_0008e4f0_Oblivion_: I've been dying to tell someone. You seem trustworthy enough... but don't tell Relmyna I said anything!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44Supplies_0007876e_Oblivion_RE: I've been gathering things for quite a while, but there are still a few I'm missing. Perhaps you'd bring them to me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b204_Oblivion_RES: I've been hearing disturbing tales about Oblivion Gates opening all across Cyrodiil. I hope it's just wild talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND05ThedretWhat_00002af6_Knights_: I've been held prisoner by these scoundrels for the longest time. They want to know how to reach the Shield, and believed I would help them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004f210_Oblivion_RE: I've been looking for just the right owner for a special home I have.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity12_00081ea9_Oblivion_RE: I've been looking for one of those to replace the one I used to have on display. At least I think I did. I truly wish I could afford to buy it...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40GreetingChoiceGrapes_000790b8: I've been looking for those. I thought Fimmion stole them thinking he could eat them, but I could never prove it. Thank you for returning them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00038fc6_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been looking for you. We have a situation in Bruma that I need you to deal with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_0002c5b9_Oblivio: I've been looking into them. Heard some disturbing things. We know they're a danger to us. And we know they're good at what they do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3_00018c7f_O: I've been losing Aureals with each attack, and I'm down to nothing but men. We are pinned down here. If we lose, the Gates of Madness will fall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3_000186fd_O: I've been losing Mazken with each attack, and I'm down to nothing but men. We are pinned down here. If we lose, the Gates of Madness will fall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk2_00034046_Oblivion_R: I've been meaning to ask you about your last contract. I heard there were some... complications.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000614ec_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been meaning to speak with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000add08_Oblivion: I've been pleading for troops for Cyrodiil for weeks, but the generals assure me that the entire Imperial Army is already fully committed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003fd38_Oblivion_RESP2: I've been preparing to join the guild for years. If you're nice to me, maybe I'll show you a few tricks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c339_Oblivion_RESP5: I've been promoted to the post of Captain of the Guard, and hope to return respect to the peacekeepers of this town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c34a_Oblivion_RESP3: I've been promoted to the post of Captain of the Guard, and hope to return respect to the peacekeepers of this town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277b2_Oblivion_R: I've been reading "Fundaments of Alchemy." I figure it can't hurt to learn something new.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277b3_Oblivion_R: I've been reading "Overview of Gods and Worship." I'm not sure if I like it yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NewCaptain_0009839e_Oblivion_: I've been reassigned! This is outrageous! The Gray Fox had a hand in this, I know it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005e076_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been storing things for when the end comes. You might find some of it useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk2_00002bb1_Knights_RESP1: I've been thinking... We need to make our presence known, throughout all the Empire. Make people feel truly safe once more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: I've been told that she really wants to return to Argonia, but her services are so useful here, she feels compelled to stay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00047421_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been told to send you to Chorrol for some duties. Speak with Oreyn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ02Skooma_00189180_Oblivion_RESP: I've been trying to catch Lonavo for months, but every time I approach the place, his lookout sees me and he goes running.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028162_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been trying to figure out who our host might be. With two people dead, it almost seems like he set this party up just to kill us all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277b5_Oblivion_R: I've been trying to finish "Brief History of the Empire." It's a lot to take in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BookResponses_000277b1_Oblivion_R: I've been trying to get through "Mysterious Akavir." It's a fairly interesting read.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00053244_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been waiting for you, Associate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SheoIntroSpeech1_00056049_Oblivio: I've been waiting for you, or someone like you, or someone other than you, for some time. I need a champion, and you've got the job.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00022e0f_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been waiting for you. Have a seat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00146849_Oblivion_RESP1: I've been watching you fight, my friend. It's a good thing we're both on the Blue Team, 'cause I sure as blazes wouldn't want to go up against you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000914d6_Oblivion_RESP1: I've better things to do than waste time speaking with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: I've bought a few things at Mach-Na's, but he's always so surly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1c6_Oblivion_RES: I've bought a good number of things at Colovian Traders. And Gunder is a friendly sort.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c194_Obl: I've bought a number of things from Gunder. I've always been satisfied.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004995: I've browsed Claudette's shop, but I haven't spent a lot of time there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001cdff_Oblivion_R: I've checked my sources, and no one knows this "Agarmir"; he's probably using a false name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028f4a_Obliv: I've come across your kind before. People get murdered, and you ask questions. It's a sure sign of a killer with a guilty conscience. Watch yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c344_Oblivion_RESP1: I've come from speaking with Count Indarys, and I've news for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12AcceptMission_00018239_Oblivi: I've come into the possession of a diary written by an Akaviri messenger. I suspect that the text within can lead you to the ruins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopYes_0001e840_Oblivion_RES: I've come to some decisions. I intend to donate all of the money I have made, as well as what is left of these stolen items to the temple.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk3_0018d7f3_Oblivion_RES: I've come to value your judgement, and your experience. Your wisdom does us all a great service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022509_Oblivion_RESP2: I've committed most of the book to memory, but I took the time to write down a passage you might find useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09BodyParts_0001357a_Oblivion_R: I've created versions of each appendage, with various enhancements. You must choose one of each. I am attached to them all. Artist's prerogative.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002006e_Oblivion_RESP6: I've deciphered part of the ritual needed to open a portal to Camoran's Paradise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_000319d1_Oblivion_RES: I've done some scouting around while we've been camped here, and it looks like Cropsford is right in the middle of a goblin war.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1b9_Oblivi: I've eaten many meals there, and I've always been satisfied.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bef_Oblivion_RESP2: I've faced your kind before. You're a coward. You use stealth and lies to destroy innocent lives. All of that ends now! Prepare to meet your doom!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026d58_Oblivion_RESP6: I've figured out another item needed for the ritual to open the portal to Camoran's Paradise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_000242f8_Oblivion_RESP1: I've fought mudcrabs more fearsome than you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34ExplainMore_0008f7b8_Oblivion: I've found a new kind of comforting inner peace here away from the chaos of Cyrodiil. I'm tired of the battles and the politics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pillar_00035f3e_Oblivion_RESP2: I've given up trying to figure it out. It's just beyond us. Why Denel stays down there, I have no idea. He's just asking to get killed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Message_0018bc5c_Oblivion_RESP1: I've given you the message. There's nothing more I can do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c7_Oblivion_RESP: I've gone aground in ports all over the Abecean Sea, and Anvil's far from the worst. Got the Fo'c's'le for my hammock, and Mirabelle to keep it warm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e829_Obli: I've got a Quintat that says they can ipanate
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000a944b_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got a bad feeling about this...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0d3_Oblivion_RESP: I've got a few hot prospects. I'm sure something will come through for me. Soon. Really soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk1_0006a85e_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got a moment, but little more. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b129f_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got a room, and a cheap one at that. You looking for one?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009216_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got another contract for you, meat. I assume you won't embarrass yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002d733_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got another job for you, slightly off the record. You'll be going on a mission with Viranus Donton. Yes -- the Guildmaster's son.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002f9e7_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got another job for you. It's a sensitive one. I need you to find Viranus Donton.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005de7f_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got food and drink, if you need it. I haven't touched it much, so it should be safe. Might want to wipe it off first anyway. You never know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071f54_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got fresh sticks. Guaranteed no leaves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000be7a_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got more for you. Important stuff, actually. You need to go talk to Lord Rugdumph.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00072e04_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got my eye on you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorWhere_0000979f_Oblivion: I've got my men scattered all over town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028beb_Oblivion_RESP3: I've got my old Legion armor and sword in a chest upstairs. It's time I geared up and showed this coward just who he's dealing with!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0006e2de_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got my orders for now. Check back in a month or so, and we can talk about what to do next.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be64_Oblivion_RESP2: I've got news for you. Vilena wasn't happy when she heard about Viranus. No shock there. She expelled Oreyn from the guild. It's a damn shame.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1b1_Obl: I've got no interest in talking about some snooty mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000be76_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got nothing else for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00047424_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got nothing else. Don't believe Azzan does either. I think you had better go talk to our friend in Chorrol. You know who.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00047426_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got nothing more for you, my friend. I believe Burz has one further assignment, but that is all. I wish you luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Fugitives_00009c30_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got nothing to say about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000bed7_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got one more for you, meat. I assume you can handle it. I need you to investigate some disappearances at Harlun's Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003457e_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got some bad news for you. Donton didn't take the news about her son well at all, not that you'd expect otherwise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c8521_Oblivion_RESP2: I've got some news for you. Vilena wasn't happy when she heard about Viranus. No shock there. She expelled Oreyn from the guild. It's a damn shame.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002c5b8_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got something for you, but we're not going to talk about it here. I want you to meet me at my house after sundown. We'll talk more then.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00009c59_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got something for you. Could be tough. There are some escaped fugitives for you to find, meat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000549bc_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got the diary, and I will turn it over to Armand the next chance I get.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005e077_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got the sharpest blades in the Isles. Maybe anywhere. Take a look.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00054219_Oblivion_RESP1: I've got your horse saddled and waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04XedilianChoice_00044f52_Obliv: I've granted you a new spell - the ability to summon Haskill, my Chamberlain, to aid you in your travels. He knows a lot. More than he knows.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f7ba_Oblivion_RESP2: I've grown quite fond of him and can't stand seeing him this way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyBruma_0004f215_Oblivion_R: I've had a look at the place myself, and it could use some furnishings inside. Quite barren in there I'm afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c23b_Oblivion_RES: I've had about enough of Sir Lazare. He thinks he's so much better than everyone else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ06Bears_0018afe0_Oblivion_RESP1: I've had attacks on my small flock of sheep lately. I was hoping that building a fence would solve the problem, but it hasn't helped at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004658: I've had many a good night in the place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1c2_Oblivi: I've had many good meals at the Count's Arms. I've had even more good bottles of wine there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDQuestionResponses_00023: I've had many meals at the Oak and Crosier. Sure, it may not be the best in all Cyrodiil, but it suits me fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004658e_Oblivi: I've had many meals there. Olav is an excellent innkeeper.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VahtacenTopic_00035f3c_Oblivion_R: I've had my fill of the place, that's for sure. And I've got the scars to prove it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC2_0003fbe0_Oblivion_R: I've had plenty of time to ponder my deeds since I came here. Ponder, and regret. An eternity of regret.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b1d8_Oblivion_RESP5: I've had some people out collecting your new combatants. The wilderness is full of 'em! Let me know when you're ready for a match, and it's showtime!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d62b_Oblivion_RESP5: I've had some people out collecting your new combatants. The wilderness is full of 'em! Let me know when you're ready for a match, and it's showtime!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000343ee_Oblivion_RESP1: I've half a mind to go down to Green Emperor Way myself and see what's there ... Well, good luck! I hope you find what you're looking for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1bd_Oblivion_RES: I've heard Azzan can sign you up for the Fighters Guild. That's someone I wouldn't mind working for.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfc5_Oblivion_RES: I've heard Brodras at the Fighters Guild is well-versed in using heavy armor, especially for a wood elf.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1df_Oblivion_RES: I've heard Carahil is a powerful illusionist. No wonder she's the ranking mage here in Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008261e_Obl: I've heard Cindanwe works the other residents day and night. They're none too happy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046630_Oblivion_RES: I've heard Edla Dark-Heart was once an assassin!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465d9_Oblivion_RES: I've heard Right-Wind is good with a blade. No wonder he's in the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDQuestionResponses_000465: I've heard Tadrose Helas does excellent work. Perhaps that's why she's always so busy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005eee8_Oblivion_RES: I've heard The Fringe has been attacked. I hope the residents were able to escape in time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfb9_Oblivion_RES: I've heard Tun-Zeeus has some fine blades at the Dividing Line. Of course, he'll talk your ear off about them if you let him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c219_Oblivi: I've heard a lot of stories about the Fo'c's'le. None of them good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004663: I've heard a number of stories, none of them good. I understand she might have been a hired assassin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000825e0_Oblivion_RES: I've heard ghosts haunt the ruined city of Vitharn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fdb_Obli: I've heard good things about the mage trainers there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004662c_Oblivi: I've heard he can teach his skills to others, for a price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008261f_Obl: I've heard he can't even sleep, he's so afraid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e976_O: I've heard he joined the priesthood to avoid serving in the military. What a coward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fc6_Obli: I've heard he knows his way around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003e255_Obl: I've heard he knows more about Mysticism than almost anyone. Strange about the sheep, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003e2ab_Obl: I've heard he never leaves his laboratory. He's certainly dedicated to his craft.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049887_Oblivi: I've heard he'll teach his skills, for the right price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_000465b7_Obliv: I've heard he's a talented mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498d: I've heard he's good with a lockpick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c21e_Obl: I've heard he's good with his bow, and he'll train you, for a price. I like the wine he makes, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1fb_Obl: I've heard he's the best in town with a shield. If you want to learn, go to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e992_O: I've heard him talk at length about the Mages Guild. I understand he's been teaching members about Illusion, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: I've heard him talk, and talk, and talk. Haven't heard anything useful yet, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDResponses_0003dfc7_Obl: I've heard if you're in the Fighters Guild, you can learn a lot from him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_00015f11_Oblivion_RESP2: I've heard it all. They say he's immortal because he's led the Thieves Guild for over 300 years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004995: I've heard it's the best light armor in the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004661: I've heard many of Alga's stories. She's got a real gift for telling a tale.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00025819_O: I've heard many tales of Black Marsh. It sounds like a truly mysterious place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018231_Oblivion_RESP1: I've heard much about your deeds from my people in Bruma.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04WhatSecrets_0004b776_Oblivion: I've heard of a hidden torture chamber. They say that Count Marius interrogates Argonian immigrants from Black Marsh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01Rohssan_00007e01_Oblivion_RES: I've heard of her. What's it worth to ya?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01AmantiusAllectus_00007dfe_Obl: I've heard of him. What's it worth to ya?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08AncestorMoth_00015f1a_Oblivio: I've heard of it. Are you willing to make a donation?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BGreenmote_000167e4_Oblivion_: I've heard of such a grand place. Ahhh... to imagine all that wonderful Greenmote under one roof.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002980_Knights_RESP1: I've heard of you! You're the Divine Crusader everybody's talking about!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NeutralReceive_00029548_Oblivion_: I've heard others say the same.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c19f_Obl: I've heard rumors about him, but I don't believe they're true.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bcf_Oblivion_RES: I've heard rumors about the Council of Mages consorting with outside sources. Why are outsiders interfering with our guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEObeliskResponses_00077d0a_Obliv: I've heard rumors about this. I hope they stay out of the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c242_Oblivion_RES: I've heard rumors that someone has been keeping a close eye on Toutius Sextius. Seems harmless enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062686_Oblivion_RES: I've heard rumors that the Council of Mages is taking advice from outsiders. I'm not sure how I feel about that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FingersoftheMountain_000253d5_Obl: I've heard rumors, but they're nothing more than that. Imperials trying to harness the power of the Ayleids... they're not fools.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c21b_Obl: I've heard she works long hours. It's worth it, though. That's some fine wine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilNQDResponses_000465f2_Obliv: I've heard she'll do anything for other guild members, and that she's an excellent trainer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008262c_Obl: I've heard she'll pay well for certain items she's been looking for.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDResponses_0004659e_Oblivi: It's a good place to stay. Hafid is quite a good proprietor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0005a756_Oblivio: It's a good thing I've kept all the weapons and armor in good condition. If I let those soldiers use them, they'd be all dented by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8d7_Oblivion: It's a grand house, Riverside, and they have grand parties there. All the rich swongs and swells of the town come in. Leave a right mess, they do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000314e8_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a great relief that the gate is gone. Now the people of Cheydinhal can breathe easier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InnofIllOmen_00023e25_Oblivion_RE: It's a horrible name for an inn, I know. But I just can't bring myself to change it. Besides, I like the sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b20_Knights_R: It's a horrible thing, truly. One cannot help but pity those such as Kellen, who have such a burden placed on them through no fault of their own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9a7_Oblivion_RESP: It's a little too rugged up here for me. Add a couple hairs to a Nord and you've got a bear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_InfoRefusal_0002459c_Oblivion_RES: It's a matter of trust. And I don't trust you enough yet.

It's a modest home in the center of town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Passwall_0008e4fe_Oblivion_RE: It's a nice enough place. Less dirty than others. I feel like I belong. That old man, in the room made out of butterflies, he said to wait here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049954_Oblivi: It's a nice store, at least for alchemists.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479da_Oblivion_RESP3: It's a pity my busy consulting and training schedule leaves me little time for gathering ingredients...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeleneTopic_0000c1cb_Oblivion_RES: It's a pity she wouldn't surrender. Such a waste of a young life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseBuySkingrad_000545db_Oblivio: It's a pleasure doing business with you. Tilmo has your horse waiting outside.
