ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001c4cd_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a pleasure to see you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFelldew_00018b7e_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a poison, plain and simple. It'll make you wish you were dead. And given enough time, you will be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice3_00026b16_Oblivi: It's a powerful sword, no doubt about that. Jet black. Got a wicked edge on it, and they say it can steal a man's soul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAClavicusChoice5_00026b18_Oblivi: It's a powerful sword, no doubt about that. Jet black. Got a wicked edge on it, and they say it can steal a man's soul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475c1_Oblivion_R: It's a pretty town, and everyone is really friendly, except maybe some Khajiit and Argonians who are upset about the Trans-Niben.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa84_Oblivio: It's a problem, all these doubles walking around. And it's tiresome. Didn't used to be like this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004ed8b_Oblivion_RE: It's a quaint building, small but tidy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004f210_Oblivion_RE: It's a quaint little house conveniently located just off the main gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_000289f4_Obliv: It's a regal name, from a rather regal family. Indeed, my father owns more property than the East Empire Company!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MerchantTopic_0002fd6c_Oblivion_R: It's a sad thing, to think that a mage would kill helpless merchants for the wares they carry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8a9_Oblivion: It's a scandal that the Mages Guild has tolerated practice of the Black Arts among its members for so long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusD_0001e8e9_Oblivion_RESP2: It's a secret way out of the Imperial City. Or it was supposed to be secret.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FawilTopic_00143eb3_Oblivion_RESP: It's a shame Farwil is gone. Although he was boastful and aloof, at least he treated me as an equal. I shall miss him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000441f8_Oblivion_RES: It's a shame Syl's gone. She didn't pay a lot of attention to what was going on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049901_Oblivi: It's a shame all the smaller bookstores are gone. I guess they just couldn't compete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_0001ceeb_Obli: It's a shame she doesn't know more about her craft, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_000335a5_Oblivion_: It's a shame so many of the Knights fell. I suppose their intentions were good, even if they were a bit self-serving.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c197_Obl: It's a shame such a good smith wastes her life in the bottle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062610_Oblivion: It's a shame that Selena doesn't join in our fun, but she takes her role as an Alchemist very seriously. If you need supplies, she's the one to see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00060ed4_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a shame that you had all the fun before I could get here. Now, there's nothing left to do but rebuild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434b8_Oblivion_RES: It's a shame, really. The Gatekeeper was a beautiful specimen. Now he'll just rot and fade like everything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e44_Oblivion_RES: It's a simple job. Go get a journal from Fallen Rock Cave. Shouldn't that be a cinch for a Fighter Guild contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09HelpGF_00014825_Oblivion_RESP: It's a small item in the possession of a powerful court wizard. Will you do this for me? I will pay you well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Medallion_00066fee_Oblivion_R: It's a small, round, gold medallion. On the back is the inscription "To Pyke, from Farwil."

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ac8_Oblivion_R: It's a town, like any other. Well, go outside, and there's the mountains and wines and sheep. Here in town, though, nothing special.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0003b345_Oblivion_RESP1: It's a wonderful room, isn't it?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e723_Oblivion_RESP1: It's about time someone got here. What took you so long?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a3840_Oblivion_RESP1: It's about time someone got here. What took you so long?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf3a_Oblivion: It's about time. I guess I have to reinstate you now. Try not to repeat this mistake in the future.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465a4_Oblivion_RES: It's always a pleasure to hear Uravasa Othrelas speak at chapel. She has a real way with words.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081539_Oblivion_RESP1: It's been an honor to host you, Lord Sheogorath.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028220_Oblivion_RESP1: It's funny. I don't even know you, and already I don't like you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027986_Oblivion_RESP1: It's funny. I like just about everyone, but the very sight of you makes me sick. Why don't you go look for the gold someplace else, friend.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ADMIRELIKE_0006230e_Oblivion_RESP: It's good of you to say so.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043519_Oblivion_RES: It's good that Resonator of Judgment is working again, what with the Gatekeeper dead and everything. Did you hear that noise?

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049934_Oblivi: It's good to know that there's a pawnbroker around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062683_Oblivion_RES: It's good to know that valuable research is still going on, even though things seem to be a bit more tense lately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241e2_Oblivion_RES: It's good to know we've got such a strong Fighters Guild presence here in town.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003337b_Oblivion_RESP1: It's good to see a friendly face. I feared we'd never see anyone from Cyrodiil again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00058e08_Oblivion_RESP1: It's good to see some reinforcements from across Cyrodiil. It's been too long since we all stood together in a common cause.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035588_Oblivion_RESP1: It's good to see you again! I hope your contracts have been giving you much pleasure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000be5e8_Oblivion_RESP1: It's good to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da6f_Oblivion_RESP1: It's good to see you again. I'm so sorry that we didn't realize Seridur's deception.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000377d4_Oblivion_RESP1: It's good to see you in the real world. I'm indebted to you for rescuing me from my nightmare.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224f3_Oblivion_RESP1: It's good to see you, friend. This inn has been cheerless for far too long.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003357a_Oblivion_RESP1: It's good to set my foot upon the soil of my home.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_0004993: Jensine's isn't bad, especially if you need to make a quick couple of septims.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004658b_Oblivion_RES: Jerall View is a nice place for visitors to stay. Hafid makes everyone feel welcome.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e0a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Jesan Sextius, singer, composer, and storyteller extraordinaire. Glad to meet you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7aa_Oblivion_RESP1: Jobs are good. I need more money. So I need more jobs. For money.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Jobs around here? Don't know that I trust you enough to recommend you to anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a1_Oblivion_RESP1: Jobs for the Fighters Guild? Hmmm... try Margarte. If she's not at home or at the Five Claws, she's probably out looking for alchemical ingredients.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7e1_Oblivion_RESP1: Jobs would be great. Too bad no one is giving us any these days. If you can find some work for us, we'll do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGThievesGuildJobs_000165e5_Obliv: Jobs? We're thieves, not masons or scribes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dce_Oblivion_RESP1: Join the Fighters Guild? Fight, and get paid for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033ddb_Oblivion_RESP1: Join the Guild, and fight for gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033d14_Oblivion_RESP1: Join the Guild. You won't regret it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkBrotherhoodTopic_000bba98_Obl: Join us, and you'll find the Dark Brotherhood to be all that, and so much more. We are, more than anything, a union of like-minded individuals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004762a_Oblivion_RESP1: Jollring, the butler. I've served Master Umbacano for many years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09ImIn_00053724_Oblivion_RESP2: Jorundr and I have had a rocky relationship at best. Against my will, I've been dragged all over Cyrodiil helping him commit petty crimes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c22f_Oblivion_: Julianos and Dibella and Stendarr are all Lorkhan's betrayers, posing as divinities in a principality that has lost its guiding light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTombSpeech_00002d07_Knights_RES: Julianos blesses you with his wisdom and his guidance. Trust in your knowledge for it is the whole of who you are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38GuardWarnChoice1_00023686_Obl: Julianos preserve us! I can't believe it ... why me?! Please, show this to the guards right away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_IngredientCollection_000279e1_Obl: Julienne Fanis has long served Arch-Mage Traven in collecting alchemical ingredients for his personal research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004763e_Oblivion_RESP1: Julienne Fanis. I'm the Alchemy Expert. At least, the best the Mages Guild has.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00023c0c_Oblivion_RESP1: Jump on my sword while you can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_00081a39_Oblivion_RESP1: Just a Gnarl, I suppose. Let them drink their fill of Order, ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilD1_0003fbe2_Oblivion_R: Just act like a prisoner, and do as I say. Once Orthe leaves, we can find a quiet spot to remove those Bands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DSNo_00023670_Oblivion_RESP1: Just as I suspected!! They've gotten to you too! Not one of them involved in the conspiracy, and you expect me to believe that?!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG02Choice1B_0002e5a9_Oblivion_RE: Just as I suspected. If you ever believe yourself to be ready, perhaps we'll have reason to speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38BPYes_0001dc31_Oblivion_RESP1: Just as I thought, just as I thought. Excellent work. There will be a bonus in this for you, don't worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ScarTailTopic_00035593_Oblivion_R: Just as a member of the Dark Brotherhood cannot kill a fellow family member, a Shadowscale is forbidden from slaying another Shadowscale.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcConversation_0007ead0_Obli: Just as long as we don't catch any of their diseases. Adventurers always get strange diseases.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDEightAndOneTopic_00002c8c_Knigh: Just as the Eight aided Pelinal of old, now the ascended One, Talos who was Tiber Septim, provides his Blessing to you, the new Crusader.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS43HowDid_000be560_Oblivion_RESP: Just be sure and keep this quiet. If the other mages even knew that I was involved with Rosentia's new guests...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607d1_Oblivion_RES: Just because the Isles didn't come crashing down around our heads doesn't mean everything is fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10LlevanaTalk_0003c375_Oblivion: Just because you run the law in this town doesn't put you above it. You're going to pay for what happened to Aldos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038580_Oblivion_RESP1: Just before I arrived here, I received a report from one of our scouts watching the roads.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00074a16_Oblivion_RE: Just between the two of us, I wish the Countess would worry a bit more about the security of the city and a bit less about her damned painting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcConversation_0007ead2_Obli: Just don't get any blood on me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatekeeperChoiceHowTears_0008: Just don't tell her I said anything. I might get another lesson in the nature of Pain. I don't like those lessons very much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00053766_Oblivion_RESP1: Just exit the city through the North Gate. It isn't far from there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002871b_Oblivion_RESP1: Just follow Savlian's orders, and everything will be fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gift_0018bc31_Oblivion_RESP1: Just give them to her; say they're from a friend. She doesn't need to know I'm the one responsible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008dc3d_Obli: Just go right up to them and introduce yourself. They love meeting new people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Prank_0001ceea_Oblivion_RESP1: Just go unlock Jeanne's desk with that spell I taught you.. Find her Manual of Spellcraft, and bring it here to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003632a_Oblivion_RESP1: Just go! I can't stand the sight of you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e95_Oblivion_RES: Just got a look at the new Maglir guy. Another 'eight-pint hero', if you ask me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_00083065_Oblivion_RESP1: Just have to take matters into my own hands. The only way now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaCombatantTopic_0002ada0_Obli: Just head through the door here on my right and take the stairs down. Be on your best behavior, though. Owyn is a bit... cranky by nature.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bcc6_Oblivion_RESP1: Just hold the ghosts off while I figure out how to open this damn door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d498_Oblivion_RESP1: Just hurry back with that ring... please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47Counterspell_0003012e_Oblivio: Just in case, it might be best if you wore this ring while you were casting the spell. I make them myself. Very useful for this kind of research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a13_Oblivion_RESP1: Just in time, Mage. We've been waiting for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007302d_Oblivion_RESP1: Just keep going. Nothing to eat here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk2_0006fdd7_Oblivion_RESP: Just keep one hand on your hilt and both eyes on the crowd. There's something sinister lurking out there. I can feel it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00062156_Oblivion_RESP1: Just keep your eyes on the menu, and off of Sheer Meedish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_00067dc6_Oblivion_RES: Just know, that whatever you need, we will give gladly. Our hearts, our blades, our lives if need be. Long live the Septim bloodline!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007eab0_Oblivion_RESP2: Just leave me alone -- go away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081da7_Oblivion_RESP2: Just leave me alone -- go away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004735a_Oblivion_RESP1: Just leave us alone. We have enough troubles here in the Savage Garden without you adding to them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChoice2A_0000c1b7_Oblivion_R: Just let me know when you're ready for a match and we can get this over with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006052c_Oblivion_RES: Just like Sheogorath to abandon us in our time of need. He has been ever fickle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c98d_Oblivion_RESP: Just like Skyrim, except for all the tight-ass Heartlanders around. All work and chapel... no wonder they're so sour.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29InvGet_0001d044_Oblivion_RESP: Just like a baker not revealing his best recipes, I must keep my sources anonymous or every merchant in town would use them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8ad_Oblivion: Just look around. Is not Cheydinhal the model of civic rule? No... don't bow! I am just a humble servant of the people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046663_Oblivion_RESP1: Just look at the Yellow Team's Dark Elf! You can see the murder in his eyes! Can the Blue Team's Bloodletter even hope to survive? Let's find out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038f14_Oblivion_RESP1: Just look for me if you need anything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00132aa0_Oblivion_RESP1: Just look for me if you need anything else.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a127_Oblivio: Just looking at you reminds me of... Him. Why has He forsaken us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff6_Oblivion_RESP5: Just make sure you understand our rules of competition for this match. Fighting the Grand Champion, well... The rules are a bit different.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037ff7_Oblivion_RESP4: Just make sure you understand our rules of competition for this match. Fighting the Grand Champion, well... The rules are a bit different.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b6a_Oblivion_RESP1: Just one more time. At least. He's a sport.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da54_Oblivion_RESP1: Just out for a brisk walk. Helps clear the head. Any other information I can help with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark03FinChoice1A_00023e54_Oblivi: Just outside the Imperial Prison is a grating that leads to the sewers. It has recently been tightly locked, but I will provide a key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000175b0_Oblivion_: Just perform the task you've been given. We'll talk more once you're done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4a7_Oblivion_RESP6: Just please, help me get that ring back. I want to save what's left of my marriage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000206ad_Oblivion_RESP2: Just remember it was I that assisted you. I expect that will carry some favor under your rule.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Ritual_0007893f_Oblivion_RESP: Just remember not to deviate from the Ritual's guidelines. One would hope you can do that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006fdca_Oblivion_RESP1: Just remember, my sword's here if you need it. You run into any trouble, just holler.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00068343_Oblivion_RESP1: Just remember, we're in this together. You must learn to rely on me as I rely on you. But I've rambled on long enough. Akatosh be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000980d2_Oblivion_RESP1: Just speak to Tolgan... you'll see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterExit_000981ba_Oblivion_RESP: Just take your trinkets and go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JoinUs_0003d4a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Just to be perfectly clear, we're not prostitutes. We do everything on our own terms, and the men never, ever lay one hand on us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Rescue_00014739_Oblivion_RESP: Just unlock the door. A couple of hours after you're gone, it will be quiet again and I can sneak out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_000c47d1_Oblivion_RESP: Just wait. He'll be here shortly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterExit_0003d08a_Oblivion_RESP: Just walk away like you don't know me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35HereYouGo_00078674_Oblivion_R: Just what are you trying to pull?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004351f_Oblivion_RES: Just when I look forward to company, they activate the Resonator. Tall-Trees-Falling is so alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006051a_Oblivion_RES: Just when I thought I was making some progress, I hear that Sheogorath himself has gone missing. Is this the end?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006c67b_Oblivion_RESP1: Just... just leave me alone, all right? I don't want no trouble!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo03_0006fde1_Oblivion_RE: Justice has been done. And henceforth, Mazoga and you shall be known as Knights of the White Stallion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo03_000908dd_Oblivion_RE: Justice has been done. And henceforth, you shall be known as Knight of the White Stallion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c37d_Oblivi: Justice has been done. Go tell Garrus what's transpired here. I await my fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02Choice1A_00023f36_Oblivion_: Justice? Hahahahaha! I been avoidin' that all my life, mate! Let me show you how!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12TraitorTaunts_0008f7c4_Oblivi: Jyggalag is coming. He cannot be stopped. He will rule this land, and all our delusions will be stripped away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12TraitorTaunts_0008f7ce_Oblivi: Jyggalag is coming. He cannot be stopped. He will rule this land, and all our delusions will be stripped away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607f4_Oblivion_RES: Jyggalag is gone, but I bet he brought a ton of diseases with him. We still aren't safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008f589_Oblivion_RESP1: Jyggalag will reward me well for your death!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060918_Oblivion_RES: Jyggalag's defeated. Took them long enough to get rid of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060887_Oblivion_RES: Jyggalag's forces have been defeated. Perhaps Order is simply an inferior element.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12FontofMadness_00017272_Oblivi: Jyggalag's minions must have introduced Order into the very wellspring of Madness. You must cleanse the Pools, or Order has won the war.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006266c_Oblivion_RES: Kalthar tried to ruin the Leyawiin guild. Just goes to show you can't trust a Necromancer, even if he claims to be "reformed."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_0001e06a_Oblivion_RESP: Kalthar was talking about it recently. He seemed very agitated about it. Almost... happy. Strange, isn't that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475b3_Oblivion_RESP1: Kantav Cheynoslin. I am the Primate of Leywiin, and Zenithar's Advocate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000488ec_Oblivi: Kastav says he works. Ha! Flies land on him, he's too lazy to brush them off. I'm sick of taking abuse for him, even if he is my brother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476aa_Oblivion_RESP1: Kastus Sintav. Uncle Iniel got us good jobs gardening. We're very grateful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018a960_Oblivion_RESP1: Kayleen's grave is outside if you wish to pay your respects.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00070405_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep an eye out for my things, won't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00072f11_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep an eye out for them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008db8b_Oblivion_RES: Keep far from the Grummite with skin a greenish-jet. If your paths should accidentally cross, don't ever get it wet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e130_Obli: Keep far from the Grummite with skin a greenish-jet. If your paths should accidentally cross, don't ever get it wet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e4_Oblivion_: Keep in mind that Anya is cowardly, and may require persuasion to tell you what she knows.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03SearchForArmand_0003362d_Obli: Keep looking boys. Armand Christophe has to be here somewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018d926_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep looking for that wine! Farewell!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001da55_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep me informed. I'm very interested to hear where he is hiding.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00027326_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep quiet, and stay out of the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008da95_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep to it, I have faith in you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00038f24_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep up the... ummm... good work, I suppose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_0002711f_Oblivion_RESP: Keep working on obtaining the items Martin needs for the ritual.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00046644_Oblivion_RES: Keep your eyes on City-Swimmer. I don't know where she goes when she's not in the canals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_00062275_Oblivion_RESP: Keep your fingers to yourself, thief!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeHelmetMagic_0001f3e3_Obl: Keep your hair from getting tangled in melee.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0018d7e0_Oblivion_RESP1: Keep your heart true... and your eyes open.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b6_Oblivion_RESP1: Keld of the Isles. Guardian of the Fighters Guild. And how did I achieve that high rank, you ask?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cd4_Oblivion_RESP1: Khajiit has no words for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000176c4_Oblivion_RESP4: Kid, you've got more guts. And skill. I think you can take the Gray Prince! Go over and talk to Ysabel if you think I'm right!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027e38_Oblivion_RESP5: Kill Mankar Camoran, and you will unmake his Paradise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2A_00032be9_Oblivi: Kill Phillida in any way, Rose or not, and the contract is complete. But to receive a bonus, you must go beyond murder. You must send a message!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2B_00032bea_Oblivi: Kill Phillida in any way, Rose or not, and the contract is complete. But to receive a bonus, you must go beyond murder. You must send a message!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice2C_00032beb_Oblivi: Kill Phillida in any way, Rose or not, and the contract is complete. But to receive a bonus, you must go beyond murder. You must send a message!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00073005_Oblivion_RESP1: Kill every last one of them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark11Choice3A_00002dd5_Oblivion_: Kill me? What is this? Who are you? I don't know who sent you, but you won't take me down without a fight! So go ahead, make your move!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000192e6_Oblivion_RESP1: Kill the Aureals. Don't stop until every last one of them is dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMephalaSpeech_000579d9_Oblivion: Kill the leaders of the two families. Plant evidence to implicate the other family as the killer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06PriestsOrderTopic_000910f7_Ob: Kill them when you see them. But don't touch the corpse until they're really dead. Which they aren't, until you deactivate the obelisk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13hunterChoiceHow_00033f57_Obli: Kill them, run them out of town - do what you will. I simply want them gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Continue_00189d08_Oblivion_RE: Kill those things. Every last one of them! They destroyed everything I hold dear!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072dab_Oblivion_RESP2: Kill! Kill the cat! Good dog.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofSheogorathTOPIC_00026adf_: Killed and ate a Bosmer there. But it made me sick. Saw Lord Sheogorath in the vomitus, so that's all right. Here to sacrifice? A limb would be nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MelusPetiliusTOPIC_00026b47_Obliv: Killed off hordes of goblins when they attacked the town. Killed off a nest of minotaurs singlehandedly. That's all in the past now, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081ed4_Oblivio: Killed the other one, huh? You're annoying, but you do good work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00146009_Oblivion_RES: Killing their chief should weaken the Black Bow Bandits, but they're still going to be a menace to travelers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_0002872a_Oblivi: Kind of stuck-up, that one. Right before you got here I told the funniest joke about an Argonian maid, and she didn't even crack a smile.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091885_Oblivion_RESP1: Kithlan seems eager to help you. When you become sovereign of Dementia, I'd keep him around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00096045_Oblivi: Kneel before the might of Jyggalag!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_00082619_Obl: Knick-knacks and bric-a-brac, once you go you're sure to go back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_00016efc_Obl: Knifepoint Hollow is my prison. As the Great Library, it once contained all the knowledge in creation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_000807ab_Obl: Knifepoint Hollow is my prison. Hewn from the stone by Sheogorath for the sole purpose of containing my knowledge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_00014b5f_Obl: Knifepoint Hollow is near the core of the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077d04_Oblivion_RES: Knights of Order have appeared in the Isles. I hear they come from the obelisks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077d05_Oblivion_RES: Knights of Order have come to destroy the Realm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef70_Oblivion_RES: Knights of Order? These aren't the valiant knights from the epic tales!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10LaunchAttackYes_00002c36_Knig: Knights of the Nine! Umaril and his Aurorans must be destroyed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsStartCombat_00002b4b_Kni: Knights of the Nine, follow me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10SirThedretSpeech01_00002c97_K: Knights of the Nine, hear me! Today we have witnessed undeniable proof of the strength and the might of the gods we serve!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0014600a_Oblivion_RES: Knights-Errant? That's just a poor knight without a castle. But I hear they got a nice lodge right on the banks of the Niben.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006053b_Oblivion_RES: Knock, knock. Who's there? Not Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7d_Knights: Know that I was the one who drew weapon first against Sir Berich. He merely defended himself, and proved the better swordsman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RufioTopic_000272ac_Oblivion_RESP: Know that Rufio is old and weak, and sleeps his days away. You could kill him before he even has a chance to wake. If you so choose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG17GoOn_000366ed_Oblivion_RESP4: Know that you have my complete confidence. I would not entrust this job to you if I did not feel you were prepared for it. Now, go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002241c_Oblivion_RESP2: Know this -- if you truly wish to become a Champion, you'll have to go through me. If we meet in that Arena, I will make you beg for death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CovenantTopic_000272af_Oblivion_R: Know this. Every Dark Brother and Sister is a child of Sithis. He whom we call Sithis has many other names. Chaos. Doom. Discord. Sithis is the Void.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d8d_Oblivion_RESP: Know this: there will be no further leniency. Any more violations, and you will be permanently expelled from the guild.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KudEiTopic_0003ca91_Oblivion_RESP: Kud-Ei has always watched over me, and it's good to know she cared enough to seek help when I was in trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KudEiTopic_00027f35_Oblivion_RESP: Kud-Ei is a member of Bravil's Mages Guild. She put the word out that a good friend of hers went missing.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062673_Oblivion_RES: Kud-Ei runs a tight ship in Bruma. She may not always play by the rules, but I wouldn't want her on my bad side.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003cd26_Oblivion_RES: Kud-Ei seems to be in good spirits again after Henantier's return. I heard she enlisted a stranger's help in the search. Good show I say!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004f223_Oblivion_RES: Kud-Ei seems upset about something lately. I'd stay away from the Mages Guild if I were you.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488d3_Oblivion_RESP1: Kud-Ei. I'm in charge here, and an Advanced Trainer in Illusion to boot, so I don't have a lot of time to stand around and chat.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000514b1_Oblivion_RESP1: La la la, la la la la...

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AlessiasRing_0003b3fa_Oblivio: Lady Alessia frowns on her staff talking about her personal life. You understand, I'm sure.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000281b9_Oblivion_RESP1: Looks like you are in some trouble. Since we are friends, don't worry. I'll look the other way and take care of that fine for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Looks like you found work for us. Good. Need some money.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bcb9_Oblivion_RESP1: Looks like you're handy with a blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0002c35b_Oblivion_: Looks like you've reached your peak. Tell you what, from here on in, you can fight one, two or three Minotaur Lords. So what's it going to be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa70_Oblivio: Looks like you've taken care of it. Good work. Now, go find something else to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheMagesGuild_0002d062_Oblivi: Looks to me like you're in trouble with the law. Clear that matter up, and then perhaps we'll discuss the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02FinChoice1A_00023e48_Oblivi: Loosen those fastenings any night between 8:00pm and 11:00pm, and the head will surely fall on Baenlin as he relaxes in his chair, as is his custom.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTombSpeech_00002d03_Knights_RES: Lord Akatosh lends you his might. When your own strength fails you, trust in the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000290d_Knights_RESP1: Lord Crusader! How can this be? You... you're alive! It's a miracle! I heard voices in the undercroft and I came to investigate...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002978_Knights_RESP1: Lord Crusader! The Prophet is here -- he's just arrived!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c22a_Oblivion_: Lord Dagon cannot invade Tamriel, his birthright! He comes to liberate the Occupied Lands!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Enemy_0002d77c_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon is the Enemy. He is the Prince of Destruction, and the Daedra are his servants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarSpeech_0008b0a3_Oblivio: Lord Dagon shall walk Tamriel again. The world shall be remade. The new age shall rise from the ashes of the old.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06RumaYes_00024e9b_Oblivion_RES: Lord Dagon thirsts for red-drink. Sate him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_0008c21a_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon will walk Tamriel again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00074a11_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon will walk the earth again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001eee3_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon will welcome your soul in Oblivion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_00097cc0_Oblivion: Lord Dagon wrote it with his own hand, and gave it to the Master as a sign of His favor. None but the Master may touch it or read from it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_00074a09_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Dagon's victory is at hand, fool.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579cd_Oblivio: Lord Drad put my little brothers in chains, working in the mines. I don't like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579d1_Oblivio: Lord Drad took my ogres. Poxy white-skin says he owns them. Lying maggot! They're MY ogres!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579cc_Oblivio: Lord Drad took my ogres. Says he owns them. Lying maggot! They're MY ogres!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Unicorn_0001ec61_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Hircine has sent you to hunt the Unicorn? Count yourself doubly blessed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OgreSlaves_0001ec4f_Oblivion_RESP: Lord Malacath doesn't want the little brothers locked up, working like donkeys so men don't get their pretty pink hands all dirty. Makes Him mad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e84_Oblivion_RES: Lord Rugdumph was going with the Blackwood Company, then thought better of it. We have to do something about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00014b5e_Ob: Lord Sheogorath chose you to sit on His throne. With the Staff, you may be able to do just that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091628_Oblivion_RESP2: Lord Sheogorath doesn't like to be kept waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08HaskillKnightsTopic3_00043f6a: Lord Sheogorath has never succeeded in doing so. They continue to grow in numbers until Jyggalag himself arrives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43GoAway_00072dc2_Oblivion_RESP: Lord Sheogorath wants me to leave? Okay, for you I will. I know a nice spot in Bliss where I can stay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofAureal_00082634_O: Lord Sheogorath will, I'm sure, be quite interested to hear of your success. Return to Him once you've checked with the commander here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofMazken_00082635_O: Lord Sheogorath will, I'm sure, be quite interested to hear of your success. Return to him once you've checked with the commander here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434f6_Oblivion_RES: Lord Sheogorath would do well to stop bothering with the Resonator, and just send everyone away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081519_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath! Have you found any yet?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10MessengerGreeting_0008f4ea_Ob: Lord Sheogorath! I apologize for the intrusion, but you must help us! Order has attacked Brellach and routed us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10MessengerGreeting_00095359_Ob: Lord Sheogorath! I apologize for the intrusion, but you must help us! Order has attacked Pinnacle Rock and routed us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081525_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath! I would love to put on a show for you some time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3df_Oblivion_RES: Lord Sheogorath's armies are back! Maybe they'll fix some of these buildings so they don't collapse on people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3e6_Oblivion_RES: Lord Sheogorath's mood seems improved now that he has an army at his back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe3_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, I believe You should leave this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008151f_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, I trust you'll protect us from the impending apocalypse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008d31f_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, here in Deepwallow? May Scalon blood flow at your feet, Lord!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreatTorchTopic_000910a9_Obli: Lord Sheogorath, in His wisdom, wishes for you to relight the Torch, to help ease the worries of the populace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d74_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, up off his throne and slumming it with us little folk, eh? Well, it's good to see you. What can I possibly do for you, My Lord?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081dc9_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath, your presence alone makes me feel more healthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081522_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath. I'll bet your palace is always neat and tidy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007a01b_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath. Your Aureal stand true.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000807a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord Sheogorath... as I expected. I will hear you and then ask for peace from your prattle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d8a_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord! How may I serve You? Do You require a sharp blade to bleed your enemies?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe7_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord, it is best You leave this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00082570_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord, you know that Brellach is ours and ours alone. You may not enter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008256e_Oblivion_RESP1: Lord, you know that Pinnacle Rock is ours and ours alone. You may not enter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAnnouncer_00048376_Oblivion_RES: Lords and ladies, citizens of the Empire, I give you the battle of the ages! Combatants, steel yourselves! Lower the gates!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenBenirus_00003a71_Oblivion_: Lorgren Benirus was a strange old man, always dabbling and experimenting with magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06Choice1A_0002fbb0_Oblivion_: Lorkmir ain't... he ain't around no more. He he he... I use his house. Here's a key! For... for you! You come whenever you... you want! Okay then...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498d6_Oblivion_RES: Lose the key to your house? Find Mandil. He can get in, I'll bet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004994c_Oblivi: Lots of big weapons there. Urbul always has some in stock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241db_Oblivion_RES: Lots of dogs in this town. Lots of sheep, too. Of course, I prefer the taste of sheep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_goblins_00028882_Oblivion_RESP1: Lots of them dead, just like it should be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8d3_Oblivion: Lots of us Dark Elves came to Cyrodiil to get away from the Temple. We're sick of living under the thumb of the priests, and scraping by on the dole.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004774b_Oblivi: Lots of us on the Waterfront are down. We can't do that dungeon stuff like you adventurers. We got no money, and no skills. Nobody wants us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMain_00002a6c_Knig: Love and Mercy! Do you still think me mad? Who shall next fall to Umaril's bloody revenge?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFence03_000165ea_Oblivion_RESP1: Luciana lives in Bravil. She is a decent fence. Better than Ongar and Dar Jee at least.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00061459_Oblivion_RESP1: Lucien Lachance's word is law. Whatever contract he has given you must be carried out, without question.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LucienLachanceTopic_000253d9_Obli: Lucien isn't here very often. His duties with the Black Hand keep him very busy, so he trusts me to keep the Sanctuary in order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003843c_Oblivi: Luckily for us, Raynil arrived in town. He said he was a vampire hunter, so we asked for his help.
Luckily, Bradon's wife wasn't home. Poor thing, she didn't even know her husband was infected.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fcc_Obli: Luckily, I haven't had to make use of their services. Still, it's good to know the Chapel is there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00022a05_Oblivion_RESP1: Lucky I'm not makin' ya swim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea7_Oblivion_RES: Lum gro-Baroth in Chorrol can train me in shield work, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00053ff1_Oblivion_RESP1: Luronk and I have both testified against the Watch Captain, Hayn. Thank you for helping us find the courage to stand up for ourselves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c98_Oblivio: Luronk and I were shopping at Jensine's when he accused us of stealing. Even Jensine said we were innocent, but he didn't care.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047690_Oblivion_RESP1: Luther Broad's Boarding House. I'm Luther. You want beds or food, see me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Minx01Positive_00015259_Obliv: Lynch sent you up here? Why? Did he send you to talk to Selene?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c97f_Oblivion_RESP: Lyra Rosentia collects Akaviri artifacts. She might have a project in mind. Her house is west of the chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47da_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq believes the children are our future. But he doesn't want them ruining all of our fun.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47e3_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq is glad he has a compass. Makes it easy to find things. Much better than wandering around like a fool.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c47ee_Oblivion_RESP1: M'aiq knows much, tells some. M'aiq knows many things others do not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47d9_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq longs for a Colovian Fur Helm. Practical, yet stylish. M'aiq is very sad he does not have one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47df_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq prefers to adventure alone. Others just get in the way. And they talk, talk, talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c47dc_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq thinks his people are beautiful. The Argonian people are beautiful as well. They look better than ever before.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000c526e_Oblivion_RES: M'aiq wishes he had a stick made out of fishies to give to you. Sadly, he does not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08PlaceGuardsNo_00017d84_Oblivi: MAZKEN! Form up! For the sake of your sorry male hides, move! MOVE!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_00089614_Obl: Ma'zaddha and Nelrene... They meet in the street during the night. No one knows what they talk about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateWho_0008e513: Ma'zaddha has been most helpful! We'll have to see what he comes back with. In the meantime, you might consider speaking with Nelrene.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateWho_00083f49: Ma'zaddha is clearly withholding something. It would seem that direct pressure has no effect, so we'll have to try another route.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Ma'zaddha is meeting Nelrene at night. How illicit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e2_Oblivion_: Ma'zaddha is particularly reclusive, and may not respond well to questioning. Again, you may find Herdir's assistance necessary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Ma'zaddha is reluctant to speak to you, and I assume there's good reason. It would be worth finding another way to get him to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895dd_Oblivion_: Ma'zaddha may have returned with more information by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Ma'zaddha was able to provide some useful evidence, even if he did not survive to see it put to use. It's time to confront Nelrene again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003dfa8_Oblivion_RES: Mach-Na runs a good business. He's a grumpy old man, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa75_Oblivion_RESP1: Made up your mind yet? There's work to be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081d71_Oblivion_RESP1: Madgod! I've been collecting jokes for you. I have thousands for you to listen to. Did you hear the one about the Grummite and the Heretic?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001a367_Oblivion_RESP1: Madness always yields to the march of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ef2e_Oblivion_RESP1: Madness always yields to the march of Order!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001a374_Oblivion_RESP1: Madness shall be purged from this realm!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c1ae_Oblivion_RES: Maenlorn and his brother run a nice establishment at the Flowing Bowl.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000465f4_Oblivion_RES: Mages Guild members have said that Kud-Ei is an excellent teacher, as well as a very loyal guildmember.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recharge_00066a51_Oblivion_RESP1: Magic items are no good without a charge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006a849_Oblivion_RESP1: Magister! We must talk! Please... It's rather urgent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e9b_Oblivion_RES: Maglir? He's the OTHER bottom boot, right? Not the rat guy?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaglirTOPIC2_000366c4_Oblivion_RE: Maglir? I think I've seen him. Try in the Lonely Suitor Lodge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofClavicusVileTOPIC_000b97c: Make a bargain or do not. You must choose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPinnacleRockTopic_00043023_Obli: Make all possible haste in reaching Dylora. She will be able to better inform you as to what happened, and what is required to secure Pinnacle Rock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEBrellachTopic_00043024_Oblivion: Make all possible haste in reaching Staada. She will be able to better inform you as to what happened, and what is required to secure Brellach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Make every effort to be present for this conversation. It may give us something to hold over Ma'zaddha and get him to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2ab_Oblivio: Make haste! Find him quickly... no telling what mischief he may get himself into and we need him as a witness!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00053870_Oblivion_RESP1: Make haste! The Sanctuary must be Purified, if this treachery is to be undone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002c2fe_Oblivion_RESP1: Make haste. I wish to be rid of Earana as soon as possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0005d8ef_Oblivion_RESP1: Make haste. Mucianus is in danger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018baff_Oblivion_RESP1: Make it fast, dreg! What little patience I have is wearing thin....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072c93_Oblivion_RESP1: Make it quick. I've work to do. I need five pod pits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000a31ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Make it quick. The longer we spend down here, the more chance we have of being discovered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TeekeeusTopic_0002acc1_Oblivion_R: Make no mention of the book to him. It's just the sort of thing he'd want to get his scaly little hands on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004cfa9_Oblivion_RESP1: Make sure Varon hands over that staff.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624cf_Oblivion_RES: Make sure not to eat nightshade. It's very poisonous.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JeanneFrasoricTopic_00086749_Obli: Make sure she's all right, will you? It's not like her to avoid contact with the University for so long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003358d_Oblivion_RESP1: Make sure you address the Count properly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7e1_Oblivion_RESP1: Make sure you have proof before you accuse anyone of a terrible crime like grave robbing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7d7_Oblivion_RESP1: Make sure you show that shovel to Thoronir. It is the final bit of proof we need to possibly clear his name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040b9b_Oblivion_RESP1: Make this brief, I have a pot of Grummite Gumbo simmering on my fire at home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice7NowWhat_00061c4f_Obliv: Make your move when you wish. But, please, do it soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa91_Oblivio: Make yourself useful. Talk with Horkvir. The proper Horkvir. He runs this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GreatTorchTopic_000910a0_Obli: Makes all of my subjects uneasy. Tense. Homicidal. Some of them, at least. We need to get that Torch relit, before the place falls apart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofMalacathTOPIC_0001ec2e_Ob: Malacath likes Orcs... when He likes anything. So you can approach the shrine. He won't hurt you. Really. Go ahead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebb7_Oblivion_RESP1: Malacath likes you. You don't look very foul or ugly... but just keep doing ugly stuff, and you'll be fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026967_Oblivion_RESP1: Malacath must think you're okay. Congratulations. You must be as ugly and disgusting as the rest of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22KnowHighFane_0002af32_Oblivio: Malada? Really? I confess, I had never made the connection. But, yes... it makes sense...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeSword_000400b6_Oblivion_: Mama always said, "You can tell a lot about a man by the sword he carries."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434d2_Oblivion_RES: Mama always said, "You catch more flies with honey than salt." Like that thing that sucks in the adventurers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeAmberMaceMagic_0001f3eb_: Mama used to say, "If sweet-talking doesn't work, try hitting him with a big stick!"
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaChampName9_00038b3a_Oblivion: Man o' War, huh? I like it! Yeah, that'll do nicely. All right, it's time to see if you're crazy good or just plain crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ec7a_Oblivion_RES: Mania has a new ruler! Perhaps Big Head will hear songs of good fortune as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_000221f6_Oblivion: Mankar Camoran bound himself to the Xarxes when he created his Paradise, using dark rituals which I will not speak of further.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e6b_Oblivion: Mankar Camoran certainly is a fascinating writer. Undoubtedly insane, but fascinating.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00088b39_Oblivion_RESP1: Mankar Camoran has a lot to answer for. No wonder he never comes down to the Eternal Garden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MankarCamoranTopic_00015882_Obliv: Mankar Camoran lives in his palace, Carac Agaialor, which overlooks the Savage Garden from the top of the mountain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC1_0003fbde_Oblivion_R: Mankar Camoran was our leader, our teacher, our Master. He had the secret knowledge. He dealt with Mehrunes Dagon as an equal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15Anaxes_0003c80d_Oblivion_RESP: Mankar Camoran's chattels trapped the Xivilai Anaxes in a cave. He is their Lord, and thus they mock him and me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetD_0003e8fe_Oblivion_R: Mankar Camoran's chattels, the unmortals that swarm here in the Savage Garden, their proper role is to test themselves in unceasing combat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasB4_0009532b_Oblivion_RE: Mankar Camoran's views on Mehrunes Dagon are fascinating, revolutionary even...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001648c_Oblivion_RESP2: Mannimarco has been defeated? I can hardly believe it! The King of Worms is no more!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00062bca_Oblivion_RES: Mannimarco himself is in Cyrodiil, hunting us down. None of us are safe!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006267e_Oblivion_RES: Mannimarco is no more! The guild is saved, and we have a new Arch-Mage to lead us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice1A_00016482_Oblivion_RE: Mannimarco will have what he seeks, but it will be his undoing at your hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024eac_O: Many Argonians say they have been "called back" to Black Marsh. They disappear into the swamps and are never seen again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TamrielGateResponses_00025019_Obl: Many are dead in the land of the Dunmer. Even St. Jiub, who drove the cliffracers from Vvardenfell, has fallen to the daedra hordes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BorderWatchTOPIC_000b122c_Oblivio: Many are the evenings we spend around the cooking fire, sharing stories of Elsweyr. The smell of our food travels for miles!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c226_Oblivion_: Many are their names and the names of their masters: the Coldharbour of Meridia, Peryrite's Quagmire, the ten Moonshadows of Mephala, and...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c34a_Oblivion_RESP2: Many guards are coming forward with more evidence of his greed, so it's safe to say he'll been spending quite a bit of time in the city dungeons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05HowBad_0000c05c_Oblivion_RESP: Many guild members could be jailed. Find Methredhel in the Imperial City. She is co-ordinating the guild's response.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0aa_Oblivion_RESP: Many of Anvil's folk are directly or indirectly associated with ships and sailing...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06JyggalagTopic_000910f8_Oblivi: Many of our citizens are... delicate. They can't cope with the prospect, and they defect to the forces of Jyggalag, becoming Priests of Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Benefits_0004b831_Oblivion_RE: Many of these abilities, Lord, are rooted in the magicks of the Isles. Should you choose to leave this Realm, they will not likely function.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001d03d_Oblivion_R: Many thanks, on behalf of all of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000165a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Many thanks. I'm preparing the ship for her return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031842_Oblivion_: Many wish to join our ranks, as we are of the highest echelon. Only a select few may join the finest force ever to grace the lands of Cyrodiil.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006234d_Oblivion_RES: Martin Septim will soon claim his rightful place at the head of the Empire, and the Blades will stand beside him.
