ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0003c16b_Obliv: There's only one last thing I can say about Marksman training. If you want to be the best, you have to learn from the best.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Yes_0006ea4c_Oblivion_RESP1: There's only one place in all the Isles to get the cure for what I have... Knotty Bramble. I'll mark it on your map.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_00031b76_Oblivion_RESP1: There's only one way to remove that gate. Venture inside, find the gate's sigil stone and take it. Once you have it, the gate should be closed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f223_Oblivion_RES: There's probably a growing pile of bodies near that new Gatekeeper. I should go count them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003356e_Oblivion_R: There's really no more I can promote you. After all, you do outrank me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00089001_Oblivion_R: There's so much I could tell you... so many secrets... but then you'd be in danger, too. It's best if we're not seen talking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004995e_Oblivion_RES: There's some fine light armor at The Best Defense. Talk to Maro Rufus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e43_Oblivion_RES: There's some kind of cover-up going on with the Fighters Guild's Fallen Rock Cave contract.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0002ba4d_Oblivion_RES: There's some strange Dark Elf in town, asking about Reynald Jemane and his brother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432bf_Oblivion_RES: There's someone new in the Realm. One more interloper to watch out for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432bb_Oblivion_RES: There's someone new in the Shivering Isles. One more person to worry about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00042da6_Oblivion_RES: There's someone new in town, I hear. Finally, someone with a wider perspective who can appreciate my art!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286dc_Obli: There's something about Nels I can't quite place. He's not from money, that's obvious. But I don't think he's quite the buffoon he seems, either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e991_Oblivion_RES: There's something about Ra'qanar I just don't trust.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDResponses_0003e98c_O: There's something about him I don't trust. He's quite a brawler though. I wouldn't want to tangle with him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: There's something about that place that's just a bit off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000498c6_Oblivion_RES: There's something strange about Ida Vlinorman. I heard she was climbing up the chapel, just so she could jump off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_0007eb5e_Ob: There, imbue the Staff with power from the Font of Madness. Soak the staff in the waters of the land, and it will open its full power to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41Yes_0006ea4c_Oblivion_RESP2: There, on the lowest level of the place, is a pool containing the cure: aquanostrum. Legend has it that it bubbles up from around an old statue.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPykeZoeMaleneResponses_00091b4f: There, there, my dear. Everything will be just fine. Don't worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34Medallion_00066eaa_Oblivion_R: Therefore, I'll not be needing this anymore. Please, take it as a reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029bf_Knights_RESP1: These Aurorans will never stand against the combined might of the Knights of the Nine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEObeliskResponses_00077d0c_Obliv: These Knights are strange creatures, indeed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_000607db_Ob: These adventurers are always causing trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofAzuraTOPIC_00098204_Obliv: These are dark times, and people's minds are poisoned by rumors and superstition.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05MethredhelJob_0000c05b_Oblivi: These are foul times for us. Armand is under house arrest, again. Our business in the Waterfront is totally shut down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7c_Oblivion_RESP7: These are people who have prayed to the Night Mother! They request a visit from a Speaker, to arrange someone's assassination.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Yes_000452f9_Oblivion_RESP2: These are perfect for my research! Thank you. Now go. Shoo!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SilencerTopic_0002fdb6_Oblivion_R: These are the Silencers. Each Speaker employs his or her own private assassin, to extend their reach and strike forth as necessary.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_00026af5_Oblivion_RESP: These are the signs as they were foretold. First, there is the Plague of Vermin. It is said our town will be overrun by disease carrying creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_0006bf17_Oblivion_RESP: These are the signs as they were foretold. First, there is the Plague of Vermin. It is said our town will be overrun by disease carrying creatures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000981f9_Oblivion_RESP1: These are troubled times in Bleaker's Way. What do you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c9d_Oblivio: These are very serious charges. If you can get two witnesses to testify against Audens Avidius, I'll arrest him. Otherwise I can't help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEArctusSpeech02_0008988a_Oblivio: These are words that the Maniacs would have you believe are "sins."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeArrows_00016538_Oblivion: These arrows will sink deep into your enemy's flesh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeBootsMagic_0001f3cc_Obli: These boots will keep your toes from getting smashed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_000356cb_Oblivion_RESP1: These certainly won't be official duties. Fact is, you'll likely be expelled from the Guild if Vilena gets wind of the fact that you're here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_0002809f_Oblivion_R: These creatures kidnapped me from my room in the inn while I was sleeping.  I don't know why ... but I'd rather not find out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Beast_0008f559_Oblivion_RESP1: These creatures will do for now. However, I'm sure I will eventually get bored with them. Ask me again later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08HaskillKnightsTopic2_00043f69: These crystalline obelisks have existed throughout the Realm for all of eternity. You will find they become more active as the Greymarch progresses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000363c2_Oblivion_RESP1: These days I get nervous whenever I see a Watchman. Maybe I'll just stay inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGauntletsMagic_0001f3dc_: These gauntlets will keep your hands from being covered in blood and guts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08HaskillKnightsTopic1_00043f68: These hearts are a source of power for the agents of Order. You may find them quite useful in certain situations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005efaa_Oblivion_RES: These invaders that everyone is afraid of don't even exist. I swear, why would someone start a rumor to create panic?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Diary_0001823b_Oblivion_RESP2: These landmarks are mentioned within the diary. The one referred to as Dragonclaw Rock has been located. I'll mark it on your map.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000c0a4_Oblivion_RESP1: These mercenary groups tend to be fanatically loyal to whomever leader they follow. Roderick's people will likely fight to the death. Be cautious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture3_00071950_Oblivion: These names offer few hints to the origin or function of the stones, though they assist scholars in identifying each type of stone on maps
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e139_Obl: These people split in two are sad but such is the will of the god who's mad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004f9cb_Oblivion_RESP1: These scamps are making my home smell like a barn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RogueMage_0002ee53_Oblivion_RESP4: These scrolls should provide sufficient resistance to frost magic, when and if you do encounter this rogue mage. Use them wisely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004b7b4_Oblivion_RESP1: These stupid scamps are driving me crazy!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b580_Oblivion_RESP1: These trees. So perfect. Almost seems like home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046668_Oblivion_RESP1: These warriors want nothing more than to please you, and if they fill their opponents with suffering and pain at the same time, all the better!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ08Wine_0018d924_Oblivion_RESP2: These will hold an honored place in my collection! I don't know what else to say but thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HowlingHalls_00043f73_Oblivio: These zealots believe her to be some sort of savior, or deity, or something. Their doctrine is very confusing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f4e2_Oblivion_RES: They SAY the armies have been restored. But you think that's the whole story? Not by half, just you wait and see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_breakins_0003573f_Oblivion_RESP4: They always come at night, after I've gone to bed. Maybe a mage transports them inside! You can just stay in the shop overnight. Good luck!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting1_00018702_O: They appear out of nowhere at the base of the Spire. We kill five of them, five more come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting1_00018c81_O: They appear out of nowhere at the base of the Spire. We kill five of them, five more come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10ChimeInfo_0001e96f_Oblivion_R: They are a key part of the ceremony for restoring fallen comrades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10ChimeInfo_00043026_Oblivion_R: They are a key part of the ceremony for restoring fallen comrades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095729_Obliv: They are a rather superstitious group, living their lives based on omens and prophecy. One such prophecy, the K'sharra, was of particular interest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035599_Oblivion_RESP2: They are called the Boots of Bloody Bounding, and carry a powerful enchantment. I'm sure you will find them most useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08AncestorMoth_00048973_Oblivio: They are masters of fighting in the dark. If you intend to visit, make sure you bring lots of torches or a lantern or something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BribeBeggar_00015f1b_Oblivion: They are masters of fighting in the dark. If you intend to visit, make sure you bring lots of torches or a lantern or something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefend_000131b5_Oblivion_: They are overconfident, as usual. We have prepared many traps and ambushes. It will be a glorious slaughter.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_0009226b_Oblivi: They are stable portals between our world and Oblivion. They violate the most basic principles of daedric magic. They should be impossible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinNQDQuestionResponses_0003: They argue a lot, but that's just their way. I don't think they're ever really angry with one another.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ee25_Oblivion_RESP2: They attacked without warning. I was praying in the Chapel when I heard Prior Maborel shout. I had just time to arm myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224ce_Oblivion_RESP1: They began raiding our farm a few days ago. There are more now, and I have no idea where they're coming from.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f237_Oblivion_RES: They built a new Gatekeeper! Yes they did. Yes they did. Aren't you just precious?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f20a_Oblivion_RES: They built a new Gatekeeper, did they? Hope they didn't use anything of mine when putting him back together.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e51_Oblivion_RES: They call it the 'Stone of Alessia'. And they got it back. That's all I know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e096_Oblivion_RESP1: They call me 'Hauls-Ropes-Faster'. I don't care. They can't pronounce my Black Marsh name, anyway.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e07d_Oblivion_RESP1: They call me 'Wilhelm the Worm,' because dirt suits me fine. Town lets me live in the warehouse to keep out the rats.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e43b_Oblivion_RESP1: They call me Cutter. For a truly inspired blade, I can forge Madness Ore! Here. Hold onto this parchment. It lists what I need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488e7_Oblivion_RESP1: They call me Isleif the Open-Handed. Because I'm so generous...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_000151f9_Oblivio: They can aid you in defeating those that carry the gem. Once you have it, bring it here to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d283_Oblivion_RESP4: They can be done in any order, but they all must be sent in to the Council before you can enter the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08ObeliskTopic_00043f6c_Oblivio: They can be overloaded and rendered inert by placing the crystalline hearts of the Knights into the obelisk itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08ObeliskTopic_0008247f_Oblivio: They can be overloaded and rendered inert by placing the crystalline hearts of the Knights into the obelisk itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1f7_Oblivion_RES: They can build a new Gatekeeper, but I can't manage to get anything done. I'm over-tasked, I tell you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f21d_Oblivion_RES: They can build a new Gatekeeper, but they can't send someone to aid me in fighting these Scalons?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayCrimeGold_000983a5_Oblivion_: They can make all your outstanding warrants go away, for only half the price of the fines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032469_Oblivion_RESP1: They cannot understand why I trust you. They've not seen what I've seen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b37_Oblivion_RESP3: They captured our commander, Dylora, and have her imprisoned somewhere inside. Our first priority must be rescuing her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017d0a_Oblivion_RESP3: They captured our commander, Staada, and have her imprisoned somewhere inside. Our first priority must be rescuing her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003f152_Oblivion_RES: They charged me 5 gold for littering! Littering!! I barely make that in a year! These fines are ridiculous!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e8a_Oblivion_RES: They cleared out the Desolate Mine, all right, but the other guys didn't make it, did they.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e88_Oblivion_RES: They cleared out the Desolate Mine, and everybody got out alive. Pretty slick, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017655_Oblivion_RESP2: They come to this Arena to see you, so go out there and give the people what they want!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12PaleNo_00018236_Oblivion_RESP: They didn't count on Lord Vivec forming an alliance with the Trident-Kings of the Dreugh. From Morrowind, he struck at their rear flank.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008e7f1_Obli: They die quickly if you jejinak them. Jejinak! Jejinak!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45BrethrenTopic_00017788_Oblivi: They don't like the sunlight much. Dangerous, too. You'll want to avoid them if you can help it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b683_Oblivion_RESP1: They doubted my power. Now they'll see!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFellmoorTopic_0003be83_Oblivion: They dream terrible dreams and one day soon, they will rise up, consume us and the rest of the Shivering Isles. Get out while you can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06Story_00002b0d_Knights_RESP2: They dropped to the floor right where he stood, and no one could lift them. It was a sign of the curse placed upon this knight by Stendarr, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice5_000133e4_Obliv: They entered this Realm, and were ill prepared. Their minds are now the property of my Lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224b4_Oblivion_RESP3: They expect me to go with them, but...  I fear in my old age, I'm not the warrior I once was. Would you... would you go in my place?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00022b40_Oblivion: They follow the teachings of Mankar Camoran, who calls for the return of the Mythic Age when Oblivion and the mortal world were not separate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e7f_Oblivion: They follow the teachings of Mankar Camoran, whom they call the Master. A shadowy figure in his own right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_00083068_Oblivion_RESP1: They gave me no choice. I'm not a violent person, but I can only be pushed so far.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AzaniBlackheartTOPIC_0002c58f_Obl: They get the weapon for Argoth, collect the payment, and tell Azani where the mage is. Easy for Blackheart to retrieve the weapon and collect on it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008dc39_Obli: They hate water. They hate the land, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_00026ef5_Oblivion_RESP: They have been plundered one by one over the years, due to their great value to mages and occultists.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08KnightsTopic_00018701_Oblivio: They have been upon us for hours. They have no interest in our surrender. Only our deaths.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_0002c8d7_Oblivio: They have caused trouble here as well. But they have gold to pay for the trouble. Things are always better when served with gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13CavernChoiceWhy_000039b4_Obli: They have given in to their instincts, and are little more than animals. They need to be exterminated, one way or another.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c231_Oblivion_: They have tricked you for Ages.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03FinKnightsofOrder_000807ba_Ob: They haven't walked among us in many hundreds of years. Now that they've returned, there's no telling what may happen to us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45DeepOnes_0001778e_Oblivion_RE: They helped us. Made us rich. But there was a terrible price. Blood -- and worse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BloodwormHelmTopic_0000c08c_Obliv: They hope to learn enough from it to find some way to fight Mannimarco. I tried to dissuade them, but it was no use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DyloraWhere_00017d0e_Oblivion: They imprisoned Dylora somewhere within Pinnacle Rock. If they killed her, she could return to us, so they keep her hostage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10StaadaWhere_00016b3a_Oblivion: They imprisoned Staada somewhere within Brellach. If they killed her, she could return to us through the Wellspring, so they keep her hostage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BlindMonks_000983ac_Oblivion_: They live in utter darkness in the secret catacombs. Of course it doesn't affect them because they are blind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f221_Oblivion_RES: They made a new Gatekeeper. I'd go see him, but that would take effort.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS93Choice01B_00095a67_Oblivion_R: They made the journey, and arrived back all right, but then... Someone murdered them! All of them! Now their spirits are haunting the ship!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_000825df_Obl: They make armor and weapons. Magical ones, if you have the correct matrix.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031c83_Oblivion_: They make grand boasts, and talk a good talk, but that's all they are. The real work goes to us, the City Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d1_Oblivion_RESP1: They met me at eleven as well. And believe me, I arrived right on time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03ATellMeMore_00018df7_Oblivion: They mistook the Focus Crystals for some sort of religious symbols, and removed them from their rightful places.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06OpenDoor_0000c20a_Oblivion_RE: They oughta just give you guys a key. But no. I have to keep locking and unlocking the door for the slop drudges. Follow me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024e1d_Oblivion_RE: They probably call us 'the Dog People' here in town. Rimalus and I love dogs. We have quite a few. So sweet and well-behaved, you wouldn't believe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043eea_Oblivion_RES: They round up people like animals in New Sheoth. I should hunt those nobles. That's what I should do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624ae_Oblivion_RES: They say Alinor on Summerset Isle is more beautiful. I've never been. For the present, I must count the Imperial City the most glorious in Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ecd_Oblivion_RES: They say Thadon is addicted to some drug. I can understand what that's like. The bones call to me like his drug calls to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b209_Oblivion_RES: They say a lost son of Uriel Septim has reappeared in Bruma. Troops are flocking to his banner from all over Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064469_Oblivion_RES: They say a thief actually stole one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Library. Who would have thought it was even possible?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0000080C_AltarESPMain: They say a whole island, with an inhuman statue, appeared near Bravil. As if the world wasn't crazy enough already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEServiceProviderResponses_0008e1: They say books aren't all Sontaire will sell, but I'm not one to kiss and tell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEObeliskResponses_0008e14e_Obliv: They say from the obelisks Knights do spawn; stay clear of them unless you wish to be gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e131_Obl: They say his fear of cats extends to the Khajiit, or pretty much anything with furry paws for feet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusA_0001e8e6_Oblivion_RESP2: They say it's the Dragon Blood, that flows through the veins of every Septim. They see more than lesser men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00060509_Oblivion_RES: They say our Lord just took off. Can you believe that? I need a drink. I need the Skooma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a0a_Knights_RESP: They say someone finally laid poor Lord Vlindrel's shade to rest. That's good. He's been haunting these hills for too long.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_000c459f_O: They say syndicates of wizards have led a boycott of Imperial goods in the land of the Altmer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000af061_Oblivion_RES: They say that Akatosh appeared and killed Mehrunes Dagon, right in the middle of the Temple of the One! Do you believe it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b1_Oblivion_RESP: They say that I was selected as Dibella's Primate in large part because of my loving nature and my striking looks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024e83_O: They say that King Helseth has made an alliance with House Dres. Together they pick apart the carcass of ruined Indoril.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029fe_Knights_RESP: They say that Kynareth granted the boots of the Crusader to someone. I can't imagine what he must've gone through to get them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b205_Oblivion_RES: They say that Oblivion Gates have opened outside cities all across Tamriel! Gods preserve us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a0d_Knights_RESP: They say that Pelinal Whitestrake has returned, and will soon put a stop to that Ayleid monster who's been terrorizing the chapels!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef26_Oblivion_RES: They say that invaders have come to the Shivering Isles. Of course, "they" say a lot of things, don't they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CurrentEventsResponses_00024e3a_O: They say that slavery has been abolished in Morrowind. House Dres and Hlaalu have renounced the slave trade, and freed the beastfolk from servitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00002a05_Knights_RESP: They say that someone's taken up the prophet's call, and is questing for the Crusader's Relics. I hope they succeed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000029f9_Knights_RESP: They say that the priests and priestesses of the Chapel of Dibella have all been murdered! No one even knows who did it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003e4c1_Oblivion_RES: They say that when you murder someone, the Dark Brotherhood comes to you in your sleep. It's how they recruit new members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e46_Oblivion_RES: They say the Fighters Guild got all the trolls in Swampy Cave, but I'm still not going anywhere near Harlun's Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Gardens_0008e4f7_Oblivion_RES: They say the Gatekeeper's magical. I don't believe in magic. But I do believe in bones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGauntletsMagic_00016ce9_: They say the heart anchors the soul to the man. Think of this while the heart of your enemy beats in your hand. Then squeeze.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0008e4cd_Obliv: They say the keys are sewn up in the Gatekeeper's body. Basically, that means you're not getting in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003406e_Oblivion_RES: They say there are a bunch of people holed up in Summitmist Manor. Locked in. Some kind of weird party or something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c14b_Oblivion_RESP1: They say there's a gate opened outside the city! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000432cb_Oblivion_RES: They say there's a newcomer about. I wonder where he's from?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDChapelAttackTopic_00002b9a_Knig: They say there's a prophet in Anvil now, preaching about the end of the world. He may have a point.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDQuestionResponses_000498a: They say they treat all their patrons like royalty. From what I've seen, it's the truth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeShield_0001f3e4_Oblivion: They say, "Behind every great man is a great woman." Mama said, "Men are squishy. Use a shield instead!"
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c68_Obli: They seem at home on land or in the water.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c6b_Obli: They seem to live fine on land and water.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Ally03Tactic2_00017d5d_Oblivi: They shall fall before my blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Ally03Tactic2_000181d2_Oblivi: They shall fall before my blade.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcConversation_0007eacd_Obli: They should have listened to me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcSpectators_0007ead3_Oblivi: They should have listened to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetD_0003e8fe_Oblivion_R: They show initiative, and Anaxes doubtless deserves humiliation, but I cannot permit this to continue.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06CastleJobs_0000bf95_Oblivion_: They sometimes need folks to work in the castle. Most are afraid to go up there though. Try asking the butler, Shum gro-Yarug.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StrangeLights_0000bed8_Oblivion_R: They started appearing a few nights ago. Odd, flickering lights. In the morning, there was nothing to see. But they were there at night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d496_Oblivion_RESP1: They still aren't letting me live this down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004992c_Oblivi: They sure do sell food. Yup. You can buy food there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_00083066_Oblivion_RESP1: They think I don't know. They think I don't see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000c1dc_Oblivion_RESP3: They took myself and Ormil, the Float's owner, hostage and put the ship to sea. I have no idea what they're after.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC2_0003fbe0_Oblivion_R: They tore me to pieces, although I have no doubt they were immediately killed by my companions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea5_Oblivion_RES: They train blunt, blade, heavy armor, and block in one of the guildhalls. Is it Anvil?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001efe0_Oblivion_RESP5: They want an Emperor to tell them what to do. And I haven't the faintest idea...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_0001778d_Oblivion_RESP: They want to bring back the Deep Ones. I thought I did, too, but ... she's so innocent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0001b68d_Oblivio: They wanted me to convert Vitharn, but I fooled them. I put them on the list. Oh, yes, they're on the list now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaE1_000a5607_Oblivion_: They were a bitterly divided people, with many warlords vying against each other for power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003570f_Oblivion_R: They were also brave, and necessary. Because of this, I am hereby naming you Master of the Fighters Guild, effective immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SwordAndArmor_000091f1_Oblivion_R: They were buried with my grandfather in the family tomb. The sword and cuirass were enchanted, and should cover my debt. Please, get them for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SwordAndArmor_000091fc_Oblivion_R: They were buried with my grandfather in the family tomb. The sword and cuirass were enchanted, and should cover my debt. Please, get them for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003857e_Oblivi: They were part of some sort of brotherhood. They would roam Cyrodiil in search of legendary treasures and the like.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StrangeLights_0000beda_Oblivion_R: They were seen around the Swampy Cave. Strange, moving lights. I've never seen anything like it. Old-timers have tales about such things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AldosOthranTopic_0003c2c2_Oblivio: They were traveling the road from the Imperial City when a bandit raiding party struck. He barely escaped alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04CarodusGreetingAbout_00002abc: They were... they were both killed in an accident when I was young. I became a ward of the crown and was drafted into the Imperial Army.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD04Choice3_0002c5bf_Oblivion_RE: They weren't always a threat. Small scale mercenary band, until Ri'Zakar took over. Then came the fat Imperial contracts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11RejectCowl_00022e8c_Oblivion_: They will not realize that you are the same person that just took off the cowl. To them, the Gray Fox just vanished into thin air.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00015134_Oblivion_RES: They won't be the first to underestimate the Blades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_00093550_Oblivion_RESP: They won't do me any good in here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008dc94_Obl: They won't make armor and weapons, especially not magic ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005c01c_Oblivion_: They worship me from the dark, basking in their misery and filth. Now, though, some would seek to bring light to their darkness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00035c58_Oblivion: They worship the daedra lord Mehrunes Dagon, according to the teachings of their leader, Mankar Camoran.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00015f23_Oblivion: They would have no qualms about killing you once they had the Icestaff back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinMischief_0002f814_Obliv: They'd boast about it just as if they won it in a war, and pretty soon the Cracked Wood tribe would launch a war against THEM.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23RolandAuthority_0001d4c7_Obli: They'd never believe he was a vampire. I retreated here to the cabin to collect my thoughts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDGauntletsoftheCrusader_00002b19: They'll almost certainly be here long after we're all gone. Certainly after Kellen's family has died out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08ObeliskTopic_00091351_Oblivio: They'll get more and more active as the Greymarch continues. If they've already taken the Fringe, they must have one there already.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_000a31b6_Oblivion: They'll pay for the murder of the Emperor. Now that we know who they are, it's only a matter of time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0002b1e7_Oblivion_: They're Argonian prisoners, brought here from Black Marsh. They've been told they have to kill you in exchange for their freedom!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_000897bc_Obliv: They're a superstitious bunch. Everything is an omen or a portent. Let's make one come true. Find their shaman and ask about the K'Sharra prophecy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009760e_Obliv: They're a superstitious bunch. Everything is an omen or a portent. Let's make one come true. Find their shaman and ask about the K'Sharra prophecy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Avenge_00189cf9_Oblivion_RESP: They're all I have left of value, but you must have them. I insist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0006edee_Oblivion_RESP1: They're all dead? Well, you'll have to take over for them. Get back there and clear out that mine. Get moving!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokChamberTwoManEnd02_000: They're all fake! Just come with me now!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d915_Oblivion_RESP1: They're all gone? I can leave the cave? Oh, thank you! I'm ever so grateful!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028c37_Obli: They're all the same, full of mead and something to prove. We lost a lot of good men up there. A lot of good men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c6d_Obli: They're amazing creatures, but hard to kill.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0001d112_Oblivion_RES: They're behind us! Wait here, sire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00078180_Obli: They're bizarre people. I'm glad they stay out of the city.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008dc35_Obli: They're certainly NOT dangerous. They're quite tame, actually.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef83_Oblivion_RES: They're coming for me. Those Knights. I should have seen it coming.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Creatures_000224b4_Oblivion_RESP1: They're coming from someplace in the Great Forest. I don't know where, but Rallus may know more by now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00078182_Obli: They're confused souls, too far from Lord Sheogorath's protection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00073007_Oblivion_RESP1: They're everywhere! Get them! Get them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028a10_Oblivion: They're getting into this house somehow, which means there must be a way out as well! We need to find the secret exit and escape this madhouse!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06ObelisksTopic_000910fa_Oblivi: They're getting more active every day. Not a good sign.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_0003572d_Oblivion_R: They're gone now. Fighters Guild took care of them. And about time the Guild showed some sand. They are 'fighters', aren't they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_vampirehunters_000039bf_Oblivion_: They're in here to eat every afternoon, and bed down just before midnight. Outside of that, it's none of my business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000a3846_Oblivion_RESP3: They're massing as if bracing for an attack. The portal is just outside the city walls through the west gates if you want to see for yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalNQDQuestionResponses_00: They're obviously very fond of one another.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025deb_Oblivion_RESP1: They're only trying to do their duty. Come, let us play our parts...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_0008dc3c_Obli: They're quite friendly with newcomers. Just walk up to them and say "hello."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b20b_Oblivion_RES: They're saying some cult murdered the Emperor and are opening the Oblivion Gates. Do you think any of it's true?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434b3_Oblivion_RES: They're saying that the Gatekeeper has been killed. Was it you? Did you do it? Did you get anything good from him?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022f13_Oblivion_: They're the pride of my collection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_0014c732_Oblivion_: They're the pride of my collection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06PriestsOrderTopic_000910f7_Ob: They're the worst of all. My own subjects, working for the Enemy! It's enough to make an old Daedric Prince get all weepy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a0_Oblivion_RESP2: They're tough to get, but I prefer fresh, and I'll pay well. And I just don't trust those Blackwood Company folks to find them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_000182cc_Oblivion_: They're twins, actually. You got to take 'em both out! Now get in there, and show those tree climbers who's boss!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistSapTopic_000356fd_Oblivion_RE: They're using Hist Sap? And they claim to have brought a tree into Cyrodiil? Amazing. I can't imagine what the sap might do to non-Argonians.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistSapTopic_000a3453_Oblivion_RE: They're using Hist Sap? And they claim to have brought a tree into Cyrodiil? Amazing. I can't imagine what the sap might do to non-Argonians.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001db22_Oblivion_RE: They're very serious about it, but I'm sure it's just some boys night out kind of a thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_00037833_Oblivi: They've been unable to solve the Oblivion Crisis. The Empire is falling apart. Only a legitimate Emperor offers any hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_0002c7bb_Oblivio: They've been undercutting us on contracts ever since, and they've no qualms about accepting jobs no guild member would be caught dead doing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECreatureResponses_00077c6a_Obli: They've got a nasty bite, as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_0001778d_Oblivion_RESP: They've got her down in the caverns. They're going to sacrifice her, you understand? You've got to save her!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice2A_00022b6a_Oblivion_RE: They've heard the same rumors I have about the Necromancers' Cult.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000355a5_Oblivion_RE: They've never been so bold before now. Always hiding in the shadows, staying away from the guild. What could have prompted this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000355a8_Oblivion_RE: They've never been so bold before now. Always hiding in the shadows, staying away from the guild. What could have prompted this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d7_Oblivion_RESP1: They've never hurt anyone yet, but its never too late for them to start.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_000091a0_Oblivi: They've opened one right in front of the city gates. Until that Gate is closed, the best I can do is try to hold these barricades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000253b6_Oblivion_RESP3: They've sent an enforcer to kill me! His name is Hides-His-Heart, and he's on his way here now! That's why I hired you! So you can fake my death!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017473_Oblivion_RESP2: They've stopped it up. You... you must make it to the Wellspring, and let the waters flow...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017cfa_Oblivion_RESP2: They've stopped it up. You... you must make it to the Wellspring, and let the waters flow...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06SidePassage_00012cbd_Oblivion: They've strongly fortified the main passage against us. If we attacked through the Underdeep, we could take them by surprise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090b4f_Oblivion_RESP1: They've taken it! The Amulet of Kings is gone! The enemy has defeated us at every turn!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0002573e_Oblivion_RESP1: They.... they didn't make it? Oh god. They died out there all alone...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004b774_Oblivion_RESP1: Thief! I will get Hrormir's Icestaff from you, dead or alive!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a28_Oblivion_RESP1: Thief! You stole that diary from me. Now I have to wait to get into the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Steal_000252b5_Oblivion_RESP1: Thief! You won't get away with this!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGNocturnal_00018334_Oblivion_RES: Thieves Guild members revere and respect her power and influence. We give her blessing with the phrase 'may shadow hide you.'
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009db4d_Oblivion_RESP1: Thieves break in, but they don't break out... they break all over, when I'm finished with them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactF_00038fb2_Oblivion_R: Thieves everywhere will curse us both for the loss of this ring, my friend. So be it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0002b1e4_Oblivion_: Thing is, this guy used to be a Blade. You know, those guys who protect the Emperor? He's a trained swordsman, so keep your damn head down!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078168_Oblivion_RES: Things Found? More like Things Found in the Trash.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00040cc1_Oblivion_RESP1: Things are always such a mess around here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008263f_Oblivion_RESP1: Things are coming along nicely here. Soon enough, they'll have no choice but to do everything I say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e70_Oblivion_RES: Things are falling apart here. Someone needs to do something about the Blackwood Company situation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ebd_Oblivion_RES: Things are really slow. You remember the last time we had a new contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007fde3_Oblivion_RESP1: Things are still quiet at Xeddefen, Your Grace. However, we are still finding the smaller Obelisks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004872e_Oblivion_RES: Things at the Mages Guild seem tense. That Falcar fellow sure keeps a tight rein on things.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024ca6_Oblivion_RESP1: Things could always be worse. And probably will be. I'm Kurz gro-Baroth. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDChapelAttackTopic_00002b99_Knig: Things go from bad to worse nowadays. Priests murdered on the Chapel altar? What next?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004768f_Oblivi: Things have been very quiet with the Atius. That suits me just fine. All this fighting is stupid. What are they fighting about? Just stupid pride.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006c296_Oblivion_RES: Things in the guild have been different since Traven was named Arch-Mage. They're more structured, but everyone seems tense.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51Talk_0003481f_Oblivion_RESP1: Things seem back to normal now. Glad the painting was recovered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00086023_Oblivion_RESP1: Think carefully about what I told you! But I'm sure you'll be fine!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeMadnessAxeMagic_0001f3ed: Think of me fondly when you bury this axe deep into your foe's skull.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeBow_00016529_Oblivion_RE: Think of me when you send arrows to bite into your foe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000029f2_Knights_RESP1: Think on this -- what happened here is only the beginning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479c9_Oblivion_R: Thinking about sticking your paw in my pocket? Go ahead. I'll blow you to cream corn, and the Law will love me for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingBlockTest_00062339_Oblivi: Thinking you know how to use a shield is one thing. Actually using one is quite another.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e12b_Obl: Thinks his house will collapse in a heap, this foolish man can't even sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Cindanwe_00072c97_Oblivion_RE: Thinks she's in charge, treats us as slaves. Do I look like a slave? No. I am a queen, rightful ruler of the Shivering Isles!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGRules_0001c154_Oblivion_RESP3: Third, don't steal from the poor. The peasants and beggars are under the personal protection of the Gray Fox, particularly here on the Waterfront.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12RecoverYes_0001823d_Oblivion_: This Akaviri ring was found with the messenger's diary. It awards the wearer with increased agility and resistance to harmful magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000545d3_Oblivion_RESP1: This Bay horse will serve you well. Try to serve him just as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043e90_Oblivion_RES: This Chalice of Reversal sounds like a horrid device. Who would want to spend their time under the effects of some... chemical?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMiscQuestResponses_0008e136_Obl: This Fork he'll seek while he's still able, sadly the Fork is a flimsy fable.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13HunterChoiceWhere_00033f58_Ob: This I cannot say. I have refrained from expressing too much interest, lest their attention be turned towards the castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08KurdanKey_0001fee5_Oblivion_R: This IS my game, and I'm changin' the rules!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0009148e_Oblivion_RES: This Mazken must return to duty.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeNord_0009f9b5_Oblivion_R: This Nord is an animal... a glorious beast. Watch her teeth... she bites!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagSpeech_0006356f_Obliv: This Realm is yours. Perhaps you will grow to your station. Fare thee well, Sheogorath, Prince of Madness.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0004351d_Oblivion_RES: This Resonator thing-a-ma-jig. I don't get it. What's it for, anyway?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Sanctuary_000251f6_Oblivion_RESP1: This Sanctuary has been here since before even I joined the Dark Brotherhood, and that was two-hundred years ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002f08d_Oblivion_RESP3: This Undercroft is... well... quite cursed. Any desecration will cause my ancestors to rise from their graves and defend their resting place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038432_Oblivion_RESP1: This area is off limits to anyone except the Bruma City Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003eac3_Oblivion_RESP2: This area is off limits, worm! Get back to your cage!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032d9f_Oblivion_RESP1: This area's clear. We've got to get inside and find the Count before it's too late. Move out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09GiveArrowHead_0001482a_Oblivi: This arrowhead advances my plan to... nevermind. I may have need of you again in the near future, if my plans hold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09GiveArrowHead_0001cf36_Oblivi: This arrowhead advances my plan... nevermind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002928_Knights_RESP1: This barrier blocks our advance, and the orb gives power to our foes!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008e521_Oblivion_RESP1: This better be good, or you'll regret it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ08ArtifactB_00038fae_Oblivion_R: This blade has slain many a hero over the years. Tamriel will be better off without it for a while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434d4_Oblivion_RES: This business with the Gatekeeper is appalling. Can no one maintain order around here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenEmperor_0000bcaa_Oblivion_: This can only lead to your death. My guardians are sworn to protect me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000a5655_Oblivion_RESP1: This can't be happening. This is horrible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03LewinC1Idle01_0008ea88_Oblivi: This can't be right... I got a bad feeling about this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreA1_00092d81_Oblivion_R: This cannot be. No one but the Emperor is permitted to handle the Amulet. Let me see it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem11_00082429_Oblivion_: This case here I'm saving for something special. Wouldn't you like to be the one to find something Odd enough to go on display here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem3_00081eb7_Oblivion_R: This case is waiting for something especially Odd. If you run across anything Odd, be sure to bring it by and it might end up on display here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KSharraProphecy_000b1220_Oblivion: This certainly seems like one of the signs. It is unnatural to have this many rats gather in one place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000352a6_Oblivion_RESP1: This citizen is accusing you of stealing the bust of Llathasa from Cheydinhal. I even found the bust in your cabinet. What do you have to say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047699_Oblivi: This city life is killing me. Work all day long. Drop dead, and they toss you in Lake Rumare. Just need to make my money at the Arena and live easy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251bf_Oblivion_RESP1: This contract requires stealth and subtlety. You possess neither. When you fail, I will gladly take your place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05FinChoice1A_0002f880_Oblivi: This contract will require a bit of detective work. I suggest you speak to your fellow Brothers and Sisters and see if they can offer any advice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArgonianBloodTopic_00053740_Obliv: This dagger has been specially treated. All you need to do is stab an Argonian with it, and there'll be enough blood on it to use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillBodyParts_00081daa_Obl: This decision is yours. I'm sure Your Grace possesses the wisdom to choose the pieces that will allow the Gatekeeper to best defend the Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029e0_Knights_RESP1: This doesn't look familiar. I think we're going the wrong way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003e1ef_Oblivion_RESP1: This doesn't look good. Not good at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00095e29_Oblivi: This ends as it always does. Order shall reign!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeShieldMagic_00016ced_Obl: This shield, like a true friend, is always willing to take a good beating.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000165aa_Oblivion_RESP1: This ship doesn't move 'til I know that Ormil's safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37ApprenticeSpell_0007b223_Obli: This spell might do for a Baliwog or an Elytra Hatchling. Don't try it on anything tougher, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice5C_0003562f_Oblivion_RE: This staff will allow you to nullify magic protecting your enemies. If you'd prefer another enchantment, we can start over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice5A_0003562d_Oblivion_RE: This staff will allow you to trap the souls of enemies you defeat, if you can do so before the effect wears off. Is this acceptable?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10reject_0001530a_Oblivion_RESP: This task can wait, at least for a little while. Return when you are ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003ccac_Oblivion_RESP1: This thing you've done goes beyond what I would have expected from you. You've chosen a dark path, and I shall help you get there sooner!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07JyggalagTopic_000911f7_Oblivi: This time, I'll beat him. I can't stand losing. And I don't mind cheating.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bee5_Oblivion_RESP2: This time, however, it comes from Arch-Mage Traven himself. You should go see him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40MelisandeRumor_0003f290_Obliv: This time, however, you've heard correctly. I might know a thing or two about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d037_Oblivion_RESP2: This time, it wasn't to take something away from the graveyard, it was to add something. I'm afraid all I can offer you is an unmarked grave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08PasswallTopic_000186ff_Oblivi: This town has stood on the edge of the Shivering Isles since they were borne from the mists of time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08PasswallTopic_00018c7b_Oblivi: This town has stood on the edge of the Shivering Isles since they were borne from the mists of time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistTreeTopic_0003570c_Oblivion_R: This tree is the source of our problems. It is an abomination of nature, and it must be destroyed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16OcatoE_000add1e_Oblivion_RESP: This victory is not without cost. We've lost Martin Septim. What an emperor he might have made.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MustRecoverAmulet_00027746_Ob: This war has seemed hopeless to me, but what else was there to do but hold on and wait for a hero to arise to save us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_0008571a_Oblivi: This was the essence of Mankar Camoran's plot. He was undone only by the merest... chance... but his complete victory remains perilously close.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00090991_Oblivion_RESP1: This wasn't part of the plan, was it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033fc2_Oblivion_RESP1: This whole business of being heir to the throne will take some getting used to.  Please bear with me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefendA1_000131b7_Oblivio: This will be a glorious day! Cylarne will finally be free of the Aureals. Follow me. We're expecting the attack at any moment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004e94b_Oblivion_RESP1: This will be my greatest achievement yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf39_Oblivion: This will help to erase the stain on the Thieves Guild. Here is the reward the Gray Fox promised you for fetching those boots.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05FinCHoice2C_0004ce4b_Oblivi: This will make it look like a simple murder, Phillida will be none the wiser, and you'll receive a nice bonus. Now go, and may Sithis go with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05FinChoice2A_0004ce49_Oblivi: This will make it look like a simple murder, Phillida will be none the wiser, and you'll receive a nice bonus. Now go, and may Sithis go with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05FinChoice2B_0004ce4a_Oblivi: This will make it look like a simple murder, Phillida will be none the wiser, and you'll receive a nice bonus. Now go, and may Sithis go with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa93_Oblivion_RESP1: This won't be the end of my story! Stay away!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SilencerTopic_0002fdb6_Oblivion_R: This you already know. What is not commonly known among our family members is that the Black Hand employs a few... additional numbers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting03_00002c11_Kn: This you must do, and you must not fail. You will not, because the Nine fight with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ef4_Oblivion_RES: This'd be a good time to have a friend with an ear to the ground, what with all the crazy goings-ons in Crucible, you know what I mean?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08Choice3_000356f4_Oblivion_RE: This? Why, it is a gift from the swamps of Argonia. Sap of the Hist. A present from my homeland. The Hist are generous to us. So generous.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001cdfe_Oblivion_R: Thoronir better pray he had no knowledge of Agarmir's grave robbing, or the Watch will have his head.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001e7cf_Oblivion_R: Thoronir didn't turn out to be such a bad fellow after all. I'm glad he decided to join the Society.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_0004991c_Oblivi: Thoronir is quite a character. He's dirty and underhanded, but he provides a service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049919_Oblivi: Thoronir isn't too picky, which is nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004765c_Oblivion_RESP1: Thoronir welcomes you to The Copious Coinpurse. Such a pleasure. How can I serve you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049917_Oblivion_RES: Thoronir will buy almost anything. And I mean anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AWhatWere_000807b9_Oblivion_R: Those "beings" as you call them aren't beings at all. They are the soulless abominations known as the Knights of Order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002946_Knights_RESP1: Those Aurorans must have been the same creatures that desecrated the Chapels of Anvil and Bravil. Thank the Nine that you stopped them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c208_Oblivi: Those Destruction spells are dangerous. I hope the Mages Guild keeps a tight lid on that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008efc9_Oblivion_RESP1: Those Fanatics are so tiresome. Do they have to interrupt our feast?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Avenge_00189cfc_Oblivion_RESP: Those Goblins in Exhausted Mine you got this from killed my poor wife while I was away from home. Now I have my vengeance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f3e5_Oblivion_RES: Those Golden Saint and Dark Seducer men are dreamy aren't they? Glad to have them back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008dc23_Oblivion_RES: Those Hearts of Order you find on the Knights can't be used to unlock special chests.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005effd_Oblivion_RES: Those Knights of Order are always causing trouble. Don't worry, though. I'll figure out what to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024d71_Oblivion_RE: Those Odiil boys ought to know better. Leave troubles like that to the town guard. That's what they're paid for.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c3e_Oblivion_RES: Those Shambles are dangerous. Make sure to stand back if you kill one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaNQDQuestionResponses_0004660: Those are dangerous skills for a novice. I hope he trains people well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f431_Oblivion_RES: Those aren't Sheogorath's real armies that have returned. The real ones are being held in a secret underground compound.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15BandsOfChosen_0003cd22_Oblivi: Those bracers you're wearing ... that's what we put on the prisoners here. It prevents them from escaping, and makes them easy to control.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f023_Oblivion_RES: Those creatures in the Fringe are scary. Not like you, you fuzzy little rascal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06AmuseiDoingHere_0001531f_Obli: Those cretin Skingrad guards caught me stealing a fish and locked me up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc7a_Oblivion_RES: Those famous for good deeds may receive Blessings of Intelligence and Magicka when they visit Wayshrines of Julianos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15BandsOfChosen_00047362_Oblivi: Those favored by the Master to wear the Bands may enter the Forbidden Grotto, and leave this Savage Garden forever.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Sithis_000251e9_Oblivion_RESP1: Those fools in the Church and their so-called "Nine Divines." There is no divinity beyond the eternal and terrible rule of our Dread Father, Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e4d_Oblivion_RES: Those guys that broke out of Bravil jail were tough customers. But the Fighters Guild got them, didn't they.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00085215_Oblivion_RES: Those new fellows here in town are making me nervous. Walking around with those big weapons; I hope they leave soon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ04Notes_0018a95c_Oblivion_RESP2: Those notes are very important to me and represent ten years of my life. If you could recover them, I'd be sure to reward you appropriately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEObeliskResponses_0008dc16_Obliv: Those obelisks are harmless. Certainly, nothing hostile appears near them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS45BrethrenTopic_00017788_Oblivi: Those of us who've changed the most, we call The Brethren. Live down in the caves, to be nearer the Deep Ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005ef84_Oblivion_RES: Those strange Knights probably have diseases from wherever they came from. Best stay away from them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AInstDoYouHandle_00018dfc_Obl: Those that are lucky enough to merely go insane will be granted a place in the Shivering Isles as a permanent resident.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043cd1_Oblivion_RESP1: Those traps up ahead will cut my Aureals to pieces!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00064446_Oblivion_RES: Those wanted posters of the Gray Fox are everywhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArcaneULecture2_00071924_Oblivion: Those who believe the runestones to be Dawn Era artifacts, created by the Aedra or Daedra, often describe them as Lorkhan's birthing gift to mortals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00088b66_Oblivion_RESP1: Those who despair will certainly never be permitted to leave the Eternal Garden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15ForbiddenGrotto_00047360_Obli: Those who earn the Master's favor are given the Bands of the Chosen and allowed to leave the Garden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc7d_Oblivion_RES: Those who live by the Commands of the Nine receive Blessings of Strength when they visit Wayshrines of Tiber Septim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaB_00022b42_Oblivion_R: Those who unlock this hidden path have proven themselves worthy to join the ranks of the Mythic Dawn cult. Finding the shrine is the first test.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08Orders_0001aeae_Oblivion_RESP: Those who you assign as archers will head to the rear and keep their distance when the enemy draws close.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ03Avenge_00189d07_Oblivion_RESP: Those wretched beasts killed her! Filthy animals! Had I only been there to stop them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000a80a6_Oblivion_RES: Though I am replicant to spread rumors, I am led to believe the philogy of skeletous beings makes them resistive to magic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RogueMage_0003020c_Oblivion_RESP3: Though I must say, I doubt it will do you much good in the end. You'd be surprised how easily they forget about the little people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034861_Oblivion_RESP3: Though I must warn you. I have seen things in your future. Things which may be, and things which will be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UlrichLelandTopic_0003c36d_Oblivi: Though I'm happy that Ulrich has been removed from his post, I'm still saddened that there'll be no true retribution for Aldos.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3ba_Oblivion_RESP2: Though his body is beyond Oblivion, his soul encircles us... always watching, waiting to pounce with lethal aplomb.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000299f_Knights_RESP5: Though many know where they are, they are still lost. I believe there is something you must do in order to retrieve them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02Mania_00082755_Oblivion_RESP3: Though the citizens and creatures of Mania are colorful, they can often be quite deadly. I'm sure you can handle it, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005dc8b_Oblivion_: Though the darkness comes, I feel no fear. In your glory, bring us to the light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bd9_Knights_R: Though we went our separate ways when the Order fell, we all served the Nine in our hearts. All but one...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000514bc_Oblivion_RESP1: Thought I sent you to Harlun's Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate2_0001447e_Oblivio: Threatened? Who threatened you, my dear?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049937_Oblivion_RES: Three Brothers have some good merchandise. Don't know if I've met all three brothers, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_0002879a_Oblivion_RE: Three guests have been slaughtered, and you want to ask me about that Legion dog? I don't know who I hate more, you or him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e12_Oblivion_RESP1: Three of the afternoon watch, and all's well. The way I like it, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023eb5_Oblivion_RESP1: Three of the afternoon watch, and all's well. The way I like it, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e27_Oblivion_RESP1: Three of the night watch, and all's well. Good night, ma'am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023eec_Oblivion_RESP1: Three of the night watch, and all's well. Good night, sir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000329e9_Oblivion_RESP3: Three of us were cut down in the first wave. We pressed on, at Farwil's behest. At the base of the citadel, we met a larger second wave of foes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c2f_Oblivi: Three people have been killed, and now Matilde thinks she's next. I guess only the killer knows for sure. Isn't that right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MatildePetitTopic_00028c30_Oblivi: Three people have been killed, and the only ones left are you, me and a little old lady. One of us is a murderer, and my money's on the old lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000286d7_Oblivion_RESP1: Three people now dead, and yet the two of us still live. Do you think I'm the killer? Because I most certainly wonder the same thing about you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028723_Oblivion_RESP1: Three people... murdered. I know I shouldn't go wandering off alone right now, but for the love of Ysmir, I need a drink!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NevilleTopic_00028793_Oblivion_RE: Three years ago, my village in Skyrim was attacked by bandits. We went to the nearby Imperial Legion outpost, but they refused to help us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_0002b43e_Ob: Through my research, I have learned that they were removed from the temple before its sack by Men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_00085992_Ob: Through my research, I have learned that they were removed from the temple before its sack by Men.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DraconianMadstoneTopic_00018233_O: Through my sources, I've learned that the last reported location of the Madstone was the ruins at Pale Pass.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeWoodElf_0009f9b8_Oblivio: Through the gate, my Wood Elf waits! Hurry, and do not disappoint me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeynonPrioryTopic_000aa08c_Oblivi: Tiber Septim is the god and patron saint of our order. And now his dynasty has come to an end. It's very painful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TidewaterCaveTOPIC_00026ad0_Obliv: Tidewater Cave? I know of it. Down along the southern coast. Nasty place, from what I hear. Full of all sorts of critters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TidewaterCaveTOPIC_00026ab4_Obliv: Tidewater Cave? Tidewater Cave! Why... why do you ask about this place?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48Orders_00026150_Oblivion_RESP: Tierra, get these civilians to the camp south of the city immediately, and then report back here at once!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007815c_Oblivion_RES: Tilse Areleth has quite a collection of things for sale at Common Treasures.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_00016efc_Obl: Time and place are nothing. Constructs of a feeble mortal mind attempting to categorize and understand the world around it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11KnifePointHollow_000807ab_Obl: Time and place are nothing. Constructs of a feeble mortal mind attempting to categorize and understand the world around it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004a987_Oblivion_RESP1: Time for you to cash in on my success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_00053242_Oblivion_: Time for you to see where the real power of the guild lies. Raminus Polus will want to speak with you; head to the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a80b_Oblivion_RESP1: Time grows ever shorter. I implore you -- deliver your precious cargo to Dyus with haste.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009811f_Oblivion_RESP1: Time grows short. The cure must be administered as soon as possible. Please, hand it over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095782_Obliv: Time is a strange thing in the Isles, so this may not set us back, and there is a task that needs to be performed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000151f7_Oblivion_RESP1: Time is against us, and our enemies grow stronger. There is much to do, and little time in which to do it. Your next task is essential.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004bf9a_Oblivion_RESP1: Time is pressing. Martin must relight the Dragonfires before the enemy can stop us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08BattleBeginNo_00017da6_Oblivi: Time is short, Your Grace. We cannot know when the next attack will come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08BattleBeginNo_000181c0_Oblivi: Time is short, Your Grace. We cannot know when the next attack will come.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014b4d_Oblivion_RESP1: Time is short. You must speak to Sheogorath immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00028c77_Oblivion_RESP1: Time is wasting. We must move swiftly!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ac6e_Oblivion_RESP2: Time need not slow you. Tell me, have you ever considered placing yourself on display?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a80c_Oblivion_RESP1: Time passes, and still you are here. Perhaps you do not wish to play the role that has been forced upon you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007e3ea_Oblivion_RESP1: Time to choose! Oh, how I missed these moments... so exhilarating!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SheoIntroSpeech1_00056049_Oblivio: Time to save the Realm! Rescue the damsel! Slay the beast! Or die trying. Your help is required.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AleronLocheTopic_0001f422_Oblivio: Time's wastin'. He's safe... for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014b4c_Oblivion_RESP1: Time. Time is an artificial construct. An arbitrary system based on the idea that events occur in a linear direction at all times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GenericBanditC_000a348b_Oblivion_: Times are hard when a robber can't even make an honest living.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e09a_Oblivion_RESP1: Timothee LaRouche, late of the Black Dog, able seaman. I'll be staying ashore 'til my stash runs out, then it's off to sea once more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0008e13f_Oblivion_RES: To Cutter's in Crucible you should go for bladed weapons to thwart your foe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d287_Oblivion_RESP3: To advance in the guild, you'll need recommendations from each local guild hall in Cyrodiil. A feat which I'm sure will elude you completely.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDerveninSpeech07_00089917_Obliv: To be a Maniac is to love and be loved. Spread the compassion and the warmth throughout New Sheoth and beyond.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8af_Oblivion: To be frank, I'd prefer a career in the Arena to this paper-pusher's position.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07DairihillOffice_00098397_Obli: To be honest, I couldn't give you directions to any special room in the castle. Anyone in the castle can tell you though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_0002826d_Obli: To be honest, I started getting a bad feeling about Nels. But now he's dead! I... I should have gotten to know him better. Now it's too late.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_000286f1_Obli: To be honest, I'm not sure if I trust him. He's a hard drinker, but there's something more. Something in his eyes, hard and calculating.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07SheoIntro2_00082468_Oblivion_: To be honest, it wasn't the best idea. And it really began to smell. Must have been clowns. Clouds don't smell bad. They taste of butter! And tears.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_00028f46_Obliv: To be honest, my instincts tell me the kid isn't the killer. Sure he's a bit obnoxious, but that doesn't make him capable of murder.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03SyndelChamberTwoMani02_000732: To be so close, and yet so far. If only we had the key! Wait.. do you hear something?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07RitualNoD_0001365f_Oblivion_R: To become ruler of Dementia, the current leader's heart must be cut out and brought to the Altar of Arden-Sul in the Sacellum.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackwoodCompany_000356df_Oblivio: To bring them down, I need more information. My sources tell me they're trying to expand, and they've set up camp in Glademist Cave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS37JulienneAmazing_00022e63_Obli: To commemerate his kind heart, she imbued the Tears with some sort of magical power. That's only rumor though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476b9_Oblivi: To earn gold, Argonians must come to the city. It is a strange life, shaped stones and whiteskins everywhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_000251ef_Oblivion_RES: To employ the services of the Dark Brotherhood, one must perform a ritual to the Night Mother. Only then will she heed their prayers for murder.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e6c_Oblivion: To find their secret shrine to Mehrunes Dagon, you'll need to study the four volumes of Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopicDarJee04_000479b4_Ob: To get the taste of Khajiit cooking out of their mouths! Hahaha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033362_Oblivion_R: To go from the gladed realm of Valenwood to a rat-infested hole like this... how very sad. Those walls must feel like they're closing in on you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062ce4_Oblivion_RESP1: To greet you? Or eat you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004768b_Oblivi: To know the right things, you have to know the right people. Ida Vlinorman, Mandil, Samuel Bantien, and Othrelos are the right people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGFindGrayFox_0001e091_Oblivion_R: To learn more about the Gray Fox, go to the Garden of Dareloth at midnight. Look in the Waterfront District of the Imperial City. I can say no more.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1C_00032bf3_Obliv: Waiting just outside is a magnificent steed named Shadowmere. She has served me well. I present her now to you, as a token of my trust and love.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018a955_Oblivion_RESP1: Waiting's been difficult, I hope your journey was successful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033349_Oblivion_R: Wake up, Redguard! Ah, there you are. How do you like your cell, huh? Roomy enough for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003333d_Oblivion_R: Wake up, kitty kitty. That's it. There's a rat in my cell, Khajiit. A fat, tasty rat. Does the kitty want it? Is the kitty hungry?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003334a_Oblivion_R: Wake up, pretty Redguard! Ah, there you are. How do you like your cell, huh? Roomy enough for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00004b9f_DLCVileLair_RESP: Walk always in the Shadow of Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00007972_DLCVileLair_RESP: Walk always in the Shadow of Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00034031_Oblivion_RESP1: Walk always in the Shadow of Sithis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32WhatCanIDo_00012d05_Oblivion_: Walk among them. There were four who failed to protect the gate lever. Find out what they did wrong and help them correct it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_0018ae86_Oblivion_RESP1: Walk just up the stairs there, and it's the door on the right. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000243bd_Oblivion_RESP1: Walk where your road must take you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00034034_Oblivion_RESP1: Walk with darkness, child of the Night Mother.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000029e8_Knights_RESP1: Walk with the Nine, Sir Knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPilgrimageTopic_00002a9b_Knight: Walking the Pilgrim's Way is the traditional start of a holy quest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_00038ab3_Oblivion_R: Wander the streets, fields, and public places of Skingrad to your heart's content. Just don't include me in your social explorations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071f30_Oblivion_RESP1: Wanna buy a stick? I gotta fresh one right here. No? Then what can I do for ya?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGreavesMagic_000400b8_Ob: Want some help putting these on?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479b0_Oblivion_R: Want to hear a Khajiit joke?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopicGrayFox_0004891c_Obliv: Want to learn more? Visit the Waterfront District of the Imperial City. Find the Garden of Dareloth at midnight. Then ask your questions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eb0_Oblivion_RES: Want to pick up a shield and go a few rounds later? Been a while since I saw real action.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007fde2_Oblivion_RESP1: War has come to the Shivering Isles at last. We stand ready to protect these lands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022500_Oblivion_RESP1: Warmest greetings to you. I trust you've already spoken with Ocheeva? I am Vicente Valtieri. I provide assignments for all new family members.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251dd_Oblivion_RESP1: Warmest welcomes to you. I am Telaendril, Wood Elf and loyal daughter of Sithis. I hope you find our Sanctuary to your liking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0014684e_Oblivion_RESP1: Warrior? You? Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Just... Just look at you! Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ebf_Oblivion_RES: Was Vigdis our most recent recruit? Or Lensi Llharam? It's been so long, I forget.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012d07_Oblivion_RESP1: Was my sin so great that I must suffer for all eternity?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ADMIREDISLIKE_0018b2a5_Oblivion_R: Was that supposed to be a compliment?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5a3_Oblivion_RESP1: Was that you? What did you eat?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081d92_Oblivion_RESP1: Was that...? Nah, just my imagination.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000343e6_Oblivion_RESP1: Waste no time. You must find Martin before the enemy does.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcc3_Oblivion_RES: Watch for minotaurs in the forests. Aggressive beasts. They'll tear right through your armor, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077c46_Oblivion_RES: Watch for the Elytra's stingers; their poison can be deadly. They don't like magic much, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09Ceremony_00014aea_Oblivion_RE: Watch my child destroy the interlopers, or run to Sheogorath. Either way, tell Him of our doings here. Send Him my tribute... and my affections.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00088b40_Oblivion_RESP1: Watch out for Anaxes. Some meddling fool must have let him loose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_000319ce_Oblivion_RES: Watch out for them if you're heading north. We ran into goblin war parties northwest of here, while starting to build a new settlement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0006b82b_Oblivion_RESP1: Watch out! There may be more of them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_sons_0002573f_Oblivion_RESP1: Watch over them, and keep them safe. I couldn't bear to lose them to those monsters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005dc94_Oblivion_: Watch over these souls, who have strayed from the light of your love.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000917ca_Oblivion_RESP1: Watch your step in the Silo. Thadon doesn't want just anyone traipsing through there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcbe_Oblivion_RES: Watch yourself around goblins. Some of the nastier ones will toss spells at you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c1_Oblivion_RESP: Watch yourself around the Fo'c's'le. Sailors despise landsmen, and won't hesitate to treat them to a good beating when they're in their cups.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFellmoorTopic_0003be76_Oblivion: Watch yourself while you're here. Cindanwe is out for us. She cares for nothing but work, and she keeps us as slaves!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc80_Oblivion_RES: Wayshrines of Arkay confer Blessings of Health on those who've pleased the Nine by righteous acts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bc79_Oblivion_RES: Wayshrines of the Nine in the wilderness confer blessings on the righteous and faithful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BleakersWayTopic_0001ece0_Oblivio: We Dalvilus are good neighbors to the Ulfgars, and our leaders, Hrol Ulfgar and Nivan Dalvilu, work hard to keep it that way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034510_Oblivion_RESP1: We agreed I would meet the Sponsor. You need to get out of sight before you blow the whole meeting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEWildernessRumorResponses_000617: We all knew that's how Thadon would go. But, Syl?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000355cb_Oblivion_R: We all love Count Marius, and his father before him... Arkay bless his soul... such a fine young man...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d28c_Oblivion_RESP1: We all owe you a debt of gratitude for closing that Oblivion Gate. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062be7_Oblivion_RESP1: We all owe you our lives. From what I've heard, the battle was hanging in the balance until you destroyed that horrible daedric machine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000475d0_Oblivion_R: We all profit by your lawful pursuit of the unlawful, and we encourage you to attack, burn, loot, and destroy them wherever you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity8_00081e8d_Oblivion_RES: We already have one of those, I'm afraid. It wasn't all that Odd to begin with, honestly. We certainly can't have two.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07Spies_00020077_Oblivion_RESP3: We always see them near the runestone at dusk. They aren't too woodcrafty, but Grandmaster Jauffre has forbidden us to range too far from the walls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_0002427e_Oblivion_RESP1: We appreciate your interest, but I understand you've got a bounty on your head. Take care of that, and we'll consider your application.
