ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_00024281_Oblivion_RESP1: We appreciate your interest, but you've got quite a nasty reputation. Do something about that, and perhaps we'll consider your application.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_00031842_Oblivion_: We are Knights sworn to uphold the laws of Cheydinhal. We fear no being, and we strike fast and true as lightning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_000c452c_Oblivion_: We are Knights sworn to uphold the laws of Cheydinhal. We fear no being, and we strike fast and true as lightning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0000344b_Oblivion_RESP1: We are a brotherhood, a family. What affects one of us affects us all. Fighting, drunkenness, dereliction of duty are not tolerated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFellmoorTopic_0003be78_Oblivion: We are a farming community. Nothing more. Nothing less. That is, when I can get these layabouts to actually put in a day's work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OrderOfTalosTopic_00033dfc_Oblivi: We are a monastic order devoted to divine Talos, who was the mortal Tiber Septim, the founder of the empire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PellsGateTOPIC_00026b13_Oblivion_: We are a small community. Mostly keep to ourselves. Can't say it isn't nice to see a new face around, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice3A_00070487_Oblivion_RE: We are after the same things, your guild and I. Yet you worry about 'good' and 'evil' and do not accept they are manifestations of the same thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bd8_Knights_R: We are all reunited once more. You have done what we once thought impossible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00055b03_Oblivion_RESP1: We are all that are left. The others were struck down by Order. How did this happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00079c09_Oblivion_RESP1: We are all that are left. The others were struck down by Order. How did this happen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002A2A_AltarDeluxe_RES: We are blessed by an Envoy of Lord Dagon!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefend_000131b5_Oblivion_: We are expecting the Aureals to attack any moment. They'll come down the main passage from the Altar of Rapture. They always do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00020086_Oblivi: We are from the IC (not to be confused with the OC).
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11LastHeist_0001fb4f_Oblivion_R: We are going to steal one of the Elder Scrolls from the Imperial Palace. Are you ready for this challenge?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OrderOfTalosTopic_00033dfb_Oblivi: We are honored to have Grandmaster Jauffre, or Brother Jauffre as he prefers, as a resident here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251d6_Oblivion_RESP1: We are kin, yet I cannot help but despise you. Leave my sight, before I do something I regret.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MSMiscKotT_000c453c_Oblivion_RESP: We are led by Farwil Indarys. Yes, the Count's son himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008511c_Oblivion_RESP1: We are not afraid of the dark. The Night Mistress gives us eyes to see night's secrets.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a78da_Oblivion_RESP1: We are not yet done with your test. When you have passed or failed, then we may have reason to speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElderCouncilTopic_000add0c_Oblivi: We are now the stewards of the Empire. We can hold the Empire together in the short term.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_0018d7f8_Oblivion_RES: We are one mind and one blade, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD07Choice2_00098198_Oblivion_RE: We are over one hundred strong now. We grow by the day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06KanehGreetA_000131ab_Oblivion: We are preparing to sweep the Mazken scum from Cylarne. Perhaps Sheogorath sent you to help us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriGreetA1_000131b2_Oblivio: We are preparing to wipe out the arrogant Aureals once and for all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008d32a_Oblivion_RESP1: We are safe in your presence, Lord. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07WhyNotKillLex_0000c049_Oblivi: We are thieves, not murderers. That is the province of the Dark Brotherhood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d23f_Oblivion_RESP2: We are, for lack of a better word, defenders. We guard this city from an infestation that plagues it. We are vampire hunters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HenantierTopic_00027f31_Oblivion_: We aren't going far, so no need to prepare for a long journey. In fact, he's still in town. More I can't say aloud without risk of others hearing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene04Negative_0000c1ef_Obl: We aren't here for that! My patience is at an end, as will soon be your life!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04WhereIsAmusei_00035fad_Oblivi: We arrested that miscreant. The stupid lizard tried to blackmail the Countess. I wouldn't waste much time thinking about him any more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice1A_00028150_Oblivion_RE: We believe it's somewhere south of Chorrol, but south-west of Fort Carmala. It may be difficult to find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04ChoiceCarahilContinue_0004f22: We believe the killings are the actions of a rogue mage. Battlemages have been sent to the Brina Cross Inn, the only common link between the victims.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MerchantTopic_0002ee50_Oblivion_R: We believe these deaths to be the actions of a rogue Mage.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061b75: We can all sleep better with the armies at full strength.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_0003d7b4_Obliv: We can do them any time of the day. You kidding? The citizens of the Imperial City would love some late-night entertainment!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0007eaaa_Obliv: We can go in? Well... I better stay here. There's no telling what kind of diseases are floating around in there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GenericBanditB_000a333d_Oblivion_: We can play it that way if you like.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002e5e5_Oblivion_: We can talk, so long as Falcar is out of earshot. If I didn't know any better, I'd say he's trying to get you killed!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateConv_000545f4_Oblivio: We can use your help! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateConv_000980aa_Oblivio: We can use your help! Let's go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043cd2_Oblivion_RESP1: We can't advance until you get that gate open!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00000923_Oblivion_RESP1: We can't be seen talking!  I waited for you last night behind the Great Chapel, where WERE you?!  I'll meet you there tonight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224a8_Oblivion_RESP1: We can't keep stopping to talk like this! We've got to get out there and fight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CastleGateTopic_00090ab5_Oblivion: We can't open that gate from out here. The only mechanism for raising it is inside the gatehouse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e63_Oblivion_RES: We can't talk about it. Just go about your business. If Oreyn needs something, he'll let us know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38StartQuest_0002a871_Oblivion_: We can't talk here. Too public. Meet me behind the Great Chapel at midnight. Don't let anyone follow you. I'll make it worth your while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05BaurusA_00022b14_Oblivion_RES: We can't talk now! Just follow my lead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_00028ac4_Oblivio: We can't wait to return to Weatherleah, now that the ogres are dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ThoronirBad_0000bca2_Oblivion: We cannot do it ourselves, as he recognizes all of us. The job pays a fair bounty in gold when he is brought to justice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3a_000186fc_: We cannot talk now -- we don't have very long until the next wave arrives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting3a_00018c7e_: We cannot talk now -- we don't have very long until the next wave arrives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsStartCombat_00002b4f_Kni: We cannot win this battle! You must destroy the Orb at once!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Become_00013657_Oblivion_RESP: We celebrate him with the Ritual of Accession... the path to Maniac Bliss.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034ea8_Oblivion_RESP1: We come to the real work at last.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ICAllNQDResponses_00049964_Oblivi: We could just listen to people talking. It's uncanny how informed people are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0002855b_Oblivion_RES: We couldn't have been any less prepared for this. Seems like they came out of nowhere. There were just so many of them...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_0003843c_Oblivi: We did a follow up investigation, and it's true that no one recollects seeing Bradon out in the daylight. He's only been spotted at night.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c144_Oblivion_RESP1: We did it! We showed those damned daedra a thing or two!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09GhostB_00036666_Oblivion_RESP: We did not know that the Underking, who was Zurin Arctus, had arisen to take his first revenge upon his former lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace2c_Oblivion_RES: We don't go looking for new worshippers. If people are interested, they can find us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d827_Oblivion_RESP2: We don't have any horses for sale right now. You bought our last Bay horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d16d_Oblivion_RESP2: We don't have any horses for sale right now. You bought our last White horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c592_Oblivion_RESP1: We don't have time to talk. I want to find Blackheart. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00032b06_Oblivion_RES: We don't know that, Sire. The messenger only said they were attacked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00028bc8_Oblivion_RESP1: We don't like strangers meddling in our affairs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028212_Oblivion_RESP1: We don't like strangers poking their noses into our business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_000286a0_Oblivion_R: We don't look kindly on strangers asking questions.  If you need a room, try Moslin's Inn.  Otherwise, you'd best be moving on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c3_Oblivion_RESP2: We don't much like spellcasters in Hammerfell. Wizards steal souls and tamper with minds. If you use magic, you're weak or wicked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGGrayFox_000165e4_Oblivion_RESP1: We don't talk about him in public. The Thieves Guild follows the Gray Fox. However, we make sure that most folks think he is just a myth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace2a_Oblivion_RES: We don't want more worshippers. We just want to be left alone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace48_Oblivion_RES: We don't welcome visitors, but we don't murder them either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c98b_Oblivion_RESP: We drink because we're happy. We're Nords. It's just the thick tongue and fat head the day after that makes me unhappy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice5C_00022bdd_Oblivion_RE: We feared Hassildor may have been involved with the Necromancers. Thanks to your involvement, it would seem that he is not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031036_Oblivion_RESP4: We figured it was time to move on to a new prank. This one was getting boring, anyway. So you can tell her you've found me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e89_Oblivion_RES: We filled the Desolate Mine contract, but the butcher's bill was pretty steep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c35a_Oblivion_RESP1: We finally got him! There'll be no excuses this time. Ulrich is mine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice9_0002c622_Oblivion_RE: We find Blackheart and get that weapon. We'll finish this contract and let all of Cyrodiil know what happened here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10FinThedretGreeting01a_00002ca: We found Umaril's body next to yours, but it seemed that you had met the same fate as Pelinal Whitestrake. We didn't know...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000329e9_Oblivion_RESP5: We found the way back blocked by more daedra. So we were stuck here until rescued by you. It's just like Farwil to leap before he looks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03AltarofKynareth_00002a4f_Knig: We gather here to pay tribute to all of the blessings she bestows upon us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022506_Oblivion_RESP1: We got plenty of rooms if you want one. Ain't nobody staying here these days 'cept old Rufio.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GaltusPreviaTOPIC_0002d729_Oblivi: We got the contract from his aunt. Was in Nonwyll looking for gems of some sort. Never heard from again. You and Viranus go find him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d49b_Oblivion_RESP1: We had a feeling you'd be surprised when you saw us in our real uniforms. I see you have a puzzled look on your face. Ask away.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42AgreeLie_0007322e_Oblivion_RE: We had an agreement, don't you remember? I'm trying to build a skyboat and you are supposed to bring me calipers and tongs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_000699fc_Oblivion_RES: We had everything here. Beautiful gardens. Fresh mountain air. Did you know Kvatch had the only Arena in Cyrodiil outside the Imperial City?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_00033efc_Oblivion_RES: We had just set up at Cropsford when Mirisa came running in. Said goblins were heading our way. We barely escaped with our lives!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsTopic_00002bd6_Knights_R: We had only the best of intentions. Truly, we did. We meant only to serve the Nine and the Empire. It's hard to believe it all went so wrong.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c98_Oblivio: We had to pay his "fine" or go to jail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_000363b8_Oblivio: We had to pay the "fine" or he was going to march us off to jail.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46NewSettlement_000319d6_Oblivi: We have a charter from the county, everything done official and by the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d49a_Oblivion_RESP1: We have a lot of paperwork and follow-up investigation to do. Please, leave us to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001fb36_Oblivio: We have a new Brother who wishes to bind himself to the service of Lord Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001fb35_Oblivio: We have a new Sister who wishes to bind herself to the service of Lord Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e60_Oblivion_RES: We have a new master. And with Oreyn to run daily affairs, we should be in good shape.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d284_Oblivion_RESP4: We have a responsibility to look after one another, don't we? I dare say we do, no matter what the costs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Trespassing_0000bf89_Oblivion: We have a... situation. The Count has sent most of the servants home. You have to leave. Sorry, but you ain't working here anymore either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15SavageGarden_00047364_Oblivio: We have all died in the Master's service. Here in Gaiar Alata we are immortal, and wait to return to Tamriel after Lord Dagon's final victory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Accuse_00035659_Oblivion_RESP1: We have already been through this, and I admitted my guilt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001c4d9_Oblivion_RESP1: We have awaited your arrival, messenger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007be56_Oblivion_RESP3: We have awaited your arrival. Tell us, what news do you bring from Akavir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_mission_000356f1_Oblivion_RESP1: We have been contracted by the town of Water's Edge to rid their town of goblins. They've been raiding for days, and appear to be in large numbers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MehrunesDagonTopic_00097cc3_Obliv: We have been preparing for the coming of Lord Dagon for many years. You come to us at a fateful time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_0006bf17_Oblivion_RESP: We have but the six sheep in our pasture, and we make sure they are well-tended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036646_Oblivion_RESP1: We have fulfilled our last duty. We go now to Aetherius without shame. Farewell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThreeSigns_00026af5_Oblivion_RESP: We have had some livestock die recently, but not all of them, which is a relief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038438_Oblivi: We have it on good authority from officials in a neighboring city that Raynil is what he says he is. So I'm not sure what you're trying to prove.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e7a_Oblivion_RESP2: We have much to discuss, but if you have time, I'd beg you stay a moment longer and hear about our home, Weatherleah.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_00015459_Oblivio: We have much to speak of, and very little time. A new task awaits you, and it is by far the most important you have been entrusted with.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000685a3_Oblivion_RESP1: We have only once chance at this! Use the portal to Camoran's Paradise before it closes again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000291e_Knights_RESP2: We have orders to leave everything just the way it was until the investigation into the Chapel attack is finished.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG11ChoiceExplain_00033540_Oblivi: We have overlooked these questions because we are so focused on rooting out the Necromancers as quickly as possible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseInquiry_0004d82e_Oblivion_RE: We have some of the best Bay horses in Cyrodiil. They are hardier than the Chestnut and faster than the Paint horses.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseInquiry_0004ce57_Oblivion_RE: We have the finest white horses in Cyrodiil. None are hardier, and only the black horses of Cheydinhal are faster.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004bf9b_Oblivion_RESP1: We have to get Martin to the Temple of the One or Mehrunes Dagon has won after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StolenGold_0005371e_Oblivion_RESP: We have to get him to tell us about the gold. Use any trick you can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0009837e_Oblivion_RESP1: We have to stay in our homes while the Watch searches for the Gray Fox.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032ea0_Oblivion_RES: We have trainers for block and marksman in Skingrad. And there's a shepherd who teaches athletics, too, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AncotarTopic_000301e5_Oblivion_RE: We haven't seen him since that whole invisibility mess. I hope it stays that way!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_00033793_Oblivion_RESP: We haven't yet spoken to the others, for fear they would be less than accepting of her situation. Perhaps it is time, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorWhy_0003446e_Oblivion_R: We heard tell that vampires have infiltrated the town. Came here to root them out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04Who_0001330b_Oblivion_RESP1: We hold on to fleeting things even as we slip. I knew, and yet I indulged myself anyway. I indulged her a fair bit, too. Hee hee!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEAltarofDespairTopic_0007ff5e_Ob: We hold the Altar of Despair, here within the Shrine of the Flame of Agnon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005c0c2_Oblivion_RESP1: We honor the Rose and its bearer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00033b26_Oblivion_RESP1: We is most pleased... eth... ified.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031036_Oblivion_RESP3: We just get tired of Jeanne lording her position over us, when she barely knows anything about magic. Every now and then, we like to trick her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004d0b7_Oblivion_RESP1: We just made it through to the Palace. The Market District was swarming with daedra.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e65_Oblivion_RES: We just need to keep our heads down and try to do our jobs. Oreyn's doing what he can from the outside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BGreenmote_000167e3_Oblivion_: We keep the Greenmote safely tucked inside the Greenmote Silo. You can imagine the ruckus if its location was known.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00090cb9_Oblivion_RESP1: We kill and kill and kill! All we know is death! It ends here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkBrotherhoodTopic_000bba98_Obl: We kill for profit, for enjoyment, and for the glory of the Dread Father, Sithis. We are family, with bonds forged in blood and death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000c4531_Oblivion_RESP3: We killed scores... nay, hundreds of evil daedra! The ground ran thick with their dark blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10FinThedretGreeting01_00002c9d: We knew you had succeeded in destroying Umaril's physical form, but it seemed that you had met the same fate as Pelinal Whitestrake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000473c4_Oblivion_RESP2: We knew you would find your way here eventually. But it is of no consequence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ecdd_Oblivion_RESP1: We know how to deal with criminals in Bleaker's Way!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000290d_Knights_RESP4: We laid you to rest in the undercroft... we kept your death a secret. We feared what would happen if our enemies thought you were dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD05Choice5_0002c5c0_Oblivion_RE: We leave as soon as you're ready. I want to investigate Blackheart's stronghold at Arpenia. Meet me at the Leyawiin guild hall. We'll go from there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007a022_Oblivion_RESP1: We live at your whim, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_00028abf_Oblivio: We look forward to returning to our family's ancestral home at Weatherleah, once the ogres are dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e6b_Oblivion_RES: We lost Vitellus and a lot of good men against Blackheart. Somebody must be pretty good to take him and all his people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062be9_Oblivion_RESP3: We lost a lot of good men that day. But Bruma is still standing. That's what counts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48SalvianWhatHappened_00098142_: We lost the damned city, that's what happened!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_000329e9_Oblivion_RESP4: We lost two more in that skirmish, as well as Farwil and I being wounded badly. It was at this point we considered retreat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39RanarrJo_00072c95_Oblivion_RE: We made Sheogorath by planting little seeds in the ground and watering them with our tears and blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e71e_Oblivion_RESP1: We made it!... errr, I mean... victory is ours once again! Huzzah!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031eba_Oblivion_RESP1: We made it!... errr, I mean... victory is ours once again! Huzzah! It's a shame that Bremman didn't make it though. He was a good knight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetB1_00002b80_Knight: We made our way to Lord Vlindrel's crypt. Sir Roderic spoke the words that unsealed the tomb...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00062157_Oblivion_RESP1: We may be in the Choosy Beggar, but here you can eat like a king.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: We may have to torture dozens of people before we find one who knows something. How exciting!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAVaerminaSpeech_0008ade3_Oblivio: We meet again, mortal, for we have met before, whether you know it or not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000292f_Knights_RESP1: We meet again. I am here to join your Order, having received a divine vision from Kynareth herself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982ca_Oblivion_RESP1: We might be able to grow turnips next spring.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jointheFightersGuild_00027f8b_Obl: We might be able to use someone of your talents... if you've got a clean record, and a good reputation. Are you interested?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalSpeech_00084a50_Oblivi: We mock the thieves, for bitter is their loss. You, mortal, may take this. It shall open the secrets of dark places for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDementiaRumorResponses_00061431: We must all be on watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13BattlePlans_000276a9_Oblivion: We must allow the Mythic Dawn to proceed with their plan to open three lesser Gates outside Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril2_00002c55_Knights_RE: We must bide our time until our Commander has finished his quest for the Relics. It is hard, but the work of the gods cannot be rushed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000806ea_Oblivion_: We must carry out her wishes, however. And I, for one, am looking forward to, ahh... interacting with the citizens of Crucible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk2_00002bad_Knights_RESP1: We must deal with that situation in Daggerfall. You know... the ghost. Dead king or some such?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017972_Oblivion_RESP2: We must discuss our next move. The spire is obviously their source of power. This battle will not end until we find a way to shut it down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017d54_Oblivion_RESP2: We must discuss our next move. The spire is obviously their source of power. This battle will not end until we find a way to shut it down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002822e_Oblivion_RESP1: We must escape! Do you understand? We're the only two left! We're next! If we don't find a way out of here, we're going to die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016ecb_Oblivion_RESP1: We must find Dylora and free her!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e57f_Oblivion_RESP1: We must find Galtus Previa. He must be here somewhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2A_000262d8_Oblivion_: We must find out who is behind this betrayal! We haven't much time... I am hunted day and night by the Black Hand! They want me dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2B_000262d9_Oblivion_: We must find out who is behind this betrayal! We haven't much time... I am hunted day and night by the Black Hand! They want me dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice2C_000262da_Oblivion_: We must find out who is behind this betrayal! We haven't much time... I am hunted day and night by the Black Hand! They want me dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10Opposition_00017d11_Oblivion_: We must free Dylora as soon as possible. She will know what to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10Opposition_00016b38_Oblivion_: We must free Staada as soon as possible. She will know what to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003640b_Oblivion_RESP2: We must get out of here! Come on!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003ca8f_Oblivion_RESP1: We must get out of this place!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000093bb_Oblivion_RESP1: We must get out of this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0006b827_Oblivion_RESP1: We must get to the Temple! Drive them back!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDKnightsStartCombat_00002b4c_Kni: We must give the Crusader time to destroy the Orb!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinBattleSpeech_0003d062_O: We must hold fast until the Hero of Kvatch can destroy their Great Gate. We must kill whatever comes out of that gate!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7f4_Oblivion_RESP1: We must hold the line until the Great Gate opens!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Lost_00081a3b_Oblivion_RESP1: We must not let down our guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk5_0018d7fd_Oblivion_RES: We must not relax our guard, not even for a second. We'll talk more about this later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5A_00022ba9_Oblivion_: We must now take our leave of each other, you and I, for there is much work to be done. I'll be following... your progress. Welcome to the family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5B_00022baa_Oblivion_: We must now take our leave of each other, you and I, for there is much work to be done. I'll be following... your progress. Welcome to the family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5C_00022bab_Oblivion_: We must now take our leave of each other, you and I, for there is much work to be done. I'll be following... your progress. Welcome to the family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk4_00002bbb_Knights_RESP1: We must prepare ourselves, spiritually and physically. An increased training regimen, for at least a week. Then, we'll be ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7ee_Oblivion_RESP1: We must protect Martin during the battle. He is the Empire's last hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008f041_Oblivion_RESP1: We must purge Order from our home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008f042_Oblivion_RESP1: We must purge Order from our home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c2a9_Oblivion_RESP1: We must put an end to this travesty of justice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_0008571a_Oblivi: We must recover the Amulet of Kings and relight the Dragonfires, before it is too late to stem Dagon's invasion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0004db71_Oblivion_RESP1: We must shut down the Obelisks!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982cc_Oblivion_RESP1: We need more pressure on Lex. He's a stubborn fetcher.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0001e7a8_Oblivion_RESP1: We need one more piece of evidence to make Agarmir's guilt complete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479ec_Oblivion_R: We need some law-and-order... bring in the Legions. 'Leyawiin for the Imperials,' I say. No sense coddling those Renrijra Krin bandits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001bb22_Oblivion_RESP1: We need the Brush to get out of here. Bring it to me so we can get out of this painting. Hurry, I'm starving.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c3_Oblivion_RESP1: We need those Gatekeeper bones. You ready to go to the Gardens with me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c595_Oblivion_RESP1: We need to check out Arpenia. Come on. I'll follow you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AzaniBlackheartTOPIC_0002c597_Obl: We need to find out what happened with him. It's all suspicious to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ea8_Oblivion_RESP3: We need to gather what allies we can before Bruma is hopelessly besieged.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05MethredhelJob_0000c05b_Oblivi: We need to get Hieronymus Lex to lift his siege. I have put together a plan.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05FoundMythicDawn_00022cf0_Obli: We need to get that fourth book, then. If Tar-Meena is right, we can use these books to locate the Mythic Dawn's hidden shrine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002920_Knights_RESP1: We need to get these gates open!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029c0_Knights_RESP1: We need to get those gates open.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00012066_Oblivion_RESP1: We need to get through the Gates of Madness. Let's go kill the Gatekeeper!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bfa2_Oblivion_RESP1: We need to get to safety.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ad7a_Oblivion_RESP2: We need to get to the castle. That's where Count Goldwine and his men should be. Last I saw, they were trying to fortify the castle from an attack.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ee25_Oblivion_RESP4: We need to go see if it is safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00023e47_Oblivion_RESP1: We need you to stage an... accident. Kill the target in the manner specified, and you'll receive a considerable bonus. Do you accept this contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateConv_00097fa9_Oblivio: We never even knew what hit us. They were inside the city before we knew what was happening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WatersEdgeTOPIC_000356fe_Oblivion: We now know the threat this group poses. Perhaps better than they themselves know it. We must take decisive action now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_00074a93_Oblivion_RESP1: We obviously didn't get enough information from the Argonian. I want you to infiltrate them. See how they work from the inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CovenantTopic_000272af_Oblivion_R: We of the Dark Brotherhood serve the Night Mother, who is the bride of Sithis. The Night Mother rules her children with a terrible Black Hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JauffreTopic_0001e910_Oblivion_RE: We of the Imperial Bodyguard are the public face of the Blades, but most of my brothers serve the Emperor quietly, behind the scenes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004767f_Oblivi: We operate throughout the Imperial City and Cyrodiil. Very fast, very accurate. News happens? The Black Horse Courier is there!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10SirAmielSpeech04_00002cc2_Kni: We owe you a debt of thanks. You have succeeded where we could not. You and your knights have held true to your purpose.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46NewSettlement_000319d6_Oblivi: We plan to call it Cropsford. My daugher Callia, her husband Aloys, and I, came all the way from High Rock to start a new life here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_0006633c_Oblivion_RES: We praise our Unholy Matron. From her shadowed womb we were born, from her breast we suckle malice and pain. She loves her children, you see.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk4_00002bbc_Knights_RESP1: We pray, fellow knight! First and foremost, we pray. The Nine must bless us, and strengthen us. Only then will we be ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000476f7_Oblivi: We rarely get real trouble here. The Watch puts a stop to rough stuff damn quick. I'm mostly ornamental at the Bloated Float. Makes folks happy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Cindanwe_000781f4_Oblivion_RE: We really shouldn't be talking about this. Someone might be listening!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a849_Oblivion_RESP1: We really taught those bastards a lesson, didn't we ma'am?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003a84a_Oblivion_RESP1: We really taught those bastards a lesson, didn't we sir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HowlingHalls_00016b7e_Oblivio: We rebuilt it here, as it was when it hosted its most famous guest. Sometimes at night, I can still hear Emperor Pelagius screaming.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ16OcatoA_000add1a_Oblivion_RESP: We saw the Temple dome explode, the avatar of Akatosh appear... that was Martin?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007babf_Oblivion_RESP1: We saw the smoke from the Gold Road while out on patrol. How can we help?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HackdirtTopic_0002869f_Oblivion_R: We scrape by, not that we've ever had nought but trouble from outsiders like you.  You'd best be moving on, if you know what's good for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11TheLightTopic_00082650_Oblivi: We seek the light with an open eye and an open heart. We carve the flesh away, seeking the light within.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008511d_Oblivion_RESP1: We seek what the darkness hides, and the Night Mistress is our guide.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08BlindMonks_000983ac_Oblivion_: We serve the retired Moth priests from the Imperial City. The work they do leads to progressive blindess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEZoeMalenePykeResponses_00091b1c: We shall celebrate our love tonight, my darling.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00016b79_Oblivion_RESP1: We shall find a way to the light.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f220_Oblivion_RESP7: We shall look forward instead of back, however. You still have work to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RolandJensericTopic_0001da71_Obli: We shall never speak of him again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDerveninSpeech05_00089915_Obliv: We shall raise our goblets to the Demented. Though misguided they are, we are all children of Arden-Sul's teachings and therefore equal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDerveninSpeech04_000898f4_Obliv: We shall raise our goblets to the great Sheogorath, may he rule the Isles for another thousand years.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081730_Oblivion_RESP1: We shall speak when we've reached the chamber.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00026daa_Oblivion_RESP1: We should be on our way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04PinerA1_00090994_Oblivion_RES: We should check the Chapel. Come on!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00033585_Oblivion_RESP1: We should continue for Farwil's sake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_000164b5_Oblivion_RES: We should find a defensible spot and protect the Emperor until help arrives.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: We should find him soon. If he knows something, it might be a key to what's going on in Crucible.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000343ef_Oblivion_RESP1: We should get Martin to Cloud Ruler Temple immediately.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e57e_Oblivion_RESP1: We should get back to Oreyn and report what we have found.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000343e9_Oblivion_RESP1: We should get moving. I won't rest easy until Martin is safe at Cloud Ruler Temple.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003e1e5_Oblivion_RESP1: We should get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03LewinC1Idle01_0008ea8a_Oblivi: We should go back, I'm not sure we should be here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalConvo1_00026ab8_Oblivi: We should go get it right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalConvo1_000878d7_Oblivi: We should go get it right now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037828_Oblivion_RESP1: We should go to the Imperial City at once. Lead on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: We should have a little chat with her as soon as possible. I look forward to it; I get the feeling she avoids me at times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03GrommokC1Idle01_0008ea70_Obli: We should just kill this stupid tree and move on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGNoBloodPrice_000153af_Oblivion_: We should not speak of this again until you can pay the blood price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006d811_Oblivion_RESP1: We should speak in your room, where it is private. Not here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk2_00002bac_Knights_RESP1: We should travel, you and I. Quell evil throughout Tamriel! To be knights, aye... But to be knights errant! The adventures we will have!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000781e8_Oblivion_RESP2: We shouldn't be seen talking until the mission is accomplished!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk5_0006a874_Oblivion_RESP1: We shouldn't keep this news a secret. Feel free to tell the others, but let them know the complications we face. We'll continue our talk later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice4C_00022bd9_Oblivion_RE: We simply wanted to survey the situation in Skingrad. Our relationship with Hassildor is tenuous at best.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479cd_Oblivion_R: We speak West-fashion for the comfort of our Western clients, but we invest the fierce pride of our ancient races in each of our mercenary contracts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0007be9d_Oblivi: We stable horses for folks in the Imperial City. We'd sell horses, too. Except... we can't seem to keep track of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StoneofStAlessiaTOPIC_00003927_Ob: We stole it. I won't try to hide that now. I'm all that's left now, though. We may have stolen the stone, but we weren't the last ones to do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11HowlingHalls_00016b7f_Oblivio: We stole the stones from Cyrodiil and reassembled the temple here in the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047746_Oblivi: We store goods here until the buyer can collect them, or until the ships come in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002927_Knights_RESP1: We strike them down, but the orb keeps bringing them back to life! You must destroy the orb, Commander!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Brothers_00084a9c_Oblivion_RE: We thought you and Mother had both been killed. If we had only known!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace4a_Oblivion_RES: We threaten no one. Why can't they just leave us alone?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQDaedricMagic_0008b603_Oblivion_: We threw ourselves into the riddles of daedric magic. We hungered for forbidden secrets. Knowledge and power were our gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000298d_Knights_RESP1: We took an oath to protect the Cuirass in death. The one who could defeat us is the one who is meant to have it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetA2_00002b86_Knight: We travelled back and forth across Colovia. He was always asking about an old noble family, the Vlindrels.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08FinChoice1A_00035df3_Oblivi: We tried to eliminate Phillida, of course, but failed on three separate occassions. He's a powerful man, and was surrounded by powerful associates.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32SiegeVitharn_0001b68e_Oblivio: We tried to gather the townsfolk into the keep, but it was too late. I barely had time to find my betrothed and get us inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003013d_Oblivion_RESP2: We trusted you to help, and you betrayed us! It would be best if you left this town and never came back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BonusTopic_0002ff51_Oblivion_RESP: We try to honor these requests whenever possible. After all, the Dark Brotherhood's reputation has been built on providing... good service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22SrazirrGoAhead_0002c526_Obliv: We wait and see how this plays out. If and when there's an opportunity, S'razirr will help you against Maric.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00058e02_Oblivion_RESP2: We were all expecting to become the next Kvatch, you know?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00062be9_Oblivion_RESP2: We were all watching from the walls, and to be honest it was looking bad. I thought we were going to have to fight 'em street by street.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice4B_00022bd6_Oblivion_RE: We were also concerned that it might drive any Necromancers in the area underground, making them more difficult to root out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09SoIHear_00053778_Oblivion_RES: We were doing petty crimes all over Cyrodiil. Small scores; 10 gold here, 25 there. Nothing big enough to have them investigate you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7e_Knights: We were estranged in life, but I had hoped that in death we could be reconciled.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005a029_Oblivion_RESP1: We were ordered out to attack the daedra coming out of that Oblivion Gate. Captain's the only one who ever knows what's going on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatHappened_00017d16_Oblivio: We were so focused on organizing quickly that by the time we realized he'd let Order in himself, it was too late. We were split up and picked off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WhatHappened_0001746f_Oblivio: We were so focused on organizing quickly that by the time we realized she'd let Order in herself, it was too late. We were split up and picked off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000151f4_Oblivion_RESP5: We were supposed to storm the place and take this gem they're holding. Only we can't. There's some sort of enchantment on the door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Shadowscale_000251fc_Oblivion_RES: We were taken at birth, and given to the Dark Brotherhood. We returned to Black Marsh as Shadowscales, trained in the arts of stealth and murder.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15EldamilC1_0003fbde_Oblivion_R: We were the Chosen. We saw more clearly than ordinary mortals. We would destroy the world and remake it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESylTopic_0008f176_Oblivion_RESP: We will catch her, and will turn her over ourselves. Her treachery cannot be allowed to stand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008ef57_Oblivion_RESP1: We will continue to hold the Fringe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13CaptainGreetA2_0001a79c_Obliv: We will defend the Palace to the end of our strength, and will cast ourselves in the path of cursed Jyggalag himself should he come here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13CaptainGreetA2_0005e378_Obliv: We will defend the Palace to the end of our strength, and will cast ourselves in the path of cursed Jyggalag himself should he come here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008247a_Oblivion_RESP1: We will defend this land until we are dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000343f1_Oblivion_RESP1: We will exact our revenge on the Mythic Dawn for the Emperor's murder. By the holy blood of Talos, Mankar Camoran will pay for his crimes!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040b79_Oblivion_RESP1: We will keep fighting until the last of us is dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001c474_Oblivion: We will make sure each person on these tax rolls gets their money back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001796b_Oblivion_RESP1: We will not be able to hold this position for long, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00082476_Oblivion_RESP1: We will not fail you, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0008247e_Oblivion_RESP1: We will not lose this land.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d14b_Obliv: We will not speak of training here. When I have settled myself in my favorite spot in the bay, then we shall talk. Follow me there, if you wish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13Gate_00031845_Oblivion_RESP1: We will remain out here until the gate is either closed, or something emerges from inside. We need to warn Cheydinhal of impending attacks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00031615_Oblivion_RESP1: We will speak when your task is complete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003b838_Oblivion_RESP1: We will speak when your task is complete.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000c42ce_Oblivion_RESP1: We will spill their blood in the name of our father!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7ed_Oblivion_RESP1: We won a great victory here today! We now have the means to recover the Amulet of Kings from Mankar Camoran.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c141_Oblivion_RESP1: We won't let those daedra take Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c146_Oblivion_RESP1: We won't let you down, ma'am. The daedra will be sorry they messed with Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c145_Oblivion_RESP1: We won't let you down, sir. The daedra will be sorry they messed with Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfb3_Oblivion_RE: We wouldn't be here if you'd done your job!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_0008b601_Oblivion_RESP1: We'd all best get back to our duties, eh, Captain?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ForsakenMineTOPIC_0002f9e8_Oblivi: We'd been contracted to clear the place of trolls. It was a tough job, but I felt the men I sent were up to it. I want to know what happened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006fdb2_Oblivion_RESP1: We'd best get back to work now, hmm? Captain catches us gabbin', it'll be our heads.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_00061417_Oblivion_RESP: We'll be ready if the daedra decide to attack, don't worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcConversation_0007eace_Obli: We'll be swimming in blood soon. Yuck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS04Faustina_0003d4a3_Oblivion_RE: We'll clean up the mess. Don't concern yourself about it. I'm sure you had no choice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_0003d7b4_Obliv: We'll do it like this. You can fight one, two, or three creatures. The more creatures you fight, the more you win. If you survive, that is! Ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_00058e0c_Oblivion: We'll give them a good fight. They'll know they tangled with the best Cyrodiil has to offer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04CheckOnAmulet_0001ee2b_Oblivi: We'll go together. But I fear the worst.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ValusOdiilTopic_000224aa_Oblivion: We'll have to break the news to him that Antus didn't make it. He fought bravely, and father will respect that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03SyndelChamberTwoMani01_000732: We'll have to fend for ourselves. Do you think you can pry the door open?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ10BurdB_0003a854_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll hold here until you're ready. Although I'd rather not sit around waiting to see what else comes out of that gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043cd1_Oblivion_RESP2: We'll hold our position here until you get that gate open. May Sheogorath's madness guard and guide you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWait_000152ef_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll hold them off as long as we can. Return quickly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091c4f_Oblivion_RESP2: We'll hold this area. You head to the back of the castle, and find the Count.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWait_00026ef2_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll hold this position as long as we can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e62_Oblivion_RES: We'll just have to trust Oreyn, and keep our mouths shut.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Agree_0001dc2d_Oblivion_RESP3: We'll meet here again tomorrow night.  Oh, and NEVER contact me in public.  They're watching.  They can't know you're helping me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JskarTopic_0000a100_Oblivion_RESP: We'll need a few days to digest this new information. Should J'skar arrive here, we'll see to it that he's well taken care of. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301d7_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll never forget how you saved us from Ancotar's crazy magic. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Convo_000282fd_Oblivion_RES: We'll see who gets to cut you, Motierre! Let me show you how a real killer operates, you Dark Brotherhood mongrel! Defend yourself!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006a84f_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll speak again later, Apprentice. Now go! Your studies await!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00088b68_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll speak again soon, no doubt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7fa_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll stand our ground as long as we can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00028754_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll talk later tonight at the gathering.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002c5b7_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll talk later. Meet me at my house after dark.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bf37_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll talk more once I've finished getting Erthor back. For now, I have work to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001551c_Oblivion_RESP1: We'll talk when we're closer, so I can show you what we're facing. Not now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d146_Obliv: We'll try again, I suppose. What does the name Hazadir mean to you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48SavlianWhatDoing_00098143_Obl: We'll try to hold our ground, that's what. If we can't hold this barricade, those beasts could march right down and overrun the encampment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeynonPrioryTopic_000aa08b_Oblivi: We're a Nine Divines priory dedicated to the Order of Talos. Lord Talos teaches us to be prepared to protect his people in peace and war.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a80_Oblivion_RESP3: We're a bit suspicious of strangers here. Don't give us anything to be suspicious about, will you, please?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00023995_Oblivion_RE: We're a mountain people, tough, independent. County Chorrol is rich in mines and timber, wool and mutton, and hard-working people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000479e4_Oblivion_RESP3: We're a small, select organization of crime fighters. We're going after the crimes and criminals the Guard overlooks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003842c_Oblivion_RESP2: We're afraid there may be retribution on Bradon's wife even though she had nothing to do with it. Vampires are a hated lot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000af065_Oblivion_RESP1: We're alive! You did it! You beat that monster! We won!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062bc2_Oblivion: We're all better off now that Necromancy has been banned from the guild. It's just safer that way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607e5_Oblivion_RES: We're all doomed. Jyggalag has won. Sheogorath is dead. The forces of Order are victorious.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d286_Oblivion_RESP1: We're all in your debt for closing that Oblivion Gate outside the city. Well done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk3_0018d7f4_Oblivion_RES: We're all on edge, and for good reason. But we can't give in to panic. Let's deal with this together, as the Blades always have.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607e6_Oblivion_RES: We're all still here. It's a miracle! Someone really needs to write a book about this. Perhaps I should....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018b1f7_Oblivion_RES: We're all talking about the emperor's murder. We have no emperor. And no heir. That's never happened before. I suppose we should all be worried.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_00061418_Oblivion_RESP: We're all wondering when more of those evil Gates are going to open. I'd leave town if I dared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_0018d2a8_Oblivion_RES: We're all wondering when more of those evil Gates are going to open. I'd leave town if I dared.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CropsfordTopic_00023f50_Oblivion_: We're almost ready to start planting crops. Cropsford is really starting to feel like home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028beb_Oblivion_RESP1: We're being stalked, like animals in the forest. I'm still not sure if the killer is one of the other guests, or is hiding somewhere in the house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpAttackA1_00012cca_Oblivio: We're better off storming the main passage, where our superior strength and bladework can come into play.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e4d_Oblivion_RESP1: We're done here. Let's go get paid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033566_Oblivion_RESP1: We're done here. Let's go get paid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b687_Oblivion_RESP1: We're doomed, doomed I tell you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0006052b_Oblivion_RES: We're doomed. The Greymarch can't be stopped. We'll all be Ordered like the old tales tell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7f6_Oblivion_RESP1: We're going to show them daedra a thing or two, aren't we ma'am?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c14a_Oblivion_RESP1: We're going to show them daedra a thing or two, aren't we sir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0003d7b6_Oblivion_: We're just not ready! It takes time to find those beasties and get them back here alive. Remember, just one show a week. Come back some other day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dd3_Oblivion_RESP1: We're looking for fighters and adventurers. You should join up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dcb_Oblivion_RESP1: We're looking for recruits. Think you're tough enough to join the Fighters Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradTopic_0018d303_Oblivion_R: We're next. I'm sure of it. First Kvatch, now Skingrad! The daedra won't stop until we're all dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a13_Oblivion_RESP3: We're not about to let the Guild interfere with our plans, for the Count or otherwise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a14_Oblivion_RESP3: We're not about to let the Guild interfere with our plans, for the Count or otherwise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a15_Oblivion_RESP3: We're not about to let the Guild interfere with our plans, for the Count or otherwise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice1_0008fabc_Oblivion_RES: We're not allowed to take care of it either. There are rules. And I don't want to end up on the Hill of Suicides. You, on the other hand....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_000242ae_Oblivio: We're not fighters; you appear to have more skill than either of us. Would you go to Weatherleah, and see if it's still inhabited by ogres?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugoTopic1Tell_00090b70_Obl: We're pals, right? So we'll kill Black Brugo and be knights! I'll wait right here until you ask me to follow you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000677c8_Obliv: We're peas in a pod, you and I. I'd be happy to offer whatever help I can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AncotarTopic_0003003a_Oblivion_RE: We're pretty sure he's still hiding out in Fort Caractacus, although he never answers when we've tried to find him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ee9_Oblivion_RESP2: We're ready when you are. Just say the word and we'll follow you into that hell-spawned Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEManiaRumorResponses_00061c9d_Ob: We're saved! Sheogorath has protected us once again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002c4d3_Oblivion_RE: We're simple, Gods-fearing folk here in County Chorrol. Easterners worship their wallets and their fat bellies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e91a_Obli: We're so close. Just bring 40 Nirnroot samples, and we can make the best version of the Elixir yet!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c987_Oblivion_RESP: We're still in Cyrodiil here in Bruma, but just barely. We build for the cold, just like in Skyrim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47WhatHappened_00030038_Oblivio: We're sure it was Ancotar's doing, but we can't find him. If you can help us, we will be extremely grateful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTopic_000178cc_Oblivion_RES: We're the Emperor's bodyguards. Our job is to get him out of situations like this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000152ed_Oblivion_RESP1: We're too late... Mehrunes Dagon is here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c991_Oblivion_RESP: We're trying to bring the comfort of the Chapel to the Nords here, but Bruma's Nords stick to their heathen gods and uncivilized practices.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00023e73_Oblivion_RESP1: We're usually called upon to take a life, but not this time. This contract requires us to stage the assassination of a marked man. Are you ready?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301df_Oblivion_RESP1: We've all agreed to let Diram be our spokesman. You'll find him in the inn, if you look very carefully.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000146d2_Oblivion_RESP1: We've been hard at work. Caranya is very determined. You should go talk to her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d76f_Oblivion_RESP1: We've been hit hard. But we'll come back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00092266_Oblivion_RESP2: We've been through too much together already for me to just abandon them to their fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4af_Oblivion_RESP2: We've been trying to foil Faustina's gang for months now. Every time we tried to interview a man who was lured there, they refused to talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000151f4_Oblivion_RESP2: We've been watching the site for a while, and have tried to stay out of sight ever since the original plan was blown.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000294c_Knights_RESP2: We've come all the way from Skyrim to join up. We can't claim any experience as knights, but we learned soldiering from our years in the Legion.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ad7a_Oblivion_RESP1: We've done good work, but this is no time to start patting each other on the back. There's still much to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028865_Oblivion_RESP1: We've done it! I can't believe it -- I didn't really think this would work. Maybe we do have a fighting chance.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e8dd_Oblivion_RESP1: We've failed. I've failed ... The Blades are sworn to protect the Emperor, and now he and all his heirs are dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00002e5d_Oblivion_RESP1: We've got one. Let's hope this one will pay well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356fb_Oblivion_RESP1: We've got some work to do if we're going to stop the Blackwood Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028872_Oblivion_RESP1: We've got to clear out all these goblins. I'll let you know when we've gotten the last of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028003_Oblivion_RESP1: We've got to clear this area so we can pull those people out of the chapel! Kill anything that moves!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003a84f_Oblivion_RESP1: We've got to get out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028168_Oblivion_RESP1: We've got to get out of here! You understand me? We're the only ones left! We need to find a way out of this house! Come on!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028cd4_Obli: We've got to kill that cold-loving bastard before he turns on us! You cover me while I strike the killing blow!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ad78_Oblivion_RESP1: We've got to make it to the castle!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AleswellTopic_00030037_Oblivion_R: We've had travellers through recently that say it's turned into a ghost town. Everyone vanished without a trace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ForlornWatchman_00035cab_Oblivion: We've learned to just accept that he's there. Every night, sure as clockwork, he appears at Bawnwatch Camp at 8 on the shore of Niben Bay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017d0a_Oblivion_RESP2: We've lost control of Brellach. Thadon let them in... We had no idea he would turn on us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b37_Oblivion_RESP2: We've lost control of Pinnacle Rock. Syl let them in... We had no idea she would turn on us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting1_00018c81_O: We've lost too many of the Aureals already. I fear that we will not be able to hold the town for much longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderGreeting1_00018702_O: We've lost too many of the Mazken already. I fear that we will not be able to hold the town for much longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001eb98_Oblivion_RESP1: We've managed to slow them down this time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e82_Oblivion_RESP1: We've met before, haven't we?...  I don't... owe you money, do I?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08TheFringeTopic_00080805_Obliv: We've received reports that the Fringe has come under attack by the forces of Order. We've been commanded to hold our posts and be watchful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13WhoAreYou_000a3847_Oblivion_R: We've sworn to protect Cheydinhal from any threat, and we've entered this Oblivion gate to do just that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47HowToHelp_00030039_Oblivion_R: We've tried to find him, but had no luck. If he's still living in the fort, he's hiding from us, and no wonder.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_000479d5_Oblivion_R: We, of course, have no use for the specialized skills of assassination. It is my task, instead, to train our agents in various aspects of stealth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028864_Oblivion_RESP1: We... we did it? And I'm still in one piece! I mean, of course we did it. I never doubted us for a second.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0005e07a_Oblivion_RESP1: Weapons and armor here. Especially weapons. Sharp ones.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_000242ae_Oblivio: Weatherleah was our family's home for generations. Our parents fled it when ogres attacked; they became separated.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00026ac4_Oblivion_R: Weebam-Na and Bejeen have been bragging about some big score they made recently. They claim it's a valuable jewel. Who knows with those two.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008606e_Oblivion_RESP1: Weebam-Na won't take me to Fisherman's Rock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FishermansRockTopic_000860d8_Obli: Weebam-Na won't take me to Fisherman's Rock. You know where it is?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00037f5b_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome aboard, ma'am. It will be an honor to serve with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00037f5a_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome aboard, sir. It will be an honor to serve with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000029a5_Knights_RESP1: Welcome again to the Altar of Kynareth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001cf1e_Oblivion: Welcome back into the guild. For getting Lex reassinged, you are being promoted to Shadowfoot. Congratulations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00026bb1_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back to the University. It's good to see you again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d935_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back to the Wawnet Inn. Looking for a room? Or did you have any more Shadowbanish Wine for me perhaps?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003cc80_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back to the true world.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00053759_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back to the world, convict! Hahaha.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e444_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back! What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate3_00015638_Oblivio: Welcome back, Muurine. It's been an unusually long while since I've seen you here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e445_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back, friend! It's a pleasure to serve you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314fa_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back, friend. Here is the painting. When you place it in your home and gaze upon it, may you always remember the deed you have done for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bee3_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back. An important task awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00098125_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome back. Have you completed your task for the Count?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047653_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to 'A Fighting Chance'. I'm Rohssan, proprietor. I sell the best swords in the City, and I offer Advanced Training for Armorers.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047655_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to 'The Main Ingredient'. Ogier Georick. If you're an alchemist, then you've come to the right place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e073_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Anvil. If you need a guard, just look around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e884_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Black Waterside Stables. Finest horses in all Cyrodiil. And I'm speaking literally. I'm Tovas Selvan, the owner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009f993_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Bleaker's Way, stranger. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b1215_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Border Watch, stranger. You are welcome here. I am Ri'Bassa, shaman of our people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026903_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Border Watch. A pleasure to see you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000980c8_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Bruma Castle. What's brought you here today?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c97d_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Bruma, stranger. Hafid Hollowleg. I'm your host at Jerall View. Bed, food, whatever you need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031504_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Chorrol Castle. I am Chanel, the court mage. What brings you to me today?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e01_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Chorrol. Keep your nose clean, and we'll be good friends. Make a mistake, and the Chorrol Guard will be all over you like a cheap cuirass.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a9e_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Colovian Traders, Skingrad's finest selection of general merchandise. I'm Gunder. Just let me know what you want.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007ac77_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Earil's Mysteries. As you probably guessed, I'm Earil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001e847_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Jensine's "Good As New" Merchandise!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047664_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Jensine's 'Good as New' Merchandise. I'm Jensine. Take your time. I'll be right here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d761_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Kvatch. We've had a spot of trouble, as you can see. But I'm open for business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475b7_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Leyawiin. I am Alessia Caro, and I have the honor to be the wife of the Count, Marius Caro.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e88a_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Newlands Lodge, the best place to drink in Cheydinhal. Not counting the Chapel... haha. I'm Dervera Romalen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aab_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Pell's Gate. What brings you around here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000237eb_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Renoit's Books. I'm the owner, Estelle Renoit. Look around. If you don't see what you want, please ask.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047682_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to The King and Queen Tavern. We treat all our patrons like royalty! I'm Ley Marillin, your loyal seneschal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047684_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to The King and Queen Tavern. We treat all our patrons like royalty! I'm Pista Marillin, your faithful lady-in-waiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dca2_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to Weynon Priory, a monastic retreat dedicated to Talos and the Nine Divines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018c6b_Oblivion_RESP3: Welcome to Xedilian, I'm the dungeon caretaker, Kiliban Nyrandil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004e95f_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to my home underground. Hehe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000b1218_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to our town, friend. The gods are always watching over Border Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476f4_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the All-Saints Inn. I'm Willet, the publican.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e1d0_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Border Watch Inn. We don't get many visitors. Please feel free to stay a while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003009c_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Brina Cross Inn. Can I interest you in something to eat, or perhaps a bed for the night?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ff11_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Chironasium. Can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000541cf_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Five Riders Stables!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000541ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Five Riders Stables! I have many fine horses for sale. Okay, so only one, but it is a fine Paint horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cf8e_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Flowing Bowl. I'm Caenlorn, the one in blue. My twin Maenlorn is the brown one. Can we rent you a bed?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003cf87_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Flowing Bowl. I'm Maenlorn. My twin's name is Caenlorn. How to tell us apart? I'm in brown. He's in blue. Simple, really.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476df_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Foaming Flask. Good food, good drink. I'm Ernest Manis. Let me know what you need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000038d5_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Great Hall of Castle Chorrol, milady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000038d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Great Hall of Castle Chorrol, milord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004ce56_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Horse Whisperer. Are you interested in a horse?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007cfe1_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the House of Mania.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007d050_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the House of Mania.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001c4aa_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Inn. If it's a room you're after, speak with Christophe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024c89_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Mages Guild. I'm Teekeeus. What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000412ce_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Museum of Oddities! Let me know if you'd like a tour of our exhibits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081526_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Museum of Oddities, Lord Sheogorath. I have collected all the wonders of your lands here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004766e_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Mystic Emporium. Calindil is here, with all your needs, under one roof. Look, and buy. Nothing could be easier.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a697_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Oak and Crosier. This one is Talasma, your hostess. Our rooms and food are at your disposal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004764d_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Orrery. I'm Bothiel, and the Orrery is my baby.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Temple of the Ancestor Moths.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d2f7_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the Wawnet Inn. Could I interest you in a room or perhaps a bit of wine?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038a87_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to the West Weald Inn. I'm Erina Jeranus, the proprietor. If you'd like food or a bed, speak to me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d282_Oblivion_RESP3: Welcome to the guild, and good luck to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_001778c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome to this holy library, Lady Camoran
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c85_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome! If you wish to talk, it is really no trouble at all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251c9_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome! Welcome to the family! I'd hug you, but Ocheeva told me not to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f99a_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Argonian, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f99b_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Breton, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f99c_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Dark Elf, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f99d_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, High Elf, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00043010_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, I'm very glad to see you again. No really, why do you look so doubtful? Have people been lying about me again?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f99e_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Imperial, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f99f_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Khajiit, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate2_00014459_Oblivio: Welcome, Miss Herrick! Welcome! I'd been hoping to have a chance to chat with you. I get the sense that you avoid me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f9a0_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Nord, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f9a1_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Orc, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f9a2_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Redguard, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Salutation_0009f9a3_Oblivion_RESP: Welcome, Wood Elf, to the Tournament of Ten Bloods. To your right, through each of nine gates, another Chosen awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e3f_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, brother. So good to finally meet you. I hope you're getting along all right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05ShrinePassword_0001f10b_Obliv: Welcome, brother. The hour is late, but the Master still has need for willing hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003640e_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, brother. You are one of the Chosen now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d288_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, child, to the Guild of Mages. You shall be called Associate by all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e3c_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, dear Sister! So good to finally meet you! I hope you're getting along all right. If you need anything, anything at all, you need only ask.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, friend, to the Tiber Septim Hotel. I am Augusta Calidia, your hostess.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc94_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, good citizen. I'm Brother Piner, and this is Weynon Priory. A monastery. Can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003997_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, guild mage. We meet again, although in different circumstances.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488be_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, my friend! I am Isabeau Bienne, the ostler of Bay Roan Stables. And today I can sell you such a very fine bay horse!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05ShrinePassword_0001f874_Obliv: Welcome, sister. The hour is late, but the Master still has need for willing hands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036410_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, sister. You are one of the Chosen now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000355c3_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, stranger, to the Five Claws. Food and beds, cheap and good, but most of all, your hostess promises, always clean!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033ef2_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, traveller. We're all so worried about the goblins, we may not be as hospitable as we should be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_0004216e_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome, welcome, to the Arena, good citizens of the Empire!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b459_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome. My master instructed me to show you up immediately. Please follow me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c98_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome. Please, don't be shy. I'm listening.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d23f_Oblivion_RESP1: Welcome. You're now in the sanctuary of the Order of the Virtuous Blood. Few outside our circle have ever set foot in our hallowed hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQLastItem_00026ef7_Oblivion_RESP: Welkynd stones contain the concentrated power of Mundus; their counterparts are Sigil stones, which are used to hold open Oblivion Gates.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDLathonGreetA_00002a79_Knights_R: Well ... yes. But Sir Roderic won many battles all the same. I'm sure if we had had more knights like him we would have beaten the Nords.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00023e4e_Oblivion_RESP1: Well I'll be a spotted Snow Bear -- a customer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseTooMuchChorrol_0004f21a_Obli: Well I'm certainly not about to lower the price.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e84_Oblivion_RESP3: Well I'm sick of it. Sick and tired, tired and sick. And perhaps a little drunk. But nevermind. You look like the honest sort, so I've a job for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00082423_Oblivio: Well aren't you a darling? I know just where I'm going to put this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueGive_0002b527_Oblivion_: Well done! Here is your payment as promised.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000275c1_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done! Not only did you kill the five guests, you acted as an agent of terror and grief. You have earned your reward and bonus, Assassin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ThoronirTopic_0001d03d_Oblivion_R: Well done! This shovel will certainly confirm Agarmir's crimes. Along with the manifest, it should prove useful to the City Watch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistTreeTopic_00035701_Oblivion_R: Well done! With that tree gone, the Blackwood Company is just another band of mercenaries. Cyrodiil is a safer place for what you've done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002aef8_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done! You have much to learn about this business, my friend, but you show definite promise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0000392e_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done! You've put in good work for me. I only wish I had more. Things are a little lean right now, as I'm sure you know. Here's your payment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095531_Obliv: Well done, My Lord. You should have this, as it is one of your artifacts. I don't know why I didn't think to give it to you sooner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002947_Knights_RESP1: Well done, Sir Knight! We are all in your debt. I don't like to think what those Aurorans would have done if you hadn't stopped them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c243_Oblivion_: Well done, champion! Your progress is swift and sure. Perhaps you will reach me after all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07LexReassigned_00098390_Oblivi: Well done, hunter! Hieronymus Lex will no longer be a thorn in the paw of the Thieves Guild. The Gray Fox shows his gratitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMephalaSpeech_000579db_Oblivion: Well done, little webspinner. Is there a prettier sight than friends at war? Take pleasure in the strife you have caused, mortal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002887f_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done, my friend. This mine is once again safe for the miners.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12CmdrAnswer2_0001c490_Oblivion: Well done, soldier. Your mission is complete, and you have my thanks. Now we may rest. Long live the Akavir!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d296_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done. Bruma will never fall while you and our intrepid Captain Burd are on duty!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009171f_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done. I suppose you deserve your new post. Now, if only you stay alive long enough to enjoy it...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000915c2_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done. I suppose you deserve your new post. Now, if only you stay alive long enough to enjoy it....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b72_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done. Summoned again. I applaud you.
