ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMeridiaSpeech_000579b9_Oblivion: Well done. Those creatures were an affront to all life, and they have paid the price for their actions. Take this ring and go with my blessing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024e53_Oblivion_RESP1: Well done. You are now a member of the Order of the Mythic Dawn, one of the Chosen. Your life belongs to Lord Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095532_Obliv: Well done. You should have this, one of the artifacts of the Realm. Perhaps it should have been given to you sooner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0005375d_Oblivion_RESP1: Well go get it! What good is it doing if you're standing here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity10_00081e95_Oblivion_RE: Well isn't that just the Oddest thing! A dagger that heals people. Who would make such a thing, and why? I absolutely adore it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CutoffTopic_00079b66_Oblivion: Well look at this, I found the easy road. How are things going over there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000319cd_Oblivion_RESP1: Well met! Come, warm yourself by our fire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00189183_Oblivion_RESP1: Well met, adventurer. A moment of your time if you please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018bafb_Oblivion_RESP1: Well met, citizen. I see few new faces these days, it seems. With the Emperor's murder, a darkness has fallen upon all of Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071f51_Oblivion_RESP1: Well met, traveler. Are you seeking treasure as well? Gortwog demands riches, so all of Tamriel will respect Orsinium.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002931_Knights_RESP1: Well met, traveler. Have you heard the call of the Prophet? Do you walk the Pilgrim's Way?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00189cfb_Oblivion_RESP1: Well met. I trust no great harm has befallen you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018885c_Oblivion_RESP1: Well met. Welcome to the Bloated Float. She's the finest inn on the water in all Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006fdbe_Oblivion_RESP1: Well now, I didn't expect to see anyone else foolish enough to venture out here in the rain! How do you fare, citizen?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033360_Oblivion_R: Well now, a pretty little Wood Elf. You're a little far from the forest, huh? Looks like your days of woodland frolicking have come to a tragic end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000bf1c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Well now, what do we have here? Caught in the act and no gold to pay your fine? I'm confiscating your stolen goods. Now it's off to jail with ya!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054032_Oblivion_RESP1: Well now, what might you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00044f51_Oblivion_RESP1: Well now, what news do you have to report?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003a90a_Oblivion_RESP1: Well now, who do we have here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008af_Oblivion_RESP1: Well now, you are an ambitious one, aren't you? I'm afraid I have no more contracts for you. Our time working together has come to an end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002f87d_Oblivion_RESP1: Well now, you are an ambitious one, aren't you? I'm afraid I have no more contracts for you. Our time working together has come to an end.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS23SeridurHeSays_000947c1_Oblivi: Well of course he'd say that! He'd do anything to save his skin!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11ErlineOpinion_00038444_Oblivi: Well of course it does! It was obviously planted here. Why would he stash a body in his own house? That's ridiculous!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril3_00002c52_Knights_RE: Well said. I will endeavor to follow your example, and continue to train for the day when we are able to strike back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29InvNice_0001d049_Oblivion_RES: Well thank you! It's not only a fine assortment of goods, but a bit of a treasure trove; you never know what I'll have in stock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetGreetA2_00002aa9_Knights: Well then, "Hail, Hero of Kvatch!" Let me add one more voice to the neverending chorus of praise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02FinChoice1B_00023e49_Oblivi: Well then, I suggest you get your affairs in order and return to me as soon as you're able.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12PaleYes_00018235_Oblivion_RES: Well then, history lesson notwithstanding, I hope you can recover the Draconian Madstone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007028f_Oblivion_RESP1: Well then, it's back to the open road for us, eh? Stay safe, my friend. And stay clear of those Goblins. Little buggers have been getting cocky...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueNo_0002b464_Oblivion_RE: Well then, you have work to do. I will continue to search the archives for any clues to the statues' locations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueNo_0002b5ed_Oblivion_RE: Well then, you have work to do. You'd best be on your way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS13GateHeard_00031c81_Oblivion_R: Well then, you know what they're capable of producing. Although, nothing has come through ever since Farwil entered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice7B_00028c7b_Oblivion_RE: Well then, you must excuse me. I have important business to attend to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinB_0002d077_Oblivion_RESP1: Well then. If you re-think your decision, I'll be around.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04NoRingYet_00035fc1_Oblivion_R: Well then. It seems you still have a job to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DSNo_00023671_Oblivion_RESP1: Well then... I suppose I must believe you. At least now I can be sure... [Scribbles something on a piece of paper.] Here. This is your last task.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00073111_Oblivion_RESP1: Won't someone end me? Take my life, please!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b59d_Oblivion_RESP1: Wonder why Solstheim wasn't on the old maps... not that anyone should care.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d2ae_Obliv: Wonderful thing, wine. It's all about the balance. The flavor, the bouquet, the consistency... just wonderful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00091d2d_Obli: Wonderful to have it back. Really, truly. I can't thank you enough. Oh, wait. I already did.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEOdditiesTourYes_00081eba_Oblivi: Wonderful! Follow me, and I'll show you around my little collection of Oddities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseBuyAnvil_0004ce5a_Oblivion_R: Wonderful! Go out front. Ernest will have the White saddled and ready for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS37SdrassaHelp_00022e5f_Oblivion: Wonderful! I had a good feeling about you from the moment that I saw you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathChoice3_00026af3_Obli: Wonderful! I would be glad to tell you more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00081eab_Oblivio: Wonderful! I'll put you on my list of Special Donors. It's a very exclusive list, you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38Oddity2_00043427_Oblivion_RES: Wonderful! Looking at the tentacle, I'm not sure whether to be disgusted or terrified. Just the kind of thing I'm looking for!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueGive_000844c3_Oblivion_: Wonderful! Remember, I will be happy to give you the same price for any others that you find.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04XedilianChoice_00044f52_Obliv: Wonderful! Time for a celebration... Cheese for everyone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22GiveCarving_0002af38_Oblivion: Wonderful! You are indeed a treasure hunter of exceptional talents! Here is your reward as promised!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightshadeTopic_00053735_Oblivion: Wonderful. I do hope you didn't try to eat any of it. It can have very nasty effects on one such as yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyBruma_0004f215_Oblivion_R: Wonderful. I'll have the deed transfered to you. Here is your key to the door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000852b3_Oblivion_RESP1: Wonderful. People are dropping dead and I'm trapped here looking for gold I don't even need! I'll be happy just to find the key and get out of here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016e95_Oblivion_RESP1: Wondering why I let her go, aren't you? I can see it in your face. Mostly in the eyes. I may take those from you when this is done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014442_Oblivion_RESP1: Wondering why I let him go, aren't you? I can see it in your face. Mostly in the eyes. I may take those from you when this is done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b596_Oblivion_RESP1: Wood Elves. Why? What's the point?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk3_0006a859_Oblivion_R: Word certainly gets around fast, doesn't it? Don't tell me -- Antoinetta has been running her mouth off again. Anyway, nothing I couldn't handle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_000151f8_Oblivion_RESP1: Word has been sent that the Necromancers have been quite busy, creating black soul gems for their master.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GuardTalk1_0006fdd2_Oblivion_RESP: Word's come down from the captain. No breaks until further notice. You ask me, he knows something. There's trouble brewin'.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002db93_Oblivion_RESP2: Words are... difficult. They come and go. The voices, though. So loud they are, they drown out the words.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be65_Oblivion_RESP1: Words cannot express my gratification for your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000314fc_Oblivion_RESP1: Words cannot to do justice for the joy I feel... many blessings upon you, my friend. I do not have much, but I wish to reward such valor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3bb_Oblivion_RESP3: Words dripped like honey from his tongue and his songs were intoned with extraordinary verisimilitude.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e919_Obli: Words fail me at this point. There must be no stone unturned in all Cyrodiil. I don't know what else to say but to thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPykeZoeMaleneResponses_00091b54: Words like that make me happy to be here with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001d0b2_Oblivion_RES: Words... fail me. I knew that Thoronir obtained his goods through dark dealings, but I never would have imagined this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_jobs_0002c7a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Work is good for money. You know something, tell Vantus. He'll put me to work. Give me money.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007109a_Oblivion_RESP1: Work on him until he talks. Try not to kill him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37EndConversation_000452e6_Obli: Work! Never. You're supposed to feel sorry for me and just give it to me. Oh! My legs are itching again. Time to run!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Idle_0018b5a9_Oblivion_RESP1: Work, work, work. Keeps my hands busy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGDPost2_0006e2dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Works for me. More contracts keep the men busy and out of trouble. It also helps bring in more gold, which benefits us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CurseTopic_00002b1d_Knights_R: Would someone taking that responsibility be merciful, or suicidal?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GSWardenGreet2_00018db8_Obliv: Would that I could exact satisfaction upon you for that insult.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000452f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Would you be willing to collect some Flame Stalk for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624eb_Oblivion_RES: Would you believe Owyn once asked for my hand in marriage? It's true! Poor bastard was heart-broken when I turned him down. I'm old, not desperate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice2B_00022b6b_Oblivion_RE: Would you dare make demands of me now?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d96_Oblivion_RESP: Would you even now attempt to trick me? You do not have what I requested.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d97_Oblivion_RESP: Would you even now attempt to trick me? You do not have what I requested.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d14c_Obliv: Would you learn from me? Then meet me during the day, out under the waves in the bay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002db93_Oblivion_RESP4: Would you lift your hands to help another, to help me find the words?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00073119_Oblivion_RESP1: Would you like a blade to cut open your foes?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEOdditiesTourTopic_00081eb8_Obli: Would you like a tour of the Museum?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37SellSpells_0007b220_Oblivion_: Would you like one of these?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ01Bread_001885dd_Oblivion_RESP1: Would you like to buy some of my Famous Potato Bread?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000299f_Knights_RESP6: Would you listen to my tale, and learn of the Gauntlets' fate?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023e7b_Oblivion_RESP1: Would you look at this! My brother - my spitting image - is here! I can't thank you enough, friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND07LathonGreetE1_00002b79_Knight: Would you make me a Knight of the Nine? I want to dedicate myself to ridding the world of evil. I owe it to Sir Roderic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071fa4_Oblivion_RESP1: Would you mind stepping to the side so I can sweep there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMQ3_00002d13_Knigh: Would you not do the same, children of Cyrodiil? No, you would not! This is plain!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000781ea_Oblivion_RESP2: Wouldn't surprise me if you were here spying on me for You-Know-Who.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000aed44_Oblivion_RESP1: Wow! You're the Grand Champion! I saw your fight against the Gray Prince!  You're the best! Can I... Can I follow you around? I won't get in the way!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00049895_Oblivion_RES: Wow. Palonirya is a tough negotiator. Hard to get her prices down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene01aPositive_0000c1ec_Ob: Wrath? I told him to guard the wheel and not talk to anybody. Who are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05TarMeenaYesBooks_00024e81_Obl: Write this down: "Green Emperor Way Where Tower Touches Midday Sun."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingCaenlorn02_0003cf91_Obliv: Wrong! I'm the one in blue! Maenlorn is the one in brown.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene05Negative_00015263_Obl: Wrong, fetcher! I'm tired of this conversation! Time to end it with steel!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene03Negative_000980fc_Obl: Wrong, fool. I've grown tired of this guessing game. I've much to do and you're in the way. I aim to rectify that!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008ef55_Oblivion_RESP1: Xeddefen has been silent, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebeb_Oblivion_RESP1: Xeddefen is the goal, Your Grace. We will hold the town as long as we can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AXedilian_00018df4_Oblivion_R: Xedilian is the ultimate test of mettle for the foolhardy adventurer that dares trespass into the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AHowDoI_00018df5_Oblivion_RES: Xedilian would normally have sent you back to the entrance when you stepped on the pad in the Resonator Chamber.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01SulinusConv_0002d918_Oblivion: Y-yes. I understand. I'll head there right now, okay?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark19Choice2D_0009e66e_Oblivion_: Y... Yes dear Listener! I... I will wait in the Sanctuary until you have further need of me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkoomaYes_0008f7b: YES! Now that's what I'm talking about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8dc_Oblivion_RESP1: Yeah! I'm Bazur gro-Gharz. I got protection from the Orum Gang. So don't mess with me. Or they'll fillet you real good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_0001e067_Oblivion_RESP: Yeah, I know all about it. I overheard Agata and Dagail talking. And you know what? I'm glad it's gone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0003d7b5_Oblivion_: Yeah, I know, you already told me. That's why there's an Arena full of Spectators and some hungry creature that wants to make you its lunch!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224c6_Oblivion_RESP1: Yeah, I still got rooms. What do you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000b1250_Oblivion_RESP1: Yeah, I've got a room. 10 gold for the night. You sure you want it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01FindMethredhel_00016257_Obliv: Yeah, I've heard of her. I'm going to need a few coins first though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AleronLocheTopic_00071321_Oblivio: Yeah, Ursanne's husband, Aleron is missing. Poor thing, I've seen her crying at the chapel. I hope someone can help her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ushnar_00072dc0_Oblivion_RESP: Yeah, he eats here. Terrified of cats though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AerinsCampTopic_000613bc_Oblivion: Yeah, it's her camp. I don't know where she is, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDChapelAttackTopic_00002b9a_Knig: Yeah, just when you think things can't get any worse, right? Whatever you think about priests, they didn't deserve to be slaughtered like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09TyrelliusTalk_000908ed_Oblivi: Yeah, sure. And I suppose I just end up rotting while you spend it all? Forget it.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04WhereIsAmusei_0000a174_Oblivi: Yeah, we got him here. Argonians aren't allowed visitors though. Countess Alessia's orders. She has a thing about the lizard folk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04GuardsConvo_0009533b_Oblivi: Yeah, well, I guess you can't blame Captain Montrose too much. This is his big career move, after all. Got to impress that lot upstairs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04DrethConvo_00045f83_Oblivio: Yeah, well, what's it been? Seven, eight years? We've had a good long run, you and me. I always knew it would end someday.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04GuardsConvo_0009533a_Oblivi: Yeah, what a laugh, huh? Just who are we keeping secure? Dreth? Since that other one got away, he's the only one rotting down here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice4_0008fabb_Oblivion_RES: Yeah, whatever. This whole conversation has worn me out. Just stay away from the other Horkvir.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003335d_Oblivion_R: Yeah, you heard me. No matter what the law says. No matter what they told you. You're going to die in here! You're going to die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9a3_Oblivion_RESP: Yeah, you think Bruma's cold, try a winter in the Wrothgarians. Bruma's a day at the beach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000475af_Oblivion_RESP1: Yeah. Buy a goddam book. It's a bookstore, ain't it? Don't just go peeking at them! Buy one!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8da_Oblivion_RESP2: Yeah. I don't need you. So go away, huh? I'm asking real nice, because my mom brought me up right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002a371_Oblivion_RE: Yeah. I used to be Fighters Guild here in Chorrol, but I done some incarceration for Trespassing and Theft. Couple of times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_0006445f_Oblivion: Yeah. I've heard of him. Isn't he a soldier or guardsman in the Imperial City?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AxeofDragol_0001f431_Oblivion_RES: Yeah. It's a battleaxe with the word "Dragol" carved into the haft. Huge. You can't miss it. I ain't gonna draw you a picture.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007be99_Oblivion_RESP1: Yeah. Restita Statlilia. I work at the Chestnut Handy Stables. Have you seen our horses wandering around? No? Okay. It's just that they're missing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8b4_Oblivion_RESP2: Yeah. This is the Cheydinhal Fighter's Guild. Look around. See any fighters? Right. That's the problem. No fighters, no guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo10_00090b7d_Oblivion_RE: Yeah. Well. Maybe you're right. A real knight shouldn't act like a jerk to his pals.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8cb_Oblivion_RESP1: Yeah? I don't care who you are. I ain't talking to you. You ain't from around here. So push off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackBrugo04_00090b77_Oblivion_RE: Yeah? Well, good luck. Let me know how it comes out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice7B_00085a6a_Oblivion_: Yeah? You think? Okay, I'll just try to calm down. Calm down, Dovesi, calm down... I'll just take it slow. I can do that. Thanks again, dear friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8da_Oblivion_RESP1: Yeah? You're who? And why do I care, exactly?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeersStone_0001e067_Oblivion_RESP: Years of service to the Empire, and not even a tombstone over his head! Hrmph. At least he was able to maintain the illusion of sanity.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Goblins_000319cf_Oblivion_RES: Yep, we're in a real predicament. Do you think you might be able to help us by getting rid of the goblins on our land?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_000352a5_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes I can. You are under arrest for the theft of the bust of Llathasa Indarys, Countess of Cheydinhal. Come with me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ08Wine_0018d92d_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes actually, I'm quite fond of collecting all manners of wines from all over Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopAgarmir_0001d047_Oblivion: Yes! That's the least I can do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BSylLeaves_0003b81d_Oblivion_: Yes! That's what I'll do. I'll go. The enemy of my enemy. Order is the key. I'll keep them close.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32MagicDagger_00012d1c_Oblivion: Yes! Yes! I can use this to charge my magicka. All I need is a source...someone nearby...someone with magicka. Someone on the list!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice4A_00085860_Oblivion_: Yes! Yes! We must kill that foul Nord before he slits our throats! Aaaaaiiiieee!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk3_00002bb7_Knights_RESP1: Yes! Yes, the time has come! I've been waiting for this moment! So, what's your plan?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageConvWait_0006bd9f_Oblivion_RE: Yes, Arch-Mage. I shall await your return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Arden_0001f3bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, Arden-Sul. Doesn't the name simply roll wonderfully off the tongue?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTopic_00033fca_Oblivion_RES: Yes, Baurus told you right. I am the Grandmaster of the Blades. We serve the Emperor and the Septim bloodline. Talos is our patron.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251d4_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, Brother? What can old Gogron do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00037b4f_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, Cyrus. This is the Emperor's son, Martin Septim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ff09_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, Faelian has been killed, but you did not exercise discretion. How many witnesses were there? We may never know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003489e_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, Faelian has been killed, but you did not exercise discretion. How many witnesses were there? We may never know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071dc1_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, Guildmaster? What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE34ExplainMore_0008f7b8_Oblivion: Yes, I admit that being a Knight of the Thorn no longer holds any interest for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SpeakerTopic_000bba99_Oblivion_RE: Yes, I am a Speaker, a representative of the Dark Brotherhood. My voice is the voice of the Black Hand, our organization's ruling body.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KnightsofThorn_000c452a_Oblivion_: Yes, I am a member of the Knights of the Thorn. Or what's left of them anyway.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00073109_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, I can take a moment to talk with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkVampChoice2_000008f0_Oblivion: Yes, I can understand your trepidation. For it is not everyday one is invited to join the ranks of the undead, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkVampChoice2_0004ce44_Oblivion: Yes, I can understand your trepidation. For it is not everyday one is invited to join the ranks of the undead, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_000613a1_Obliv: Yes, I did quite a bit of traveling. Back before I met Silgor, and decided to settle down. It's all about pacing yourself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09JoinedGuild_00018335_Oblivion: Yes, I did. After you saved me in Castle Skingrad, I vowed to join. I was having no luck on my own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KvatchTopic_0018ad5a_Oblivion_RES: Yes, I followed the priest here. I'll be safe here, won't I? They can't come on holy ground, can they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47Invisible_0003003c_Oblivion_R: Yes, I have been working on a new invisibility spell. As you can see, it works quite well. Why?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting1b_00019cd1_O: Yes, I have heard of you. Tell me, is it true? Has Sheogorath sent you to kill Ciirta for her vendetta against Him?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Investigation_00031528_Oblivion_R: Yes, I have heard that the painting of the Count was taken. I was unaware she hired an outsider to conduct the investigation. May luck be with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c0cd_Oblivion_RESP: Yes, I have the staff Varon sold me. I'm afraid I'm not willing to part with it. I paid good money for it, after all. You understand, of course.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Topic_00028d70_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, I heard Bernadette Peneles say that she thought he was following her. It might finally be time to do something about that crazy Wood Elf.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0005f1eb_Oblivion_RES: Yes, I know the Gatekeeper is back, but so what? He's missing the best parts, so what's the point?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FaelianTopic_0002ff0f_Oblivion_RE: Yes, I know who Faelian is. Know quite a bit about him, actually. But... I probably shouldn't gossip. I mean, we hardly know each other...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BThadon_000167de_Oblivion_RES: Yes, I must attend to him. Speaking to you has already cost me time. I must go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00081368_Oblivion_: Yes, I orchestrated it. Syl deserves to die a painful death for turning on all of us, and consorting with our enemies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gelebourne_0003857d_Oblivion_RESP: Yes, I remember Bradon mentioning that name once. He was part of the brotherhood he had created with Raynil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice3A_00022b6c_Oblivion_RE: Yes, I see that now. I regret that Traven has involved you in this way. At least you've survived... for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07AReplace_00013fff_Oblivion_RE: Yes, I see you may have what it takes to replace her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArdalineTopic_0002ba5f_Oblivion_R: Yes, I sort of know her. Well, I mean I don't really know her, but I've talked to her some.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS11LastChance_0003858c_Oblivion_: Yes, I suppose it is. Well, then, we've talked enough. Only one of us will walk out of here alive this day. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00000929_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, I think ... no.  Wait.  Never mind.  I must go now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001da69_Oblivion_RE: Yes, I think that the Order will live on. Give me time to make arrangements, and meet me in Seridur's basement.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a6c_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, I'm selling my grandfather's house, Benirus Manor. If you're interested, I could let you have it for a modest sum.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e65f_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, I'm the city's Arena Gatekeeper, but I'm not on duty now. If you want to bet on a fight, see me at the Arena between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KudEiTopic_00027f32_Oblivion_RESP: Yes, I'm the one looking for my friend. His name is Henantier. If you find him, I'll be glad to offer you a sizeable reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35Brithaur_00078662_Oblivion_RE: Yes, I've heard of Brithaur's "exploits" in Crucible. Up until now, I thought he was harmless.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_000878d6_Oblivio: Yes, I've heard of the place, but I'm not sure where it is. I think your best bet would be to speak to Sabine Laul at the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fb9_Obli: Yes, I've heard some of the finest mages in Tamriel belong to the Mages Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolNQDResponses_00029fb5_Obli: Yes, I've heard the Fighters Guild offers some wonderful opportunities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0007130c_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes, I've noticed some of them in my establishment. They don't break the law while they're here so there's nothing I can do.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGJoin1_0002427f_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes. Unfortunately, it seems you have a price on your head. Clear that up, and perhaps we can speak about this again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019d69_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes. What can I do for you? I imagine you're here about the door?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice5a_00085863_Oblivion_: Yes. Yes, this whole thing has taken quite a bit out of me. I think I'll go to my room for a bit and get some sleep. Thanks for the talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChalYes_0003a916_Obli: Yes. Yes... I accept your challenge. Go... Go speak with Ysabel. Tell her you're ready. Then we'll... We'll meet in the Arena. Yes, that'll do...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12MartinA2_000a31c5_Oblivion_RE: Yes. You did. I can't force you to do anything. I understand that. And I thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEStrangeDoor_000133df_Oblivion_R: Yes. You have entered and now you are here. Amazing. Truly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081b6c_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes. You've gotten rather proficient with your new ability. As I said, try not to abuse your power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000291a_Knights_RESP1: Yes... I heard of you. Found a few relics and you imagine yourself to be the next Whitestrake, do you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalk3_00002bb4_Knights_RESP1: Yes... Yes, I see. You have a strategy, then? A plan?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07Become_00013657_Oblivion_RESP: Yes... how we would all aspire to be as great a leader as the First... our savior Arden-Sul, the greatest Duke of the ages.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gelebourne_0003844c_Oblivion_RESP: Yes... that's right. Somewhere in Skingrad I believe. He said he tracked Gelebourne down and killed him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefendA3_00018f9a_Oblivio: Yes... yes! Their commander, Kaneh, is gullible enough to take you at face value...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03Reactivated_0008e94b_Oblivion: Yes? Ah... silly me. The book has no pictures. Can't really expect you to read that, now can I?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007cf43_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Change of heart? Do tell.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e49_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Do you have questions about your contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AyleidStatueTopic_0002b43f_Ob: Yes? Have you found another statue for me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073024_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? How can I help you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e400_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? How may I assist you? I'd be happy to help, if helping you means helping Thadon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee61_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? I assume you've spoken to that lout Maglir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutside_000790b1_Oblivio: Yes? I have idea for you. But first sweetroll for Fimmion. Sweetroll for Fimmion, idea for you! Saa-WEET-ROOOOLL!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002db92_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Is there something I can help you with, Associate?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002e40_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Is there something else I can help you with?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002dd9_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Is there something you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251c0_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Is there something you need?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072c8f_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Is there something you require?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072c94_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Oh look, you have some pod pits! I need five of those myself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESheogorathTopic_00078caa_Oblivi: Yes? Speaking to me? I'm he. He's me. And others, as well. Or, they were. Weren't they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035676_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? The Mages Guild, you say?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006edeb_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? What can I do for you, my tight-lipped friend?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036619_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? What can I do for you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013566_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? What do you want? Out with it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001a112_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? What is it you want?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00090e2f_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? What news are you bringing me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_0001ac5a_Oblivion_: Yes? What would you have me say about it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026a9e_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? Why do you not approach the Shrine?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000844bb_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? You have something of interest to me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4be_Oblivion_RESP1: Yes? You need my help, don't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Retirement_00067dd3_Oblivion_: Yessir, I worked too hard to collect that money. I'm not about to let anyone steal it from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ09Retirement_000cbb73_Oblivion_: Yessir, I worked too hard to collect that money. I'm not about to let anyone steal it from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0007b726_Oblivion_RESP1: Yessir, no more fish for me. Just long peaceful days ahead for ol' Aelwin Merowald.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007b727_Oblivion_RESP1: Yessir, no more fish for me. Just long peaceful days ahead for ol' Aelwin Merowald.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08UrsanneTell_0001f42b_Oblivion: Yesterday, the usurer, Kurdan gro-Dragol, sent for my husband to meet him at the Lonely Suitor Lodge. He hasn't returned since.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AmuletofKingsTopic_00033fcc_Obliv: Yet those gates to Oblivion existed. The old rules no longer apply. Kvatch is only the beginning of what Mehrunes Dagon will do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073016_Oblivion_RESP1: Yikes! Get away from me you foul beast!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00042ff1_Oblivion_RESP1: Yikes! Get away from me you foul beast! Somebody help! A mountain lion has gotten into the village!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043520_Oblivion_RES: Yikes! To bad that Resonator of Judgment doesn't get rid of troublesome beasts. I bet you could swallow me whole, couldn't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047355_Oblivion_RESP2: You ... how can you be here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd68_Oblivion_RESP1: You Elves are all the same! All flash and no fury!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_000488ba_Oblivion_RES: You MUST have a fast horse! Travel quickly to ruined forts and caves nearby! It will pay for itself in precious time saved!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a366_Oblivion_RESP1: You MUST leave! If you don't, I'll call the guards!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022f11_Oblivion_: You actually found them? Interesting. I'll have to make a note of that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038b31_Oblivion_RESP1: You again, huh? Look, I told you, if you want to challenge the Gray Prince that's your right. But don't say I didn't warn you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00029d5e_Oblivion_RESP1: You again, huh? So what is it this time? Better start talkin' before my sword starts swingin'!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002b3d1_Oblivion_RESP1: You again. Are you ready yet?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee75_Oblivion_RESP1: You again. Fine. I imagine you're looking for work from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003b968_Oblivion_RESP1: You again. Guess you're not afraid of catching it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00023ff3_Oblivion_RESP1: You again. Have you reconsidered? The offer still stands. Say the word, and I'll tell you all about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ee5e_Oblivion_RESP1: You again. I imagine I know why you're here, guild rat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d92c_Oblivion_RESP1: You again. What is it this time?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251ff_Oblivion_RESP1: You again? I thought I'd made it clear I'm not looking for a friend. If you're here to buy or sell something, get on with it already!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003be82_Oblivion_RESP1: You again? Make it quick. I have work to do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038b34_Oblivion_RESP1: You again? You're becoming a real pain in my arse, you know that? I thought I made myself clear. You don't belong down here. Now get!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002b106_Oblivion_RESP1: You ain't gonna stop until you hit Champion, are you? Well good! The Blue Team needs as much glory as we can get!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002529b_Oblivion_RESP1: You ain't one of me crew. What business ye be havin' here, mate?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_0004666b_Oblivion_RESP1: You almost have to feel bad for the Yellow Team's Khajiit, for the Blue Team's Gladiator is a combatant you know and love! Let's see how they fare!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Manor_00003a60_Oblivion_RESP1: You already bought the manor, and I have nothing more to say about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CureforVampirism_0005c2fd_Oblivio: You already have the cure. Shouldn't you be delivering that somewhere?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_00089530_Oblivion_: You already know my part in this. There is nothing more to say.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Benefits_0004b831_Oblivion_RE: You also have the ability to affect the weather in your Realm. As it is an extension of yourself, it will often have an effect on you, as well.
You also have the benefit of Sheogorath's Protection. Cast this upon yourself, and if your life is threatened, you will be returned to your castle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e00_Oblivion_RESP3: You also managed to leave Phillida's severed finger as a warning to his successor. Well done! Your bonus, 500 additional gold coins, is well earned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJauffreHelp_0005d2c7_Oblivion_R: You also should talk to Prior Maborel and Brother Piner. I'm sure they will help you in whatever way they can.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_0003e453_DLCThievesDen_RES: You always bring in good business.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d2a0_Oblivion_RESP1: You and Captain Burd sure gave them daedra a good kick in the teeth. I wish I had been there to see it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008670f_Oblivion_RESP1: You and I are the only ones left, but we're not alone in this house. That killer is in here with us, hiding. But where?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00092d87_Oblivion_RESP1: You and I are the only ones left. But we did it. We survived. We... we won!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08MothPriestNote_0001474a_Obliv: You and I have even met before, when I was not wearing the cowl. To your clouded memory he and I are two different people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251d3_Oblivion_RESP1: You and I, we've got to stick together, eh? The others, they don't understand. Orcs may not be quiet, but can anyone kill as well as us? Never!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004f3e7_Oblivion_RESP1: You and Maglir need to catch those thieves.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NelsTheNaughtyTopic_00028180_Obli: You and Nels... both still alive. One of you is a cold-blooded killer! I... I never did trust that Nord....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002d716_Oblivion_RESP1: You and Viranus are to go to Nonwyll and find out what happened to Galtus Previa. Now get to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e587_Oblivion_RESP1: You and Viranus have business to attend to. Why are you wasting time here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05WhatIsPlan_0000c05d_Oblivion_: You and four other operatives will stage high profile thefts, all at the same time. Hopefully that will force Lex to reassign the Watchmen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_0006834c_Oblivion_RES: You and the other Blades have extended me every courtesy. But please, don't forget, I'm just a man. I need the company of friends, like any other.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d149_Obliv: You answer a simple question, and I'll think about training you. So here it is: What does the name Hazadir mean to you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice2_000133e1_Obliv: You approach the Shivering Isles. Through the door behind me lies the realm of Sheogorath, Prince of Madness, Lord of the Never-There.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebd5_Oblivion_RESP1: You approach the Shrine of Boethia. Tread lightly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aa7_Oblivion_RESP1: You approach the Shrine of Clavicus Vile. You should not be here unless you have business with Lord Clavicus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebcf_Oblivion_RESP1: You approach the Shrine of Hircine. Are you hunter, or are you prey?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebcc_Oblivion_RESP1: You approach the Shrine of Mephala. The Webspinner watches you, stranger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000251d9_Oblivion_RESP1: You are Argonian, yes, but you are no Shadowscale! What chaos you must have known as a hatchling! Thank Sithis you have come home at last. Welcome.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_00188f41_Oblivion_RES: You are Conjurer no more. Guild members shall now address you as Magician. Congratulations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026ddf_Oblivion_RESP1: You are a breaker of Tenets, and have been eternally exiled from the Dark Brotherhood! Begone from here, and never return!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor02_0002ad13_Oblivion_RES: You are a citizen of Tamriel, and you, too, shall serve her in your own way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001470c_Oblivion_RESP1: You are a credit to the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000276a5_Oblivion_RESP1: You are a diplomat as well as a warrior, it seems! I would prefer more men, of course, but if we must offer battle now, so be it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000356a6_Oblivion_RESP1: You are a fool to be here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Minx02Negative_0001525a_Obliv: You are a liar! Lynch had specific instructions not to disturb me. Since you came from below decks, you must have gotten past Lynch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkDisappearances_00014e21_Altar: You are a noble soul and a follower of the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00094ebc_Oblivion_RESP1: You are a person of your word. You must hasten to Rosentia and tell her at once!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGNoBloodPrice_0001c4e4_Oblivion_: You are a rogue hunter. Membership in the Thieves Guild is denied. Leave me now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071f6d_Oblivion_RESP1: You are a skillful thief. The guild is lucky to have you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014e87_AltarDeluxe_RES: You are a true champion to the Nines and you shall be rewarded.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bfa0_Oblivion_RESP1: You are a welcome sight in these troubling times.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12GotStoneAlready_00026efc_Obli: You are a wonder! Not only the Hero of Kvatch, but the Master of Miscarcand as well!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0011cad6_Oblivion_RESP1: You are about to witness the glorious rebirth of Ayleid civilization. Stand aside!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002957_Knights_RESP1: You are almost ready to confront your nemesis, Umaril. Do not allow yourself to be led astray now, so close to victory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00189d0c_Oblivion_RESP1: You are always welcome at Harm's Folly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a45_Kni: You are an asset to your Order. You have claimed the Boots, and for this I am grateful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002910_Knights_RESP2: You are an embodiment of Pelinal Whitestrake, the bane of Umaril the Unfeathered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07LexReassigned_00098390_Oblivi: You are being promoted to Shadowfoot, and may now use Orrin of Castle Anvil as your fence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DABoethiaChoice1_0001ec92_Oblivio: You are brave. Or suicidal. Approach then, and make an offering. Boethia demands a daedra's heart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ClaudeMaricTopic_0002c525_Oblivio: You are cautious and perceptive. Good traits to have in this business. Yes, you guess correctly. This one is working for Maric.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32AcolyteWarning_0005a753_Obliv: You are defiling this holy place!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueGive_0002b51f_Oblivion_: You are doing very well in your treasure hunt, my friend. Only one more statue remains to be discovered!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00025291_Oblivion_RESP1: You are finding your contracts agreeable, I hope?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MankarCamoranTopic_00097cc2_Obliv: You are fortunate indeed, to have heard the Master preach at your initiation!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GSWardenGreet2_00018dbb_Obliv: You are fortunate that my duty forbids me from satisfying my honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002955_Knights_RESP1: You are fortunate. A vision from the Divine Crusader himself is a sign of high favor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04Choice1A_0002ee4f_Oblivion_RE: You are going to help me do so.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014e87_AltarDeluxe_RES: You are hebery made a Paladin of the Hour and shall receive weapons and gear befitting the hero of Akatosh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081da9_Oblivion_RESP1: You are here to help rebuild the Gatekeeper. That is very good of you... considering what you did to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003999_Oblivion_RESP1: You are here to see the Count, yes? He has been expecting you. Please, wait here. I shall inform him of your arrival.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22SrazirrPay_0002c820_Oblivion_: You are honorable. Unlike that renrij Maric, may the moons never shine upon his path. This one will not forget.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC1_0003e8f6_Oblivion_: You are impertinent, mortal. I did not offer to answer questions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000a173_Oblivion_RESP1: You are in good spirits today, milady
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireAshTopic_000977d8_Oblivion: You are indeed a force to be reckoned with. I shall take the ashes; finally, some part of him can be put to a good use.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002526c_Oblivion_RESP1: You are like a dark gift from the Night Mother herself. Please, tell me how I can help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00009175_Oblivion_RESP1: You are like an unholy vision. So beautiful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01BribeBeggar_00007dff_Oblivion: You are most generous! He lives in the Temple district on the far east side. He's an early riser, usually up by sunrise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG10BribeBeggar_00016254_Oblivion: You are most gracious. The Earl of Imbel has a home in the Talos Plaza, facing the center plaza.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22SrazirrNotEnough2_0002c822_Ob: You are no better than that renrij Maric. S'razirr should have known better than to trust you. Get out of this one's sight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22SrazirrScrew_0002c824_Oblivio: You are no better than that renrij Maric. S'razirr should have known better than to trust you. Get out of this one's sight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDJoinOrderReject_00002b32_Knight: You are no doubt correct. I will continue to train and meditate here at the Priory until I become worthy to serve Auri-El.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG02GiveItem_0001c477_Oblivion_RE: You are no longer a Thieves Guild member until you pay the blood price. Guild tradition holds that you must pay it for each person slain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04AhdarjisStolenRing_00007de7_O: You are no longer a member of the Thieves Guild until blood price is paid for the lives you took.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD09JafazirGreet_000a5658_Oblivi: You are no longer one of us! Fighters Guild spy! Traitor! Your life is forfeit!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026902_Oblivion_RESP1: You are no longer welcome here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e809_Oblivion_RESP1: You are not a member of the society. Watch if you must, but don't get in the way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00082643_Oblivion_RESP1: You are not one of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003eac4_Oblivion_RESP2: You are not to speak to me, worm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00047374_Oblivion_RESP1: You are now one with the Dark Brotherhood. Visit Ocheeva at the Cheydinhal Sanctuary and your new life will begin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038acb_Oblivion_RESP2: You are obviously of low birth. Unless you dispute my judgement... and you would press your suit at the end of a sword.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGStealingFromGuild_0001d4d0_Obli: You are removed from the guild. You must pay a fine to one of the guild Doyen to get back in.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee3d_Oblivion_R: You are skillful, but not skillful enough. Prove your worth to me. Provide the guild fences with the bounty of your work, then return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02RelmynaVisit_0001a128_Oblivio: You are strong like Him. I made you for Him. But still He refuses me. Why?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0c3_Oblivion_RESP: You are stupid if you come to chatter. If you want to train, and you pay me, then that is not so stupid.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BravilTopic_00048920_Oblivion_RES: You are stupid, so I'll make myself clear... you are stupid. Go away. I don't want your blood and puke all over me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a9485_Oblivion_RESP1: You are summoned by the Lord Hermaeus Mora. He sees your path as he sees all things. Make your way to his shrine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038ace_Oblivion_RESP1: You are talking again. You will stop.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting1a_00019cd2_O: You are the Duchess, yes? And Sheogorath has sent you to find Ciirta, has he not? He finally seeks to kill her?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting1a_0007eaf4_O: You are the Duke, yes? And Sheogorath has sent you to find Ciirta, has he not? He finally seeks to kill her?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c246_Oblivion_: You are the last defender of decadent Tamriel. I am the midwife of the Mythic Dawn, Tamriel Reborn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarSpeech_0008b09f_Oblivio: You are the last gasp of a dying age. You breathe the stale air of false hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMMythicDawnNotes_00014e02_Altar: You are the last that was needed. Go to Mingo Cave, dressed as one of us, and revel in the fire.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002ad84_Oblivion_RESP2: You are the one from my dreams...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10LetsGo_00016bb9_Oblivion_RESP: You are the only remaining Duchess, which is a situation quite unprecedented. Normally you would never be permitted to pass within Pinnacle Rock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10LetsGo_00017d12_Oblivion_RESP: You are the only remaining Duchess, which is a situation quite unprecedented. Normally, you would never be permitted to pass within Brellach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10LetsGo_00017d14_Oblivion_RESP: You are the only remaining Duke, which is a situation quite unprecedented. Normally, you would never be permitted to pass within Brellach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10LetsGo_00017d13_Oblivion_RESP: You are the only remaining Duke, which is a situation quite unprecedented. Normally, you would never be permitted to pass within Pinnacle Rock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d28a_Oblivion_RESP1: You are the toast of Anvil, my friend! It may be only a temporary respite, but everyone feels better with that Gate closed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0008c262_Obliv: You are to find a way to make the first two parts of the prophecy come true. I'll take care of the rest, because it's the most fun. Now, run along.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009760d_Obliv: You are to find a way to make the first two parts of the prophecy come true. I'll take care of the rest, because it's the most fun. Now, run along.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG04ChoiceCarahilContinue_0004f22: You are to travel north to the Brina Cross Inn, and speak with Arielle Jurard. She will give you further instructions.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00023e70_Oblivion_RESP1: You are to travel to Bruma, enter the house of the Wood Elf Baenlin, and kill him. It should look like an accident. I'm sure you can handle it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06PriestGreetA_00040149_Oblivio: You are truly Demented, as I always suspected. Release yourself to your secret fears and desires. Let them rule you, as they must in the end!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk4_00034050_Oblivion_R: You are truly an asset to this Sanctuary. Here's hoping all of our contracts work out that well!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a82_K: You are truly the Divine Crusader reborn. You are ready to face Umaril, and destroy him, in the name of the Eight and One.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC6_0003e8fc_Oblivion_: You are unlike any other mortal I have encountered. You serve me, and then you spurn the reward for your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0000a1b5_Oblivion_R: You are unproven, or at least insufficiently proven for the tasks this one has available.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueGive_0002b51f_Oblivion_: You are very close to earning the reward for completing the set of ten. I urge you to redouble your efforts!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0001eee4_Oblivion_RESP1: You are weak, like the gods you pray to!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_WeatherleahTopic_0008dc3f_Oblivio: You are welcome here anytime, my friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00071ee8_Oblivion_RESP1: You are welcome in my home anytime, friend! Maybe one day you'll learn to love it so much, you'll wish to stay here, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJauffreHelp_0005dcca_Oblivion_R: You are welcome to take my horse. I rarely travel, so I'm sure you will put her to better use than I.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseInquiry_0004f212_Oblivion_RE: You are? There is a positively gorgeous home for sale right on the main plaza.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982c3_Oblivion_RESP1: You aren't a member of the castle staff. What are you doing here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00086739_Oblivion_RESP1: You aren't brooding on that little unpleasantness at Malada, are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa9c_Oblivion_RESP1: You aren't going to kill me. I know it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022e55_Oblivion_: You aren't the first person to go looking for those. Quite a remarkable story, really. I know a bit about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10LlevanaTalk_0003c373_Oblivion: You bastard! How many more people are going to "pay the price"? How many more have to die just so you can earn another gold coin?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06NoRescue_0001473a_Oblivion_RE: You bastard! It's not like I killed her. I just roughed her up a bit. Nothin' the healers can't fix.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0002b1e2_Oblivion_: You beat all three, and you get named Champion! I know you can do this! Now get up there and show everyone why you're the best!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000164e2_Oblivion_RESP1: You beatin' those twins is a good sign. You got a lot of fight in ya. Let me know when you're ready to get bloody again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_0003abf9_Oblivion_RES: You become more valuable to the guild with each passing day. The guild wishes to reward that, and so you are raised to the rank of Conjurer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003632e_Oblivion_RESP1: You befoul the very air with your presence. Begone!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice2B_00022b6b_Oblivion_RE: You believe your Council would send you here to merely fetch a book? No, they wanted information on me and what is going on here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofBoethiaTOPIC_0001ec94_Obl: You believe yourself worthy to approach the Shrine of Boethia? Perhaps. Or, perhaps you will be slaughtered. It is your choice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00085213_Oblivion_RESP1: You best be careful around here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007eab9_Oblivion_RESP1: You better have a good reason for disturbing me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001ad47_Oblivion_RESP1: You better have a very good reason to interrupt me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000ace63_Oblivion_RES: You better have the right offering, or you're wasting your time here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c334_Oblivion_RESP1: You better hope I never get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301dd_Oblivion_RESP1: You better stay away from Diram. He's not very happy with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022ca6_Oblivion_RESP1: You blew it. You had it in the palm of your hand and you threw it all away. You make me sick.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0002819b_Oblivion: You bloody half-wit! Do I have to spell it out for you? She's a killer! A murderer!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004d840_Oblivion_RESP1: You bought an execellent Chestnut horse. Take care of him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterBuyItem_000091eb_Oblivion_R: You bought that for a song.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ElixirofExploration_0004e946_Obli: You bring me 10 samples of Nirnroot, and I'll make the Elixir available to you at a huge discount as well as give you one for free.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45HaveFork_00078785_Oblivion_RE: You bring the Fork! Happy day! The blind shall see! The lame shall walk! The short shall tall! Forks for all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAMalacathSpeech_000579ca_Oblivio: You brought a present. Good. That's smart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreB3_00092d84_Oblivion_R: You brought me the Amulet of Kings? This cannot be. Let me see it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00061395_Obliv: You came all this way for training from Aerin? You must be really disappointed that she's not here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008c239_Oblivion_RESP1: You came for the Amulet. Take it then!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b0ac_Oblivion_RESP4: You came for the Amulet. Take it then!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046665_Oblivion_RESP1: You came here for a fight, and a fight you shall have! But talk is for the weak! You want blood! Lower the gates!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00047c62_Oblivion_RESP1: You came to watch a fight, and a fight you shall have! It's the Blue Team versus the Yellow Team in a battle to the death! Lower the gates!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046662_Oblivion_RESP1: You came to watch these two Bloodletters do what they do best, and they're dying to prove their worth! So let the bloodletting... begin!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37ExpertSpell_0007b228_Oblivion: You came up short? Well, I'm not going to haggle with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017787_Oblivion_RESP1: You came. Good. I don't have much time. I have to get to the Gathering before I'm missed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024e03_Oblivion_RE: You can PAY for a bed at the Grey Mare or the Oak and Crosier. But if you get a bed for free at a guild, why would you pay for one?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasPhintiasB_00022b54_Obli: You can be sure I won't be back! I've never been treated so shabbily in all my life! Good day, sir!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b2_Oblivion_RESP: You can best know Anvil by walking its streets and speaking with its people. My favorite time is the harbor at sunset, the sun and sea to the west.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaBettingTopic_0002ada1_Oblivi: You can bet on either the Yellow Team or Blue Team. The opponents are always evenly matched, so your chance of winning is 50/50.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000488f1_Oblivion_RESP1: You can call me Hillod the Outlaw. Because I'm on the lam.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08NelsNevConvo_000852c4_Obliv: You can call me a barbarian. It's true and I'm proud of the fact. But you call me pathetic again and I'm going to show you just how barbaric I am.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_00029ca8_Obliv: You can compete in the Arena any day from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Just come to me, tell me you're ready for a match, and away you'll go. Got it? Good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000917ca_Oblivion_RESP2: You can count on the presence of the Golden Saints to defend his impressive store of Greenmote.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c42cd_Oblivion_RESP1: You can do it, Antus. You can do it... just follow big brother's lead...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000624cd_Oblivion_RES: You can find Cairn Bolete growing in caves. They're said to mark the place someone has died.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00035dd8_Oblivion_R: You can find her at the Lonely Suitor lodge. I wouldn't recommend bothering her at home, unless the door is unlocked.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07DairihillOffice_00098398_Obli: You can find her in the audience chamber in the mornings. She dines with the Countess from evening's eighth bell until midnight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS10AnyoneWhoCares_0003c29c_Obliv: You can find him roaming the County Hall of the castle most of the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00078169_Oblivion_RES: You can find some good deals at Things Found. Ahjazda has an interesting collection.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0006e2e3_Oblivion_RESP4: You can find your monthly stipend in the Master's Chest upstairs, along with anything we find that you might find useful. Here's the key.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0006770a_Oblivion_RESP1: You can go now. Run along. Scoot!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQDaedricMagic_0008b603_Oblivion_: You can guess the rest. We got in over our heads. People died. My friends died.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e4c0_Oblivion_RESP2: You can hear them better that way, too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47WhatHappened_00030038_Oblivio: You can imagine how difficult it is to run an inn while invisible. Once you get a reputation as a haunted inn, you can just forget about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JoinUs_0003d4aa_Oblivion_RESP1: You can make a good deal of money in our gang. But you have to be willing to show a little skin if you know what I mean.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SkingradNQDResponses_0003c1fd_Obl: You can never be too good with a bow. I know I'm not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c1e1_Oblivi: You can never know too much about how to handle a sword.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_0003d7b4_Obliv: You can only fight once a week, though. We'll need that much time to catch new creatures for you to fight against.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasC2_0009532e_Oblivion_RE: You can only get Volume 4 directly from a member of the Mythic Dawn. I had set up a meeting with the Sponsor, as he called himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DLC06FenceTopic01_000079bb_DLCThi: You can pay your fines to the guards, serve your time, or pay me half and I'll fix them all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayCrimeGold_000983a3_Oblivion_: You can pay your fines to the guards, serve your time, or pay me half and I'll fix them all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03LlathasaIndarys_00045f77_Obli: You can pay your respects in the northern croft. Just don't touch anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32WhatCanIDo_00012d05_Oblivion_: You can put away your sword in these halls. Unlike the defending spirits, within these walls, none will war with you. Not even the Fanatics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09ArmorTopic_00026d6e_Oblivion_: You can reassure Jauffre that I will not destroy the armor. All I need is a scraping of Talos's divine blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032d3e_Oblivion_RESP1: You can say what you like, but I'm never going back to Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48Choice1A_00028030_Oblivion_RE: You can see the marks on the ground where they were, with the Great Gate right in the middle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LeyawiinTopic_00086074_Oblivion_R: You can speak to the Count near the throne weekdays between eight in the morning and four in the afternoon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00077d0e_Oblivion_RES: You can stay at the Choosy Beggar in Bliss, but I wouldn't.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_StealNoCrime_000626bf_Oblivion_RE: You can take that one, but let's not make it a habit...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47AncotarContinue_00030134_Obli: You can tell them not to worry, the effect is not actually permanent. It should wear off eventually.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000917ca_Oblivion_RESP3: You can try to sneak by them or you may elect to eliminate them, but the latter is hardly the way of Mania, now is it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BThadon_00016570_Oblivion_RES: You can usually find her roaming around New Sheoth, or spending a lot of time on the palace grounds.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_0003d7b4_Obliv: You can wear whatever ever you want, of course. We don't want you getting killed out there!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a388_Oblivion_RESP1: You can't be here now. Please leave, and quickly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0018bcbd_Oblivion_RES: You can't be too careful out in the wilderness. Almost any creature you find is liable to give you a disease.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_000be425_Oblivion_: You can't fight now! You have a bet down on an Arena match. Look, finish up with our gambling, and then you can fight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0ce_Oblivion_RESP: You can't imagine the fuss some people make. My rats are no problem for anyone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002824e_Obliv: You can't possibly think that Primo had anything to do with the murder, do you? That's madness!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008c0e1_Oblivion_RESP1: You can't see me. You can't see me. Neither can He. No one can see me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c93d_Oblivion_RESP1: You cannot deceive me. Anaxes has fallen. Now I must restore order to the Garden myself, and this angers me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Seen_0006c63f_Oblivion_RESP1: You cannot escape the Master's vigilance!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15BandsOfChosen_0003c80e_Oblivi: You cannot pass through the door to the Forbidden Grotto unless you wear the Bands.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38Reward_00023668_Oblivion_RESP: You certainly earned this. Take it with my thanks. I believe it must have been fate that brought the two of us together. Goodbye.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b19b_Obliv: You certainly know your Destruction spells. I wish I could be of more help, but... I just don't feel comfortable talking about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062c83_Oblivion_RESP1: You choose to share your time with me? You humble me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040141_Oblivion_RESP1: You chose well. The Great Torch shines as a beacon of Mania to inspire and enflame all who gaze upon it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004013e_Oblivion_RESP1: You chose well. The Great Torch shines with the luster of Dementia and the glory of Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa7e_Oblivio: You cleared that up. You must be exhausted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e8a7_Oblivion_RESP1: You closed the Gate? I knew you could do it! This is our chance to launch a counterattack!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d75e_Oblivion_RESP1: You closed the gate. That's the first good news in a long time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d762_Oblivion_RESP1: You closed the gate? How did you do it? We can't thank you enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000251b8_Oblivion_RESP1: You come crying to me for help? Perhaps Lucien Lachance was wrong about you after all, eh?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035598_Oblivion_RESP1: You come speak with me, yet you do not bear Scar-Tail's heart. Please, you must slay that traitorous snake so Ocheeva and I can find peace!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00027998_Oblivion_RESP1: You come to me for knowledge, for advice? I would sooner see you flounder in a pool of your own blood. Good luck, worm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00019fc3_Oblivion_RESP2: You come to me glowing with violence and death. Your light has no place here. We seek harmony for ourselves and the Shivering Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00028bb6_Oblivion_RES: You coming to the gathering tonight?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000285a1_Oblivion_RESP1: You complete and utter disgrace! Disqualified? For not wearing your Battle Raiment? Don't you dare humiliate the Blue Team like this again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDHelmTopic_00002d25_Knights_RESP: You completed the quest that I could not. I am glad that my death at least served to lead you here, as I had hoped.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000bee5_Oblivion_RESP1: You continue to do the guild proud. As such, a new task awaits you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GreetingLazare02_00038acd_Oblivio: You contradict me. This conversation is tiresome. Leave me. Or draw your sword.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_vampirehunters_00009226_Oblivion_: You convinced them to leave, I see. A wise plan.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c240_Oblivi: You could learn a lot from Pinarus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c9c_Oblivio: You could try taking your problem to Itius Hayn. Maybe he'll be willing to risk his career by arresting Audens.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cea_Oblivion_RESP1: You creatures are all the same.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29ShadyDeal_0001e7f1_Oblivion_R: You cut back now, and I'm going to take my business elsewhere. Or maybe pay a visit to that Jensine and tell her about your little scheme.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081f59_Oblivion_RESP1: You cute little bunny. You've done a horrible thing here. Bad bunny. Bad!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005c01f_Oblivion_: You dare approach my shrine, Child of the Light? You, who walk this plane basking in the light of the warm, cruel sun?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateConv_00091aee_Oblivio: You dare challenge the power of Oblivion?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebbd_Oblivion_RESP1: You dare come here to the shrine of our lord? You are not one of us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081194_Oblivion_RESP1: You dare disturb me in my sanctum?!?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd73_Oblivion_RESP1: You dare oppose the might of the Imperial Legion?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Assault_00098387_Oblivion_RESP1: You dare to attack Fathis Aren?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e91d_Oblivion_RESP1: You dare torment me? Valen Dreth? Let me out of this cell, you fetid piece of Guar dung!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000711ba_Oblivion_RESP1: You decided to turn yourself in? Good. You lack the gold to pay your bounty, so you must serve out your sentence. Your stolen goods are now forfeit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000711b9_Oblivion_RESP1: You decided to turn yourself in? Smart move. Pay your bounty, or serve your sentence... your choice... but your stolen goods are forfeit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ03ComeWithMe_0001e8d7_Oblivion_: You destroyed the Oblivion Gate, they say. You gave them hope. You helped them drive the daedra back.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c93c_Oblivion_RESP1: You destroyed the Sigil Tower at Ganonah. My kin say you fought well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00095a64_Oblivion_RESP1: You did it! You actually made it back with the crystal ball! Oh thank you! Here, please take this as a reward!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000176c4_Oblivion_RESP1: You did it! You beat them, every last one! Do you know how long it will take for the Yellow Team to recover from this? Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_OblivionGateTopic_0001e8af_Oblivi: You did it! You closed that damned Gate! Now we have a chance to take the enemy by surprise.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0014684a_Oblivion_RESP1: You did it! You made it to Gladiator rank, same as me! Here's to a long, successful career, my friend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00046307_Oblivion_RESP1: You did it, Captain! You closed the Oblivion Gate! We didn't think we'd ever see you alive again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MartinA_0003782c_Oblivion_RES: You did it. You defeated him. Then you have it... you have the Amulet of Kings?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGDefault2_00024295_Oblivion_RESP: You did it? I'll be talking to Maglir soon. I don't need one wet-ear covering for another. Still, the job got done. Here's the reward.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000473c2_Oblivion_RESP1: You did not expect to see me again, did you? You have no grasp of the power that my father has at his command.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03TestofKynareth_00002a57_Knigh: You did not heed my warnings, did you? I told you not to delay, to go directly to the Grove.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00023660_Oblivion_R: You did the right thing showing us that note. My brother and I will take care of him, don't worry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038b00_Oblivi: You did what had to be done. There should be no regrets or doubts in your mind about it. Raynil was an evil Dunmer, and he deserved that fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ12MartinA1_000a31c4_Oblivion_RE: You did. I can count on you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a34a_Oblivion_RESP1: You didn't leave, so I called the guards! Now you'll be arrested!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c21c_Oblivion_: You didn't think you could take me unawares, here of all places? In the Paradise that I created?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27UmbacanoB2_000a6580_Oblivion_: You disappoint me. I was counting on your help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002d922_Oblivion_RESP1: You do NOT belong in here!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE01HaskillChoice7_000133e6_Obliv: You do as you will. You may leave the way you entered. Your life will be none the worse for your time spent here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk3_00068355_Oblivion_RES: You do me too much honor. For who am I? The bastard heir of a dead Emperor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00025038_Oblivion_RESP: You do not have all the materials you were told to collect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_0002503d_Oblivion_RESP: You do not have all the materials you were told to collect.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS40Choice3A_0009813a_Oblivion_RE: You do not have the cure. Please do not attempt to deceive me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000bb9bb_Oblivion_RESP1: You do not have the money for me, so I do not have a room for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_000836d2_Oblivion_RES: You do not yet qualify for further advancement in the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd71_Oblivion_RESP1: You do realize I've been holding back?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk4_0006a871_Oblivion_RESP1: You do realize this raises quite a few questions? The overall impact on Alchemy is a complete unknown. And what of Spellmaking?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09MetoDO_0005377a_Oblivion_RESP: You do this for me, and you get the gold. All of it. All I need as proof is that damn amulet she always wears. Show that to me and the money's yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_000174b8_Oblivion_: You do, however. I believe the key he used for the well should also work on his quarters.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting3c1_00019fd1_: You do? Give them to me, and we can start now! I did not think that it would be so easy!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraChoice1_0001ce9b_Oblivion: You do? Perhaps you should. You are repulsive, displeasing to the eye. Namira might find favor in you. Approach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraChoice1_0001ce9a_Oblivion: You do? You are too pretty to worship in this place. People like you. Like to hear you talk. When you are more loathesome, you may return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000b97d2_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't appear well, milady. Perhaps you should rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000b97d3_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't appear well, milord. Perhaps you should rest.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a38a_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't belong here. Please leave. Now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000bb9b7_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't even have the money! Why are you wasting my time? Is this some sort of joke to you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_0000921f_Oblivion_RESP: You don't expect me to make that deal, do you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfc0_Oblivion_RE: You don't find something soon, I'm gonna lose my temper.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f220_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't follow orders well, do you? You were supposed to find me before you spoke to anyone else here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01Lockpicks_0009fd6e_Oblivion_R: You don't have enough coin to buy one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006139c_Obliv: You don't have my coin, so you don't get any training. I haven't changed my mind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranDagger_0001a813_Obliv: You don't have the daggers yet? Time is growing short. Do whatever you must to get them!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_000355ec_Oblivion: You don't have the diary. Stop wasting my time!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37JourneymanSpell_0007b226_Obli: You don't have the gold. I hope you didn't think I was just going to give it to you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyA_0000c52a_DLCBat: You don't have the item I need. I'm sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyB_0000c52c_DLCBat: You don't have the item I need. I'm sorry.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BattlehornTrophyE_0000c532_DLCBat: You don't have the item I need. I'm sorry.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_0018ae85_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't have the money for the room. Perhaps some other time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000bb9c9_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't have the money, so I can't let you stay in the room. I'm sorry.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000bb9b9_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't have the money. I'm not just going to let you sleep here for free.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00032e12_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't have the scroll? Then we have nothing to talk about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_knightDontLook_000860ca_Oblivion_: You don't know anything about being a knight, so shut up about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SECaldanaMonriusSkoomaNo_0008f786: You don't know what it's like! I need the Skooma!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05MazaddhaWhy_00081187_Oblivion: You don't know, do you? She's kept it a secret even from you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e8c8_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't listen? You stupid? Crot. I'm wasting my breath. Then go ahead. Stand there. Talk all you want. You're a fly. Go ahead and buzz.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08Choice1_000356ef_Oblivion_RE: You don't look strong enough to me, though. A bit inexperienced, perhaps. Still, maybe we will find work for you. You may join. For now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01JoinThievesGuild_000355e9_Obl: You don't look very trustworthy. I have no idea what you are talking about.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00024157_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't look well, my friend. You should seek a healer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01SulinusConv_0002d919_Oblivion: You don't need to understand. Just tell Adrienne that the new Associate is the one who saved you. Or else. Are we clear?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003c14f_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't need to worry about the daedra taking Bruma. You've got the best soldiers in Cyrodiil here now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0006143c_Oblivion_: You don't really know what it's like to crack skulls. Until you do, I've got nothing to say to you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0002f502_Oblivion_R: You don't really need to do anything else. The Cracked Wood tribe will stop attacking Timberscar Cave once they figure out the head is gone.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilNQDResponses_0003c228_Oblivi: You don't see a lot of Human-Bosmer marriages. I don't know if it's even legal in Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE41PostHere_0008fa23_Oblivion_RE: You don't seem to have the bottle with you. Shame on you for lying to a sick woman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BedYes_000bb9b5_Oblivion_RESP1: You don't seem to have the money for the room. Perhaps you should look elsewhere for accomodations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopAgarmir_0001d047_Oblivion: You don't think he would dig up another... oh no, he wouldn't. But I guess he has been. Oh my. What have I done?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_00013388_Obli: You don't understand. This isn't just about the Chalice. This is about you. We must discuss Dunroot Burrow.
