ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenGlenroy_0000b205_Oblivion_: You don't want to do that again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028bf8_Oblivion_RESP2: You don't want to fail me again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS38DionneWarnChoice3_0001dcc5_Ob: You don't want to get involved with him. I don't care how much he's paying you, it isn't worth it. Like I said, he's crazy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE42NoSell_00073235_Oblivion_RESP: You don't want to sell them? I'll have to get you to sign a no competition writ a few days ago. Can't have you building your own skyboat.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChalNo_0003a914_Obliv: You don't? Oh! Well good! Very good indeed! Maybe after you've helped me out, eh? So please, make haste to Crowhaven! This waiting is unbearable!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChalNo_0003a913_Obliv: You don't? Oh... Well I can only hope you'll change your mind. In the Arena... Yes, in the Arena anything could happen. Anything...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArenaAgronakChalNo_0003a912_Obliv: You don't? Oh... Well, all right. I'm sorry, it's just that I fully expected a challenge! It is your right. If you change your mind, I'll be ready.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseOrgnolf1_00031521_Obliv: You ever hear the expression, 'fools rush in where Daedra fear to tread'? Well, accusing anyone without evidence is mighty foolish.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025572_Oblivion_RES: You ever talk to Honditar? Odd fellow, but he seems to know his way around these parts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0002870e_Oblivion: You fiend! Are you suggesting Dovesi is the murderer? You'd do well to watch your mouth, and your back!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RulesOfCompetition_00029ca8_Obliv: You fight for the Blue Team. You fight against the Yellow Team. In order to fight in the Arena you must wear an Arena Battle Raiment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_00037ce2_Oblivion_RESP1: You find the room okay? Right at the top of the stairs. First one on the left. You really can't miss it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00071dc2_Oblivion_RESP1: You finish the clean-up, new blood. Look in the houses. Get moving, so we can go home.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0003d4af_Oblivion_RESP4: You fit the bill perfectly. It's a shame it had to end in so much violence, but someone was bound to get hurt sooner or later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001dc2c_Oblivion_RESP1: You fool!  You'll ruin everything!  We can't be seen talking together!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranConfrontCiirta04_0001: You fool! I am the light! Come if you dare, I will cast you into darkness for all eternity!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029ab_Knights_RESP1: You fought at Garlas Malatar, did you not? Tell me about the battle, if you would.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06UlfriFinalB_000400e1_Oblivion: You fought well. I would almost grant you the honor of kindling the Altar, if you were an immortal. Farewell. The waters of Oblivion await me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutside_000790ae_Oblivio: You found a place for me to sleep? Outside under the stars too small to fall and hurt me? Excellent, excellent! Tell me more!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003782b_Oblivion_RESP1: You found a way back! Does this mean... ?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GarridansTears_00022f14_Oblivion_: You found five of the Tears? Fantastic! This turned out better than I expected. Perhaps a little bit of a bonus is in order.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrenusAstisJournal_00024293_Obliv: You found it, huh? Good work, I guess. Well, take it back to Oreyn, then. He can pay you on the contract. Tell him what you want about me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be67_Oblivion_RESP1: You found my belabored daughter! I will tell Burz gro-Khash about your indentures! Take this. It has been passed in my family for many generators.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMMythicDawnNotes_00014e01_Altar: You found the notes, you share our vision. But I did not survive this long by being trusting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEMMythicDawnNotes_00014e02_Altar: You found the notes. You follow the will of the Lord of Change.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05AChoice1A_00028c07_Oblivion_R: You gave HIM the book? What were you thinking? And here I thought one of you Guild mages might actually have a brain...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e657_Oblivion_RESP1: You gave those Maniacs something to think about, lighting the Torch for us. Well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000661f7_Oblivion_RESP1: You get any closer and I'll turn your bones to ash. Back off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GiftScript_0002fbad_Oblivion_RESP: You get me some... now listen up... sk...skooma. You know what that is? Get me some skooma and... and... we'll be good, good friends. Okay?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46Choice2_0008fab9_Oblivion_RES: You get rid of those Manics. All of them. If you can take care of that for me, I'd make it worth your while.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9a2_Oblivion_RESP: You get used to the cold. Got a good set of fur boots to keep my feet warm. Give a Nord a good thumping to keep the blood flowing, khah-khah-khah.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0004f3ed_Oblivion_RESP1: You go get 'em! And whip their asses for Newheim!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJauffreHelp_0005dccb_Oblivion_R: You go into danger. Jauffre didn't tell us any more than that, but know that our prayers go with you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Question_00034078_Oblivion_RESP1: You going to visit the Lucky Old Lady today? Wish for good tidings?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_00061c5c_Oblivion_: You got a good deal there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_00061c61_Oblivion_: You got a good deal there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_000091d8_Oblivion_: You got a great deal there.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033358_Oblivion_R: You got a wife back home? Tell you what. I'm getting out of here in a couple of weeks. When I get back to Morrowind I'll look her up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LadyRogbutTOPIC_0000be7e_Oblivion: You got her back in one piece? Good work! I've always liked that girl. May have to look her up sometime. Here's your payment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00003a69_Oblivion_RESP1: You got quite a deal on that house.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00073027_Oblivion_RESP1: You got some Skooma, yeah? Right buddy? Pal? To share? Come on, pass the Skooma already!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AjumKajinTopic_000356b8_Oblivion_: You got some information out of him, which is good. We can use it. Here, take this. It might help you some time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AyleidReference_0003353a_Oblivion: You got the book, eh? Good for you. I've given up trying to deal with her for now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00028889_Oblivion_RESP1: You got the weapons there and cleared the mine with no casualties. Better than I expected from you. Here's your reward, and a little bonus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047693_Oblivi: You got to be careful. You don't want people taking notice. Just keep quiet, keep your head down.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8d9_Oblivion: You got your people, and you got your dogs. Dogs are loyal and stupid. People are smart and devious. I'll stick with dogs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008da8a_Oblivion_RESP1: You grace my presence once again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000290d_Knights_RESP3: You had no wounds on your body, but you were dead. I saw it with my own eyes -- you did not draw breath!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0002d934_Oblivion_RESP1: You had your chance, fool! Now you will never leave this house alive!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00025de9_Oblivion_RESP1: You handled yourself pretty well back there. Just keep out of our way, got it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cf4_Oblivion_RESP1: You hardly seem worth talking to.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006fdc0_Oblivion_RESP1: You have a death wish, citizen? Put that weapon away. Now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: You have a few options, I believe. Either wait for Ma'zaddha to return with more information, or have a chat with Nelrene in the meantime.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AlbertJemaneTopic_0008b073_Oblivi: You have a lot of nerve accusing my father of such a heinous crime... and with no proof to back it up?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13NarinaMartin1_0002777f_Oblivi: You have a rare gift, to know when desperation is the path of wisdom. I will do everything in my power to defend your city, my Lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06WhereSkrivva_00084477_Oblivio: You have a short memory, Cat Burglar. Mine needs a little jogging too.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDCrusadersRelicsTopic_00002a82_K: You have achieved what no knight since the legendary Divine Crusader has achieved. You have reassembled Pelinal's holy armor and weapons.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Necromancers_000038b7_Oblivion_RE: You have again performed admirably. You have my thanks, and that of the Council as well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000029a2_Knights_RESP1: You have agreed to be tested. You must finish your test.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_00053240_Oblivion_: You have all the recommendations you need, I believe. Raminus Polus will want to speak with you. You can find him at the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofBoethiaTOPIC_0001ebe1_Obl: You have approached the shrine and spoken with Boethia. Enter the portal or do not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f146_Oblivion_RESP2: You have arrived at an opportune time. You may have the honor to be initiated into the Order by the Master himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e6_Oblivion_: You have been asked to work with Herdir, I understand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGCastOutTopic_0001e863_Oblivion_: You have been cast out for mistreating your fellow Thieves Guild members. In order to be returned to the rolls you must make reparations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025033_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been found guilty of breaking guild rules, and have been suspended. Should you wish to clear your name, speak with Raminus Polus at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024fd3_Oblivion_RESP2: You have been found guilty of killing a guild member. As such, your guild privileges have been suspended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002501a_Oblivion_RESP2: You have been found guilty of killing a guild member. As such, your guild privileges have been suspended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024ff9_Oblivion_RESP2: You have been found guilty of theft. As such, your guild privileges have been suspended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025022_Oblivion_RESP2: You have been found guilty of theft. As such, your guild privileges have been suspended.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ce93_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been given a task by Namira? Truly, you are terrible in my eyes. Disgusting and foul. Blessed are you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofNocturnalTOPIC_000b97c0_O: You have been given a task. Do it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebbf_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been graced with the presence of Hircine. Do not fail him, lest you be hunted for the rest of your days.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03AltarofKynareth_00002a4f_Knig: You have been in the Chapel of Kynareth from the moment you stepped outdoors. Have you not felt her presence?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026904_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been set on a path. Follow it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026d90_Oblivion_RESP2: You have been suspended from the guild for the death of a guild member. Are you willing to do what is necessary to make amends?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026d92_Oblivion_RESP2: You have been suspended from the guild for theft. Are you willing to do what is necessary to make amends?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebc8_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been told all that is necessary. Approach the shrine or do not.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026a9d_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been told how to summon Sanguine. If you feel worthy, proceed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aa1_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been told the proposition: your donation for a possible audience with Clavicus Vile. The choice is yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026aa0_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been told the way to reach Molag Bal. Do what you will.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ce94_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been told to approach the shrine. Perhaps Namira will find favor in you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofMolagBalTOPIC_000b166a_Ob: You have been told what must be done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebc0_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been told what you must do to speak with our Lady. What more do you ask of us?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebc6_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been told what you need to know. Your path is now your own.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e43f_Oblivion_RESP1: You have been unfaithful. His blades are dull and uninspired. Mine are sharp and exquisite.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026def_Oblivion_RESP1: You have broken a Tenet, and have been exiled from the Dark Brotherhood! You must defeat the Wrath of Sithis to regain any status you once had!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona12_00022e86_Obli: You have broken my heart for a second time. I cannot let the infamous criminal mastermind, the Gray Fox become the Count of Anvil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035f3f_Oblivion_RESP1: You have business here? Don't tell me Jarol sent you...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008da8d_Oblivion_RESP1: You have but to lead us to Weatherleah.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANamiraSpeech_0005dc88_Oblivion_: You have cleansed my followers' perfect darkness. The Forgotten are free to wallow in their misery.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireAshTopic_000977d9_Oblivion: You have come across a vampire or two in your travels, perhaps? I assure you, they are nothing like what you must face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024e51_Oblivion_RESP1: You have come to dedicate yourself to Lord Dagon's service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranGreeting1b_00019cd1_O: You have come to kill her, have you not? I can sense it all through you. You stink of violence. It is glorious!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047681_Oblivi: You have complaints against merchants here? You file complaints with me. I fill out lots of forms, which go to a lot of people who ignore them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10SirAmielSpeech02_00002cc6_Kni: You have completed your divine task. You have restored the Order. You have defeated the enemy of the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d8d_Oblivion_RESP: You have completed your task, and so your privileges in the guild will be restored.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MGExpelYes_00026d8e_Oblivion_RESP: You have completed your task, and so your privileges in the guild will be restored.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035a34_Oblivion_RESP1: You have completed your tasks for the Count, have you not? Then please, wait here while I inform him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_JemaneFamily_00028ac6_Oblivion_RE: You have decided you have time to listen to my tale after all? It is a good one. I promise you won't be disappointed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_0007eb5e_Ob: You have defied the expected and accomplished something that denies all logic. I must contemplate the error in my calculations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e00_Oblivion_RESP2: You have done a great service to the Dark Brotherhood today, Assassin. Your reward is well earned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e01_Oblivion_RESP2: You have done a great service to the Dark Brotherhood today, Assassin. Your reward is well earned.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d883_Obliv: You have done much to prevent the flow of Oblivion into Tamriel. The world is in your debt, and I am at your service. My knowledge is yours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0002c2f6_Oblivion_RESP1: You have done the right thing. Thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RogueMage_0003020c_Oblivion_RESP2: You have done well enough for yourself. I'll pass along my recommendation to Raminus.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_00033567_Oblivion_R: You have done well so far. I hereby promote you to Apprentice. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDUmarilTopic_00002bfb_Knights_RE: You have done what Pelinal Whitestrake himself could not, and have banished Umaril once and for all. The whole of Tamriel is in your debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG09Choice5C_00022bdd_Oblivion_RE: You have done your job admirably, and I thank you for it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b18b_Obliv: You have done your part, so I shall do mine. What I know I will teach you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Betrothed_00012d02_Oblivion_R: You have driven all meaning from my life. I shall throw myself upon the swords of the Fanatics so that I may join her sooner.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ09ArmorTopic_00026d60_Oblivion_: You have earned a place of honor in the rolls of our Order for recovering the holy relic.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQChampionOfCyrodiil_000ade33_Obl: You have earned the highest rank possible in the Order of the Dragon, the illustrious order of Imperial knights founded by Tiber Septim himself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06GiveBook_000174b9_Oblivion_RE: You have earned the reward. Here is your payment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04GiveRing_00035fc0_Oblivion_RE: You have earned the reward. The Thieves Guild was always good to Ahdarji's dearest mate. I am grateful that the memory is still honored.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000981f1_Oblivion_RESP1: You have entered a holy place. What is your business here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21StatueGive_0002b463_Oblivion_: You have exceeded my fondest hopes, my friend. The Ten Ancestors are reunited at last! This is truly an historic day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a235d_Oblivion_RESP1: You have failed Namira. Cursed forever are you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ef78_Oblivion_RESP1: You have followed the path set for you by the Lord Hermaeus Mora. Approach his shrine and speak with him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00015447_Oblivion_RESP1: You have found Theranis and the Lost Histories of Tamriel?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEAltarofDespairTopic_0007ff5d_Ob: You have found it. The holiest of holies within Cylarne, aside from the altar of the Flame of Agnon itself.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06GSWardenGreet2_00018dba_Obliv: You have great faith in my powers of forebearance. Do not test me further, mortal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014d86_AltarDeluxe_RES: You have greatly pleased my Lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a86_Knights_R: You have heard him. Like me, you know he speaks the truth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting02b_00002cd5_K: You have heard of the god Talos? One of the Nine? And surely the name of Tiber Septim has not escaped you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_00023ff5_Oblivion_RE: You have helped ensure that this book will remain safe from those who would misuse it. You have the Guild's thanks. Now, if you'll excuse me...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000270ef_Oblivion: You have helped me by closing the Oblivion Gate near Skingrad. I will likewise help you by sending aid to Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00061394_Obliv: You have helped to save Kvatch, or what is left of it. For that, I can do nothing less than help you spread healing throughout Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE39Notebook_00078200_Oblivion_RE: You have her notebook? I'm too important to read that. In fact, I've never read a book in my life. I pluck knowledge straight from the minds of gods.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16BStolenItem_00028c79_Oblivion: You have it? Let me see it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000976ac_Oblivion_RESP1: You have kept your word. Now I will keep mine. What is it you wish to know?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001b681_Oblivion_RESP1: You have lifted the curse. All of Vitharn thanks you, Lord Sheogorath. You may keep my helmet. It never did me much good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008151b_Oblivion_RESP1: You have lifted the curse. All of Vitharn thanks you. You may keep my helmet. It never did me much good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND02SirAmielBattleCall_00002c05_K: You have lost, Sir Juncan. Sir Torolf, show the challenger the ferocity of the North.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007be56_Oblivion_RESP1: You have made a long and perilous journey, but there is no time to rest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SQ08Wine_0018d925_Oblivion_RESP1: You have more? Amazing! Well, as promised, your finder's fee once again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorTownYes_0003446b_Oblivi: You have my assurance that my men and I will do everything in our power to keep the people of... Skingrad safe. We're here to help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_00188f3e_Oblivion_RES: You have my congratulations, and my thanks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017469_Oblivion_RESP1: You have my thanks for freeing me, but... Just who are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017cfb_Oblivion_RESP1: You have my thanks for freeing me, but... Just who are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002908_Knights_RESP1: You have my tribute, sir knight. In three hundred years, none have passed the gauntlet. In three hundred years, we have never known hope.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000811c8_Oblivion_: You have no proof! You cannot hold me accountable for anything!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_0008199d_Oblivion_: You have no proof! You cannot hold me accountable for anything!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00053796_Oblivion_RESP1: You have no rights here, convict.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018b18c_Obliv: You have not done that which I ask. Kill the bears and bring me their hides. Then I shall do as you ask.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ef7a_Oblivion_RESP1: You have not yet followed the path required to speak with the Lord Hermaeus Mora.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038acb_Oblivion_RESP1: You have obviously made a mistake. Sir Lazare Milvan would never speak with someone of your low birth.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12RootDungeon_0001a328_Oblivion: You have one Pool yet to cleanse, and the traitor is still at large. These would seem to me to be your highest priorities.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND02SirAmielBattleCall_00002c03_K: You have overcome half of us and yet you remain standing. Perhaps Sir Caius shall test your true mettle.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a48_Kni: You have passed Kynareth's test. The Boots are yours for the taking. They await you in the Grove.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND04Mace_00002ac8_Knights_RESP3: You have passed our test and now, I must ask you to press forward where I could not. I must ask you to face the challenge of Zenithar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d150_Oblivion_RESP1: You have passed your test. Well done. I shall be more than happy to train you in the skill of Alteration from now on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026a99_Oblivion_RESP1: You have pleased Molag Bal. Blessed is the one who spreads the seeds of dissent.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00026987_Oblivion_RESP1: You have pleased the Lord Clavicus. A wise decision.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAVaerminaSpeech_0008ade9_Oblivio: You have proved yourself, mortal. It is fitting, as well, that you should bear my token.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00045651_Oblivion_RESP1: You have proven to be quite the hunter. Take your bounty. You've earned it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00037cea_Oblivion_RESP1: You have proven yourself a loyal servant of the Empire, as worthy as any of the Blades to stand by Martin's side during this crisis.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21AnotherTask_0002af2e_Oblivion: You have proven yourself more than a simple grave robber. I believe you can handle a more complicated assignment. Are you interested?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d884_Obliv: You have proven yourself worthy, and have earned my respect. What I know, I shall teach to you for a fee.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0005421d_Oblivion_RESP1: You have purchased a fine piece of horseflesh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09HaskillGatekeeper_00040372_Ob: You have rebuilt the Gatekeeper. Good show! Perhaps Your Grace should proceed on to Lord Sheogorath to give him the news?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0005323e_Oblivion_: You have received recommendations from every guild hall, have you not? Then you are ready to advance to the Arcane University.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000268f6_Oblivion_RESP1: You have reneged on your bargain with Lord Clavicus. You are not welcome here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_000bb9c4_Oblivion_RESP1: You have rented the only room I have for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001c4e3_Oblivion: You have restored the honor of the Thieves Guild. This one welcomes you back into the guild. I am promoting you to Cat Burglar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_000165f6_Oblivion: You have restored your honor and that of the Thieves Guild. I can now officially pay you for your efforts and promote you to the rank of Bandit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_0001c474_Oblivion: You have restored your honor within the Thieves Guild. Now I can pay you for your recovering the taxes and promote you to the rank of Footpad.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAPeryiteSpeech_0008dd57_Oblivion: You have returned my followers, mortal. The natural order is restored, and for this, I thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013563_Oblivion_RESP1: You have returned with all the components? Excellent. All that remains is to choose the body parts.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebbe_Oblivion_RESP1: You have returned, and you are not a corpse. Boethia may be pleased by this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06AmuseiDoingHere_0001531f_Obli: You have saved my life, again. You are a true friend. I will not forget this. I've decided to join the Thieves Guild. No more jails for me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017ca3_Oblivion_RESP2: You have saved us. We are forever grateful, your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017cf9_Oblivion_RESP2: You have saved us. We are forever grateful, your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_00062443_Obliv: You have seen the beggars. You have, I hope, used your powers of speech to raise their spirits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DAHermaeusSpeech_000a9482_Oblivio: You have served me well, and I am pleased. I give you this, the Oghma Infinium. Knowledge given by me to Xarxes is recorded within.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000008af_Oblivion_RESP4: You have served me well, and I choose now to extend that gift to you. Shall I use my dark powers and turn you into a vampire?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG05Choice2A_00023ff2_Oblivion_RE: You have shown yourself worthy of the guild, and for that I thank you. You shall have the recommendation you need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06Choice1A_0002fbb0_Oblivion_: You have skooma! Ha ha ha ha! Oh... Oh my friend! Yeah... You're my friend now! Thank you... Thank you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a3b2f_Oblivion_RESP1: You have some nerve addressing me after slaying my son. You're lucky I didn't have you executed on the spot! Now get out of my sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29InvStolen_0001d045_Oblivion_R: You have some nerve! Where do you come off accusing me of something you know nothing about?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0002b5f5_Oblivion_RESP1: You have something to say, dungheap?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008b072_Oblivion_RESP1: You have something to tell me about my father?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_0002365c_Oblivion_R: You have something you want to tell me about that nutcase?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002910_Knights_RESP1: You have stepped from the humble shadows of obscurity and into legend. No feat you have accomplished in your life compares to what you have become.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND02SirAmielBattleCall_00002c06_K: You have stood against the Knights of the Nine and lived. However, the final test is upon you. Ready yourself, Sir Knight, and face me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS51AccuseChanel1_0003565c_Oblivi: You have strong evidence, but I do not trust you enough to speak true my motivations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03Reactivated_0008e944_Oblivion: You have the Attenuator, the Manual, and a map. I'm certainly not going to carry you there, so I'd suggest you get to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE45NotYet_00078786_Oblivion_RESP: You have the Fork? I hear it singing so close? Songs of such closeness! Songs of almostness!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07NewCaptain_00098399_Oblivion_: You have the Imperial Watch recommendation for my new guard captain?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateWho_000805f3: You have the evidence you need. It's time to bring in Muurine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bc9f_Oblivion_RESP1: You have the eyes of a trained marksman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bc98_Oblivion_RESP1: You have the hands of a healer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bcb4_Oblivion_RESP1: You have the hands of an illusionist.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016efa_Oblivion_RESP1: You have the items. Contrary to all prediction. Once again, you defy the path set before you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004e925_Oblivion_RESP1: You have the next batch of Nirnroot yet?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0003c15b_Obliv: You have the right equipment. This is good.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022db6_Oblivion_RESP1: You have the scroll? I can hardly believe it! The odds were clearly against you. Capital job! Capital!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEChaliceofReversal_0001344d_Obli: You have the stink of Mania about you. Leave before I start vomiting.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_001885d7_Oblivion_RESP1: You have them! You have them! I can sense they're with you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranDagger_00019fd4_Obliv: You have them? Do you? Give them to me! I thirst for Ciirta's blood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11RakheranDagger_0001a814_Obliv: You have them? Do you? Give them to me! I thirst for Ciirta's blood!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE35FlawlessPearlsTopic_0007866a_: You have them? Please, please! Hand them over!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0011e155_DLCOrrery_RESP1: You have them? The items I requested? Give them to me, please! Yes... yes, this seems to be everything. Here's your reward. Thank you again!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00014449_Oblivion_RESP1: You have things to do. Talking to me isn't one of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016e9e_Oblivion_RESP1: You have things to do. Talking to me isn't one of them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241d9_Oblivion_RES: You have to admit, this is a good place to live. Friendly folks, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05GwinasB4_0009532b_Oblivion_RE: You have to believe me! I truly had no idea. I mean, I knew they were a daedric cult.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarMaTopic_0001778d_Oblivion_RESP: You have to believe me, I didn't know what they were planning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_0001ee3e_Oblivion_R: You have to find your own jobs now. Just keep selling stuff to the fences.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_000488e6_Oblivi: You have to watch out for pickpockets in the city. You'd be surprised how many waterfronters earn a good income that way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VaronVamoriTopic_0004cfad_Oblivio: You have what you need to help him talk. I admit, it's not standard guild procedure, but I'd do anything for one of my girls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: You have what you need, don't you? Time to seek out Muurine, I think.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0009f912_Oblivion_RESP1: You have work to do. Go on. Get out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00066a08_Oblivion_RESP1: You have your orders, Silencer. Ask of me what you will, and then make haste to Hero Hill. Your first dead drop contract awaits.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006d810_Oblivion_RESP1: You have your orders. Now carry them out.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_00035549_Oblivion_RESP1: You have your task. Acquire wood for a staff from the grove outside Wellspring Cave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000355a2_Oblivion_RESP1: You have your task. Find Delmar, and ask for his help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035677_Oblivion_RESP1: You have your task. Perform it as well as you would any other.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000399b_Oblivion_RESP1: You have your task. Return as soon as you have the information.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034ea8_Oblivion_RESP2: You have, no doubt, seen some of the worst the guild has to offer. As much as we try to hold mages to a higher standard, they are only human.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_RaynilDralasTopic_00038f3c_Oblivi: You haven't gone to the cave yet? Well, what are you still doing here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AxeofDragol_0001fdba_Oblivion_RES: You haven't guessed it yet? There never was any Axe of Dragol. It was just a ruse to lure you out here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04ChaliceNo_00013309_Oblivion_R: You haven't heard of it, yet you know its name? What a strange creature you are.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00029d66_Oblivion_RESP1: You haven't run home to momma yet, huh? That's a good sign. So, you ready for a match, or do you just need some information?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072db4_Oblivion_RESP1: You haven't seen that filthy cat beggar have you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000139ab_Oblivion_RESP1: You haven't spoken to both Priests. You'll end up making a stupid decision, and you won't live to regret it. Don't do that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bbe_Oblivion_RESP2: You haven't truly eaten a decent meal until you've had my Strawberry Harrada, Greenmote Lime Surprise, and Spiderling Under Glass!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ArgonianBloodTopic_00053734_Obliv: You haven't used it yet, have you? Don't be hesitant. This is the only way.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_00034e13_Oblivion_: You haven't yet been given recommendations by all the necessary individuals, Associate. Keep working at it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS14ChoiceHeard_0001b947_Oblivion: You haven't? That's strange. Rythe is known far and wide as one of the best painters in all Cyrodiil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_EmfridDEMOChoice1_00028a2e_Oblivi: You haven't? Why not? Is this just a game to you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003d4cb_Oblivion_RES: You hear about Gogan? A gang of thieves is running a scam in town, and he fell for it! Hahaha... what an idiot!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00053763_Oblivion_RES: You hear about Jorundr? He was caught stealing gold, and now he's in jail! I bet Arnora's beside herself with grief.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00027f34_Oblivion_RES: You hear any word about Kud-Ei's friend? She's offering a generous reward, so hopefully someone will show up and lend a hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FishermansRockTopicWhy_000860d5_O: You hear me? I TALK to him first. No smashing in his teeth or chopping off his head! Understand?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032eb7_Oblivion_RES: You heard about any new contracts? They'd tell us, wouldn't they?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e3a_Oblivion_RES: You heard about the Fighters Guild members tearing up a tavern in Leyawiin. As if they didn't have enough problems with the Blackwood Company.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e9d_Oblivion_RES: You heard any more about the rat thing in Anvil?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Goblinhunting_00038abf_Oblivion_R: You heard of 'Goblin Jim's Cave'? It's a big one. It's a long walk due north of Skingrad, in the Imperial Reserve... a long way from civilization.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG06Choice1A_0001ceee_Oblivion_RE: You help me pull off a little prank, and I'll help you find J'skar.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD08Choice6_000a345d_Oblivion_RE: You helped her pay my debt. I heard about you. She never hurt anyone! Who could have done this? What monster would do this?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003c143_Oblivion_RESP1: You helped our city fight off those damned daedra. Now it's our turn to help Bruma.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00080d90_Oblivion_RESP1: You helped us at Cylarne. The Mazken do not forget their friends.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002886c_Oblivion_RESP1: You here looking for work, meat? Maybe you want a contract?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017832_Oblivion_RESP1: You hit that Orc so hard, her mother in Orsinium started bleedin'! That victory advances you to the rank of Gladiator. Enjoy the gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_000949a3_Oblivi: You hold the staff, but you are no Daedric Prince!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00081dd0_Oblivion_RESP1: You honor me with your presence, Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00081536_Oblivion_RESP1: You honor me with your presence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081dcb_Oblivion_RESP1: You honor me, Lord. May your Realm be free of cats.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000a0e9_Oblivion_RESP1: You honor us with your presence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00081f5a_Oblivion_RESP1: You horrible creature! You've ruined everything!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0018bd6a_Oblivion_RESP1: You humans are all the same! Weak and worthless!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000907a0_Oblivion_RESP1: You idiot! How could you kill Kurdan before you got Aleron to safety? Get... get out of my sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022cad_Oblivion_RESP1: You idiot! You complete piece of gutter trash! Two disqualifications? That's it! You are hereby stripped of all titles! Get out of my Bloodworks!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e59_Oblivion_RESP1: You impossible fool. What possessed you to think I would suggest a meeting here, of all places?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07KeepForgedLetter_0009839f_Obl: You insolent... do you know who I am? I'll see that Countess Umbranox knows what kind of a fetcher you are!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002a367_Oblivion_RE: You joined the Fighters Guild? Very good. Hard-working, trustworthy folk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002a361_Oblivion_RE: You joined the Mages Guild? Excellent. Good people. Substantial.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f85c_Oblivion_RESP1: You just couldn't wait, could you? So impatient...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gift_0018bc33_Oblivion_RESP2: You just go give them to her. No need to let her know where they came from; it doesn't matter. So long as she's happy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_00047689_Oblivi: You just have to know the right people. Look up Ida Vlinorman and Othrelos in the Elven Gardens. They're the right people.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingDontCare_000131d7_: You just have to try it. It'll change your world, expand your horizons. Contracting leads to expanding, you know. Well, most of the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001d031_Oblivion_RES: You just take care of Agarmir, and I will be sure these things are disposed of properly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a343_Oblivion_RESP1: You just wouldn't leave! So I HAD to call the guards!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS09YourAmulet_0005377c_Oblivion_: You kill me here and now, and as far as the town guard is concerned, it's a crime. So you make your choice. You want to do it my way, or Jorundr's?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_0008fa76_Oblivio: You killed him? Good. I've got to get back to work. And so do you. Keep at it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00090cb5_Oblivion_RESP1: You killed my mother! You ruined my life! I will destroy you all!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017201_Oblivion_RESP2: You killed someone in the Chapel, and now you have to pay the blood price. Until you do, you are no longer a member of this guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46GoblinWar_0002f478_Oblivion_R: You killed the shaman of Cracked Wood Cave!? I'm impressed! Barthel Gernand will be glad to hear that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018d88e_Obliv: You know as much about Mysticism as I do. If you wish to learn more, Dagail can teach you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0003c169_Obliv: You know as much as I do about the art of being a Marksman. There is only one person I know of that is more skilled.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_000097b1_Oblivion_R: You know better than to contact me here. Meet me at the usual place. Dareloth's Garden, at midnight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_0018d7f7_Oblivion_RES: You know how it is. There are whispers in the halls of Cloud Ruler, as in any other place. But it matters not. The Blades stand united!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS21TempleOfAncestors_0002b460_Ob: You know it as White Gold Tower -- the center of the ancient Ayleid capital of Nibenay.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadGukimir1_00002cf1_Knigh: You know me too well. Something someone said today reminded me of Sir Gukimir. He was a fine knight, wasn't he?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_00074a10_Oblivion_RESP1: You know nothing of my father's true power!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_KSharraProphecy_00026af4_Oblivion: You know of the K'Sharra Prophecy? How odd! Are you some sort of scholar?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MythicDawnTopic_00024e7f_Oblivion: You know of them? One of the most secretive of all the daedric cults. Not much is known about them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk4_0018d7f9_Oblivion_RES: You know that no matter what happens, no matter what fate befalls us, together we honor the memory of Uriel Septim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49Choice1A_0002ad7d_Oblivion_RE: You know the drill. Stick close, and keep your eyes open. Let's move out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Interrogate4_00015628_Oblivio: You know truth when you hear it, Herdir. I have spoken truth. You cannot intimidate me, so I suggest you release me at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEMazken_00012cc4_Oblivion_RESP1: You know us as Dark Seducers. A name given us by our enemies. But we are the Mazken in our own tongue, Sheogorath's only truly loyal servants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000164d6_Oblivion_RESP1: You know what Brawler rank is worth around here? Nothing! Face it kid, you're still a maggot! You need to keep fighting if you want to be somebody!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_0008adec_Oblivion_: You know what I know. There is no more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Response_000343b7_Oblivion_RE: You know what I think. We should go home before the goblins find us and kill us all.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00013452_Oblivion_RESP3: You know what it's like now... Always wanting that next fix, hating it but craving it at the same time, and hating yourself for all of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BrumaTopic_0003c9a5_Oblivion_RESP: You know what it's like. Make lots of friends, and look busy. Same as anywhere.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Sanctuary_000251fa_Oblivion_RESP1: You know what they say -- home is where you hang your enemy's head.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeBoots_000400c0_Oblivion_: You know what they say about the size of a man's boots....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeHelmetMagic_000400b7_Obl: You know what they say about the size of a man's forehead, right?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeGauntlets_000400bb_Obliv: You know what they say about the size of a man's hands....
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06ObelisksTopic_000910fa_Oblivi: You know what would be a good sign? "Free Sweetrolls!" Who wouldn't like that?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEThadonWaitingShort_000131db_Obl: You know what's NOT amusing? I don't have my Chalice of Reversal. It makes me sad. When I get sad, I don't care to do much of anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22MaricHighFane_0002b09c_Oblivi: You know what? I will help you, although it is liable to get you killed. The High Fane is now known as Malada, up in the Valus Mountains.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03ElvenBust_0000918a_Oblivion_R: You know where the bust is hidden?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00032e8d_Oblivion_RES: You know where they're burying Rienna?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000434db_Oblivion_RES: You know who's responsible for killing the Gatekeeper, don't you? It's Them.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00025571_Oblivion_RES: You know, Bongond has got some fine horses for sale over at the Grey Mare. Too bad he's such a pushy man.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38TalkItem2_00082432_Oblivion_R: You know, I always walk over here thinking there's another exhibit, but there never is. Silly me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a9848_Oblivion_R: You know, I haven't seen him around for a while. But I'm still getting paid, so what do I care?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_00043ec9_Oblivion_RES: You know, I need to get me a habit like Thadon. Might take the edge off. Life can be so hard. Makes me want to cry all the time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000aed4a_Oblivion_RESP1: You know, I saw your fight against the Gray Prince. Nobody thought that Orc could be beat, but you showed them all! Ha ha ha ha ha!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000241da_Oblivion_RES: You know, I think the mutton here in Chorrol is the best in all the Empire. Mmmm... that's good mutton.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0003c24a_Oblivion_RES: You know, if you need to get better at archery, you should talk to Reman Broder. He's quite a good shot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS37JulienneAmazing_00022e63_Obli: You know, if you're really interested in more, there's a book I read once called "Knightfall." It may have more about Garridan.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033367_Oblivion_R: You know, my time's almost up. Pretty soon I'll be free, and you'll still be stuck in this rat hole, waiting for your execution.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_000607d0_Oblivion_RES: You know, of course, that the Realm would still be in jeopardy were it not for me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImperialCityTopic_0004763b_Oblivi: You know, of course, the Imperial Palace is Ayleid. White Gold Tower, they called it, back in the Middle Merethic, when the Aldmeri ruled Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_0002870d_Oblivion: You know, offer her comfort and support during this difficult time. Besides, I want to watch over her, make sure she stays safe.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UmbacanoTopic_000a984b_Oblivion_R: You know, sometimes I get thirsty during the night shift. Duck out to the Tiber Septim for a quick drink.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_0003333a_Oblivion_R: You know, sometimes, when they let us in the yard, you can hear the sounds from the lake. The boats, the gulls. So close...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00066f26_Oblivion_RESP1: You know, stranger, there comes a time in every man's life when he has to admit that he's lost the fight. Well, I've fought and I've lost.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08Choice5C_00085865_Oblivion_: You know, that's what I like about you. You're such a good listener. Thanks. I feel so much better now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_0002a371_Oblivion_RE: You know, they kick you out of the guild if you get caught doing some incarceration. How many? I forget. But I did a lot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingH2HFight_0006245a_Oblivio: You know, throw a good punch? Can you? I'd like to find out if I'm going to spend time working with you. So are you up for a sparring match?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000176b5_Oblivion_RESP1: You left that Nord in pretty rough shape, Warrior. They'll probably have to ship her back to Skyrim in pieces. Nice work. Here's your take.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00003931_Oblivion_RESP1: You left your charge in that place? Get back there!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE43Ignore_00072dc4_Oblivion_RESP: You like dogs too? That's nice.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c456b_Oblivion_RESP1: You like my amulet? It's enchanted, makes me lucky! I swear it helps me win these matches!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000285a1_Oblivion_RESP2: You listen good. This is your only warning. One more disqualification, and you'll never fight in the Arena again! Now get out of my sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008fa9f_Oblivion_RESP1: You little sugar pie! You've done such a good job! Yes, you have!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00028d6a_Oblivion_R: You look concerned. Is there something you want to tell me about Glarthir?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982c6_Oblivion_RESP1: You look familiar. Do I know you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bca0_Oblivion_RESP1: You look like a bright one.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE30ForgeBowMagic_000400be_Oblivi: You look like a man who can shoot straight and long!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c459d_Oblivion_RESP1: You look like a shrewd businessman.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d491_Oblivion_RESP3: You look like just what we need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a2b8_Oblivion_RESP1: You look like one of the low lifes that infest this place.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00035a1b_Oblivion_RESP1: You look like someone I might be able to help.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c459b_Oblivion_RESP1: You look like someone who's comfortable in heavy armor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d48d_Oblivion_RESP2: You look like you can handle yourself in a fight. And I'm sure you wouldn't mind making a little extra money. Hmmmm...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003d4c6_Oblivion_RESP1: You look like you can hold your own in a fight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022f0f_Oblivion_RESP1: You look like you've seen some travel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0018bcb8_Oblivion_RESP1: You look like you've swung a mace or two in your time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000c4598_Oblivion_RESP1: You look skilled in Alteration. Maybe you can teach me something.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0006fdb3_Oblivion_RESP1: You look tired, my friend. I hope you're holding up all right.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033d11_Oblivion_RESP1: You look tough. Want to join the Fighters Guild?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0001e0dd_Oblivion_RESP1: You look uneasy. I hope things are going well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0003d4dd_Oblivion_RESP1: You look upset that we deceived you. Please, don't be.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechMQ3_00002d14_Knigh: You looked away when the fires flickered, and now act lost that they are gone! Only death remains for Tamriel! Death and oblivion!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGHieronymusLex_00007dfa_Oblivion: You lookin' for him? I might be able to help you... for a donation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000164e8_Oblivion_RESP1: You made it to Bloodletter, which is more than I can say for most people who step into that Arena. Keep it up.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004d0b1_Oblivion_RESP1: You made it! Not that I was worried about you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047226_Oblivion_RESP1: You made it. I didn't think you'd have any trouble. Let's get these Bands off you ...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutsideChoiceSweetroll_0: You make Uungor go away faster. He won't leave without his lucky grapes. Can't eat them. I tried. Give back to him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000224f1_Oblivion_RESP1: You make me sick! Now get out of here before I have Manheim throw you out!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEZoeMalenePykeResponses_00091b17: You make me so happy, Pyke. I will stop my other portraits and paint a picture of this moment to capture it in time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009181_Oblivion_RESP1: You make progress, but your work is not yet done.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000275c2_Oblivion_RESP1: You managed to kill the five house guests, yes. But your inability to remain undetected will cost you. Your bonus for this contract is forfeit.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Benefits_0004b831_Oblivion_RE: You may also summon entertainment to your throne room. Your predecessor found this most invigorating. Speak with me if you wish entertainment.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CastleResidents_000038ba_Oblivion: You may also want to speak to Bittneld, the Captain of the Guard. He can be found on patrol in Chorrol or in the Barracks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00053263_Oblivion_RESP1: You may as well make yourself useful. Carry that torch and stick close.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000178c5_Oblivion_RESP1: You may as well make yourself useful. Here, carry this torch and stick close.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQJauffreHelp_0006b83e_Oblivion_R: You may as well take Prior Maborel's horse from the stable. He won't have use for it any longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001d245_Oblivion_RE: You may ask Gilen Norvalo or Grey-Throat about these creatures as well. They've learned much.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE04Audience_0007fe1e_Oblivion_RE: You may attempt to approach her then. The Lady has been concerned about her safety lately, so be prepared for a hostile reaction.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_0002798d_Oblivion_RESP1: You may be a killer, but are you an actor? I think not. The guests will discover your true identity and you will never leave that house alive.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00030032_Oblivion_RESP2: You may be wondering why you can't see me. We are all wondering the same thing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND10SirAmielSpeech06_00002cbd_Kni: You may call upon our spirits when you need us. Simply pray at our tombs, and each of us will grant you a blessing from the Nine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AChamber_00018ff1_Oblivion_RE: You may choose to spring a fire trap and cause them great harm as they stand before the gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_000811ca_Obl: You may continue to do your worst, Inquisitor, but unless you have some evidence of this preposterous conspiracy, you'll get nothing from me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE12TraitorTaunts_0008f7db_Oblivi: You may find me rather harder to kill than poor, innocent Thadon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05Conspiracy_000895e5_Oblivion_: You may find the enormity of your task daunting at first. Use Herdir's talents to aid you with those who are unresponsive to questioning.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk1_00067dc9_Oblivion_RES: You may have as much of my time as you need, so long as you stop calling me "lord." My name is Martin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00028d6d_Oblivion_R: You may have heard that he's a bit touched in the head, and that may be true, but he's always been a quiet neighbor.  Never given us any trouble.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQWhatNext_00026ef5_Oblivion_RESP: You may have run across lesser Welkynd Stones; they are fairly common in Ayleid ruins. But a Great Welkynd Stone will not be easy to come by.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000982c5_Oblivion_RESP1: You may join us for morning prayers in the chapel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG09accept_00014826_Oblivion_RESP: You may kill Fathis if necessary, but not in the castle. My spy network will tell me when you have it. Return here with the arrow when you do.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesGuildTopic_00062618_Oblivion: You may need to ask around, but training in all the schools of magic can be found at our various guild halls.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003640a_Oblivion_RESP1: You may not leave here until your initiation is complete. Lord Dagon thirsts for red-drink. Sate him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05ShrinePassword_0001f10b_Obliv: You may pass into the Shrine. Harrow will take you to the Master for your initiation into the service of Lord Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ05ShrinePassword_0001f874_Obliv: You may pass into the Shrine. Harrow will take you to the Master for your initiation into the service of Lord Dagon.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG08GiveStone_00014705_Oblivion_R: You may pay me now, or Armand Christophe later should you choose to return to my good graces.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Benefits_0004b831_Oblivion_RE: You may request any of the Golden Saint or Dark Seducer Escorts at the castle to accompany you. They will defend you to the death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ResistArrest_000459ba_Oblivion_RE: You may rule Mania, but you will learn that Lord Sheogorath's justice still applies to you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_00054829_Oblivion_RES: You may slay me, but we have already won.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NecromancersMoon_00002dcf_Oblivio: You may take that with you for now, if you wish. The Council may have use for it. Please ask them to return it quickly, as I may need it again.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaB2_000a5603_Oblivion_: You may think so, in your ignorance. But I take a larger view. As a scholar of the Ayleids, I have no wish to see their evil power return.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0002db97_Oblivion_: You may try to speak to her. If... if it doesn't go well, come see me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VampireTopic_0001d4b4_Oblivion_RE: You may want to see if Grey-Throat or Gilen have done more research.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SeridurTopic_0001d4c2_Oblivion_RE: You may want to speak to Phintias at the First Edition bookshop in the Market District of the city. I know he goes there occasionally.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseBuyImperialCity_000531bc_Obl: You may want to spruce it up a bit with some furnishings. I'd suggest talking to Sergius Verus at Three Brothers Trade Goods in the Market District.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06WhereIsShum_0000bf94_Oblivion: You mean other than at the Castle? Hmmm. He's around town at midday. Try the Colovian Trader and the West Weald Inn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32Betrothed_00012d0f_Oblivion_R: You mean that stupid doll? I think he's been blessed a little too well by Lord Sheogorath. He's on the list. Not first though. Definitely not first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetTopic_00002a8c_Knights_R: You mean the Holy Hermit of Anvil? No one knows where he comes from, but they say he has the true word. I'd love to go hear him preach.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MartinTopic_0001e8aa_Oblivion_RES: You mean the priest? Last I saw him, he was leading a group towards the Chapel of Akatosh.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DaedraShrineTopic_000a4959_Oblivi: You mean the shrine to Nocturnal? That's north of Leyawiin, east of the Lower Niben.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG06Theranis_00010500_Oblivion_RE: You mean the thief? He was in the big cell with that Argonian. They were always whispering to each other. The Pale Lady took him days ago.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Choice2B_000242b4_Oblivion_RE: You mean there are still ogres there?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG04GoodWord_00035faf_Oblivion_RE: You mean with the Thieves Guild? Sure, that way I'll be a member in good standing when they put my head on a pole!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG11TalkToMillona10_00022e84_Obli: You mean you were unable to return?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HorseTooMuchSkingrad_000545de_Obl: You mean you're too poor. That's a fair price for this horse.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e896_Oblivion: You might also look at Quickwater Cave to the north. I cleared it out, but I haven't been there in years. It might have new tenants.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0001c27e_Oblivion_: You might be ready, but the Arena ain't. Matches take place between 9:00 AM and 9:00 PM. Come back later, moron.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ImpGallTOPIC_0002ee71_Oblivion_RE: You might check Robbers Glen Cave for the imp gall. That place has been known to contain the imps.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MiscarcandTopic_00026efe_Oblivion: You might find 'Glories and Laments Among the Ayleid Ruins' useful. I have the library's copy at my table if you need it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE44AllItems_0007873c_Oblivion_RE: You might find it handy to cause confusion in your enemies. You know... when the time comes.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG01Choice1A_0002d414_Oblivion_RE: You might want to ask around, and see if anyone can be of some help. Let me know when he's back, and you'll have your recommendation.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BleakFlatsCaveTopic_0002d6e7_Obli: You might want to make sure she remembers. Especially the part about it being her idea.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG13EridorWhy_0003446f_Oblivion_R: You mind your business, and we'll mind ours.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BradonLirrianTopic_00038f3d_Obliv: You must avenge his unjust death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002c51a_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be Umbacano's new plaything. Well met! I am Claude Maric, another pawn in Umbacano's game.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0000c167_Oblivion_: You must be downright determined to get yourself killed, huh? Okay then, head back up to the Arena and try not to die before the gate opens.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS12Reman_000980f6_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be joking, right? Who hasn't heard of the greatest known hero of the First Age?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d58e_Oblivion_RESP2: You must be new. Oh, it's so nice to see new faces in the guild!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MysteriumXarxes_00022b3c_Oblivion: You must be referring to Mankar Camoran's "Commentaries on the Mysterium Xarxes." A common mistake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0004f8b0_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be rid of the staff, or the scamps will follow you around forever!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS26CorruptGuard_00035c9f_Oblivio: You must be stupid to accuse me of corruption to my face.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDBootsoftheCrusader_00002a49_Kni: You must be tested by Kynareth before you are worthy of the Boots.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000a7156_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be the Gray Fox. Your reputation precedes you, as I'm sure you know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000982d9_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be the cat burglar I've been told to expect. Follow me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0000bf98_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be the new slop drudge.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028877_Oblivion_RESP1: You must be the reinforcement from the guild. Good. I hope you brought weapons for us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark09RetFinChoice1A_00032bec_Obl: You must break one of the Tenets you have sworn to uphold. I know this is an unexpected turn of events, but drastic measures must be taken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark09RetFinChoice1B_00032bed_Obl: You must break one of the Tenets you have sworn to uphold. I know this is an unexpected turn of events, but drastic measures must be taken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark09RetFinChoice1C_00032bee_Obl: You must break one of the Tenets you have sworn to uphold. I know this is an unexpected turn of events, but drastic measures must be taken.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c360_Oblivion_RESP1: You must bring that evidence to Garrus. Make haste.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00002de1_Oblivion_R: You must do more to fill the guild's treasury before I can assign you commission jobs.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ07ProgressNone_00038fad_Oblivio: You must eliminate both the Mythic Dawn agents in Bruma. We cannot allow them to continue to plot against us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000685a4_Oblivion_RESP1: You must enter the portal to Camoran's Paradise and reclaim the Amulet of Kings!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029de_Knights_RESP1: You must excuse me, as I'm not feeling well.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0018bc60_Obliv: You must find J'baana, and learn from him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HistTreeTopic_0003570c_Oblivion_R: You must find a way to destroy the Hist, though I can imagine Ri'Zakar will have it well guarded. Expect an unfriendly welcome at their hall.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000029da_Knights_RESP1: You must finish what you have started if you wish the gods to look upon you with favor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetGreeting03_00002c11_Kn: You must first kill his living body. While beyond the power of most mortals, this is only the lesser of your two tasks.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7c_Oblivion_RESP5: You must fullfill your new duties. The statue in Bravil serves as a conduit between the Night Mother and the Listener.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGBaurusF_0001e90a_Oblivion_RESP1: You must get the Amulet to Jauffre. Take no chances, but proceed to Weynon Priory immediately. Got it?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00038580_Oblivion_RESP4: You must get there before he acquires whatever artifact is being kept there and makes his escape.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00089938_Oblivion_RESP2: You must get to the top of the large tower. The Sigil Keep, they call it. That's what keeps the Oblivion Gate open!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00022a12_Oblivion_RESP1: You must get us out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreE1_0001e74e_Oblivion_R: You must go to Kvatch and find him at once. If the enemy is aware of his existence, as seems likely, he is in terrible danger.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark04FinChoice1A_000253d7_Oblivi: You must go to the city of Chorrol and break into the house of Francois Motierre. Inside you will find Motierre waiting for you. Do not kill him!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Selene05Positive_00015264_Obl: You must have been hiding down there and made your way up here. How did you get past Minx, Wrath and Lynch?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE32WhatCanIDo_00012d05_Oblivion_: You must help us break the cycle of torment. Help my people overcome their weakness and defend Vitharn from the Fanatics.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000293f_Knights_RESP1: You must help us, Sir Knight! Save Cheydinhal from those monsters!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000293c_Knights_RESP1: You must help! They appeared out of nowhere and started attacking!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS29StopNo_0001e841_Oblivion_RESP: You must hurry. We cannot let him do this horrible task any longer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark06FinChoice1A_0003005d_Oblivi: You must infiltrate Fort Sutch, find Roderick's medicine, and replace it with a poisoned bottle I will provide. But you must remain undetected!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_000233d8_Oblivion_RESP1: You must infiltrate the Imperial Prison and kill Valen Dreth, a Dark Elf. He should be easy enough to eliminate, once you actually get inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ServiceRefusal_0018d15c_Oblivion_: You must know your craft, and its history, before I will teach you anything.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS05WhatGives_0002c6db_Oblivion_R: You must learn to broaden your thoughts and hold your tongue! Allow me to explain before jumping to conclusions!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c35d_Oblivion_RESP1: You must locate Aldos. He's a danger to himself and others in his condition.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BlackSoulGemMG17_000151f5_Oblivio: You must make sure the gem does not reach Mannimarco. We are doomed if it does.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00094c38_Oblivion_RESP1: You must not have heard me the first time. Good day!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GlarthirTopic_00029aa5_Oblivion_R: You must not have heard. He went crazy and killed Davide Surilie with an axe! Nobody can figure out why.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15Anaxes_00047366_Oblivion_RESP: You must not release him, for pity's sake!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5A_00022ba9_Oblivion_: You must now go to the city of Cheydinhal, to the abandoned house near the eastern wall. Enter the basement, and attempt to open the Black Door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5B_00022baa_Oblivion_: You must now go to the city of Cheydinhal, to the abandoned house near the eastern wall. Enter the basement, and attempt to open the black door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice5C_00022bab_Oblivion_: You must now go to the city of Cheydinhal, to the abandoned house near the eastern wall. Enter the basement, and attempt to open the black door.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00035e02_Oblivion_RESP3: You must open these sealed orders immediately and follow their instructions to the letter. It would seem the Black Hand itself has a task for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE03AWhatWere_000807b9_Oblivion_R: You must proceed to Sheogorath at once and tell him the Knights have returned! Quickly now... go!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirGauntlets_00002b24_Kni: You must prove to Stendarr you are worthy to lift the Gauntlets once more. Seek out the priests in Chorrol. Perhaps they can help you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG00JoinA_0002d289_Oblivion_RESP2: You must receive a recommendation from every local guild hall in Cyrodiil before you may advance through the ranks of the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DEAkTimeWound_00014e28_AltarDelux: You must retreive it at all costs, Hero.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b5_Oblivion_RESP2: You must return any property that does not belong to you. Now, will you serve your sentence in the dungeon, or pay reparations?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b7_Oblivion_RESP2: You must return any stolen items. I regret that I have no choice but to escort you to the dungeon, as you are short of the required reparations.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ02JauffreE1_0001e74d_Oblivion_R: You must return to Kvatch at once, and rescue Martin if he lives. There is no time to lose!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024e54_Oblivion_RESP1: You must slay the sacrifice to bind yourself fully to Lord Dagon's service. Lord Dagon thirsts for blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001d243_Oblivion_RESP1: You must speak with Seridur first.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Choice2A_0004cacf_Oblivion_: You must then flee from Chorrol, and Hides-His-Heart must not be killed! That way he can go back and tell his employers I'm dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark05Choice2B_0004cad0_Oblivion_: You must then flee from Chorrol, and Hides-His-Heart must not be killed! That way he can go back and tell his employers I'm dead.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_00188308_Oblivion_RES: You must understand our need for darkness and secrecy? Speak to me only between the hours of midnight and 3:00 AM, and we will be off.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice4SoWhat_00061c4c_Oblivi: You must... you must kill me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChorrolTopic_00024e11_Oblivion_RE: You need a place to sleep in Chorrol? Well, why don't you just join the Fighters Guild, or Mages Guild? Sleep for free around Cyrodiil!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00091757_Oblivion_RESP2: You need his blood, so take it!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGSpecialJobs_00034877_Oblivion_R: You need more experience before I can use you on a commission job. Ongar tells me that you haven't turned in much loot yet.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_bed_0003b346_Oblivion_RESP1: You need someplace to rest? I can rent you a room for the night for 10 gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00004b9d_DLCVileLair_RES: You need something... special? Check out my wares. You won't find this stuff at your local general store, that's for damn sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000c45bb_Oblivion_RESP1: You need something... special? Check out my wares. You won't find this stuff at your local general store, that's for damn sure.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00025292_Oblivion_RESP1: You need something? A room maybe?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00027d7e_Oblivion_RESP3: You need to close the Great Gate! We'll try to hold them off as long as we can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MartinTopic_0003406c_Oblivion_RES: You need to find him at once and bring him safely back here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007bacf_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to find the Count! Get moving!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00003935_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to find the Stone of St. Alessia and return it to Cirroc at the Chapel of Talos in Bruma. Now, get to it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfbf_Oblivion_RE: You need to find us work. You're supposed to be boss!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000091f6_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to finish out the contract with Biene Amelion in Water's Edge. What's the status?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e8b1_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to get out of here. There's no telling who will come first, the Blades or more assassins.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002006f_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to get the Mysterium Xarxes from the Mythic Dawn's Shrine of Dagon. It is our only hope to retrieve the Amulet of Kings.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000be61_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to go find Lady Rogbut, meat! Why are you standing here talking to me?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008320d_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to help Arvena Thelas with her rat problem. What's on your mind?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_0007dfe9_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to leave this place, mortal. Quickly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterFail_000091e1_Oblivion_RESP: You need to make a better offer.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00054221_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to see Ugak if you want to buy a horse. She's inside.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEFelldew_00043020_Oblivion_RESP2: You need to strike a balance with how often you ingest Felldew, and how willing you are to live with the side-effects.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00009c35_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to take care of those fugitives from the prison break in Bravil.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00024da5_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to take care of you problems with the guild before we can talk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002e586_Oblivion_RESP1: You need to track down Maglir. Again. Look for him in Bravil. Now go.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_VidkunTopic_0002e5b1_Oblivion_RES: You needn't concern yourself with him. He was unfit to be a guild member, and it's better that he's no longer part of it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c67c_Oblivion_RESP: You needn't tell me the details of what was involved in getting it; it's perhaps better that I know nothing about it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Barter_00038992_Oblivion_RESP1: You never know when you might need a good strong potion. Best to stock up now while you can!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00047630_Oblivion_RESP1: You new here? I'm Servatius Quintilius, Officer of the Watch. Just stay out of trouble, and we'll get along just fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0ba_Oblivion_RESP: You notice all the Nords around here? It's partly because Nords like ships and sailing. Mostly, we're sick of freezing our asses off in Skyrim.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07ARuler_00031622_Oblivion_RESP: You now have the power to summon Dark Seducers. They've always served the Duke of Dementia. I think they have a thing for pain.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE07BRuler_0009130d_Oblivion_RESP: You now have the power to summon Golden Saints. They've always served the Duke of Mania. I think it's the bright colors. They just love 'em.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_00019cce_Ob: You now hold the physical component of the Staff of Sheogorath. Before it is complete however, it must be imbued with power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_0001811e_Oblivion: You now owe your loyalty to our guildmaster, the Gray Fox. He has three rules you must follow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG01ThievesTest_0001c14e_Oblivion: You now owe your loyalty to our guildmaster, the Gray Fox. He has three rules you must follow.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_UniqueSummoningTopic_00091914_Obl: You of course recall Rufio, the feeble old man I sent you to kill when we first met? He was weak in life, but his spirit is quite angry in death.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355a_Oblivion_R: You outrank me, now, so there's certainly no more I can do for you. You might check with an old friend of yours, though.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000a55ec_Oblivion_RESP1: You owe S'razirr. Will you pay?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE09VictimChoice1b_00082090_Obliv: You persecute genius when you find it, because we are able to see around the sharp corners of your simplified "morality."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d765_Oblivion_RESP1: You picked a bad time to visit Kvatch.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDProphetSpeechLoremasters_00002d: You pore over your dusty tomes of lore. You study ancient genealogies and bloodlines.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice2A_00090792_Oblivion_: You possess strength, and cunning, and a heart as black as midnight. You were marked by Sithis the moment you emerged from your mother's womb.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice2B_00090793_Oblivion_: You possess strength, and cunning, and a heart as black as midnight. You were marked by Sithis the moment you emerged from your mother's womb.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark18Choice2C_00090794_Oblivion_: You possess strength, and cunning, and a heart as black as midnight. You were marked by Sithis the moment you emerged from your mother's womb.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE11StaffOfSheogorath_0007eb5e_Ob: You possess the eye and the branch. Together, they shall form the physical shape of the Staff of Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice2C_00022ba1_Oblivion_: You prefer silence, then? As do I, my dear child. As do I. For is silence not the symphony of death, the orchestration of Sithis himself?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BarterSellItem_0009ea87_Oblivion_: You probably cheated me, didn't you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS49ChoiceNoTime_00031d2c_Oblivio: You probably couldn't find it on your own. I'm coming with you. If we make it, I'll open the door for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE36Choice6HowDie_00061c4e_Oblivi: You probably want to do it without spectators though, so you don't get in trouble. Best to make it look like an accident.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDSirBerichTopic_00002c7c_Knights: You put right the evil that I began through my own weakness. Sir Berich is once again part of our fellowship, and shall be forevermore.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE38OddityDonate_00043439_Oblivio: You really are a dear! A true friend to the Museum. Perhaps Lord Sheogorath himself will come see the exhibit one day.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000301e0_Oblivion_RESP1: You really enjoy this whole hero thing, don't you? Everybody fawning all over you? I'm not like that.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002983_Knights_RESP1: You really fought that Umaril creature in the sky over the Imperial City? I would have liked to have seen that!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00053774_Oblivion_RESP2: You really should be more careful when you talk in the dungeons... the sound tends to carry. Jorundr's such an idiot.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SESheogorathHitTalk_0005552c_Obli: You really shouldn't have done that. Enjoy the view.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002914_Knights_RESP1: You redeemed my soul from the evil that had ensnared me. For that I am forever in your debt.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e43e_Oblivion_RESP1: You remain faithful. That is good. I will cut your throat if you visit that other smith.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007311e_Oblivion_RESP1: You remind me of a character from a book I'm reading.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cec_Oblivion_RESP1: You remind me of a witch I once knew. I hate witches.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_00062cf5_Oblivion_RESP1: You remind me of my homeland. During the Blight.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06HelpDefendA2_000131b8_Oblivio: You return to Kaneh and lead her into the trap. Once they are destroyed, I will kindle the Altars. Good hunting, friend.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000029a4_Knights_RESP1: You return to Kynareth's Altar. Have you changed your mind? Do you still seek the Boots of the Crusader?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003630e_Oblivion_RESP1: You return to me, yet you bear no news? Go, Silencer, uncover the identity of the traitor! The fate of the Dark Brotherhood rests in your hands!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND03TestofKynareth_00002a56_Knigh: You return unsuccessful, but have involved yourself in other matters. Settle your combat, and return to me then.
