ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00033dd5_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not afraid of trouble, are you? You'd like the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril4_00002c4d_Knights_RE: You're not alone. We all find the waiting difficult at times. I will pray for you, and I ask the same of you. Go with the blessing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS16Brothers_00084a9f_Oblivion_RE: You're not dreaming, Reynald. It's me, your brother. Guilbert.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00022b8b_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not easy to get a hold of. What have you found out?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DovesiDranTopic_00028711_Oblivion: You're not even worthy enough to mention her name, you low-born parasite. Now get away from me before YOU wind up dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AnvilTopic_0003e0b9_Oblivion_RESP: You're not from around here, are you? Just a warning... be careful if you go swimming. It's the slaughterfish. They'll swarm you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatesOfMadness_0007eae7_Obliv: You're not getting in because you're not blessed by Sheogorath. You can try to get the keys. My Lord had them sewn into my child's body.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13MartinA1_00027101_Oblivion_RE: You're not going to like it. Jauffre doesn't like it. The Countess of Bruma certainly isn't going to like it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfb5_Oblivion_RE: You're not half the man your father was.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenTaunt2_00033355_Oblivion_R: You're not leaving this prison 'til they throw your body in the lake. Oh, that's right. You're going to die in here, Breton! You're going to die!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CheydinhalTopic_0004e8cf_Oblivion: You're not on my list. And that's all I have to say. If you were somebody, I'd know. But I don't, so you aren't.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofMalacathTOPIC_0001ec2f_Ob: You're not one of Malacath's favorite people. He likes Orcs. Too bad for you.  So you approach His shrine at your own risk.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004735b_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not one of us, are you? Are you here to destroy Gaiar Alata and end our nightmare?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000a172_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not supposed to be down here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002a377_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not supposed to be here now. Leave, please.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Trespass_00062272_Oblivion_RESP1: You're not supposed to be in here...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE06DSWardenGreet2_00018e7f_Obliv: You're not very good at this are you?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_AxeofDragol_0001fdba_Oblivion_RES: You're now the prey in Kurdan's insane hunt, just like I am. And here, we'll most likely die.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE37Errand_000452f8_Oblivion_RESP: You're offering to help me with my research? Well... I suppose I could find a use for you, despite your lack of training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfce_Oblivion_RE: You're paying for all of this!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_0002830a_Oblivion: You're pissing me off, what next?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MaladaTopic_0002c52a_Oblivion_RES: You're probably wondering what this one is doing in this gods-forsaken wilderness. Same here. S'razirr doesn't get paid nearly enough for this.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_0003d7b3_Oblivion_: You're ready to fight? Good, good! All right then, head up to the Arena and give the people a great show!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003c354_Oblivion_RESP1: You're really pushing it. Just keep disturbing me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkUmaril3_00002c50_Knights_RE: You're right, of course. When we strike, we will strike with the holy power of the gods behind us!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27HerminiaD2_000a5606_Oblivion_: You're right. Even if I persuade you, he'll send someone else, someone less amenable to reason.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DANocturnalConvo1_00026ab3_Oblivi: You're right. I know. I'm just worried. I'll try to calm down.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS48IlendA2_001778d0_Oblivion_RES: You're right. You're right. I can't just leave poor Menian to his fate. If he's still alive, we've got to try to save him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight3_00002cd9_Knight: You're right. You're right. Thank you. Perhaps we can reminisce more later.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_0003d4d5_Oblivion_RESP1: You're sharp for an adventurer. If you ever decide to retire, I'm sure the Anvil City Watch would love to have you.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE46DoublesTopic_00081ed5_Oblivio: You're still annoying me, but not as much as the other J'zidzo.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000476fa_Oblivion_RESP1: You're talking to Algot the Northerner. Guess you've got nothing better to do.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_LorgrenLichSpeech_0006e7f6_Oblivi: You've assisted me in completing the very thing Carahil and his cabal sought to prevent all those years ago... my ascension to immortality.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355b_Oblivion_R: You've been doing a good job, and under a lot of scrutiny. I've been authorized to promote you to the rank of Guardian. Good work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001e3ff_Oblivion_RESP1: You've been speaking to Thadon. I can tell. He has a certain... effect on people.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025df4_Oblivion_RESP1: You've brought back the horns. Your rank and responsibilities are restored. There will be no further chances given you.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_0002ae2d_Oblivion_RESP1: You've calmed them down. That's good. Now go find out what the hell is going on down there! Look past the symptoms, fool!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000452e4_Oblivion_RESP1: You've caught me a Baliwog! I can't wait to study it. Let's go inside and I'll pay you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0006a7ef_Oblivion_RESP1: You've certainly done your part protecting Xedilian. Should Sheogorath ever decide to visit, I'll be sure to inform him of your proficiency.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008e8e4_Oblivion_RESP1: You've chosen a side, little one. You'll get what's coming to you eventually.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00028865_Oblivion_RESP3: You've come this far with us; will you go further? If we're truly going to succeed, I'll need much more of your help.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025e22_Oblivion_RESP1: You've committed yet another crime against your Fighters Guild brothers. Go speak with Donton. Until then, goodbye.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f11f_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you do not belong here. Quickly! Put on a robe before the others see you! They will kill you on sight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00016b58_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you do not belong here. You are a stranger!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000286d9_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you murdering dog! How could you have killed all those people? For the gold, is that it? You filthy peasant!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05SylWho_000139b3_Oblivion_RESP: You... you will help me. Yes, yes. You will be most useful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS08UrsanneNoWorry_0001f42c_Obliv: You... you will? Oh thank you! Please be careful, I don't wish any harm to befall you either.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00072dab_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you're a cat! Get away from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NightMother_00086763_Oblivion_RES: You... you're asking me about the Night Mother? Well, I... I mean... she is our Unholy Matron! She... she speaks... to you!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000286d6_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you're still alive... For all I know, you're the killer! You stand your ground, or so help me they'll be blood between us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002822c_Oblivion_RESP1: You... you're the only one left... By Azura, no! Please, please don't kill me. I beg of you! Spare my life! Aggghhh!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_PrimoAntoniusTopic_0002818d_Obliv: You... you're trying to turn me against that sweet boy. Make me think he's the murderer! Get away from me, you fiend!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEBolwing_0008153b_Oblivion_RESP1: You...you can! Bless you, My Lord! I should have known that you of all people would be able to understand me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02GatekeeperChoice2Accepted_000: You? Hah! No. You have a "conventional" type of soul. But, I don't make that decision. The Shivering Isles belong to Lord Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00095023_Oblivion_RESP1: You? What are you doing here?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003e901_Oblivion_RESP1: You? Why would I want to talk with you? Very well, out with it before I change my mind and add you to my list of experiments!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS31Minx03Final_0001525c_Oblivion: You? You bested Lynch? I always knew he was out of practice. Oh well, I suppose it's up to me to do his job for him as usual!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FGD02Insults_0002cfb6_Oblivion_RE: You? You wouldn't know a good sword if it stabbed you in the throat!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofAureal_0008f173_O: Your Grace has noted the chimes around the Wellspring, I assume. If one chime is insufficient, perhaps all four chimes may be enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofMazken_0008f174_O: Your Grace has noted the chimes around the Wellspring, I assume. If one chime is insufficient, perhaps all four chimes may be enough.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofMazken_000824bd_O: Your Grace has restored the Wellspring, and saved us. For this we thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofAureal_00082636_O: Your Grace has restored the Wellspring, and saved us. For this, we thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofMazken_0008ef32_O: Your Grace has restored the Wellspring, and saved us. For this, we thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10WellspringofMazken_0008ef33_O: Your Grace has restored the Wellspring, and saved us. For this, we thank you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f049_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace must assist us, or we could be lost to this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008f04d_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace must assist us, or we could be lost to this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DukeofDementia_0001746c_Obliv: Your Grace! I am sorry, I did not realize...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10DukeofMania_0001746d_Oblivion: Your Grace! I am sorry, I did not realize...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001797d_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace! We didn't expect you here. Aurig Desha is in command. You should speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017976_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace! We didn't expect you here. Grakendo Udico is in command. You should speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001796c_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace! You... you're alive! Truly, you are the greatest warrior ever to hold the seat of Dementia!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f37f_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, Adeo has been waiting for you. Please, speak with her at once.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebf1_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, I bend my knee to you. How you survived the collapse, I cannot imagine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001f380_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, Issmi has been waiting for you. Please speak with her.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001796f_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, a dark time has been thrust upon us. Passwall is under attack. We are outmatched and outnumbered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040363_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, has Relmyna sent you on an errand? Do you need help with your task?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00017967_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, the situation is grim. Passwall is under attack. We are outmatched and outnumbered.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001680f_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, there is trouble! You must come quickly!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040366_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, why disturb this ceremony? Oh,  I must have come accidentally. I should come when it is more appropriate. My apologies.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000459b5_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, you have committed a crime. Only the Lord Sheogorath is above the laws of this Realm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007ec70_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Grace, you honor us with your presence.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ChallengeHighElf_0009f9b2_Oblivio: Your High Elf opponent is cool and confident. Go! Let the contest begin.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000146f1_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Highness, what are your orders? Shall the Guard fall back to the Palace?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ04Conv_00037c3b_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Highness. The Blades are at your command. You will be safe here until you can take up your throne.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000276a8_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Highness? I am Narina Carvain, Countess of Bruma, at your service.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND09ProphetQuestionsEnd_00002c18_: Your Knights will assemble at Garlas Malatar and await you there. Gather all those who you deem worthy.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenMain_0004f779_Oblivion_RES: Your Majesty, we need to keep moving.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7b_Oblivion_RESP3: Your Purification of the Cheydinhal Sanctuary. You, a mere underling, even managed to single-handedly eliminate half of my Black Hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0008faa3_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Seducers are at the ready, Your Grace.

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0004ed61_Oblivion_RESP1: Your Strong Elixir is complete. I think you'll be pleased with the results.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355e_Oblivion_R: Your accomplishments are impressive. Because of this, I bestow upon you the rank of Warder of the Fighters Guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002d3a1_Oblivion_RESP4: Your actions are duly noted, and your reward will be in gold.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MagesStaff_0002c67c_Oblivion_RESP: Your actions for the guild more than merit a recommendation. I shall send it to the University promptly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00025036_Oblivion_RESP1: Your actions have gotten you suspended from the guild.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Gang_0008676b_Oblivion_RESP2: Your actions have set back our investigation, and maybe driven the rest of the gang into hiding. Nice work.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_00046825_Oblivion_RES: Your assistance may be needed in Hale, Lord. If you are otherwise occupied, I'm certain the survivors will understand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Attacks_00046820_Oblivion_RES: Your attention is still needed at Highcross, though I realize it must be inconvenient for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ND06CasimirHurryUp_00002b26_Knigh: Your attitude does not bode well. Nevertheless, you may yet succeed where I failed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GatherClues_000034aa_Oblivion_RES: Your best bet is to speak to residents of the castle. Once you have found out all you can, search for physical clues.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018f96_Oblivion_RESP1: Your betrayal of the Aureals was a strategem worthy of one of my own people! Victory by means of treachery is the sweetest kind.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00036414_Oblivion_RESP1: Your blood will satisfy Lord Dagon just as well as the prisoner's. It will be our honor to spill your blood for Him, if you choose that path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HouseTooMuchSkingrad_0004f218_Obl: Your blood? I wouldn't dream of paying 10,000 gold for your blood. But that is the price for that house. Take it or leave it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG18Choice2B_00070486_Oblivion_RE: Your body will be preserved as a Worm Thrall. Your soul is mine; I intend to study both to learn more about the source of your power.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d29f_Oblivion_RESP1: Your bravery is the talk of Skingrad. Well done!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001ebb4_Oblivion_RESP1: Your business with Vaermina is complete. Tremble should she visit you in your dreams.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13NarinaMartin1_0002777e_Oblivi: Your champion has already explained the situation to me. I have agreed to it. We will not win this war through caution.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08ChoiceStartOver_00035623_Obli: Your choices are Destruction, Illusion, or Mysticism. Which will it be?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TrainingQuestTopic_0006139e_Obliv: Your courage is admirable, but now is not the time. Once Kvatch is safe from these attackers, then we might speak of training.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG03Reveal_00045f69_Oblivion_RESP: Your credibility is suspect. You'll have to do better than that to persuade me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000295c_Knights_RESP1: Your crimes are of no account to me. I am neither judge nor priest.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1A_000262d5_Oblivion_: Your dead drops went unvisited, your targets ignored. Instead, you have been systematically killing off all the members of the Black Hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1B_000262d6_Oblivion_: Your dead drops went unvisited, your targets ignored. Instead, you have been systematically killing off all the members of the Black Hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1C_000262d7_Oblivion_: Your dead drops went unvisited, your targets ignored. Instead, you have been systematically killing off all the members of the Black Hand!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ShrineofClavicusVileTOPIC_000b97c: Your deal is made. Return when you have done your part.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DABoethiaChoice2_0001ec93_Oblivio: Your decision is a wise one. You would be foolish to think that you might gain the favor of Boethia.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ec5e_Oblivion_RESP1: Your desires are my command, my lady.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007ec5d_Oblivion_RESP1: Your desires are my command, my lord.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CharGenEmperor_0000bcac_Oblivion_: Your destiny calls you down a different road. Please help us.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05PostTortureGreet_000811c7_Obl: Your efforts are futile. You'll get nothing from me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Hit_00074a08_Oblivion_RESP1: Your efforts are in vain, mortal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000270f0_Oblivion: Your efforts are starting to pay off. Just knowing we do not stand alone has raised the morale of the Bruma Guard.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0009db23_Oblivion_RESP1: Your failure angers Mephala. Leave here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15MankarRant_0008c23e_Oblivion_: Your false gods could not entirely rewrite history. Thus you remember tales of Lorkhan, vilified, a dead trickster, whose heart came to Tamriel.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS46Response_000343b4_Oblivion_RE: Your father was the one that got us into this mess! I'm tired of you always defending him.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_contract_00003885_Oblivion_RESP1: Your first contract requires the killing of a pirate captain, on his ship. Are you ready to accept?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1A_000262d5_Oblivion_: Your first dead drop contract, you carried that out, killed Celedaen. After that, you eliminated the Draconis family, as ordered. Then, betrayal!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark16Choice1B_000262d6_Oblivion_: Your first dead drop contract, you carried that out, killed Celedaen. After that, you eliminated the Draconis family, as ordered. Then, betrayal!

ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Duties_0004b830_Oblivion_RESP: Your first duty is to attend to the needs of your subjects. You will find that there are constant threats to the residents of the Isles.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_duties_000356c4_Oblivion_RESP1: Your first duty should be to name your second-in-command. I can think of no one better for this job than Modryn Oreyn.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00034065_Oblivion_RESP1: Your first priority now should be to find Martin and bring him back here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS22HighFane_0002af36_Oblivion_RE: Your first task is to locate the ruins of the High Fane. I believe it must now be known by a different name.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE40SleepOutside_000790bf_Oblivio: Your friend ain't sleeping, eh? You could buy one of me sticks - a dreamstick, yes! Hit him over the head. Knock him into dreamland. No? Hmmm.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_000153ae_Oblivion: Your generosity restores your honor within the guild. You may now seek membership.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_information_00009224_Oblivion_RES: Your guild does not fully appreciate the danger which quickly approaches. Hopefully when you return to them, their eyes will be opened.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TGPayBloodPrice_000174ba_Oblivion: Your honor is restored. The Thieves Guild welcomes you back. This one may now pay you for finding the book.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan3_00018c88_Obliv: Your insight is impressive. While we draw their attention here, you should be able to slip inside Xeddefen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE08CommanderPlan3_00018c89_Obliv: Your insight is impressive. While we draw their attention here, you should be able to slip inside Xeddefen.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE10GreymarchTopic_0009148a_Obliv: Your job is still to stop it. And to stop Jyggalag. You've already forced Order's hand.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE14Duties_0004b830_Oblivion_RESP: Your job is to protect them, either by dealing with the matter yourself, or sending your armies to take care of it for you.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00009c7b_Oblivion_RESP2: Your killing of the old man Baenlin... the execution of Adamus Phillida... the way you stalked and murdered each member of the Draconis family...
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTalkDeadKnight3_00002cda_Knight: Your kind words comfort me. I'll try to follow your example. Thank you for lending me your ear.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002fdb3_Oblivion_RESP4: Your life in the Sanctuary is over. Those contracts are behind you. Now, you will serve the Black Hand. You will serve me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Attack_0008f127_Oblivion_RESP1: Your light will shine no more.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC6_0003e8fd_Oblivion_: Your mind follows the simple path ... the choice of an animal. You see an enemy and you attack it, unthinking.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetC2_0003e8f7_Oblivion_: Your mind follows the simple path, the choice of an animal. But you have courage, at least.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0002e71e_Oblivion_RESP6: Your name shall be revered and your deeds placed into song to be performed by the greatest bards for generations to come. Congratulations!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00031eba_Oblivion_RESP6: Your name shall be revered and your deeds placed into song to be performed by the greatest bards for generations to come. Congratulations!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00018f97_Oblivion_RESP1: Your name will be hailed whenever we toast this day's victory in our halls at Pinnacle Rock.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab2_Kn: Your need must be great for the gods to allow us to speak.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1A_00032bf0_Obliv: Your next contract can be found at the dead drop on Hero Hill, southeast of here. A hollow in the moss-covered rock contains all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1B_00032bf1_Obliv: Your next contract can be found at the dead drop on Hero Hill, southeast of here. A hollow in the moss-covered rock contains all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark10SancChoice1C_00032bf3_Obliv: Your next contract can be found at the dead drop on Hero Hill, southeast of here. A hollow in the moss-covered rock contains all you need to know.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_000182c6_Oblivion_: Your next opponent is a Khajiit. Not one of the quick, jumpy ones either. This cat goes in heavy, usually with an axe! Now go get 'em!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_00018290_Oblivion_: Your next opponent is the most savage, blood-crazed Orc I've ever seen, and believe me I've seen a lot of 'em! This will not be fun!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_ReadyForAMatch_000182b9_Oblivion_: Your next opponent wears a Heavy Raiment, but attacks with a short sword. She's like a heavily-armored wasp, and has the temper to match. Careful.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0009148d_Oblivion_RES: Your pardon, citizen. I must return to my post.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GOODBYE_00047373_Oblivion_RESP1: Your path is clear. Send Rufio to his death, and the Dark Brotherhood will embrace you as family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0003d7f5_Oblivion_RESP1: Your place is on the battlefield. I have trusted you this far. Do not fail me.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ13BattlePlans_0003d7f7_Oblivion: Your plan is madness. There must be another way for you to recover the Amulet without risking Bruma's destruction.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG07WhereSkrivva_00098394_Oblivio: Your poor memory is my good fortune. What's it worth to ya?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDPelinalVisionSpeech_00002ab0_Kn: Your prayers have woken me from my endless dream. Or perhaps you have entered my dream, and I still sleep.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEDyusTormentTopic_000807af_Obliv: Your predecessor cursed me with immortality and placed me in this remote location in order to "protect His Realm from my knowledge."
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_00095779_Obliv: Your predecessor did have one task He wanted performed, though He never found a mortal suited for the task.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Seen_001854ee_Oblivion_RESP1: Your presence here will not be tolerated!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002985_Knights_RESP1: Your quest for the Crusader's Relics was the equal of any of the old tales! Well met, Sir Knight!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00002956_Knights_RESP1: Your quest proceeds apace. You may yet prove a worthy successor to Pelinal Whitestrake.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0018d295_Oblivion_RESP1: Your reputation precedes you, Gate-Closer, Scourge of Oblivion, Hero of Kvatch!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ11BrumaAllies_000270fb_Oblivion: Your reputation precedes you, Hero of Kvatch! You have done my city a great service by closing the Oblivion Gate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_0007ec71_Oblivion_RESP1: Your return is most welcome, Your Grace.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS27UmbacanoD1_000a6583_Oblivion_: Your reward will be whatever plunder you wish to carry off from Nenalata.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ06MankarSpeech_0001f87a_Oblivio: Your reward, Brothers and Sisters! The time of Cleansing draws nigh. I go now to Paradise. I shall return with Lord Dagon at the coming of the Dawn!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_00188f40_Oblivion_RES: Your role within the guild becomes ever more essential. You have now attained the rank of Warlock, and are freely able to access the Council Chamber.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_HELLO_000206c7_Oblivion_RESP1: Your safe return speaks volumes of your success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_advancementFG_0003355f_Oblivion_R: Your service to the guild has not gone unnoticed. Henceforth, you will carry the rank of Defender. Bear the title proudly.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Advancement_00084b4a_Oblivion_RES: Your services to the guild have not gone unnoticed. As of this moment, you have gained the rank of Evoker.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE13JyggalagVoice_00095e30_Oblivi: Your staff does not make you a Daedra, foolish mortal.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice3B_00035626_Oblivion_RE: Your staff will give you power over ice. Is that what you want? If not, we can start over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MG08Choice3C_00035627_Oblivion_RE: Your staff will let you wield the power of lightning. If you want something else instead, we can start over.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032473_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Apprentice shall serve you at the forge of destiny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032474_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Atronach shall aid you with your appointed burden.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032478_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Lady shall fortify you in your quest for glory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032479_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Lord shall prove a faithful patron in your quest for glory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247b_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Lover shall sweeten your journey as you confront your fate.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032472_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Mage shall light your way on the paths of glory.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032475_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Ritual shall speed you on your star-patterned path.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247e_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Serpent shall sting the foes who seek your blood.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247c_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Shadow shall hide you from destiny's cunning hounds.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032477_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Steed shall speed your progress on the road to destiny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247a_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Thief shall guide your steps on the road to destiny.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_0003247d_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Tower shall prove a stout refuge in time of need.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_CGEmperor14_00032476_Oblivion_RES: Your stars are not mine. Today the Warrior shall prove a stalwart companion when fortune fades.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008151e_Oblivion_RESP1: Your stick is a lot nicer than mine, Sheogorath.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_FromTheDead_0001d036_Oblivion_RES: Your story is ridiculous. This sounds like some lie created by Jensine and her damned "society" to have me run out of town.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQ15KathutetA_0003c80c_Oblivion_R: Your swift retribution earned you much respect among my people. We had not expected that a mortal would act with such resolution and honor.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0000298c_Knights_RESP1: Your sword and your faith are true. You may claim the Cuirass with my leave.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TG05WhatIsPlan_0000c05d_Oblivion_: Your target is the Arcane University. We've had our eye on Hrormir's Staff for some time, but have been waiting for the wizards to be distracted.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_000206ba_Oblivion_RESP1: Your task is nearly complete. All that's left is to touch the Altar and let Arden-Sul devour the Duchess' heart.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0001a329_Oblivion_RESP1: Your task is only half done. The Font will not be fully cleansed while Order pollutes one of the pools that feed it.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE05HerdirInvestigateCurrentTask_: Your task now is to listen in on Ma'zaddha's conversation with Nelrene without being noticed.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DASheogorathSpeech_0009571e_Obliv: Your task would be to make the first two signs of the prophecy occur. Your predecessor already put plans in motion for the final step. Good luck.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_tasks_0005e1db_Oblivion_RESP1: Your tasks now come directly from Arch-Mage Traven. Please speak with him if you're unsure what you should be doing.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Recommendation_0005323f_Oblivion_: Your time has come. The Arcane University needs you, child. Raminus Polus waits for you even now.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MQVoice_00033df9_Oblivion_RESP1: Your timing is excellent! I'll take the one on the right!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0007fde4_Oblivion_RESP1: Your victory at Xeddefen was well won, but the war still carries on.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark08NelsNevConvo_000852c7_Obliv: Your words border on treason, Nord, and I will not tolerate them! You will respect the Empire! You will respect the memory of our dear Emperor!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SEPykeZoeMaleneResponses_00091b56: Your words warm my heart, my love. Being here is the best choice I've made in my life.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ea34_Oblivion_RESP1: Your work is done here, Your Grace. I'm sure Sheogorath will want news of your success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_0008ea35_Oblivion_RESP1: Your work is done here, Your Grace. I'm sure Sheogorath will want news of your success.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark01Choice2A_00022b9f_Oblivion_: Your work, your deathcraft, pleases the Night Mother. And so, I come to you with an offering. An opportunity... to join our rather unique family.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_SE02OrcSpectators_0007ead6_Oblivi: Yuck. Look at all the blood and gore. I'm getting out of here.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_INFOGENERAL_0007815a_Oblivion_RES: Zealots have dedicated themselves to the worship of Arden-Sul.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_NDTombSpeech_00002d09_Knights_RES: Zenithar grants you good fortune. May you always endeavor to become the master of your craft.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_GREETING_00040bc4_Oblivion_RESP1: Zoe Malene's the name. Sorry I don't have much time to have a formal introduction, but I must get my latest painting finished!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MS47NeedAntidote_0003003f_Oblivio: [Ancotar hands you a scroll.] Here. Stand in the center of town, to make sure you get everyone. Oh, and make sure... never mind. Should be fine.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Announcer_00046679_Oblivion_RESP1: [Gasp!] Can this be? The Blue Team combatant is not wearing an Arena Battle Raiment! The Blue Team is hereby disqualified!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_000626b8_Oblivion_RESP: [Gasp!] Guards, guards! This filthy cutpurse has purloined my valuables!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Corpse_00027528_Oblivion_RESP1: [Gasp!] Oh my goodness. Excuse me, are you all right? I... By the Divines, this person's dead!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_MageTalk3_0006a866_Oblivion_RESP1: [Gasp!] Surely you're joking! Are... Are you sure? I mean, I'm excited by this news of course, but think of the ramifications!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Pickpocket_00062277_Oblivion_RESP: [Gasp!] Why you dirty little thief! How dare you touch me!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_Dark02PirateDoor_00049881_Oblivio: [Knock knock knock!] Captain! Captain Tussaud! Are you all right sir? We... We heard a clamor. Captain? We're coming in!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_BladesTalk3_00068351_Oblivion_RES: [Sigh.] Look at me, acting the paranoid fool. I apologize, my lord. I meant no disrespect. My nerves are taut as a bowstring!
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_DarkSancTalk5_0003405a_Oblivion_R: [Sigh.] Well, I suppose I should get going. So many contracts, so little time.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_avmafrenagaia_00054021_Oblivion_R: mafre' seems to translate to frost. So a spell with frost damage should work for it. Anything else?
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00029914_Oblivion: my current disp is 30 or lower
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00029913_Oblivion: my current disp is 70 or higher
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00028f55_Oblivion: my current disp is between 30 and 70.
ST_ResponseTexts.LOC_RT_TestToddNeutral_00028f54_Oblivion: my current disp is big fat zero.

ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE181: A warm, gentle breeze causes a tickle on your face, but as you go to brush it off, you find you cannot move your arms. Looking at your skin, you realize that it has turned to a brittle, green glass. Standing perfectly still, you breathe in shallow gulps of air, knowing that moving would cause your skin to shatter into thousands of pieces. The tickle on your face worsens, and you know that you are about to sneeze. As your skin shatters, you wake up sweating.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_MQ09SancreTorDoorScript_LINE19: A weather-worn iron plaque is affixed to the door above an imposing lock. The inscription is barely legible: 'Sealed by authority of the Grandmaster of the Blades, 36th Year of the Reign of Tiber Septim.'

ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SE03TeleporterGateSCRIPT_LINE21: Gates don't unlock until adventurers have left the chamber.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_ShrineKynareth_LINE21: Go carefully upon Nature's path. Pray at my chapel altars to receive my blessings.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_DAAzuraStatueScript_LINE56: Go! Follow my Star, do great deeds, and seek out your fate!
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_DAHircineStatueScript_LINE40: Go, my champion. May you be the last head on the Huntsman's wall.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SESummonHaskillSpellSCRIPT_LINE42: Haskill has been summoned too recently.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneUshnargraShadborgobSCR: He asked to be buried with his beloved dog. Oh, well.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneEarilSCRIPT_LINE4: He taught us to make the seconds count before we close our eyes.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneHeleneScript_LINE4: Helene the Deaf. She never heard it coming.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_HenantierScript_LINE17: Henantier mutters what sounds like an incantation of some kind, then subsides into sleep.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_HenantierScript_LINE15: Henantier sinks into an even deeper sleep.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_HenantierScript_LINE13: Henantier stirs and moans in his sleep, but does not wake.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_DarkAndreasGraveScript_LINE5: Here lies Andreas Draconis, dutiful son and master brewman. May he forever serve Azura in the afterlife.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneBlaiseSetteScript_LINE: Here lies Blaise Sette. Faster than the wind, dumber than a stump.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_DarkCaeliaGraveScript_LINE5: Here lies Caelia Draconis, dedicated daughter and noble member of the Leyawiin City Watch. Killed in action.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SE32TombEpitaph01SCRIPT_LINE17: Here lies Count Cesrien Vitharn, Noble conqueror and just leader of our people.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SE32TombEpitaph01SCRIPT_LINE15: Here lies Count Csaran Vitharn, to whom the Love of family meant so much.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SE32TombEpitaph01SCRIPT_LINE19: Here lies Countess Jideen, Lady of color from whom we all had so much to learn.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SE32TombEpitaph01SCRIPT_LINE13: Here lies Countess Sheen-In-Glade, Matron Scholar of Vitharn, and Ambassador of Black Marsh.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_DarkMatthiasGraveScript_LINE5: Here lies Matthias Draconis. His mother always told him he'd end up dead if he didn't clean up his life...
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_DarkPerenniaGraveScript_LINE6: Here lies Perennia Draconis, kind and gentle matron of the Draconis family. May her spirit forever curse the murderer who stole her precious life.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_STTombOfRemanIISCRIPT_LINE5: Here lies Reman II of Cyrodiil, crowned Emperor of Tamriel in the year 2812. He fell in battle against the Dark Elves, in the fifty-seventh year of his age, after a reign of thirty-nine years and eight months wanting a day.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_STTombOfRemanIIISCRIPT_LINE5: Here lies Reman III, last Emperor of the Cyrodiils, the scourge of the Dark Elves, who was cruelly slain by treachery, in the year 2920. He reigned forty-three years.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_STTombOfRemanISCRIPT_LINE5: Here lies Reman of Cyrodiil. He defeated the Akaviri Horde and brought peace to Tamriel. 2762.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_TombTimTest01_LINE6: Here lies Rindsey, acclaimed archer and celebrated aficionado of Tamrielic ales. We honor him for his bravery and for his famous Daedric Lava Whiskey, discovered during his perilous expedition to Dagon's Realm.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_DarkSibyllaGraveScript_LINE5: Here lies Sibylla Draconis. She died as she lived -- like a beast.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_GraveScript03_LINE3: Here lies Tyree, native of Chorrol / E Star 25 428 / 27 yrs
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_TombANScript_LINE13: Here lies the mysterious Lennasaan, renown master of writing and storyteller supreme.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SE32TombEpitaph01SCRIPT_LINE9: Herein Interred Lies Count Vitraen, Primogenitor of the Keep and Nobility of Vitharn.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SE32TombEpitaph01SCRIPT_LINE11: Herein Interred Lies Countess Mawean, Mother of Vitharn.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_DAHircineStatueScript_LINE44: Hircine demands a more powerful champion to begin this quest.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneHirrusClutumnusSCRIPT_: Hirrus Clutumnus never felt like he fit in anywhere. He fits in a coffin quite nicely, now.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_ShrineZenithar_LINE21: Honest labor earns its own reward. Pray at my chapel altars to receive my blessings.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_ShrineAkatosh_LINE20: Honor the Nine and do your duty. Pray at my chapel altars to receive my blessings.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_ShrineArkay_LINE21: Honor your body and spirit. Pray at my chapel altars to receive my blessings.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_MS08HuntersRunInnerDoorScript_LIN: Hunter's Run keys used to open door.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SE32Fanatic4Script_LINE118: I killed the last Fanatic raider, but not until after he opened the gate. I'll have to try again.

ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneBolwingScript_LINE4: I think his name was Bolwing.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_MG05RockScript_LINE108: I was struck by lightning, and have been granted a powerful new spell.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_MS09Chest_LINE9: I'll need to deal with Tyrellius before I can open the chest.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_MS43Script_LINE40: I'm no longer feeling the urge to possess the Staff of the Everscamp.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_LairVileShrineBlessingSCRIPT_LINE: Ichor of Sithis is required to activate the altar.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE172: In a dream from your childhood you remember playing hiding games with your young friends on a warm summer afternoon. You hide in your parents' barn, sure you will not be found. Soon, the sweet smell of hay is replaced by a darker, sickly smell. You move deeper into the barn, only to stumble on the rotting corpses of your parents, their throats ripped out. You try to scream as your parents rise and pull you into an embrace.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneDumaggraBonkSCRIPT_LIN: In honor of Dumag gro-Bonk. He made killing things fun again.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneAhjazdaScript_LINE4: In memory of Ahjazda. The world wasn't coming to an end -- only her.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneBhishaScript_LINE5: In memory of Bhisha. Killed because he loved dogs.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneBigHeadScript_LINE4: In memory of Big Head. Completely Forked.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_SETombstoneCutterScript_LINE4: In memory of Cutter. She enjoyed every cut to the last. And she enjoyed that one the most. It cut her spirit free.

ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE169: In your dream, an old wise-woman treats you for burns on your hands. As she applies a salve to your skin, you feel the tingle of magic as the pain begins to subside. But as you watch, the flesh of your hands begins to bubble, crack, and split, falling in chunks to the floor of her hut. As the wise-woman smiles, you wake up.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE187: In your dream, you approach a vampire ancient. Having just completed a perilous task for him, you swell with pride, sure that he will now bestow even greater power upon you. The entire clan's eyes are upon you. Walking towards the dais where he stands, you realize that your task for him is actually unfinished, and that all of your vampiric powers have left you. You cry out as the clan descends upon you, and the ancient's fangs rip into the flesh of your throat.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE184: In your dream, you open your eyes to a beautiful blue sky. The sun is bright, but you feel cool, even a bit damp. You draw a breath but begin to cough, as you expel blood and dirt that you've inhaled into your lungs. As you try to draw another, you see a shovel of dirt being emptied onto your face. The sunlight grows fainter as you view it through the soil that covers your body. You would scream, but your mouth fills with dirt before you can make a sound.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE166: In your dream, you see a beautiful young woman holding an infant to her breast. It is only as you draw near that you realize that the woman is a desiccated corpse and the child is purple and bloated, dying of plague. As mother and child crumble to dust, you awaken.

ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE175: You dream of a sumptuous banquet spread out before you. You feast on a particularly choice cut of roasted meat, and its aroma makes your mouth water. It is only as you cut into the last portion that you see the larvae squirming inside. You cough blood as the larvae begin eating their way out of your stomach.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE163: You dream of long days spent basking in the sunlight of your native lands. You feel the warmth and the heat, and feel your body become refreshed. Then you awaken, knowing it was but a dream.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE58: You dream of someone sleeping peacefully in his bed, when a shadowy, gaunt figure silently enters the room. Approaching the bed, the figure leans down and sinks its fangs into the sleeping person. After a few moments, the pale figure rises, blood dripping down her chin. As color flows back into the vampire's face, and her features fill out, you recognize the face as your own. You awake screaming.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE56: You dream of someone sleeping peacefully in his bed, when a shadowy, gaunt figure silently enters the room. Approaching the bed, the figure leans down and sinks its fangs into the sleeping person. After a few moments, the pale figure rises, blood dripping down his chin. As color flows back into the vampire's face, and his features fill out, you recognize the face as your own. You awake screaming.
ST_ScriptContent.LOC_SC_VampireScript_LINE190: You dream of walking through the cool night air. Your body cries for blood, having not fed for days. Weakly, you stumble to a small pool. As you bend down to it, you see that it is not water in the pool, but warm, fresh blood, steam rising off of it. You lower your head to drink, but cannot open your mouth. As you realize in horror that your lips have been sewn shut,  a pair of cold, white hands reach out from the pool and draw you under.
